tei:titleStmt.tei:title: bka' brgyad mgon po/zhing skyong ru dar dmag bzlog dang*/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha sha
bka' brgyad mgon po/zhing skyong ru dar dmag bzlog dang*/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha sha

tei:div.tei:p: bka' brgyad mgon po/ zhing skyong ru dar dmag bzlog dang*/ oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /mchims phu'i gter byon mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrub dang*/ kha skong mkha' 'gro'i skor bcas stod cha'o/ /phyi ma rtsa ba'i chos sde chos skyong skor/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ padma sbas tshal gter byon ye shes kyi/ /mgon po'i sgrub skor dang ni de bzhin du/ /gze rgyal gter byon zhing skyong dmag 'gyed rgyud/ ru dar nag po'i skor bcas them byang 'god/ /de la'ang dang po mkha' 'gro'i sgrub skor pod snga ma'i 'phros las/ ka) ye shes mkha' 'gro khro gnyer gtum mo rtsa ba gsum dril gyi cha lag /gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub gnam lcags ur mo'i phrin las bklag chog tu bkod pa gnas gsum ḍākki'i bka' rgya ma/ kha) sku gsum dgongs 'dus gdugs dkar mo'i gsol 'debs bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal/ ga) sku gsum dgongs 'dus chos sde'i kha skong gtsug tor dkar mo'i sgrub thabs gshed ma 'bum thub/ nga) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ rtsa gsum spyi'i smad las dang 'brel ba'i gtsug tor dkar mo'i zlog bsgyur bklag chog tu spel ba byad gdon g.yul 'joms/ ca) rje btsun 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'chi med gter bum/ cha) sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo las/ tshe sgrub gsol 'debs/ ja) yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe yi sgrub pa/ nya) sgrol dkar tshe 'gugs/ ta) sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshogs mchod/ tha) dag snang sgrol chog tshogs gnyis myur lam gsal byed kyis brgyan pa/ da) sgrol ma'i tshogs bsdus/ na) sgrol ma'i zhi ba'i me mchod/ pa) mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs kyi gsol 'debs padma'i do shal/ pha) zab yangs nam mkha'i chos sde las: mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs padma'i phreng ba/
ba) dregs 'dul gnam lcags 'khor lo las: gtum po nā ga raksha'i gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar bcas chos tshan bco lnga bzhugs so/ ༈

rtsa ba'i chos sde las/ bye brag chos skyong gi skor ni/ dang po ye shes mgon pa la/ ka) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: legs ldan mgon po'i dbang bskur bsdus pa/ kha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i dgra chos byad ma snying 'byin nag po/ ga) bka' brgyad chen po gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i las byang rngam pa 'od klong yangs pa/ nga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i bzlog pa'i mdun bskyed/ ca) bka' brgyad chen po gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i bskang bsdus nor bu'i phreng ba/ cha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gsol mchod bsdus pa/ ja) bka' brgyad chen po gsang ba zil gnon las: myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i gsol bsdus/ nya) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po bya rog gdong gi gsol mchod/ ta) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i gsol kha/ tha) bka' rgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: ma hā kā la'i ka bstod ye shes rol pa/ da) khrag 'thung legs ldan mgon po'i srung bzlog khrigs su bsdebs pa/ na) bya rog gdong gi bstod pa/ pa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i bskyed chog dregs pa rab 'bar nag po/ pha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i dmag bskul gri gug rngam chen/ ba) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i bsgral las byad ma snying 'byin/ ma) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las mgon po'i rtsang bskul khrag zhag 'bar ba/ tsa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i bzlog pa yang gsang dgu sgril/ tsha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i gser skyems mchog gnyis bde chen/ dza) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las:

mgon po'i zor mda' ma rungs snying 'byin/ wa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i dgongs gsol chos sku rngam klong bcas chos tshan nyi shu bzhugs so/ ༈ gnyis pa las mgon zhing skyong dmag bzlog ru dar nag po'i skor la/ ka) dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rgyud rngam klong 'od 'byin/ dpal mgon zhing skyong legs ldan rngam klong las: kha) dbang bskur dregs pa'i srog thig dmar po/ ga) dpal mgon zhing skyong legs ldan rngam klong las: sgrub pa'i phrin las khrag 'thung rab 'bar nag po/ nga) thun gtor/ ca) ma hā kā la khrag 'thung rngam klong las: tshogs mchod rgyal ba spyi mnyes/ cha) dpal mgon zhing skyong dmag 'gyed nag po'i rgyud phreng las: las byang spu gri dmar po byad ma reg gcod/ ja) dpal mgon seng gdong nag po'i gtor 'bul byad ma snying 'byin gdug pa'i g.yul 'joms/ nya) dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i gtor zlog zur 'gebs/ ta) dpal mgon zhing skyong ru mtshon nag po'i rgyud las: rtsang bzlog spu gri reg chod/ tha) dpal mgon zhing skyong ru mtshon nag po las: zor bzlog byad ma 'bum thub/ da) dpal mgon zhing skyong dmag 'gyed ru dar nag po'i rgyud: zor bzlog rlung gi spu gri dmar po/ na) bsad khang bcu gnyis rgyug byang*/ pa) dpal ldan zhing skyong rngam klong las: gser skyems gling bzhi sgo 'byed/ pha) tshe 'gugs/ ba) dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po ma hā kā la yi: rten gzugs rgyun gsol khams gsum zil gnon/ ma) dpal mgon zhing skyong gi bca' 'don phyag len zin bris bcas chos tshan bcu drug bzhugs so/ slar smras pa/ rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje btsun mo che/ /rtags kyi phyag rgya'i skur snang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /zag med mchog gi dngos grub la spro ba'i/ /skal ldan snying nor khyod las gzhan du min/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa ring du byed pa dang*/ /bstan pa'i snying po bshad dang sgrub pa'i sde/

/spel la rtag tu brtson pa'i dam tshig can/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi srung ma khyod bsten 'os/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e wam̐ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga yi grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ka) ༈ ye shes mkha' 'gro khro gnyer gtum mo rtsa ba gsum dril gyi cha lag /gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub gnam lcags ur mo'i phrin las bklag chog tu bkod pa gnas gsum ḍākki'i bka' rgya m-i atsha/ bdud 'dul ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku la 'dud/ de la 'dir mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i phrin las bklag chog tu bkod par/ stegs kyi khar mchod gtor gru gsum dmar po gtso 'khor dgu pa dar gdugs dang dkar dmar gyis rgyan can/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka /mdun du nyer spyod lnga sogs bshams la/ skyabs sems ni/ na mo: dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyal yum 'gro ba'i mgon: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: bdag gi dge des ma gyur 'gro kun tshogs: 'ja' lus go 'phang thob par sems bskyed do: dkar gtor sngon du song nas/ bgegs gtor ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong : dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang 'byung po'i tshogs: mchod sbyin 'di longs gzhan du phyir dengs shig: 'khu zhing 'da' na brlag par gdon mi za:

ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha gnod byed bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: thugs las sprul pa'i phyag mtshan 'bar ba'i mes: steng 'og bar mtshams med pa dum gcig dang : rab tu 'khrigs pa'i gur khang cher gyur nas: nam yang glags lta 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra dzwa la karma tsakra hūm̐ rakṣa ye swā hā: gtor mchod byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phyi snod gling bzhi nyi zla bhandha'i snod: nang bcud dbang po rnam lnga sman raka dang : gtor mchod bha ling ga ṇa tshogs kyi rdzas: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs la sogs pa: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba a haṃ pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐: om̐ ru tra mā ra ni ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ mdun gyi zor gtor dang bdag nyid 'jug pa gcig gis bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ bhrūm̐: thod pa dmar smug brtsegs pa'i pho brang dbus: chos 'byung dmar nag gdengs ka gyen du phyogs: de nang pad nyi ro yi gdan steng du: bdag nyid mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong pa can: sku mdog mthing nag seng zhal khros pa'i gdong : g.yu ral gseb nas seng chung sprin ltar gtibs: rab brjid thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan: phyag g.yas gnam lcags gri gug mkha' la phyar: phyag g.yon bhandhar rakta bcud bzang gtams: gru mor kha ṭwāṃ brten pas dug gsum 'joms: ḍākki rgya rtags rus rgyan me long spras: thod rlon mgo phreng ga sha dar dpyangs 'phur: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang baṃ ro'i gdan la 'gying : gtso mo'i phyogs bzhir drag po gdong can bzhi: stag dang phag zhal dom gdong lce spyang mgo: rigs bzhi gtso mthun phyogs mdog rang rtags spras:

gzhan yang sgo skyong srung ma nyid sprul bcas: snang la rang bzhin bral ba gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros ma sring mkha' 'gro spyan drangs nas: bdag la dbang bskur byin rlabs mchog thun stsol: hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod rang byung gdod ma'i klong : chos dbyings drag po e yi dur khrod nas: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: bla med dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra ḍākki nī baṃ siṃ ha mu kha ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes pas spyan drangs dbyer med bsgom/ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum: chos dbyings ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: rigs lnga bde chen lhun grub rang bzhin 'bar: dbyings las ma g.yos rnal 'byor ḍākki tshogs: gus pas phyag bgyis brtan par bzhugs su gsol: om̐ na mo a ti pu hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can gtso 'khor la: phyi mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum bha ling 'bul: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ga ṇa tshogs mchod 'bul: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo sgra ldan 'bul: om̐ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa bam ri 'bar ba ni/ bhyo bhyoḥ baṃ ri thod mkhar 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: ma cig 'dod khams dbang phyug seṅge'i gdong : g.yu ral sprugs pas stobs bcu'i phrin las rdzogs: khro mo'i gdong ni za byed 'jigs la rngam: dmar la 'khyil ba'i spyan rtsa sdang mig bgrad: rno ba'i 'od ldan 'bar bas phyag mtshan gdengs: mdangs ldan 'od ris dmar chen bhandhar gtams: mkhar phur las mtshon rtse gsum gyen du gzengs: ma rgyud 'bum gyi gtso mos rus rgyan gsol: me long 'od ldan lhag lhag ma sring sdud:

nu ma bha ga rgyas pa'i bde drod 'phel: 'khor ba stongs phyir mgo phreng tshal du dngar: brkyang bskum 'gying ba'i dga' bzhi'i gar dang ldan: 'bar zhing sreg pa'i me dpung sku la 'khril: ye shes mkha' la rol pa seṅge'i dpal: dur khrod rgyan drug spras la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ sku yi sprul pa bde chen mkha' 'gro ma: nad gdon zhi mdzad dkar mo seng gdong ma: dza landha ra'i gnas kyi dbang mo che: badzra ḍākki'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ gsung gi sprul pa brda sgrogs mkha' 'gro ma: tshe bsod dbang sdud dmar mo stag gdong ma: lam pā ka yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: padma ḍākki'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ thugs kyi sprul pa ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: gnas lugs mngon gyur phag gdong mthing nag ma: a tsi te yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: buddha ḍākki'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ yon tan sprul pa dga' bzhi mkha' 'gro ma: 'byor drug rgyas mdzad ser mo dom gdong ma: tri sha ku na'i gnas kyi dbang mo che: ratna ḍākki'i yon tan phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ phrin las sprul pa rab g.yo mkha' 'gro ma: dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad sngon mo spyang gdong ma: tshandho ha yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: karma ḍākki'i phrin las phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ sgo skyong sgrol byed dus kyi pho nya mo: lo zla zhag dus phra men drug cu bzhi: bdud mo srin mo 'chi tshe srog bdag ma: ye shes las grub 'khor dang bcas la bstod: bhyo: bskul lo bzhengs shig ma sring ḍākki tshogs: thugs rje'i sku mchog mngon sum mtshon pa dang : rig sngags sgrub pa'i nus rtsal shugs phyungs la: bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dngos grub stsol: bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng mthing la gting mdangs dmar ba'i ngad chags pa sgra gdangs di ri ri sgrog pa g.yon du 'khor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa cher 'phros pas/

nang gi gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad bskul ba/ de thams cad las kyang 'od zer chem chem 'bar zhing mched pas las nyon sdig sgrib pha rol gyi byad grib sogs nyes ltung thams cad dag ste/ sku mdog mthing 'od bkrag mdangs gzi brjid cher 'bar bas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor longs spyod/ 'byung lnga'i bcud thams cad shugs kyis bsdus te 'khor 'das kun na 'gran zla dang bral khyab bdag dpa' mo chen mor nga rgyal bskyed la/ om̐ baṃ ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes rtsa sngags dang*/ om̐ badzra ratna padma karma buddha ya ha ri ni sa ḍākki sa ma ya hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes las sngags bzlas pa'i tshe khyad par gdong can lnga la sogs pa'i spro bsdus las bzhi mchog dang bcas pa sgrub pa'i ting 'dzin gang 'dod du bsgyur shes par bya'o/ yang bzlog ni/ spyi bor aḥkaḥ mgrin par saḥmaḥ snying khar raḥtsaḥ lte bar shaḥdaḥ gsang bar raḥsaḥ brla g.yas su maḥraḥ brla g.yon du ya phaṭḥ ces bkod pa ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro phra men shugs 'gro thams cad kyi srog snying drag tu bskul ba'i shugs kyis/ sngags 'bru rnams las 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa drag tu khol zhing phyur ba las/ srid gsum thams cad drag sngags thog rgod kyi char phab pas pha rol byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa bsregs bcom rjes shul med par brlag /slar yang thugs rje'i shugs las bskal ba'i 'thor rlung g.yos pas 'dzin snang bag chags dang bcas pa dbyings su gtor te sbyang*/ snang srid thams cad du khro mo'i sprin rab tu 'khrigs pa'i rta bros gzir bas/ dgra bgegs byad gdon log 'dren thams cad nam yang ldang med thugs rje'i dbyings su rgyas btab par mos la/ phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ kham̐ e ka tsa na e sa bhyo zlog: ram̐ dza tri mun tri rmug thum bhyo zlog:

yam̐ sha ma sha na du shan bhyo zlog: ces bzlas mthar thun rdzas la yang bsngags/ hūm̐: rang nyid khyab bdag bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku: g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis gnam sa nyi zla'i dal: tsha grang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i e dbyings su: dgra bgegs byad ma'i yul mkhar mngon du gsal: rig sngags dmod pas gnam sa brdab pa'i tshe: dgra gdon phye mar rlog cig mā ra ya: las ngan bag chags gtor cig hūm̐ yaṃ phaṭḥ lhag med dbyings su bstab bo satwaṃ bha ya: 'khor 'das mnyam par sbyor cig a a āḥ zhes thal rdeb bya/ de'ang sgrub pa'i skabs su rtsa sngags dang*/ las phran skabs drag sngags bcu gnyis/ zor las sogs kyi tshe yang bzlog ste skabs dang bstun nas bzla'o/ tsha nag la dmigs te/ tri dzaḥ snang srid 'jig rten phung rdzas dregs pa'i dpal: phung 'dre byad gdon rbod gtong 'dus pa'i srog: ngan sngags dmod pa nag po'i ri bo la: dmod cing gzir mnan nus rtsal rdzogs par gsal: sha da ra sa ma ra ya bha bi na a ri sha bar wi thun thun dza dzaḥ zhes phung rdzas byad kyi ri bo nad mtshon dug rlangs gtibs pa'i klong las dregs pa'i srog yig 'byung lnga pa so so'i kha dog gi zer zhags snang srid kyi khyon gang bar 'phros pas/ bdag gzhan phyi nang 'byung lnga'i byad rgyar chud pa'i drwa ba thams cad gru gu 'thor ba ltar bsdus te tsha nag dang tshon skud kyi drwa bar thim par mos la/ sngags stong phrag gcig tsam du bzla/ tsha dkar la dmigs nas/

thabs mchog srid pa'i hom chung bsil ba'i 'od: shes rab bhyo yig zung 'jug 'khrul 'khor gyis: ye shes lha mo seṅge'i gdong can dkar: gcer bu rgyan med gzi 'od bkrag mdangs 'bar: phyag gnyis bdud rtsi'i bum bzang chu rgyun 'bebs: 'khor 'das dmod pa'i rig sngags byad zor sogs: nyes tshogs drungs nas 'byin pa'i mthu ldan gyur: a ka sa ma ra tsa phaṭḥ e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shuddhe shuddhe swā hā: zhes ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma dkar mo'i sgrub pa thugs rje'i 'od zer dkar la reg na bde ba'i bdud rtsi rang bzhin can steng 'og khor yug mu med du 'phros pas snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum byad grib kyis 'thum pa'i nyes tshogs thams cad sbyangs nas lus shel sgong g.ya' bral ba lta bur dga' bde'i tshogs yongs su rdzogs te snang stong lha sku'i rol pa chen por mos la sngags stong phrag las mi nyung ba bzla/ thun mtshams su/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ drag mo seṅge'i gdong can gtso 'khor la: phyi mchod sogs nas khā hi 'i bar gyis mchod la/ sngags bstod ni/ bhyoḥ rgyal kun rdo rje rnal 'byor rigs: drag mo khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs: nam mkha'i mdog can me 'od 'phros: seṅge'i gdong can lha mor bstod: ༈ tshogs mchod ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros nyes skyon bsregs gtor bkrus: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis 'dod yon dpag med pa: 'khor 'das yongs la mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang : bka' gter skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor bcas la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes par bzhes la thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong gyur pa nyid thob ste: nyams chag bshags shing mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi:

skong bshags ni/ bhyoḥ khyad par mnyes shing mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: dur khrod pho brang rgyan spyod bkod pa 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: thod pa ltag sprod zhing lpags g.yogs pa 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: mchog chen gri rkang gling bu'i dbyangs ring 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: bhandha lcang lo rakta rnam lnga'i tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: sha chen tshil chen dri gsur ngad ldan 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: dmar chen dpal chen dar nag ba dan can: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: dgra bgegs sha khrag ri ltar spungs pa'i tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: zhing lpags rgyal mtshan dar nag g.yab mo phyar: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: phyag mtshan rnon po mtshon cha 'khor lo'i rtsibs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: ging pa gar pa dpa' mo'i gar bsgyur tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: gnas nyul dus mtshan ma mo gcer bu 'bum: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: gzhan yang mthun pa'i dam rdzas dgyes pa'i phud: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: 'bod pa'i gdangs chen 'brug ltar ldir ba bcas: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: bhyoḥ mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas sna tshogs kyis: rdo rje mkha' 'gro seng gdong thugs dam bskang : padma mkha' 'gro stag gdong thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phag gdong thugs dam bskang : rin chen mkha' 'gro dom gdong thugs dam bskang : phrin las mkha' 'gro spyang gdong thugs dam bskang : las byed lcags gdong nag po'i thugs dam bskang : las bdag mtshan mo sgra sgrogs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa ma mo mched gsum thugs dam bskang : yang sprul srin mo stong sde'i thugs dam bskang :

thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam dngos grub stsol: ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i spyan lam du: mchod pa lor zlar 'das pa mthol lo bshags: tshogs dang bskang mchod chag pa mthol lo bshags: sbyor sgrol gnad du ma khel mthol lo bshags: dus sgrub dus su 'das pa mthol lo bshags: dus min las la sbyor ba mthol lo bshags: bcu nya stong bzhi chag pa mthol lo bshags: rten 'brel sna tshogs chags pa mthol lo bshags: thabs shes kha 'byed spyod pa mthol lo bshags: bde stong zung du ma 'jug mthol lo bshags: dam tshig spang blang bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: rdo rje'i sngags dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: 'gyod tshangs dge bas mnyam nyid la gnas la shog: ces yig brgya bzla/ lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: gnas yul dus bdag phra men ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: 'bar ma pho nya'i tshogs rnams la: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'bul: bstan srung mel tshe sgrubs par mdzod: om̐ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta kha kha khā hi: dbang blang ba ni/ hūm̐: zab dbyings ye shes 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: bdud 'dul ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs: thugs dam rgyud bskul mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dbang bzhi ye shes thob par mdzad du gsol: om̐ badzra siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī kā ya siddhi om̐: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: gu na siddhi hrīḥ gu hya sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bzod gsol nyer bsdu ni/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor cho ga'i yan lag ma tshang dang : ma 'byor dam nyams 'di phyi'i sgrib g.yogs rnams: ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bshags: dkyil 'khor ngo bo 'dzin med stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ yig gyen ldog mi dmigs chos skur āḥ gsal stong gdod ma'i dbyings phyug mngon gyur shog: a a āḥ bsngo smon ni/ hoḥ ji snyed phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun thugs rje'i bdag: brtse bas dgongs phyir smin mdzad smon lam tshogs: grub ste ci lta'i bdag gi dge tshogs kun:

mtha' yas ma gyur byang chub 'thob phyir bsngo: bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsang ba'i yum: ye shes mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i 'od: rā ga'i mdangs ldan g.yo ba mo: seng gdong ḍākki'i bkra shis shog: de ltar byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub ur mo'i gzhung ci bzhin las/ sngon rjes sogs rigs mthun gzhan nas mi 'gal bar brgyan te bkod pa 'di yang mnga' bdag nyang chen gyi gdung*/ sprul sku nam mkha' 'gro 'dul gyi dbon rigs su gyur pa/ rig sngags 'chang ba dbang chen mthu stobs 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis bskul ba ltar/ zab rgya mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod cha shas tsam 'dzin pa dus mtha'i sngags 'chang skyid grong smyon pas kong yul sa yi thig le/ kṛ ta drag sngags rol pa'i yang dben sku gsum rdo rje'i gzhal med khang chen du sbyar ba 'dis bdud rigs log par 'dren pa dmigs med du gzhom zhing*/ gsang chen gyi theg pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /slar rtswa nang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mchog dam par grub cing 'dzin pa ban chung ngag dbang dbyangs can gyis bris/ rig 'dzin dam pa de'i phyag bris dngos nas khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gi gnas brda bshus pa maṅga laṃ// // kha) ༈ sku gsum dgongs 'dus gdugs dkar mo'i gsol 'debs bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī/ bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms thub pa'i dbang po yi/ /gtsug tor las 'khrungs bcom ldan gdugs dkar mo/ /rnam 'dren stong dang rgyal sras mchog rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal stsol/ /rgyud sde'i bka' bab dga' rab mañdzu shrī/ /pad 'byung bī ma khrag 'thung nag po sogs/ /mdo sngags bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal stsol/ /brgyud srol kun 'dus karma a rā ga /nye brgyud bka' bab bdud 'dul pad rgyal gling*/

/rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal stsol/ khyad par rig sngags lha mo nyer gcig dang*/ /phyir bzlog phra men dbang phyug 'bar ma dang*/ /ma ning la sogs bka' 'khor dam can la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal stsol/ /rdo rje'i gur gyis bdag 'khor yon bdag srungs/ /gnam lcags dbal gyis byad gdon phye mar 'thags/ /rig sngags mtshon chas phas rgol g.yul ngo zlog /bdud bzhi tshar gcod nus pa'i mthu thob shog /gnas skabs byang chub bsgrub pa'i bar chad sol/ /mthar thug 'gro kun bder gshegs gdugs dkar mo'i/ /go 'phang mchog la dkri ba'i dpal dam pa/ /bdud 'dul he ru ka par bdag 'gyur shog / ces pa'ang nyer mkho'i ched du 'phen sprul pas bskul ngor sprul ming gu hyas smras rim bzhin bskul ba pos bris pa 'dis kyang 'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ga) sku gsum dgongs 'dus chos sde'i kha skong gtsug tor dkar mo'i sgrub thabs gshed ma 'bum thub bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru shākya mu na ye/ tshe dpag med kyi yum chen gos dkar mo/ /drag tu khros pa gtsug tor dkar mor 'dud/ /bya rgyud bla med ltar du nyams len thabs/ /dga' rab 'jam dpal bshes gnyen bī ma lar/ /brgyud pa rnying ma'i lugs te bka' ma dang*/ /gu ru khrag 'thung nag po'i gter ma sogs/ /gter gzhung tshad ldan rnams kyi dgongs pa'i bcud/ /mkhas grub chags med zhabs kyi gdams srol 'dir/ /cung zhig rgyas spros sbyor rjes tshang bar bkod/ /stegs bu dkar po'i dbus su 'bru dkar gyi/ /tshom bu nyer gcig bya rgyud bum pa dang*/ /zlum gtor gdugs dkar can la nyer spyod bskor/ /dang po sbyor ba'i rim par skyabs sems dang*/ /tshogs bsags bka' bsgo mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab/ /dang po skyabs sems dang ni tshogs bsags ni/

rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis bskul ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor dkar mo la phyogs bcu'i skyabs yul rgya mtshos bskor ba badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor sad par mos la/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum la snying nas skyabs su mchi: sems can don du byang chub sgrub pa la: bar du gcod pa'i bdud dpung 'dul ba'i phyir: bcom ldan gtsug tor dkar mo bsgom par bgyi: lan gsum/ tshogs bsags ni/ hoḥ bcom ldan gtsug tor rgyal ba sras bcas la: phyag mtshal mchod 'bul sdig ltung snying nas bshags: yi rang bskul zhing bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: dge tshogs 'phags ma'i go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal bral/ /bde las nyams med btang snyoms la gnas shog dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa tshogs zhing rnams rang gi snying khar thim par gyur/ rang nyid rdo rje gtsug tor drag mo'i skur gyur/ dkar gtor spyi ltar song nas/ bgegs gtor/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin brlab/ sarba bhū ta ā karṣa ya dzaḥ sa mgron dgug /sarba bhighnan ba liṃ ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos la/ hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje gtsug tor drag mo rgyal/ /nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: sbyin pa'i zas zo bden pa'i bka' la nyon: so so rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: gal te mi 'gro bar chad byed pa na: lus ngag yid gsum rdo rjes gzhom par 'gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: gtsug tor drag mo'i gsang gsum ye shes mdangs: phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud sems can lha: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor la: gnyis 'dzin bgegs kyi bar chad ga la srid: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra kro ta dzñā na rakṣa āḥ mchod rdzas byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bdag gi thugs ka'i ye shes me rlung chus:

snod bcud dngos 'dzin dri ma dbyings su sbyangs: gnas yul rnam dag padma drwa ba'i zhing : phyi nang mchod sprin ye shes rol par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra puṣpe sogs nas shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hā: oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ gnyis pa dngos gzhir lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs/ phyag 'tshal mchod bstod drug gi dang po ni/ /bdag mdun bum gsum mngon rtogs gcig gis gsal/ dang po lha bskyed ni/ āḥ chos rnams smra bsam brjod med stong pa nyid/ /oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i gdugs dkar yongs gyur las/ /dran rdzogs dam ye dbyer med gnyug ma'i lha/ /rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog chen mo'i sku/ /dbu stong mdun zhal sgeg pa nyis brgya dkar/ /g.yas zhal nyis brgya 'jigs rung dgod pa ser/ /rgyab zhal nyis brgya dmar po gshe dang rngam/ /g.yon zhal ljang khu nyis brgya snying rje zhi/ /steng zhal sngon po nyis brgya drag la gtum/ /dbu rer rdo rje'i mtshan rtags spyan gsum gsum/ /sku mdog dkar zhing spyan mig bye ba 'bum/ /zur mig bgrad dang glog ltar drag tu gzigs/ /g.yas phyag lnga brgya g.yon phyag lnga brgya yis/ /thams cad bsad gcod ral gri 'bar ba phyar/ /zhabs g.yas lnga brgya brkyangs pas 'jigs kun mnan/ /zhabs g.yon lnga brgya bskums pas gdon kun gnan/ /sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun cod pan 'chang*/ /dbu gtsug gdugs dkar bdun ni brtsegs mar 'khor/ /ba spu thams cad ye shes 'od zer 'bar/ /lha rdzas na bza' zhi khro'i rgyan dang ldan/ /dpral bar rnam snang thugs kar oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par snang mtha'i thugs kar āḥdamar po/ /thugs smad rdor sems thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ /thugs dbus zla steng oṃ yig dkar po'i mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od kyis sgrib bsal mthu stobs rgyas/ /ya so khro bcu ma so khro mo bcu/ /sma ra me dpung ral gri ngar ma'i lce/ /mgrin par nyi zla rang lus me dpung 'bar/

/gnod byed thams cad gzhob thul bsregs par bsam/ /mngon rtogs 'di nyid sgom pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /gzhan gyi mnan gtad ngag mnan la sogs grol/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ: chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i zhing khams nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi yum chen mo/ /bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs ma lus pa/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dka' thub bdag po legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag /dur khrod ma mo bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /pha rol gshed ma'i rbad gtong bzlog pa sogs/ /srid gsum gdug pa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ oṃ e hya hiḥ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs la/ hūm̐/ dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /srid gsum log 'dren bsnol ba'i gdan khri la/ /bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs rje'i rngam pa'i gar gyis bzhugs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lha/ zhes dam ye dbyer med bzhugs par gsol/ hūm̐/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi yum chen mo/ /bcom ldan gtsug tor dkar mo 'khor bcas la/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ a ti pu ho pra titstsha ho/

zhes phyag byas/ hūm̐: dngos su 'byor bsham yid kyis rnam 'phrul pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang mchod pa'i sprin: zhing khams rab 'byams rgyas par bkang byas te: bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pa dyaṃ nas shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe dharma dhā tu sarba pū dza hoḥ zhes mchod/ oṃ/ tshe dpag med kyi yum mchog gos dkar mo/ /bde gshegs gtsug tor las 'khrungs gdugs dkar can/ /dbu stong bye ba spyan ldan drag mo'i sku/ /sa gsum dkyil 'khor kun tu mnga' dbang sgyur/ /rdo rje mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ /sa gsum gdug pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal mchod bstod mthus/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub bsgrub pa la/ /bar du gcod pa'i ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs/ /myur du zhi zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag dang bdag gi 'brel bcas sems can rnams/ /nam zhig 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /bde ba can gyi zhing mchog rab bgrod nas/ /myur du byang chub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bstod cing gsol ba btab la/ thugs dbus zla steng oṃ yig dkar po'i mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od kyis sgrib bsal mthu stobs rgyas/ /ya so khro bcu ma so khro mo bcu/ /sma ra me dpung ral gri ngar ma'i lce/ /mgrin par nyi zla rang lus me dpung 'bar/ /gnod byed thams cad gzhob thul bsregs par gyur/ thal mo sbyar la/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo/ /phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ /dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ /spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ /rdo rje mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen pos sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma/ kun nas bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la nyin dang mtshan du bsrung du gsol lo/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/

bi shuddhe bi shuddhai/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badzra dha ra ni/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭ/ ma ma rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ bdag dang bsrung bya'i lus ngag yid gsum mnan pa dang bcings pa thams cad phyes phyes/ khrol khrol/ mnan pa dang*/ bcings pa dang bsdams pa thams cad sarba a pā na ya swā hā/ zhi ba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar rab nyer gcig 'bring bdun/ tha ma gsum las mi nyung bar brjod/ snying po dang ni nye snying gnyis/ /rang gis gang mos bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po/ oṃ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal rten snying dang yig brgya bcas kyis lhag chad kha skong*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ nas shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ/ tshe dpag med kyi yum mchog gos dkar mo/ /bde gshegs gtsug tor las 'khrungs gdugs dkar can/ /dbu stong bye ba spyan ldan drag mo'i sku/ /sa gsum dkyil 'khor kun tu mnga' dbang sgyur/ /rdo rje mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ /sa gsum gdug pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces dang*/ 'di ltar bsgom bzlas byas pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /mi gtsang lus 'di bor bar gyur ma thag /bde ba can du rdzus te skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab bgrod nas/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog rtsa ba'i gsum pa tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ /sha chang la sogs tshogs rdzas gya nom par/ /legs par bsags la las chus bgegs bsang bya/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ bdag gi thugs las 'byung ba'i yi ge 'phros: me rlung chu yis tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin sbyangs: slar yang oṃ āḥhūṃ gis tshogs rdzas rnams: sbyang rtogs sbar bas ye shes 'khor lor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sa byin gyis brlabs la/

tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni/ oṃ: chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i zhing khams nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi yum chen mo/ /bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs ma lus pa/ /'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa e hya hi: sa mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor sad pa la rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ oṃ badzra rū pa āḥhūm̐ de bzhin shabda rū pa gandhe rā sa sparshe rnams kyis spyir mchod/ bye brag tshogs phud rim pa gsum gyi dang po mchod pa ni/ e ma ho: tshogs khang gsang chen rol pa nyams re dga': rab 'jigs dur khrod drag po'i rgyan dang ldan: tshogs gzhong padma bhandha rgya re yangs: tshogs gtor ye shes bdud rtsi bcud re che: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i longs spyod dwangs re spro: tshogs rje bla ma yi dam byin re che: byin rlabs dngos grub sprin phung thibs se thib: tshogs mgron dpa' bo mkha' 'gro grangs re mang : dar dang ratna rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan: cang te'u dang ni dril bu'i sgra dang bcas: rdo rje'i glu dang gar stabs shigs se shig: 'du tshogs rnal 'byor pho mo dam re gtsang : nyams dang rtogs pa'i ye shes sha ra ra: bla med gsang chen sngags kyi dam tshig rdzas: bde chen tshogs kyi 'khor lo e ma rmad: a la la ste thugs dam dbyings su skong : srid zhi mnyam nyid thig le chen po'i dbyings: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi: nyams chag rtog tshogs ma spangs rang grol nas: rang rig dag pa sku gsum mngon gyur te: kun bzang gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: zhes dang*/ hūm̐: bla med tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di: dpag med 'dod yon lha mos gar bsgyur bcas: bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra ba liṃ ta pū dza khā hiḥ

gnyis pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ ye thog 'khrul gzhi blangs nas da lta'i bar: rig dang ma rig 'khrul pa'i las dbang gis: bcas dang rang bzhin nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs: 'dod yon tshogs kyi 'khor los bskangs shing bshags: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ gsum pa bsgral mchod ni: rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje gtsug tor drag mo'i skur gyur bar bsam la/ na moḥ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam pa dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par du gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo rdo rje gtsug tor drag mo'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus/ pha rol byad ma mkhan sogs ma rungs pa'i sems can bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig e dgra bgegs nṛ tri a karṣa ya dzaḥ sa bgugs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa bstim/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gtsug tor drag mo'i ye shes mtshon/ /gzir cig dam nyams dgra bgegs snying rtsa la/ /sgrol cig ma rungs 'dul dka'i sde dpung tshogs/ /chos dbyings skye med klong du sgrol zhing stob/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa sa pa ri wā ra dgra bgegs nṛ tri sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥ ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti sarba ru tra pra bhan tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi: ha ha ha: hi hi hi: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: tshogs kyi dam rdzas rang lus gdan gsum dkyil 'khor la nang mchod sreg blug gis tshim par rol zhing lhag ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bhyoḥ lhag la dbang ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong ba: dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badzra a rā li: ma tshogs dbang phyug ging lang 'bar ma'i tshogs: lhag gtor dgyes bzhes rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs: utstshi ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes lhag gtor gtsang sar gshegs/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: phyogs bcu dag pa'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa nas:

thugs rjes dgongs shig bslu med dkon mchog gsum: dbyings nas bzhengs shig ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso: rdo rje gtsug tor drag mo gdugs dkar can/ /rigs bzhi'i gdong dang lha mo nyi shu gcig /legs ldan mched gsum ma mo bye ba 'bum/ /brgyud gsum dam can srung ma las la bzhengs: sna tshogs gang 'dul phrin las dus la bab: phyi yi dus 'khrugs snod kyi rgud pa sol: nang gi 'byung 'khrugs nad mug mtshon bskal zlog: gsang ba sems 'khrul dug lnga'i rnam rtog gzhil: shin tu mi bsrun gdul dka' tshar gcod pa'i: phrin las myur du mdzod cig sa ma ya: skabs 'dir srung ma'i gtor gshegs dang zor gtor yod na btang*/ de nas chad tho bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang : he ru ka yi dam la rab gnas pa'i: bka' yi lha 'dre rgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde: chad tho gtor ma longs la phrin las sgrubs: brtan ma'i gtor ma bshams la/ ma bhyoḥ khyad par slob dpon padma kā ra yi: bka' dang dam gnas bod khams skyong ba'i ma: dus sbyor bcu gnyis dag pa'i brtan skyong tshogs: bshal chu'i gtor ma dgyes bzhes phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: gtor ma 'bul la gtor gzhong kha sbub/ 'gugs gzhug dang bcas rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: rnam thar gsum ldan e yi dbyings nyid du: gzung 'dzin mtshan mar lta ba'i dam sri thul: ye shes lnga yis glu blangs bro brdung bas: 'od gsal stong nyid bde ba'i klong du sba: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: laṃ ya ma dam sri tri satwaṃ bha ya nan: gtor gzhong kha yar gzed la 'bru 'thor/ de nas mchod kha gsos la/ 'bru gsum byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba mchod bstod 'dod gsol bcas gong bzhin bya/ dngos grub len pa ni/ bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga yangs pa nas: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang :

thun mong las bzhi grub brgyad 'dod rgu'i char: da lta nyid du bstsal zhing brtan par mdzod: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta aṣṇi ṣa kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ dngos grub blang zhing bum chu myang*/ thal mo sbyar la/ hoḥ gsang ba'i sgor zhugs rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos: bag med dbang gyur ting 'dzin ma gsal zhing : lha sngags ma dag cho gar lhag chad sogs: ye shes lha dang srung mar bzod par gsol: yig brgya bzla/ rten yod na 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang rten med na/ bdag bskyed nyer bsdu ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang cha lha sngags 'khor lo dbyings su bsdu: mi gnas thugs kyi thig les rtag mtha' bral: a a āḥ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ stong nyid rang gdangs thugs rje'i ye shes rtsal: sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor los chad mtha' spangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra ma mā ka wā tsi rakṣa haṃ: zhes go bgo hoḥ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags mthus: nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can kun: bla med theg mchog sngags kyi snod gyur nas: gtsug tor dkar mo'i go 'phang myur thob shog / zhes bsngo'o/ /rten snying sngon du 'gro ba'i/ bde gshegs thugs rjes gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*/ /bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed tshar bcad nas/ /bde legs 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bde mchog gdugs dkar can gyi bkra shis shog / mtshams med lnga sogs las ngan sdig sgrib 'dzad/ /tshe bsod ye shes rgyas shing byad phur dang*/ /mi mthun phyogs kun srung zhing zlog pa sogs/ /phan yon dpag med dpal gyi mgul nas gdams/ zhes phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'phags ma gtsugs tor dkar mo'i sgrub thabs ral gri ma zhes yongs su grags pa 'dir sgom bzlas tsam las sgrub thabs dben pas gtor 'phang gi las sogs la 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas te slob dpon skal ldan mchog gis lha rdzas kyi rten bcas gsung bskul ngor dus mtha'i sngags nag kā ma rā dza dī pas bka' gter zung 'jug gi tshul du bsdebs te sbyar ba siddhi rastu//

// nga) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ rtsa gsum spyi'i smad las dang 'brel ba'i gtsug tor dkar mo'i zlog bsgyur bklag chog tu spel ba byad gdon g.yul 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru ārya uṣṇi ṣa bhye/ bde gshegs gtsug tor las byung ba'i/ /rigs sngags lha mo gdugs dkar mo/ /phyir bzlog chen mo la btud nas/ /smad las bklag chog 'di na spel/ de yang bka' gter man ngag chu bo gcig 'dres gter chen bla ma'i bka' srol gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed gtor chen la brten nas zlog bsgyur bya tshul gter gzhung rtsa gsum spyi'i smad las khro chu'i zhun thigs dang gtsug tor dkar mo'i bzlog bsgyur zung bsdebs bklag chog tu spel ba la/ dang po bca' gsham ni/ rang gi mdun du gzhi nag por 'bru nag gi tshom bu nyer gcig bkod pa'i khar/ mañdzis btegs pa'i gtor ma 'bru nag gi bag phye dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i gtor chen khru gang las mi chung bar gtor chung nyer gcig dang sha khrag ke tshe shang tshe yungs dkar nag gis brgyan pa'i mthar/ dug shing gi rtsang phur/ rtse mor srung bzlog gi tsakra/ mngon rtogs dang mthun pa'i sku tsaka /de steng dar gdugs dkar po dgu brtsegs/ thod skam rtse rgyan sogs kyis spras pa nus na khro zhal du bcos pa me ri brjid ldan can/ phyi rtsang la bha su ta dang sngo dmar skud pas dkṛ ba sogs spyi 'gros ltar bya/ 'og tu lcag hom nang liṅga bris pa khrus lteb lag len bzhin byas pa'am/ zan ling gang rung*/ mtha' bskor du/ khrag gi arghaṃ/ dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ dbang po'i me tog /sha chen gyi bdug spos/ tshil chen gyi zhun mar/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas sogs drag mchod kyis g.yon du bskor g.yas g.yon sman raka bcas bsham/ phyi rol zur rdzas sna dgu spungs zor ram/ spro na thun zor dang*/

khram zor/ khrag zor/ thod zor/ yungs zor/ mda' zor/ rdo zor/ dug zor/ gtor zor/ bcas dang mda' gzhu gri ring sogs gang 'dzoms kyis bskor/ zur du bzlog mchod 'bru nag gtor chung sha dum brgya rtsa bsgral chas sogs dang*/ lam sel dkar gtor/ dgra gzugs liṅga sogs mthong rgyun ltar bsham/ rang gi mdun g.yas nas rim bzhin las bum ḍā ma ru nas gzeb yungs gzeb dar dmar nag rdo dril las phur nang mchod bcas 'du bya'o/ dngos gzhi la/ dang po ni mngon rtogs gcig gis bdag mdun dus gcig la bla med ltar gsal btab la/ bsnyen sgrub ci nus dang srung bzlog gi dmigs rim sogs gzhung gsal las gsar spros mi dgos/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying gsum re mchod bstod grub nas gsol ka rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ skong bshags song nas tshogs mchod bshags pa'i bar btang*/ gnyis pa smad las gzhung la 'jug pa la/ dang po thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med nam mkha'i klong nyid las: ma 'gag gzugs sku ci yang 'char ba'i gar: ma g.yel bzhengs shig rtsa gsum srung ma'i tshogs: drag po mngon spyod las kyi dpung mdzod cig:

gnyis pa dam rdzas gser skyems mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog rtsa gsum lha: mchod par 'os pa 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs: ma lus 'khor bcas gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi gzu dpang mdzod: gsum pa bden rdzun gzu dpang gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po gzu dang dpang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ra mdar sbran: bden rdzun drang shan ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: bdag ni zhing bcu dgra yis rgol ma bzod: da ni myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: gshin rje'i lto ba chu srin gre ba dang : nyi zla'i go bar chos bon srung ma'i 'og: 'jig rten srid pa'i gab bskung gar gnas kyang : skyabs bral byi'u khra yis ded pa bzhin: skad cig yud kyis 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bkug nas myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bzhi pa hom khung bskyed pa ni: e yaṃ dzwa la raṃ: rang mdun las kyi gshin rje'i hom khung du: nṛ tri yongs gyur dgra bgegs dngos su gsal: las kyi dbang gis phyogs bcu'i dgra gdon tshogs: sha rul sbrang ma 'khor bzhin 'du bar gyur: lnga pa rnam shes rten la 'gugs pa ni: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa gsum srung ma'i bden stobs dang : khyad par gdugs dkar lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: ma rungs sems can bsgral ba'i zhing gyur kun: srid pa gsum gyi khab bskung gar gnas kyang : skad cig yud kyis dmigs rten 'di la khug: tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shuddhe bi shuddhai/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badzra dha ra ni/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭ/ dgra bgegs sarba nṛ triḥ a karṣa ya dzaḥ gsum nas brgya stong la sogs grangs rtags sbyar: bkug nas thar med gnad du gzir ba ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs:

nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: khug cig badzra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ lcags kyus gzir: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: dbyer med chings shig badzra pā sha hūm̐: zhags pas chings: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: yan lag sdoms shig badzra spho ṭa baṃ: lcags sgrog gis bsdam: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: myos par gyis shig badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ dril bus myos: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: lha dang phrol cig pra we sha ya phaṭḥ sgro zung gis dbye/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: gnad du phob cig a be sha ya aḥ gu gul dang dug khrag gis dbab: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi thugs sprul dpal gyi pho nya'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i phrin las dus la bab: bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i sems can rnams: rdul du rlogs shig badzra sha rī raṃ: yungs dkar gyis brab bo: drug pa bsgral bar thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub dur khrod chen po nas: 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul yi dam dkyil 'khor lha: bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs dus la bab: yab yum sras dang bka' sdod sprul 'khor bcas: ma g.yel bzhengs shig drag po'i phrin las mdzod: gnad nas bskul zhing phur bu lhar gsal gdab: tshe khrus dgongs pas 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral:

hūm̐: nga ni rang byung don gyi he ru ka'i: lag gnyis rigs lnga'i sbyor mtshams hūm̐ yig las: sras mchog phur bus srid gsum thal bar 'byin: g.yas su 'dril bas pho rgyud las la 'gyed: g.yon du 'dril bas mo rgyud gnad nas bskul: steng du bskor bas bdag 'khor yongs su bsrung : sked la bskor bas nus mthu phyir mi ldog: mdun du 'dril bas dgra bgegs srog rtsa 'dren: btab pas lha yang rung ste thal bar brlag: hūm̐: chos dbyings 'bar ba gsum gyi 'od zer gyis: las ngan sgrib pa sbyongs shig kī la ya: rnam shes a yig dkar po'i rnam pa ru: chos kyi dbyings su drongs shig kī la ya: tshe bsod nṛ ljang bhrūm̐ ser rnam pa ru: dwangs ma drongs shing badzra kī la ya: khams gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags bshig pa'i phyir: rten gzhi sgrol cig badzra kī la ya: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phur bu gsum gzir bas sgrib pa sbyang : a spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ phur bus yar drangs 'khor ba gnas nas spar: nṛ bhrūm̐ singha ra ṇa hūm̐: phur bu snying khar reg la dwangs ma bsdu: drag sngags brjod cing phur bu bskor zhing 'dril: gnas lnga dang ni yan lag bzhir gdab pas: bag chags las kyi rten gzhi rtsad nas bshig: ral gris phung po dum bur gtub pa ni: hūm̐: rno ngar shes rab 'bar ba'i ral gri 'dis: ma rig phung khams bag chags dbyings su phral: drag po dpal gyi dam rdzas bla na med: stong gsum rab 'byams sha khrag dmar chen bskyil: tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shuddhe bi shuddhai/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badzra dha ra ni/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭ/ gnod byed dgra bgegs sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥ rdo rje tho bas phye mar brdung ba ni: hūm̐: shes rab e dbyings 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: thabs mchog bde chen rdo rjes gnyis med brdung : a 'thas gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba'i lnga phung rdzas:

bdag med chos kyi dbyings su gzhig par bya: tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shuddhe bi shuddhai/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badzra dha ra ni/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭ/ gnod byed dgra bgegs sarba ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ gsum pa lha tshogs kyi zhal du bstab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phung khams sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di: gtsug tor drag mo'i lha tshogs zhal du bstab: bstan srung dregs tshogs bcas pas lhag med rol: dgra bgegs thal bar brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shuddhe bi shuddhai/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badzra dha ra ni/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭ/ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa la khā hiḥ ma hā rakta la khā hi: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā tsitta la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: brgyad pa bsgral rdzas bam gyi bskang ba ni: hūm̐: sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bla na med: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bshams pa 'dis: rtsa gsum srung ma bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang : khyad par drag po dmar gyi gtor ma 'di: gang la dmigs pa'i dgra gdon dbyer med pa: dgyes par bzhes la lo zlar ma 'gyang bar: ma rungs rtags dang mtshan ma ston pa dang : dgra gdon rmang nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: tshogs kyi dam rdzas rang lus gdan gsum dkyil 'khor la nang mchod sreg blug gis tshim par rol zhing lhag ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bhyoḥ lhag la dbang ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong ba: dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badzra a rā li: ma tshogs dbang phyug ging lang 'bar ma'i tshogs: lhag gtor dgyes bzhes rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs: utstshi ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes lhag gtor gtsang sar gshegs/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: phyogs bcu dag pa'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa nas:

thugs rjes dgongs shig bslu med dkon mchog gsum: dbyings nas bzhengs shig ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso: rdo rje gtsug tor drag mo gdugs dkar can/ /rigs bzhi'i gdong dang lha mo nyi shu gcig /legs ldan mched gsum ma mo bye ba 'bum/ /rgyud gsum dam can srung ma las la bzhengs: sna tshogs gang 'dul phrin las dus la bab: phyi yi dus 'khrugs snod kyi rgud pa sol: nang gi 'byung 'khrugs nad mug mtshon bskal zlog: gsang ba sems 'khrul dug lnga'i rnam rtog gzhil: shin tu mi bsrun gdul dka' tshar gcod pa'i: phrin las myur du mdzod cig sa ma ya: thugs dam skong zhing bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol: rol mo'i drag tu bskul la/ hūm̐ bhyo/ chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i sku yi sras/ /ma lus dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i mthu mo che/ /drag rtsal phrin las skad cig thogs pa med/ /bcom ldan gdugs dkar drag mo'i lha tshogs rnams/ /srid gsum gdug pa ma lus bzlog pa'i phyir/ /dad dang dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /thugs rje thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /ma lus dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzad phyir bzhugs su gsol/ /srid gsum gdug pa ma lus bsgral ba yi/ /dmar nag khrag gi arghaṃ la sogs pa'i/ /drag po'i nyer spyod mthun pa'i dam rdzas dang*/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /srid pa'i chag sgo ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ /bde gshegs rigs kyi bcom ldan gdugs dkar mos/ /lha yi gdon tshogs ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi bcom ldan gdugs dkar mos/ /klu yi gdon tshogs ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ /rin chen rigs kyi bcom ldan gdugs dkar mos/ /dbang ldan gdon tshogs ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ /padma rigs kyi bcom ldan gdugs dkar mos/ /rgyal po'i gdon tshogs ma lus bzlog tu gsol/

/las kyi rigs kyi bcom ldan gdugs dkar mos/ /rbad 'dre rbod gtong ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ bhyoḥ lha mo gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul can/ /lha yi gdon tshogs ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ /lha mo gtum pa chen mo stobs chen mos/ /klu yi gdon tshogs ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ /lha mo 'bar ba chen mo stobs chen mos/ /lha min gdon tshogs ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ /lha mo dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mos/ /rlung lha'i gdon tshogs? lha mo 'bar ba'i phreng ba gos dkar mos/ /mkha' lding gdon tshogs? lha mo 'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ dri za'i gdon tshogs? lha mo rgyal ba'i rdo rje phreng zhes grags/ /mi'am ci yi gdon tshogs? lha mo padma'i mngon mtshan rdo rje mtshan/ /lto 'phye'i gdon tshogs? lha mo gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can/ /gnod sbyin gdon tshogs? lha mo rdo rje mkhar bsnams 'joms pa mo/ /srin po'i gdon tshogs? lha mo zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod mas/ /yi dwags gdon tshogs? lha mo gzugs bzhin gzi brjid chen mo can/ /sha za'i gdon tshogs? lha mo 'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mos/ /'byung po'i gdon tshogs? lha mo rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan zhes/ /grul bum gdon tshogs? lha mo rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin mas/ /srul po'i gdon tshogs? lha mo lag na rdo rje rigs ser phreng*/ /lus srul gdon tshogs? lha mo le brgan rtsi dang rin chen mas/ /skem byed gdon? lha mo snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags/ /brjed byed gdon tshogs? lha mo rnam par 'gyings ma rdo rje can/ /smyo byed gdon tshogs? lha mo gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' mas/ /grib gnod gdon? lha mo rdo rje'i 'gros dang dkar mo'i mtshan/ /gnon po'i? lha mo padma'i spyan dang zla 'od mas/ /nam gru'i gdon tshogs ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shuddhe bi shuddhai/

bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badzra dha ra ni/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭ/ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu? ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu? glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig? dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad? rbad 'dre rbod gtong phur kh rmi lam mtshan ma ngan p za kha sri khar zhugs p za 'dre phung 'dre langs p mi mthun bkra mi shis kun zlog /hūm̐ bhyoḥ zas su mngal za khrag 'thung ba/ /zas su sha tshil za la sogs/ /zas dbang tha dad gdon gyi tshogs/ /rang rang ba ling 'di bzhes la/ /bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ /bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol/ /mnan pa khyog la bsdams la lhod/ /phyin chad 'khor 'dir ma gnod cig /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces dang*/ than zlog ni/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs la/ /mthu stobs thogs pa med pa'i mthus/ /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /yas kyi bdud du g.yos p mas kyi sri ru langs p rbad 'dre rbod gtong thams cad? pha mas byur 'dre langs p yul na yul chag che b grong na grong chag che b sgo na sgo chag che b khyim na khyim chag che b rmi lam mtshan ma ngan p mo ngan ltas ngan thams cad? srin byas phyung phyung zer b 'ug pas ha ha zer b dur sar wa mo brgyal b dur khrod spyang ki ngu b phu ru shwa pho'i rwa 'dzing? mda' yi nya mo gshog 'dzing? bar gyi pho rog sder 'dzing? grong gi nag mo dred 'dzing? srod la bya pho 'tsher b nam phyed rta pho 'tsher b tho rangs sgo khyi ngu b lo skag zla skag thams cad? pho brgyas mda' ltar gsor b mo brgyas bal ltar g.yeng b hūm̐ bhyoḥ za byed nyi shu rtsa gcig gis/ /lha yi gdon la sogs pa yi/ /gdon rigs nyi shu rtsa gcig zlog /gnod byed gdon chen bco lnga zlog /gdon chen phal pa bcu bzhi zlog

/gnod byed lha srin sde brgyad? /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu? bdag la gnod byed thams cad? byams pa gnyen gyis 'khon p rgyal khams mi yis gleng b mi kha bram mchu gleng b sdang dgra gnod byed thams cad? bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad? de ltar gdon gyi tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa rnams rigs sngags kyis bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shuddhe bi shuddhai/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badzra dha ra ni/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭ/ gzhan yang grub chen las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'i zlog pa/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs rnams/ /mthu stobs thogs pa mi mnga' zhing*/ /thugs rje'i smon lam mthu btsan pas/ /bdag gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /chag che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol/ /rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa zlog /dgra 'dre'i bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog /glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog /yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa zlog /mas kyi sri ru langs pa zlog /dpral ba'i gshed du bskos pa zlog /pha mes dur sri langs pa zlog /mi la nad du gtong ba zlog /phyugs la god kha byed pa zlog /gnam gyi dal kha thebs pa zlog /sa yi dug mda' g.yos pa zlog /sme ba spar kha ngan pa zlog /skeg dang phung sri langs pa bzlog tu gsol/

/ces pa brgya nas stong gi bar grangs bsags pas zlog pa'i phrin bcol gyi rim pa grub la/ nyin tha ma 'phang ba drag po g.yul 'gyed la bzhi/ zor du sgrub pa/ g.yul gshom pa/ zor gdab pa/ 'phang ba dngos so/ /dang po ni/ hūm̐: dngos su 'byor bsham yid kyis rnam 'phrul pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang mchod pa'i sprin: zhing khams rab 'byams rgyas par bkang byas te: bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pa dyaṃ nas shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe dharma dhā tu sarba pū dza hoḥ zhes mdun mchod bzlog gtor ru stob/ oṃ/ tshe dpag med kyi yum mchog gos dkar mo/ /bde gshegs gtsug tor las 'khrungs gdugs dkar can/ /dbu stong bye ba spyan ldan drag mo'i skus/ /sa gsum dkyil 'khor kun tu mnga' dbang sgyur/ /rdo rje mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ /sa gsum gdug pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes bstod cing*/ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kyis dbye ba'i rgyas: skad cig mdun bskyed gtor ma'i ye shes pa: nam mkhar gshegs shing gzu dpang mdzad par gyur: singha ra ṇa hūm̐ gis bsdu rgya bcas: mdun bskyed dmar chen gtor ma'i dam tshig pa: bdag gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur: sa ma ya dgra bgegs ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ slar yang sngar bzhin gtor chen skad cig gis: khro gtum mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba: 'phang ba tsam gyis stong gsum brlag nus pa'i: ha la ha la'i sdong po chen por gyur: tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shuddhe bi shuddhai/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badzra dha ra ni/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭ/ sa ma ya ha la ha la zor ya zor ya thun ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri: sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad sod phaṭḥ thun zor gyi rdzas la sngags kyi rno ngar btags: de ltar gtor chen drag po'i zor du bsgrub:

gsol kha mthar dbyung*/ thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med nam mkha'i klong nyid las: ma 'gag gzugs sku cir yang 'char ba'i gar: ma g.yel bzhengs shig rtsa gsum srung ma'i tshogs: drag po mngon spyod las kyi dpung mdzod cig: dam rdzas gser skyems mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog rtsa gsum lha: mchod par 'os pa 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs: ma lus 'khor bcas gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi gzu dpang mdzod: bden rdzun gzu dpang gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po gzu dang dpang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ra mdar sbran: bden rdzun drang shan ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: bdag ni zhing bcu dgra yis rgol ma bzod: da ni myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: gshin rje'i lto ba chu srin gre ba dang : nyi zla'i go bar chos bon srung ma'i 'og: 'jig rten srid pa'i gab bskung gar gnas kyang : skyabs bral by-i'u khra yis ded pa bzhin: skad cig yud kyis 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bkug nas myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: chad tho bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang : he ru ka yi dam la rab gnas pa'i: bka' yi lha 'dre rgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde: chad tho gtor ma longs la phrin las sgrubs: de nas zor lam bsal ba ni: hoḥ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bslu med dkon mchog gsum: brgyud pa dgu ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang : yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams dang : khyad par gdugs dkar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : brgyud gsum dregs sde dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sde brgyad spyi dang de ring zor lam du: gnas pa'i snang srid lha 'dre ma lus rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes zor lam dgra la phyes: sgo bas sgo phyes 'phrang bas 'phrang sol cig:

khyed rnams sku bzur rang rang dmag bsdus la: drag po las kyi g.yul ngo dgra la sprod: dgra dpung bdun rgyud rtsad nas 'joms par mdzod: bgegs dpung phye mar thal ba rdul du rlog: lha tshogs thugs dam zor du bskul ba ni: hoḥ nyon cig bka' yi lha srin sde brgyad tshogs: rdo rje'i thog chen ha la nag po che: me 'od mtshon thun dug rlangs nad sprin 'khrigs: gtor zor gnyan po sdang ba'i dgra la ya: gnam lcags thog char gnod pa'i bgegs la ya: zor gyi lam phyes rang rang dmag bsdus la: ma g.yel drag po zor gyi dpung la bzhengs: phyogs bcu'i bla ma dkon mchog dpang du bzhugs: bdud 'dul khro rgyal rnams kyis mthu stobs skyed: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis steng nas non: phyogs skyong sde brgyad dmag dpung mtha' nas bskor: klu srin sa bdag gdug pas 'og nas 'degs: ma mo dmag zor rgyal mos zor sna drongs: srin mo za lam ma yis sde brgyad kyi: rang rang keg bsgyur zor lam dgra la sgyur: sngon tshe dpal chen po yi bka' ma bcag: da lta rnal 'byor bdag gi dam ma bral: drag po zor gyi dmag dpung dgra la bhyoḥ thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: rkang gling gsum dang drag rol 'ur chems dang bcas ser sbreng dkar gtor zor rdzas gtor chen rnams rim par brdzangs la slob dpon zhwa ber g.yab dar bcas rting bdas pa'i tshul 'phang sar 'byor ba dang*/ rol mo 'cham stabs bcas/ dam rdzas gser skyems thogs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog rtsa gsum lha: mchod par 'os pa 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs: ma lus 'khor bcas gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi gzu dpang mdzod: lan gsum/ bden rdzun gzu dpang gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po gzu dang dpang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ra mdar sbran: bden rdzun drang shan ye shes spyan gyis gzigs:

bdag ni zhing bcu dgra yis rgol ma bzod: da ni myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: gshin rje'i lto ba chu srin gre ba dang : nyi zla'i go bar chos bon srung ma'i 'og: 'jig rten srid pa'i gab bskung gar gnas kyang : skyabs bral by-i'u khra yis ded pa bzhin: skad cig yud kyis 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: bkug nas myur du bsgral ba'i dus la bab: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: de nas zor lam bsal ba ni: hoḥ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bslu med dkon mchog gsum: brgyud pa dgu ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang : yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams dang : khyad par gdugs dkar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : brgyud gsum dregs sde dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sde brgyad spyi dang de ring zor lam du: gnas pa'i snang srid lha 'dre ma lus rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes zor lam dgra la phyes: sgo bas sgo phyes 'phrang bas 'phrang sol cig: khyed rnams sku bzur rang rang dmag bsdus la: drag po las kyi g.yul ngo dgra la sprod: dgra dpung bdun rgyud rtsad nas 'joms par mdzod: bgegs dpung phye mar thal ba rdul du rlog: lha tshogs thugs dam zor du bskul ba ni: hoḥ nyon cig bka' yi lha srin sde brgyad tshogs: rdo rje'i thog chen ha la nag po che: me 'od mtshon thun dug rlangs nad sprin 'khrigs: gtor zor gnyan po sdang ba'i dgra la ya: gnam lcags thog char gnod pa'i bgegs la ya: zor gyi lam phyes rang rang dmag bsdus la: ma g.yel drag po zor gyi dpung la bzhengs: phyogs bcu'i bla ma dkon mchog dpang du bzhugs: bdud 'dul khro rgyal rnams kyi mthu stobs skyed: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis steng nas non: phyogs skyong sde brgyad dmag dpung mtha' nas bskor: klu srin sa bdag gdug pas 'og nas 'degs: ma mo dmag zor rgyal mos zor sna drongs: srin mo za lam ma yis sde brgyad kyi:

rang rang keg bsgyur zor lam dgra la sgyur: sngon tshe dpal chen po yi bka' ma bcag: da lta rnal 'byor bdag gis dam ma bral: drag po zor gyi dmag dpung dgra la bhyoḥ thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: de nas 'ben du dmigs bya 'gugs pa la hom khung bskyed pa ni: e yaṃ dzwa la raṃ: rang mdun las kyi gshin rje'i hom khung du: nṛ tri yongs gyur dgra bgegs dngos su gsal: las kyi dbang gis phyogs bcu'i dgra gdon tshogs: sha rul sbrang ma 'khor bzhin 'du bar gyur: lnga pa rnam shes rten la 'gugs pa ni: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa gsum srung ma'i bden stobs dang : khyad par gdugs dkar lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: ma rungs sems can bsgral ba'i zhing gyur kun: srid pa gsum gyi gab bskung gar gnas kyang : skad cig yud kyis dmigs rten 'di la khug: tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shuddhe bi shuddhai/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badzra dha ra ni/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭ/ dgra bgegs sarba nṛ triḥ a karṣa ya dzaḥ lan gsum dang*/ 'phang ba'i 'gor zor gdab ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: sde brgyad 'bum gyis thun zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba'i rdul du rlog: aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs ma ya: sarba raksha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ zhes dang drag sngags brjod bzhin drag rol bcas gdab/ zor dpung dang rgyas pa sde brgyad so sor kha phral ba ni/ thun zor thogs la/ aḥbhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: lha dmag 'bum gyi thun zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba'i rdul du rlog: aḥdāe ba rakṣa mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ khram zor thogs la/

yaḥbhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: gshin rje 'bum gyi khram zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba'i rdul du rlog: ya ma rakṣa mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ khrag zor thogs la/ maḥbhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: ma mo 'bum gyi khrag zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba'i rdul du rlog: ma mo rakṣa mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ thod zor thogs la/ duḥbhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: bdud dmag 'bum gyi thod zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba'i rdul du rlog: duḥpra ma rakṣa mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ yungs zor thogs la/ ruḥbhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: rgyal po 'bum gyi yungs zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba'i rdul du rlog: ruḥrā dza rakṣa mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ mda' zor thogs la/ tsaḥbhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: btsan dmag 'bum gyi mda' zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba'i rdul du rlog: tsaḥshu la rakṣa mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ rdo zor thogs la/ shaḥbhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: gnod sbyin 'bum gyi rdo zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba'i rdul du rlog: shaḥyakṣa rakṣa mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ dug zor thogs la/ naḥbhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: klu dmag 'bum gyi dug zor thog ltar 'khrugs:

bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba rdul du rlog: naḥn ga rakṣa mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ gtor zor thogs la/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan pho nya zor gyi bdag: bka' sdod 'bum gyi gtor zor thog ltar 'khrugs: bstan dgra bdud sde dpung dang bcas la ya: yul khams dang bcas thal ba'i rdul du rlog: aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs ma ya: sarba raksha mā ra ya zor ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri rbad sod phaṭḥ zhes drag tu gdab/ 'phang ba dngos ni/ dngos gzhi dpal gyi gtor chen 'phen pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni rang byung don gyi he ru kaḥ drag po dpal gyi gtor zor gnyan po 'di: bstan dgra bdud sde'i dpung dang bcas la ya: dgra bgegs dpung tshogs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shuddhe bi shuddhai/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badzra dha ra ni/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭ/ zhes brjod gtor chen me hom du 'phang la dgra bgegs dpung 'joms drag rol ldir/ thal brdeb bya/ mthar rig stong ngang la ci nus bzhag pa gal che te/ rig stong skye med don gyi he ru kaḥ lta ba'i gdeng bskyed stong nyid ngang la gnas: sgom pa'i gzengs bstod snang srid phyag rgyar bzhengs: spyod pa'i 'phrang grol re dogs dbyings su zhig: gzhom zhig mtshan bral don gyi srung 'khor bsgom: zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ kha nang du phyogs la srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: gtsug tor drag mo'i gsang gsum ye shes mdangs: phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud sems can lha: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor la: gnyis 'dzin bgegs kyi bar chad ga la srid: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra kro ta dzñā na rakṣa āḥ de nas kha phyir gyu la zlog dmigs dang bcas/ bzlog pa bya ba ni/

gtsug tor drag mor gsal ba yi/ sku las spros pa'i khro mo dang : yang sprul khro tshogs dpag med kyis: dgra bgegs bdud sde'i tshogs rnams la: sna tshogs mtshon cha'i char phab ste: dgra sde dpung bcas rdul du rlog: rnam shes chos nyid zhing du spar: dmigs med chos sku'i klong du zlog: phaṭḥ de nas zlog sngags ni: tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shuddhe bi shuddhai/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ badzra dha ra ni/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭ/ a hi kā li na ra dgra bo byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: tsa tri ma tri dgra la bhyoḥ tri ma ha ri sha tri dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ e sa bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces bdun gsum nyer gcig tu bzla zhing dmod bcol thal rdeb bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs rnams/ /mthu stobs thogs pa mi mnga' zhing*/ /thugs rje'i smon lam mthu btsan pas/ /bdag gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /chag che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol/ /rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa zlog /dgra 'dre'i bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog /glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog /yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa zlog /mas kyi sri ru langs pa zlog /dpral ba'i gshed du bskos pa zlog /pha mes dur sri langs pa zlog /mi la nad du gtong ba zlog /phyugs la god kha byed pa zlog /gnam gyi dal kha thebs pa zlog /sa yi dug mda' g.yos pa zlog /sme ba spar kha ngan pa zlog /skeg dang phung sri langs pa bzlog tu gsol/

ces dang mthar bkra shis ni/ bgegs rigs stong phrag? brjod la sgo drung du sleb pa dang*/ brtan ma'i gtor ma bshams la/ ma bhyoḥ khyad par slob dpon padma kā ra yi: bka' dang dam gnas bod khams skyong ba'i ma: dus sbyor bcu gnyis dag pa'i brtan skyong tshogs: bshal chu'i gtor ma dgyes bzhes phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: gtor ma 'bul la gtor gzhong kha sbub/ na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis gnod byed sdang dgra gdug pa can thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og tu khug cig dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ 'gugs pa drag po dang bcas rnal 'byor pa rnams lag bsnol la mtheb chung phan tshun sbrel zhing bro ra bskor nas/ hūm̐: rnam thar gsum ldan e yi dbyings nyid du: gzung 'dzin mtshan mar lta ba'i dam sri thul: ye shes lnga yis glu blangs bro brdung bas: 'od gsal stong nyid bde ba'i klong du sba: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: laṃ ya ma dam sri tri satwaṃ bha ya nan: gtor gzhong kha yar phyes la shis pa brjod/ bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa la/ sogs brjod bzhin nang du log la tshe 'gugs pa ni/ om̐ bhrūm̐ swā hā: a mṛ ta ā yurda te ma mā a yurdzñā na puṇye puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rtsa sngags ci nus bzla/ mda' dar g.yab la/ hūm̐: 'og min zhing khams rab 'byams nas: rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams: thugs dam thugs rje'i dbyings nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das kun nas tshe khug la: sgrub mchog tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hrīḥ snang srid rnam dag pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam thugs rje'i dby-ings nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das kun nas tshe khug la: sgrub mchog tshe yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ bhrūm̐ swā hā: a mṛ ta ā yurda te ma mā ā yurdzñā na puṇye puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rtsa sngags brjod/ rtsa gsum tshe yi lha tshogs rnams:

'ja' dang 'od du me re re: sku dang tshom bur shigs se shig: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ya la la: byin rlabs char rgyun si li li: sgrub rdzas bdud rtsi me re re: ma rig rtogs pa sangs se sang : gzugs phung 'od du ya la la: bdag nyid rdo rje'i sku thob nas: 'gyur med dbyings su rgyas thob cig: om̐ bhrūm̐ swā hā: a mṛ ta ā yurda te ma mā ā yurdzñā na puṇye puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: badzra ka wā tsi ma mā rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ brjod la rgyas gdab/ dngos grub blang chog mchod bstod nongs bshags bsngo smon bkra shis bcas phrin las kyi khrigs gzhung ltar mthar dbyung bas grub bo/ /slar smras pa/ dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug pa la/ /go mtshon bzang po bsgo ba bzhin/ /bla med byang chub sgrub pa la/ /'di nyid gces nor nyid du chongs/ /'di brtsams pa las byung ba'i dges/ /'gro kun bar chad g.yul rgyal zhing*/ /'brel bar bcas pa'i sems can rnams/ /bde chen zhing du dbugs dbyung shog /ces pa'ang dus mthar pha rol gshed ma'i sbyor rtsub spyod ngan gyis 'gal rkyen shin tu mang ba'i skabs 'dir phyir zlog ngan log gis nus mthu 'di las lhag pa sa steng na med pas lag len bde zhing nye bar mkho ba'i dbang gis/ dus mtha'i sngags nag kā ma rā dzas mdo dang ngan sngags gi dgongs pa dkyus gcig tu bsdebs te sbyar ba nyid rtsa ba'i dgongs pa bcos bslad med par nag 'gros su bkod pa 'di'ang*/ bal yul gsang sngags phur pa gling gi sgrub bla o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul gyis ma dpe 'phrul 'jug dang bcas glog klad drwa rgya'i rgyud/ a ri e wam̐ gsang sngags gling du 'di bzhin dkrug mi dgos par nar 'don chog pa zhig ci nas phyogs bsgrigs yong bar zhu zhes bskul ngor/ de ma thag grub par bgyid nas slar phul ba po ni gter slob tha shal ba gsang sngags bstan pa 'dzin pa'i ming gis zhus pas/

gter chen bla ma'i thugs bskyed phrin las yongs su rdzogs nas 'gro kun bar chad bdud kyi g.yul ngo las rnam par rgyal zhing*/ gsang chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sa gsum yongs su khyab pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ca) ༈ rje btsun 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'chi med gter bum zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum/ /tshe dbang bcud sbyin 'phags ma'i zhabs pad la/ /mi phyed gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol na/ /'di bzung tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'dzin stsol/ /'phying bar bang so'i gsang gter bcud/ /jo mo'i nang sgrub zab pa'i phul/ /lha dang bla ma dbyer med pa'i/ /rjes gnang ji bzhin nyung gsal bkod/ skyid grong rig 'dzin chen po thugs mchog rdo rje'i zab gter las byon pa'i mtsho rgyal nang sgrub 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i smin grol gdams pa'i snying po dril ba 'di la gnyis/ sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ dang po la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gtsang zhing dge ba'i gnas su stegs bu khebs ldan gyi steng dkyil 'khor padma 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog can nam 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu gtso bo gcig la 'khor nyer gcig bkod pa'i khar mañdzu'i steng du bum pa gang chu dang nyer lnga'i rdzas kyis gtams pa mgul chings dkar po can bzhag /de'i steng bhandha a mṛ tas gang ba dar dmar gyis bkab pa'i steng me long dri med shel rdo bkod/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du mda' dar/ rgyab tu tshe chang*/ mdun du sman raka gtor gsum/ zhi mchod g.yas skor/ byang shar du las bum/ tshogs gtor sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams kyang tshogs par bya'o/ de nas thog mar khrus dkar bgegs mtshams gcod spyi 'gros ltar bya/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams su:

snang ba mtha' yas tsaṇḍa li: las kyi dbang mo nā gardzu: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas dang : bla ma rje btsun 'phags ma la: bdag sogs gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gzhom du gsol: lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ na mo: bdag gis 'phags ma khyod sgrub pas: tshogs gnyis yongs su smin nas kyang : bde gshegs mdzad pa bdag gis bsgrub: pha rol phyin drug la gnas shing : 'gro kun mchog tu 'god par bgyi: lan gsum/ tshogs bsags pa ni/ hoḥ 'phags ma dkon mchog 'khor bcas la: rab tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul: las dang nyon mongs ci mchis bshags: 'gro don mdzad la rjes yi rang : chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge ba bsod nams ci bsags pa: 'gro kun yongs la bsngo bar bgyi: mchod pa byin brlab ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bhrūm̐ las rin chen snod yangs su: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥdang ni: a las thod par om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhu ba las byung nyer spyod dang : 'dod yon sman raka gtor ma sogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ni: zad med nam mkha' gang bar gyur: nam mkha'i mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po bdag mdun dam tshig bskyed pa ni/ om̐ ma hā shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: bdag gzhan snod bcud mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang : steng 'og phyogs kun rig 'dzin 'bar ba'i dal: 'od zer lnga ldan kun nas rab 'khrugs pa: mi shigs sra brtan gser 'khor rtsibs stong ldan: pad dkar zla steng tāṃ yig dkar ser ni: ring cha tsheg drag can las lnga ldan gyis: 'od zer 'phro 'dus yid bzhin 'phags ma'i sku: dkar gsal gser 'od zhi 'dzum spyan gsum ldan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas mchog sbyin rgya: g.yon pas utpal dkar po'i yu ba nyid: mtheb srin gyis 'dzin snyan g.yon me tog rgyas:

phyag zhabs mthil du zhi ba'i spyan res mtshan: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bcu drug lang tsho can: dbu skra mthon mthing ser 'bol spyi bor bcing : zar bu 'phyang zhing dar sngon cod pan 'phur: dar dkar stod g.yogs dar dmar smad dkris klub: dbu rgyan snyan rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub dang : do shal dpung rgyan se mo do la sogs: rin chen rgyan mdzes 'od sku drwa ba'i gzugs: 'ja' zer 'od lnga 'phro ba'i klong na 'gying : tsitta pad dmar 'dab brgyad kha zum pa'i: nang du gser 'khor rtsibs brgyad dbus dang ni: rtsibs steng zla dkyil tāṃ yig sngags 'bru re: rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor bar gyur: om̐ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā: tāṃ yig las 'phros 'od kyis mdun gyi dal: pad dkar 'dab stong zla dkyil tāṃ yig las: yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin lha mo ni: rab dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi 'dzum zhal: phyag g.yas mchod sbyin utpal dmar po'i steng : dus gsum sangs rgyas ye shes 'od phung 'bar: g.yon pas mnyam bzhag tshe bum bcud kyis gtams: rdo rje skyil krung zhi ba'i spyan bdun ldan: longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen mdzes: dbu gtsug mgon po 'od dpag med pas mtshan: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi byin 'od du 'bar: 'khor yug 'dab stong 'phags ma nyer gcig la: sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam dpa' bo dang : 'byung lnga'i bcud 'dzin tshe lha rig 'dzin sogs: til gang phyur ltar thugs rjes rol par gsal: thugs rjes kun sgrol thugs kar rtsibs brgyad la: zla steng tāṃ yig sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: gnas gsum zla ba padma nyi zla la: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gsal de las 'od 'phros pas: mdun bskyed rgyud bskul thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis: rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing kun rab tu g.yos: dwangs ma'i gzi 'bar sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs: 'phags ma thugs rjes kun sgrol skur bzhengs nas:

nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang kun gang ste: bdag mdun gnyis la thim pas dbang rdzogs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ om̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: thugs rjes smon lam las sprul pa'i: 'phags ma sgrol ma 'khor bcas rnams: dad pas bdag gis spyan 'dren na: brtse bas dgongs te gshegs su gsol: sgrub pa'i skal ldan bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ ārya tā re badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ āḥ pho brang gzhal yas 'od du 'bar: padma ge sar zla ba'i steng : bcom ldan 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams kun: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: ārya tā re sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum: 'gro drug bu bzhin skyong ba'i ma: rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo: lha mo thugs rje'i ngang can ma: brtse gdung mkhyen stobs nus pa ldan: yid bzhin ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dus min 'chi ba la sogs pa: mi mthun phyogs rnams kun skyobs ma: skyabs chen ma la phyag 'tshal lo: ārya ta re a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba la/ phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐: dri med dag pa bdud rtsi'i chu: yan lag brgyad ldan dge ba'i rdzas: zhabs bsil dang ni mchod yon sogs: 'phags ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi: om̐ ārya tā re arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de bzhin pā dyaṃ dang mañdza ma nam sbyangs pas mchod/ spro na maṇḍal gang rung lan gsum sogs 'bul/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten phyogs dus thams cad du: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa'i bye brag ni: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: rgyal yum 'phags ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis yongs su smin par shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ tā rā dhe ba ḍākki nī badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhai nai wi dye shabda hūm̐: nang mchod ni: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na:
