gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos ji snyed pa: rdo rje 'dod ma'i tshogs su mngon sprul nas: 'dod yon mchod pa dbang po rnams la 'bul: 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: ye shes dbang po drug gi dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe dharma mu dra pra tītstsha ham̐'u: gsang mchod ni: sku lnga rigs 'dus rje btsun 'phags ma la: dug lnga ngo bo rnam par dag pa yi: ye shes lnga yi bde ba'i mchod pa 'bul: kun tu bde ba'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig: om̐ tā rā dzñā na sarba pū dza sa ma ye swā hā: sman raka gtor mchod ni/ hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi 'di: slob dpon gnyen dang yi dam lha: 'phags ma bde gshegs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dam can gter bdag rnams la mchod: dgyes par dgongs la dngos grub stsol: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes mchod/ kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi hūm̐: zhes dngos grub blangs/ hūm̐: thabs shes rten 'brel rgyu las byung ba yi: bde mchog bde spyod rakta'i mchod pa 'bul: 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bdag 'dzin 'khor ba stongs par mdzad du gsol: tā rā dhe ba ḍākki nī ma hā rakta pū dza ye hūm̐: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi phung por gsal: dpag tu med pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig: tshe dpal ye shes rgyas pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ tā rā dhe ba ḍākki nī a mṛ ta ma hā bha lingta ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: drug pa bstod pa ni/ āḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum: 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum: yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma: lha mo khyod la rtag tu 'dud: 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma: tutta ra yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol:

tu re'i nad rnams kun las skyobs: sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag ni deng nas byang chub bar: sku gsung thugs kyi rjes bzung nas: tshe dpal ye shes rgyas pa dang : bar chad bdud las rgyal bar mdzod: bdun pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/ thugs srog mtha' mar snying po 'bru brgyad pa: g.yas su 'khor bas lnga ldan 'od zer 'phros: mdun bskyed lha mo'i rgyud bskul sngags phreng bskor: de las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin 'jig rten gyi: zhing kun g.yos shing tshe bcud dwangs ma ni: a nṛ dza yi rnam pas stong khams kun: nyi zla'i 'od 'bar them mer gang ba rnams: mdun bskyed la thim stobs dang gzi byin 'bar: sangs rgyas zhing khams ma lus gcig tu rdzogs: mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro: thugs kyi bdud rtsi lnga ldan 'od zer rgyun: bar mi chad par bdag nyid thugs kar thim: nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chod kun zhi zhing : gzi brjid 'od 'bar 'khor 'das stobs bcu rdzogs: snang srid brtan g.yo kun la dbang bsgyur bas: bskal bzang stong gi bstan pa ma rdzogs bar: tshe gcig bya ba byed pa'i yon tan ldan: thugs rjes stobs kyis bden pa 'grub gyur cig: om̐ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

zhes bzlas bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi skabs dzap dmigs zhib cha ni gter chen nyid kyis mdzad pa las shes par bya'o/ brgyad pa tshe 'gugs ni/ mda' dar g.yab la/ hūm̐: 'og min zhing khams rab 'byams nas: rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams: thugs dam thugs rje'i dbyings nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das kun nas tshe khug la: sgrub mchog tshe yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ā yu siddhi āḥ snang srid rnam dag pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam thugs rje'i dby-ings nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das kun nas tshe khug la: sgrub mchog tshe yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma a yurdzñā na puṇye puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rtsa sngags brjod/ rtsa gsum tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: 'ja' dang 'od du me re re: sku dang tshom bur shigs se shig: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ya la la: byin rlabs char rgyun si li li: sgrub rdzas bdud rtsi me re re: ma rig rtogs pa sangs se sang : gzugs phung 'od du ya la la: bdag nyid rdo rje'i sku thob nas: 'gyur med dbyings su rgyas thob cig: om̐ tā re sogs brjod/ dgu pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba ni/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus 'bul/ nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul rje btsun 'phags ma'i sku: rgyal kun bskyed yum yid bzhin rnal 'byor ma: mi phyed gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na: ma gdung bu bzhin brtse ba'i thugs rjes gzigs: bdag ni bla med theg chen sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag rnams: gnong 'gyod drag pos 'phags ma'i spyan sngar bshags: nyes ltung sgrib tshogs byang zhing dag pa dang : tshangs pa don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ zhes dang yig brgya brjod/ bcu pa mdun bskyed brtan bzhugs ni: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : mkhyen brtse thugs rje'i rol pa phyag rgya sngags:

lhag med rtag tu gsal mdzad brtan par bzhugs: bde legs yid bzhin 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes brjod pas me tog 'thor ro/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ dang po tshogs mchod ni/ ji ltar 'byor ba'i tshogs rdzas bsang chus bran la byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros me rlung chus: rnam rtog bag chags bsregs gtor bkrus: om̐ āḥhūm̐ 'phros bdud rtsi zhu: 'dod yon nam mkha' mnyam par spel: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bde chen dbyings phyug gsang ba bha ga'i klong : rnam dag dam tshig gsum gyi sgo 'byed ma: a ma mtsho rgyal thugs rje khros ma'i sku: lā sye dkar mo 'phags ma tshe yi dpal: dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku bcom ldan ma: kun la snyoms pa'i thugs rje'i spyan mnga' ba: rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes lnga yi bcud: zhal zas bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod dam pa 'di: zhal du bstab bo rol gcig kha raṃ khā hi: thugs dam bskangs la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bshags pa ni/ hoḥ dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bla med snying po'i sgor zhugs nas: nongs par spyad pa'i nyes pa ci mchis pa: kun nas yangs pa chos dbyings bha ga'i klong : 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyis bskangs shing bshags: g.yar dam sor chud mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ces dang yig brgya brjod/ tshogs la rol pa'i mthar lhag ma byin brlabs la/ hūm̐: dbang phyug dpal gyi bka' nyan rnams: bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las sgrubs: pha ma rigs drug sems can dang : lan chags bgegs rigs thams cad la: bka' yi pham phab 'di bsngos pas: zad med bdud rtsi longs spyod shog: ces bsngo/ dngos grub blang ba ni/

om̐: ye shes lha tshogs dgyes pa'i 'od rab 'byin: 'byung lnga dbang sdud mchog gi bde stong ma: yid bzhin tshe 'phel kun skyob lha mo dgongs: sgrub mchog bu la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dpal bcu'i dbang thob las bzhi'i grub chen brgyad: ma lus deng 'dir thogs med mthu stobs kyis: 'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las rab sgrol zhing : tshe gcig 'ja' lus chos sku mngon gyur stsol: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur/ ma ma kā ya wākka tsitta sa ma ya a dhiṣṭha na a be sha ya a āḥ zhes brjod bdud rtsi sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas la longs spyod do/ de nas mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang nongs bshags gong smos ltar bya/ tshogs zhing sogs rten la brtan bzhugs bya zhing bsdu rim ni/ hūm̐: chos rnams gzhi med rtsa ba bral: rig stong ye shes snying po can: spro dang bsdu bar mi dmigs kyang : kun rtog sbyang phyir dbyings su muḥ zhes lta ba rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la: gnas sh-ing thun mtshams khyer so lam du slong : smon lam ni/ hūm̐: de bzhin dbyings kyi klong chen ma: bla med dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi 'dzin ma'i mthus: rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i mthu stobs yongs rdzogs te: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: shis brjod ni/ rang byung dpal gyi lha lam rdo rje'i sku: thugs rje thogs pa med pa'i byin rlabs mthus: dus gsum rgyal ba'i tshe dpal rdo rje'i srog: skal ldan bdag la rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog: zhes me tog gi char du bsnyil zhing dge bsngo spyi ltar bya/ dbang bskur gyi rim pa ni gnam lcags dbang chog phyogs bsgrigs ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen du bzhugs pa lags so/ 'phags ma'i thugs rje zla ba'i 'dzum zer gyis/ /sdig dang 'chi bdag mun pa mthar bskrad do/ /ring 'tsho'i chu gter rdo rje'i srog spel nas/ /bstan 'gro phan bdes yun du skyong gyur cig

/ces pa'ang bla ma dang lha gnyis su med pas rjes su gnang ba stsal ba ltar khyer bde'i yan lag tu 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pas dben khrod kun bzang bde gling du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// cha) sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo las/ tshe sgrub gsol 'debs zhes bya bzhugs/ hrīḥ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /chos sku tshe bdag snang ba mtha' yas la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /gru 'dzin ri bo tā la'i zhing khams nas/ /longs sku tshe bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /lho nub padma 'od kyi zhing khams nas/ /sprul sku tshe bdag padma 'byung gnas la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /po ṭā la yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /tshe 'dzin sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /spyi gtsug pad zla 'ja' 'od gur khang nas/ /rig 'dzin chen po mi 'jigs rdo rje la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /mi 'da' dam tshig gnyan gyi pho brang nas/ /bstan srung ḍākki tshe ring mched lnga la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ tā re tu re tuttā re ma ma ā yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ? ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes mi 'jigs rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/ sa phyogs bkra shis dar zhing rgyas gyur cig/ // ja) yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe yi sgrub pa bzhugs// // rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum la 'dud/ sa ma ya/ phyi ltar dbyings kyi yum chen te/ /nang ltar rdo rje phag mo dang*/ /gsang ba spyan chab las 'khrungs shing*/

/'gro kun 'jigs pa skyob byed ma/ /gang zhig sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /'jigs brgyad dus min skye 'chi bral/ /'chi med rdo rje'i go 'phang 'grub/ /nam zhig sgyu lus bor ma thag /bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon 'gyur/ /de phyir yid bzhin 'khor lor brtson/ sa ma ya/ rdzas la/ bum pa rgyan can bum chus bkang*/ /phyi nang mchod pa legs par bkram/ /rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'khod/ /de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ na mo/ ka dag skye ba med pa chos kyi sku/ /zag med mchog dga'i ye shes rab bskul ba/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ na mo/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun/ /tshe 'phrang bdud las rab grol nas/ /skye 'chi bral bar sems bskyed do/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid/ /blo yis blangs te sprul pa'i tshogs/ /ḍākki mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur/ om̐ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ om̐ badzra dhū pe ā hūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba pañtsa rakta ba lingta pū dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ gzhal yas lha bskyed pa ni/ hrīḥtāṃ bhrūm̐/ skye med chos dbyings bum pa gzhal yas khang*/ /phyi nang 'od zer 'ja' tshon gtibs pa'i klong*/ /sna tshogs padma ge sar zla steng du/ /rang sems tāṃ yig dkar po'i 'phro 'du las/ /gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs rje btsun sgrol ma dkar/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar gsal ston zla'i mdangs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan bdun 'dzum pa'i mdangs/ /rin chen rgyan cha zur phud thor tshugs mdzes/ /phyag gnyis skyabs sbyin utpal thugs kar 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis sems ma'i skyil krung dung ltar 'khyil/ /dar ljang stod g.yogs mthing gsal tshangs skud mdzes/ /rā ga'i mdangs ldan lha rdzas smad du gsol/

/rin chen rgyan cha longs spyod rab tu rgyas/ /snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i rnam par gsal/ /de ltar thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel spyan drangs gyur/ oṃ tā re tuttā re sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas spyan drangs/ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hrīḥ skye med mkha' spyod rnam dag zhing khams nas/ /rje btsun sgrol dkar yid bzhin tshe 'phel ma/ /byams ldan brtse bas thugs rjes gnas 'dir gshegs/ /tshe bdud bar chad bsal phyir brtan par bzhugs/ /mos blo dga' tshal dwang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dug lnga'i dbang gyur srog bcad mthol lo bshags/ oṃ tā re tuttā re sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ badzra shuddhe hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hrīḥ phyi mchod lha mo spyan gzigs nam mkha'i khyon/ /yid las sprul pa'i sna tshogs dpag yas gtibs/ /rab 'byams zhing rdul mnyam pa spros pa'i tshogs/ /yum chen rje btsun sgrol ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza hoḥ nang mchod ni/ hrīḥ dung chen yangs pa mtshan ldan snod mchog tu/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /mkha' gsang rmad byung ma hā rakta dang*/ /bsrubs mchog stong sbyar ba liṃ brjid chags dang*/ /zag med bde stong dga' bzhi lugs ldog rtsal/ /phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid la sogs/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol/ om̐ sarba pañtsa rakta bha lingta ma hā pū dza ātma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ tā re tuttā re i daṃ bha lingta pū dza me gha ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐/ a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi/ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hrīḥ spyan chab las 'khrungs rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'gro kun brtse ba'i ma/

/'jigs pa brgyad skyob ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkar gsal dri med ston ka'i mdangs dang ldan/ /'gro kun nyon mongs bag chags bsal ba'i brda/ /zhal 'dzum spyan bdun phyogs bcur gzigs pa ni/ /ma rig mun pa'i sdug bsngal bsal ba'i brda/ /phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin mnyen lcug ldem pa ni/ /ngar 'dzin dug lnga 'jigs brgyad skyob pa'i brda/ /g.yon pas utpal mdangs ldan 'dzin pa ni/ /sgrub la 'chi med dngos grub stsol ba'i brda/ /rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rin chen brgyan pa ni/ /'gro la 'dod rgu dngos grub ster ba'i brda/ /lha rdzas sngo dmar stod smad g.yogs pa ni/ /sna tshogs thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul ba'i brda/ /zhabs gnyis sems ma'i skyil krung bzhugs pa ni/ /bdud bzhi zil gnon tshe 'phrang bsal ba'i brda/ /'od lnga'i zla ba'i rgyab yol brten pa ni/ /thugs rje'i bsil bas tsha gdung bsal ba'i brda/ /brda yi don rgyan rje btsun ma la bstod/ hrīḥ ma yengs mi bsgom lhug pa'i gzer bzhi yis/ /mi gtong yun du khyod nyid sgrub lags na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes che chung ran pa bung ba tshang zhig pa lta bur bzlas pas/ phyi snod nang bcud thams cad sgrol ma'i skur gyur par bsgom/ yang 'od zer rnam par gyur nas rang la sib sib thim par bsam zhing mthar dmigs med ngang du bzhag /de nas dngos grub len pa ni/ hrīḥ skye ba med pa'i thugs rjes yongs la gzigs/ /spyan chab las 'khrungs rgyal kun skyed pa'i yum/ /mchod bstod bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin nus pa'i rtsal/ /tshe chos zas nor snyan grags mnga' thang stobs/ /'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje bum pa'i sku/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ zhes sgrub bum gnas lngar dbang blangs/

de nas bdud rtsi myong*/ gzhan don du ril bu dang tshe 'o drangs/ 'jigs pa brgyad dang bdud bzhi zlog /'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje bris// // nya) ༈ sgrol dkar tshe 'gugs bzhugs so/ hrīḥmaḥ po ṭā la yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'jigs skyob tshe 'phel ma/ /spyan chab las 'khrungs 'khor 'das las grol ma/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo ḍākki tshe 'phel ma/ /dkar gsal mdangs ldan dri med ston zla'i mdangs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan bdun zla ba'i 'od/ /g.yas g.yon skyabs sbyin utpal bsnams mdzad ma/ /rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan lha rdzas stod smad g.yogs/ /nor bu la sogs rin chen rgyan dang ldan/ /zhabs gnyis sems skyil bdud bzhi tshe bdud 'gems/ /zla ba'i 'od la sku rgyab bsil sbyin brten/ /brda rtags rgyan rdzogs ma yis tshe dbang khug /bstan pa'i las mdzad tshe ring mched lnga la/ /ḍākki rigs lnga mda' dar rang rtags bsnams/ /'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus tshe bsod snang ba khug /bdag cag rnams kyi tshe yi bar chad sgrol/ /mos blo dga' tshal dwang bas dngos grub brnyes/ /rig 'dzin drang srong grub thob rje 'bangs rnams/ /rab 'byams zhing rdul mchog stsol tshe khug cig /chos longs sprul sku rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ /lo ha badzra mi 'jigs rdo rje sogs/ /chos bdag rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i bcud bsdus tshe khug cig /gling bzhi gling phran steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams/ /rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /tshe srog nyams bkang chad pa mthud nyams gsos/ /rnal 'byor bdag la tshe yi dbang bzhi stsol/ /'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog /oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/

zhes sngags sgrogs/ zhes pa 'di'ang sgrol dkar gyi tshe 'gugs dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor/ rtsa gling zlos gar gsum pa gsang sngags ming gis bdud 'dul sngags gling du sbyar ba'o// // ta) sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshogs mchod bzhugs so/ rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum la 'dud/ de yang rgyu bsod nams tshogs kyi longs spyod bya ba ni/ phyi nang bskang rten gzhung bzhin bshams/ lhag bsam rnam dag mos 'dun du/ spos rol dbyangs snyan 'di skad do/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rig yum chen gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ /tshogs rdzas ma dag sbyong byed ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ /mnyes byed 'dod rgu bdud rtsi rgya mtsho ru/ /mi zad ka dag mchod sprin om̐ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma 'og min mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing*/ /yum rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /bcud 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /bdag mos pa'i bu la brtser dgongs bzhugs/ /dus nam yang 'bral med phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub myur du stsol/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dgyes byed ga ṇa mchod pa bla med 'di/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum rigs 'dus lha yi tshogs/ /rgyal yum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul lo bzhes/ /mi shigs 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ oṃ gu ru dhe ḍākki nī dharma pā la ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐ hrīḥ phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg /chos nyid rnam dag sprin phung mchod pa 'dis/ /yum chen sgrol dkar tshe 'phel thugs dam bskang*/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi dmar chen rakta'i tshogs/ /'bru bcud kun 'dus rmad byung ba liṃ ta/ /spyan gzigs mchod sprin ma tshang med pa 'dis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum/ /tshe 'dzin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dam can gter bdag srung ma'i thugs dam bskang*/

/mchod bstod bsgrubs pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskangs la bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ kye ma/ ka dag skye med yum chen dgongs su gsol/ /bdag sogs bag med ma rig dbang gyur pas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i thugs dang 'gal ba kun/ /rgyal yum sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor lha la bshags/ yig brgya bzlas/ hūm̐/ mdun du tha ma tshogs kyi liṅga la/ /a 'thas log lta'i dgra bgegs myur du khug /ka dag skye med rig pa'i mtshon chas bsgral/ /rang grol mi dmigs gdod ma'i dbyings su phaṭḥ rgyud drug dug lnga'i phung po zhal du bstab/ /re dogs 'dzin bral ye stong kha khā hi/ tshogs la rol ba ni/ e ma ho/ rmad byung dag pa mchog gi dngos grub 'di/ /skye 'gag bral ba rang byung a la la ho/ dngos grub tu rol/ de nas lhag ma ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ thog ma'i yum chen ma cig rje btsun ma'i/ /dkyil 'khor gnas nyul dam tshig rjes gcod cing*/ /'dod yon bza' btung lhag la dbang ba yi/ /ma sring mkha' 'gro ging sman sde tshogs rnams/ /dam rdzas lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las sgrubs/ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta kha kha khā hi/ de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥmaḥ gnas mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas/ /ma rgyal yum yid bzhin 'khor lo ni/ /lha dpa' bo 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /thugs mi mngon dbyings nas bskul lo bzhengs/ /bcud sman mchog bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'bul/ /phyi 'byung bzhi bcud kyi bkrag mdangs skyed/ /nang rtsa rlung sems kyi sgron me sbor/ /don gsang ba mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /yum khyed dang 'bral med rjes bzung shog de nas chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang snyigs ma'i dus skabs la/ /skye 'gag 'khrul bral rang shar dkyil 'khor du/ /snang yul 'gyu ba'i tha tshig gter gyi bdag /ka dag so ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sems can sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/

hūm̐/ rgyal kun yum gyur tshe 'dzin sgrol dkar gyi/ /bka' btags tha tshig srung ma thams cad kun/ /dam rdzas 'dod yon phud kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni/ /rnal 'byor drod nyul legs nyes stangs 'dzin zhing*/ /rnam 'gyur ma nges yang 'khor 'bum phrag kun/ /sman chab phud kyi gtor ma 'bul lo bzhes/ /yang zab bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod/ oṃ badzra ma hā ma ti pra mo li hrīṃḥdzaḥ i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi/ gtor bro ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /rang gsal rig pa'i bro brdungs pas/ /rnam rtog dug lnga'i phung po rnams/ /mi dmigs ka dag rgya yis gdab/ om̐ lam̐ āḥlam̐ hūm̐ lam̐ satwaṃ bha ya nan/ de nas dngos grub bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i spyi dpal tshe 'dzin yid bzhin 'khor/ /thugs dam bskul lo mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /mi 'gyur mi 'gags mi 'khrul 'dod don rnams/ /skal ldan sgrub la myur ba nyid du stsol/ oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza hoḥ hrīḥ spyan chab las 'khrungs rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'gro kun brtse ba'i ma/ /'jigs pa brgyad skyob ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bsdu ldang ni/ phyi nang snod bcud ye shes lha tshogs rnams/ /mi dmigs ka dag rgya yan lhug par āḥ bsngo smon ni/ yum chen bsgrubs pa'i dge ba yis/ /ma gyur 'gro drug sems can kun/ khyod kyi go 'phang myur thob shog / bkra shis ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku'i bkra shis ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings/ /chos nyid zad sar mthar phyin bkra shis shog /longs sku'i bkra shis sna tshogs mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /rtsa rlung snang ba bde stong bkra shis shog

/sprul sku'i bkra shis ma cig mtsho rgyal ma/ /gdul bya smin grol gegs med bkra shis shog /yum chen khyed nyid sgrub pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di'ang rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje'i sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i kha skong du/ rig 'dzin rje rin po che de nyid kyi rjes 'jug o rgyan ming gis mos 'dun che bas bris so// // tha) dag snang sgrol chog tshogs gnyis myur lam gsal byed kyis brgyan pa bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru ārya tā re ye/ /bla ma yum chen 'phags mar 'dud/ spyi don gsum gyi dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med par bcom ldan 'das ma mngon sum du bzhugs par bsams la/ kyaiḥ 'od dpag med mgon phyag gi dkyil 'khor dang : 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan las legs 'khrungs pa'i: ma rgyud rgya mtsho'i sprul gzhi myur zhi yum: bcom ldan thugs rje'i bdag nyid nyer gcig gar: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las myur ma dpal: dbyer med rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma rjer: phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol: na moḥ skyabs yul rgya mtsho'i ngo bo rje btsun mar: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba'i ma gyur 'gro: rje btsun 'phags ma'i go 'phang sgrub par bgyi: lan gsum/ hoḥ rje btsun 'phags ma rgyal ba sras bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig ltung snying nas bshags: yi rang bskul zhing bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: dge tshogs 'phags ma'i go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo: gnyis pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnas yul rnam dag g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing : kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos bkang ba'i dbus: tāṃ: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs 'phags ma'i skur: gsal ba'i gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge dang : thugs srog 'od kyis rgyal ba sras bcas kun: rje btsun 'phags ma'i rnam par spyan drangs la:

sgyu 'phrul lha mo nyer gcig rol gar bcas: dbang po mngon sum bzhin du lhun ner gsal: zhes mdun mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod bstod lan gsum bya dgos pa'i dang po ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang : bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs maṇḍal 'bul: bdag gzhan myur du tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag nas: 'di nas byang chub snying po thob kyi bar: 'bral med thugs rjes zungs shig rje btsun ma: bstod pa rgyas pa'am/ rgyal ba kun gyi spyan sngar thugs bskyed rgyal ba'i yum gyur ma lus rgyal ba'i phrin las kun sgrub ma/ /myur ma dpa' mo dbyangs can ma dang bsod nams mchog gter rnam rgyal rig byed ma dang 'jigs byed ma/ /gzhan gyi mi thub gzhan las rgyal dang seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma 'jig rten gsum rgyal nor ster ma/ /bkra shis don byed dgra dpung 'joms mdzad khro gnyer ldan mdzad rab zhi ma dang 'bar ba'i 'od can ma/ /dpag med gnon ma rma bya chen mo mi pham rgyal mo ri khrod ma dang 'od zer can mar 'dud/ /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol phyir byang chub thob 'dod bdag kyang khyod la re'o rje btsun ma/ zhes tshar gnyis brjod/ ces skyabs par zhal gyis bzhes nas phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi 'og tu bdag sogs 'khor bcas tshud par bsams la sngar bzhin mchod bstod gnyis pa la bstod pa gsum/ gsum pa la bstod pa bdun brjod rjes su gong gi /kyaiḥ 'od dpag med mgon phyag gi dkyil 'khor dang : 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan las legs 'khrungs pa'i: ma rgyud rgya mtsho'i sprul gzhi myur zhi yum: bcom ldan thugs rje'i bdag nyid nyer gcig gar: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las myur ma dpal: dbyer med rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma rjer: phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol: ces dang*/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gnas gsum las:

'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser rim cig car: bdag gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob: 'phags ma dgyes bzhin 'od zhu rang la thim: rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur gsal bas: gsal stong zung 'jug don gyi 'phags mar blta: om̐ tā re tutta re tu re swā hā: zhes bzlas/ gsum pa ni: om̐ padmo sa twa sa ma ya sogs nas sa twa āḥ sa nongs pa bshags/ hoḥ ma dag nyes tshogs 'phags ma'i spyan sngar 'chags: sgo gsum rnam dag ye shes lam la spyod: dus gsum dge tshogs zag med dbyings su bsngo: zung 'jug 'phags ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog: byang chub bar du bla ma rje btsun mas: 'bral med thugs rjes skyong ba'i bkra shis shog: ces pa'ang rgyun khyer dang grangs bsog la nye bar mkho phyir 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pas phrin las kyi gnas chen seng rdzong gu ru'i bzhugs khri'i ke'u tshang nas gsal byed cung zad bcas bris pa siddhi rastu// // da) sgrol ma'i tshogs bsdus ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ tshogs gzhong rnam dag padma 'bar ba ru/ /tshogs rdzas ngo bo ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin/ /zag med 'dod yon rgyan gyi rol mo mchog /mi 'dzad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor gyur/ tāṃ/ po ṭa la sogs rab 'byams zhing kun nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur tā re ma/ /rnam 'phrul nyer gcig rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor sprin/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /'dod yon zag med tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /mi mthun 'gal 'khrul nyams chag nyes ltung bshags/ /gzung 'dzin nyon mongs ye shes chen por stobs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen dbab tu gsol/ /lhag ma bshal chur re kun mnyes shing tshim/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad mtha' dag sol/ /'jig brgyad zhi sogs las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/ /dag pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i grogs mdzod cig /ye shes pa rnams chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ /slad nas dam tshig dbang gis 'byon mdzod la/

/byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes su zungs/ /don gnyis bsam kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ ces pa'ang sgrub bla mgon po lha dar gyi bzhed skong du padma rnam par rgyal bas bris pa dge/ // na) sgrol ma'i zhi ba'i me mchod ni/ phrin las snying po 'di dang 'brel ba'i zhi ba'i me mchod bsdus gsal snying po bya bar 'dod pas/ gter gzhung las/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mthar son rnal 'byor pas: don gnyis 'bras bu g.yur du 'byin 'dod na: phyi yi 'byung khams gza' skar dus sbyor dang : nang 'byung lus yang rgyan gos kha dog bsgyur: zhes pas/ zhi bar thab dbyibs zlum dkar rdo rje'i mtshan par byas: spungs rdzas spyi dang zhi bar til dkar nag: ces pas rje btsun sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs gzhan dang man ngag snying po 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor bas gnas skabs mthar thug gi 'bras bu myur du 'byin phyir zhi ba'i me mchod la brtson par bya ste/ phyi'i 'byung khams sa chu nang 'phrad chu gnyis bdud rtsis dus sbyor bzang por rnal 'byor pa'i rgyan gos kha dog sogs dkar por bsgyur zhing kha shar phyogs pa'i thab dbyibs zlum po dpangs khru gang rgyar rang mtho gsum pa kha dog dkar po dbus nas mtha' bar rim par cha snyoms par mu khyud zlum bskor lngas bskor ba'i dbus su lte bar rdo rje dkar po'i lte bar utpal tāṃ gyis mtshan pa dang*/ ma bde na tāṃ yig gcig pus kyang 'thus/ mu khyud gnyis par pad 'dab nyer gcig dang*/ gsum par rdo rje phreng ba/ bzhi par pad 'dab grangs med nang bstan du bskor ba/ lnga par zhi ba'i me ri g.yas 'khyil gyis bskor bas grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa rab rdul tshon/ 'bring ras bris/ tha na'ang ri mo bor te lha gnas su 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu nyer gcig bkod pas kyang rung la/ rang gi g.yas phyogs su stegs bu kheb ldan gyi steng du dkar zhing zlum la gas chag med pa'i snod du dug rigs sogs med pa'i zhi bar 'os pa'i spungs rdzas spyi dang*/

bye brag til dkar nag gnyis kyi dpung bskyed de bsham/ de las cung zad mtho ba'i sar zhi gtor maṇḍal nyer spyod sogs 'dzoms la gang bder bshams/ ma 'byor na yid kyis sprul pas 'thus/ mdun gyi me thab khar 'o ma can gyi shing sogs zhi bar 'os pa'i thab shing ngam ma 'byor na srog chags med pa'i ba lci skam po sogs zlum por brtsigs pa'am/ shin tu spros med ri khrod pa sogs kyi rang gi rgyud thab tu bsreg rdzas phul bas kyang rung la/ rgyas bsdus gang ltar yang*/ 'jig rten gyi me lha mi dgos par me'i dam tshig gos dkar mo'i mkha' klong du rtsa ba'i lha skad cig dran rdzogs su bskyed de dam ye gnyis med kyi zhal du bsreg rdzas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phul bas/ gnas skabs 'jigs chen brgyad sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs ris ngan pa mtha' dag zhi zhing*/ mthar thug 'khor ba dang ngan song gyi rgyu 'bras bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag te rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu myur du thob par byed pas na tshul bzhin du brtson par bya'o/ bshad ma thag bzhin sbyor ba'i chos rnams sngon du 'gro bas lus skyil krung*/ ngag smra bcad/ lag rdor dril/ sems ting 'dzin te sbyin sreg gi dam tshig bzhi dang mi 'bral ba'i ngang nas mtha' dbyung bar bya ste/ dang po thab dang bsreg rdzas la las chus bran te/

a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnas yul rnam dag g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing : kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos gang bar gyur: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shw sogs nas khaṃ swā hā: zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum dang*/ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes bde stong ye shes kyi rnam rol kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho mkha' khyab kyi phyag rgya sad par bsam mo/ gnyis pa dngos gzhir snang srid rnam dag gi thab dang dam ye dbyer med kyi thab lha bskyed pa ni/ āḥ 'khor 'das ye dag lhun grub rgyal ba'i zhing : sor rtog ye shes na bza' dkar mo'i mkhar: ye shes sgyu ma rol pa'i dkyil 'khor pa: chu zla'i zlos gar ma 'dres rdzogs par gsal: tāṃ: thab dbus skad cig dran rdzogs 'phags ma'i skur: gsal ba'i gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge dang : thugs srog 'od kyis rgyal ba sras bcas kun: rje btsun 'phags ma'i rnam par spyan drangs la: sgyu 'phrul lha mo nyer gcig rol gar bcas: dbang po mngon sum bzhin du lhun ner gsal: zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang : bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs maṇḍal 'bul: bdag gzhan myur du tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag nas: 'di nas byang chub snying po thob kyi bar: 'bral med thugs rjes zungs shig rje btsun ma: oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de bzhin/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ bye brag tu bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu ram̐ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od dkar rab 'phros te: zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: zhes dgang blug rtsa sngags/ oṃ tā re tutta re tu re swā hā: lan bdun gyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar g.yas bskor zhing phul la/

bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod gtsos sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon bar chad sdig sgrib bag chags sdang dgra gnod byed byad phur rbod gtong sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs ris ngan pa thams cad sarba shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes spel tshig sbyar/ rdzas gzhan rnams kyang de bzhin rtsa sngags yig bcu kho nas 'bul zhing*/ brgya phrag re'i mtshams su gong bzhin spel tshig dang*/ ram̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: tshul de lta bu'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong yin na bsnyen pa'i bcu cha dang gzhan du stong phrag gcig las mi nyung bar long skabs dang bstun te 'bul zhing sgrol bstod rgyas pa'am/ rgyal ba kun gyi spyan sngar?rje btsun ma/ zhes lan gsum gyis bstod de slar yang*/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang? sogs nas bdag gyur cig / gtor ma yod na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod yon lnga'i sprin phung 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sa lan grangs bdun nam nyer gcig phul la/ rje btsun 'phags ma 'khor bcas kyis/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs nas kun 'grub mdzod/ ces gtor ma thab tu dbul/ slar yang thal mo sbyar la/ rje btsun bcom 'das ma thugs rje can? sogs nas yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ ces me tog thab tu 'thor la 'dod don mngon par gsol ba gdab/ rang mdun thab kyi dbus su bzhugs pa yi/ /'phags ma dgyes bzhin 'od zhu rang la thim: rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur gsal ba: sogs nas bkra shis shog: ces dang*/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor? bdag gi tshe rabs? sku yi skyon spangs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /gsung gi skyon spangs ka la piṅka'i dbyangs/ /thugs kyi skyon spangs shes dang shes bya mkhyen/

/bkra shis dpal 'bar ma yi bkra shis shog /rgyal yum sgrol m khyed la bstod cing? gzhan yang shis brjod ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan pas grub bo/ ces pa'ang nye bar mkho ba'i dbang gis 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pas sbyar ba siddhi rastu// // pa) mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs kyi gsol 'debs padma'i do shal bzhugs so/ na mo/ dzñā na ḍākki nī ye/ skye med ka dag chos sku kun bzang mo/ /'gags med lhun grub longs sku wā ra hī/ /thugs rje'i rtsal snang arya tā re la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mkhar chen bza'/ /grub pa'i rgyal mo dbyings phyug manda ra/ /thugs rje'i rang rtsal mon bal dhakki bcas/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'khrul snang rang grol stsol/ /snang srid gdod nas rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i dal/ /bde stong rol pa 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs gar sgyur ma sring srung ma la/ /gsol 'debs so brtul zhugs mthar phyin stsol/ /phung khams skye mched gdan gsum lha skur rdzogs/ /rlung sems las rung rtsa mdud dbu mar grol/ /bcu drug dga' ba'i gtsug tor rtse mo'i sa/ /'khor lo tshogs chen zhing du byang chub shog / ces pa 'di yang sgo chen dgon gyi byang 'dren pa tshe dbang bdud 'dul nas tshul 'dis cha lag tshang bar bri rogs zhes dar bcas bskul ba yid 'jags thog slar yang 'phan sprul nas zhu bskul bzhin sngags rig 'dzin pa padma'i myu gu gu hyas bris pa'o// // pha) zab yangs nam mkha'i chos sde las: mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs padma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so: sham/thā/: maya: dus gsum rgyal yum mtsho rgyal sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs 'di la 'jug par spro na: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes chog gsum las: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni:

rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing mchog nas ma cig rgyal yum mtsho rgyal mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ na moḥ dbyings rig ngo bo ka dag spros dang bral: ye shes rab dga' bde chen g.yo ba mo: bde dga' rgya mtsho'i grol lam mchog gi sku: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal sku la skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ ma gyur 'gro ba mkha' khyab sems can kun: tshe rabs thog med a 'thas 'khor bar 'khyams: 'khor 'das cig car rig pa'i yo lang gis: kun khyab byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum: yan lag bdun pa ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: sogs? gsum pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig nga bdag gzung 'dzin bgegs kyi rigs: lta log ru tra srid pa'i 'dre bo che: zag med ting 'dzin 'dod yon 'dis tshims nas: dga' bral bde ba'i dpal la longs spyod kyis: kun mkhyen sor rtog shes rab dbang bsgyur bas: bdag med stong pa nyid du phyir dengs shig: oṃ dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa badzra hūm̐: nyon mongs bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐ ma: ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: mi shigs chos bdun 'bar ba mtshon cha'i gur: gu yangs lta ba'i rgyal po'i btsan sa zin: phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub srung 'khor gyur: dzñā na badzra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐: lnga pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: snang srid snod bcud kun bzang mchod sprin gtibs: phyi nang gsang gsum dngos 'dzin dri ma rnams: dmigs med ka dag rig stong rjen pa'i ngang : rang byung ye shes lnga yi byin gyis rlobs: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: drug pa byin dbab pa ni:

hūm̐: ma bcos chos dbyings pho brang nas: kun tu bzang mos byin phob cig: rang byung ye shes e klong nas: rgyal yum sgrol mas byin phob cig: e waṃ bde chen zung 'jug nas: ye shes mtsho rgyal byin phob cig: zag med dga' bzhi'i pho brang nas: rigs bzhi'i ḍākkis byin phob cig: las sgrib rnam dag klong yangs nas: ma mo tsaṇḍas byin phob cig: phrin las so sor mnga' sgyur ba'i: bka' skyong yongs rdzogs byin phob cig: bdag dang gnas khang rten rnams la: mchog thun phrin las rnam pa bzhis: 'bral ba med par dngos grub stsol: badzra dzñā na ḍākki a be sha ya a āḥ bdun pa brda sgo brda phyag ni: hūm̐ ma: lhan skyes kun brtags ma rig sgrib pa rnams: rang byung so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis: ye grol ka dag klong du brda sgo dbye: rang rig rang gsal ngang du mjal phyag 'tshal: dzñā na pra be sha ya phaṭḥ dharma dhā tu a ti pu hoḥ dngos gzhi las rim bstan pa las: dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'khor 'das snang srid bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun: ye nas kun gzhi chos sku'i ngo bo la: gzung 'dzin re dogs gnyis snang spang blang bral: stong gsum dag pa rab 'byams ngo bo nyid: dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las zang thal klong yangs nas: 'byung ba rim brtsegs sa bon spro bsdu las: ma bcos lhun grub rang byung gzhal yas khang : thig le nyag gcig chos dbyings pho brang dbus: sna tshogs ge sar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng : rang rig ma bcos ye shes mtsho rgyal sku: gzhon nu sku lus bcu drug lon pa'i tshul: mtshan bzang dpe byad dkar dmar mdangs dang ldan: gser g.yu mu tig rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: sngo dmar ljang gu'i na bza' rnams kyis bklubs: sa le sbram gyi ska rags rdor mdud bcings: dpral bar ratna'i me tog 'od lngas mtshan: dbu skra thor tshugs rigs bdag pad 'byung mtshan:

lhag ma tsho gsum sku rgyab sked par bslebs: phyag g.yas mchod sbyin sde snod glegs bam bsnams: g.yon pas bhandhar bdud rtsi tshe bum 'dzin: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum nu ma bha ga rgyas: lang tsho rab rgyas thugs kar pad nyi'i steng : rje btsun sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo sngo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol: skyabs sbyin padma longs sku'i rgyan chas spras: de yi thugs kar pad nyi zla gdan steng : yum chen sher phyin kun tu bzang mo mthing : dbyer med rgyan spangs mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: spyi bor sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro wā ra hī: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang ni: ka la siddhi shākya de ma dang : manda ra ba bkra shis khye'u 'dren: rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs: snying rje byams pa dga' ba btang snyoms kyi: so so'i rang rtags phyag mtshan g.yas na bsnams: g.yon pas bum pa zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bzhengs: mtshams bzhir sgo ma phyogs mdog rus rgyan rdzogs: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma: gzigs sham la sogs dpa' chas gar stabs can: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: steng 'og bar gsum bla ma yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter gyi bdag: e ka dzā ṭi dbyings phyug chos sgron rnams: rang bzhin gnas nas nyi zer rdul 'khrigs ltar: gnas 'dir spyan drangs badzra sa mā dzaḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ ma: mi dmigs 'og min zhing khams su: snang ba sna tshogs sku yi bkod: lhun gyis grub pa gsung gi rol: ka dag spros bral thugs kyi ngor: sku gsung thugs mchog spyan drangs nas: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir byon cig dbang mchog bskur: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin rlabs 'od dpung thibs se thib: dngos grub char rgyun si li li: rol mo'i sgra dbyangs di ri ri: dri zhim spos ngad chi li li:

dam tshig bzhin du ci bder gshegs: log 'dren bgegs tshogs ma lus sel: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral padma nyi zla'i gdan: dus gsum 'pho 'gyur bral ba rang thog tu: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rang sar 'dzin: dam ye gnyis su med par bzhugs su gsol: dzñā na ḍākki sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med sku gsum lhun gyis grub: gang 'dul der ston thabs kyis 'gro rnams sgrol: ye thog mi 'gyur mkha' 'gro'i rang zhal las: gcig 'dres ngo mtshar chen pos mjal phyag 'tshal: a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid rnam dag lha mo bcu drug tshogs: 'dod yon ma tshang med pa'i blos blangs nas: phyi nang gsang gsum dngos yid sprul byas te: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pū dza hoḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā rakta a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya dharma dhā tu pū dza hoḥ bstod pa ni: hūm̐: chags med skyon bral lang tsho rgyas pa'i sku: bcu drug gzhon nu dri med zla ltar rgyas: e waṃ bde stong rgyal sras bcas yum la: dbyangs can ye shes mtsho rgyal phyag 'tshal bstod: mdog sngo skyabs sbyin ge sar phreng ba 'dzin: 'jigs pa brgyad skyob 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsgral: yid bzhin mchog gi thugs rje glog ltar myur: rje btsun myur ma dpa' mor phyag 'tshal bstod: snang srid 'khor 'das ye nas 'khrul ma myong : dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yum chen mo: gang 'dul thabs kyis zab mo'i chos sgo 'byed: yum chen bzang mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

yas babs mas brtan dga' bzhi'i 'byung ldog bskyed: zab lam dhū ti'i rlung sems dbu mar tshud: skye 'chi bgres rgud bral ba ye shes sku: ḍākki mkha' 'gro rigs lngar phyag 'tshal bstod: las bzhi lhun grub phrin las mnga' sgyur ba: tshad med bzhi ldan rang rtags phyag na bsnams: snying rje khros tshul stong nyid nga ro 'byin: ta krita sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las bka' yi srung ma mthu rtsal can: ma rungs gdug pa dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa: dam ldan sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol: bka' srung ma mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'khor 'das gdod nas rang bzhin rnam par dag: gnas lugs don la cha lugs so sor ston: snang stong sgyu ma sku yi ngo mtshar che: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: brgyad pa 'dzab dgongs ni: rang nyid mtsho rgyal thugs ka ru: rgyal kun 'dus sku rje btsun ma'i: thugs dbus yum chen kun bzang mo: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gnas gsum las: sa bon pam̐ tāṃ aḥs mtshan mthar: so so'i sngags 'khor 'od zer gyis: dus gsum rgyal kun thugs rgyud bskul: spro bsdus 'gro ba'i don gnyis byas: ha ri ni sa yongs gyur las: zag med bde ba chen po yi: dga' bzhi las byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun: babs pas mchog gi dbang bzhi thob: snang bzhi mthar phyin 'od skur grub:

spyi dril rtsa sngags ni: oṃ padma yo gi ni dzñā na ḍākki tā re sa manta ha ri ni sa sarba siddhi hūm̐: rtsa bsnyen so so ni: pam̐ padma yo gi ni dzñā na ḍākki siddhi hūm̐: oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā: oṃ dharma ma hā su kha dzñā na hūm̐: oṃ ḍākki ha ri ni sa buddha badzra ratna padma karma dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ pa shaṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ yig brgyas skyon bshags dbyangs gsal kha skong rten snying rgyas gdab: bsnyen bstod mdor bsdus mchod 'os lha ru ldang : sa ma ya: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni: tshogs kyi yo byad 'du byas la: dang po tshogs la byin rlob ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum: rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros bsregs gtor bkrus sbyangs pas: 'bru gsum byin rlabs ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min gnas dang o rgyan mkha' spyod zhing : sa spyod gnas yul rtsa khams zhing mchog sogs: a ma mtsho rgyal sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha: ma sring mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams: rigs lnga phyag rgyar rdo rje'i brdas bskul bas: bde ba g.yo zhing byang sems tshogs kyi mchod: a haṃ sems gsum 'dres pa'i dngos grub stsol: sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: gsum pa bskang zhing bshags pa ni: hūm̐: gzugs snang dag pa bde ba can gyi zhing : dgos 'dod kun 'byung kun bzang mchod sprin gtibs: kun kyang ma tshang med pa'i bskang rdzas 'di: ye shes lnga yis byin brlabs bdud rtsi rnams: e waṃ gsang ba zab mo'i gter 'byed pa: a ma mtsho rgyal ma yi thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas gzhan las byin rlabs myur mdzad ma: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang :

ye nas 'khrul ma myong ba'i dbyings yum ma: yum chen kun tu bzang mo'i thugs dam bskang : gti mug rtog pa rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: chos dbyings sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : zhe sdang rtog pa rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: me long rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : nga rgyal rtog pa rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: mnyam nyid rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : 'dod chags rtog pa rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: sor rtog padma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : phrag dog rtog pa rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: bya grub las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : zhi ba'i las mdzad byams pa tshad mthar phyin: sgo ma lcags kyu ma yi thugs dam bskang : rgyas pa'i las mdzad snying rje mtha' ru phyin: sgo ma zhags pa ma yi thugs dam bskang : dbang gi las mdzad dga' ba tshad mthar phyin: sgo ma lcags sgrog ma yi thugs dam bskang : drag po'i las mdzad btang snyoms tshad mthar phyin: sgo ma dril bu ma yi thugs dam bskang : rang lus rtsa khams 'khor lo gnas dag pa'i: sa ya drug 'bum mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : gnas yul dur khrod kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i: sna tshogs mkha' 'gro bye 'bum thugs dam bskang : legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma: ma mo e ka dzā ṭi'i thugs dam bskang : dam ldan sgrub la bu bzhin skyong nus pa'i: dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : o rgyan padmas bka' yi gnyer du bskos: bka' srung gter srung rgyud srung thugs dam bskang : spros bcas spros med spros bral bskang rdzas rnams: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: don gnyis lhun grub 'bras bu mthar phyin shog: de nas bshags pa ni: kye ma rigs drug sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'dir: thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu: mi dge mtshams med so thar byang sems sngags: ma rig nyon mongs dbang gis bsgribs pa yi:

dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung ci mchis pa: a ma mtsho rgyal lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags: byang zhing dag nas mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: oṃ badzra sa twa sogs?yi ge brgya pa brjod: bzh-i pa tshogs bsgral ni: hūm̐: khams gsum 'khor ba'i brub khung thar med nang : ngar 'dzin bdag lta ru tra nyam thag 'khod: na mo: skyabs gnas bslu med mkha' 'gro'i bden pa'i mthus: bdag lta'i ru tra 'byung po 'dir khug la: khyod nyid phyi nang gsang ba'i lta ba de: ma rig gnyis 'dzin nga bdag ru tra la: khyod kyi gnyen po ro gcig khros pa'i sku: cig car rig stong rjen pa'i phur bu 'debs: rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'phang lo 'dra ba zhig: ma bcos ka dag gnas lugs rang sa zungs: gnyis snang khyab brdal rang bzhin de ru phob: oṃ badzra dzñā na ḍākki kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ lnga pa zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong yangs mkha' 'gro'i zhal phyes shig: ma dag dug lnga bsgral ba'i phung po 'di: rang mdangs ye shes lnga yis byin brlabs nas: sku lnga mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dzñā ḍākki ha ri ni sa sarba ma hā māṃ sa rakta keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: tshogs la rol pa ni: hoḥ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: sogs? drug pa lhag ma ni: oṃ e ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan sha za shugs 'gro dang : laṅka ging dang gnas nyul mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan cha du mas spras: bhandha'i skyogs bzang lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: rgyal khams yongs la sgrub bstan spel ba dang : ma sring mkha' 'gro rnams kyis sun kha zlog: utstshiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi: bdun pa bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgongs pa chos dbyings klong nas skur bzhengs shig: ma dag log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs: zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan bshig dam nyams la: ye shes mkha' 'gro khyed kyi rdzu 'phrul 'gyed:

gtor zor thugs rje'i me dpung mtshon cha bsnams: hūm̐ phaṭ bhyo bzlog sgra skad di ri ri: lus ngag yid gsum mthu rtsal gzi brjid bskyed: kla klo mu stegs mtha' dmag gdug 'dre zlog: oṃ dzñā na ḍākki wā ra hī sa ma ya gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya bhyo zlog: brgyad pa chad mdo ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la: dgongs brda brgyud kyi bka' lung 'bog pa'i tshe: ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal dam bsgrags pa: so so'i khas blangs dam bca' de bzhin du: gtor ma bzhes la bka' yi tha tshig srungs: dam ldan sgrub pa po la nyams rtogs spel: gsang sgrub sgra dbyangs bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badzra dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa bha lingta khā hi: dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: bhyoḥ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: bdud mo ma bzhi gnod sbyin sman mo'i tshogs: re re'i 'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum 'bum 'gyed: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i na bza' sku la gsol: rin chen rgyan cha mang po si li li: sgra dbyangs rol mo mang po di ri ri: 'dir gshegs bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bod khams yongs kyi mtha' dmag so kha srungs: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'khu ldog zhi: gsang sngags bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang : mthun rkyen sgrubs la 'gal rkyen bar chad sol: las bzhi gang bcol phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le taṃ taṃ bha lingta khā hi: bcu pa rta bro ni: hūm̐: stong gsum gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og: gnod byed dam sri pho mo'i gdan steng du: ye shes lnga yi glu blangs bro brdungs pas: ma dag 'khor ba'i sa bon steng nas skems: mtshan 'dzin spang blang re dogs bag chags kun: a ti'i lta bas bro brdung rang sar grol: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ sarba satwaṃ bha ya nan nan: bcu gcig pa tshe sgrub ni:

hūm̐: rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal thugs rgyud kyi: tsaṇḍa li dang sgrol dkar manda ra'i: thugs srog 'od 'phros drang srong tshe lha'i tshogs: thugs dam rgyud bskul 'chi med sku 'grub gyur: oṃ ḍākki ha ri ni sa āḥyurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ zhes bzlas: 'gugs shing bcu gcig pa dbang blang ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings bum pa rin chen gzhal yas khang : kun bzang sgrol dkar mtsho rgyal manda ra: phag mo gos dkar rigs bzhi'i ḍākki tshogs: mkha' 'gro tshe lha rnams kyis tshe khug la: lha klu mi dang drang srong tshe'i rig 'dzin: khams gsum srid gsum 'byung bzhi'i bcud drangs nas: thabs shes a nṛ hūm̐ gsum snying po'i bcud: mi 'gyur g.yung drung mi shigs sku rdo rje: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bcas rnams la: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs: oṃ dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni kā ya wākka tsitta sarba ā yurdzñā na siddhi a la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bcu gnyis pa bsdu rim ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha rnams mtha' nas rim pa bzhin: 'od zhu gtso bo'i sku gsum lha rnams kyang : 'ja' ltar gshegs nas thugs srog hūm̐ la thim: hūm̐ yang nā da mi dmigs ngang du āḥ slar yang snang grags rig gsum sku gsum ldang : bkra shis ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis kun bzang yum chen mo: gnas lugs chos skur rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis rje btsun sgrol ma yum: gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gyi: thugs rje phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: rigs lnga'i bkra shis ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga: dug lnga rang sar grol ba'i bkra shis shog: sgo ma'i bkra shis tshad med bzhi dang ldan: las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis ral gcig dbyings phyug mas: sa lam bar chad sel ba'i bkra shis shog:

zab chos bkra shis yang gsang ye shes sgras: 'gro kun byang chub thob pa'i bkra shis shog: ces brjod bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bsngos bzhin tu: de bzhin bdag gi dge ba ci mchis pa: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo yis: mkha' khyab sems can sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo: smon lam ni: hūm̐: ma gyur 'gro ba mkha' khyab sems can kun: a ma mtsho rgyal khyed kyi mthu byin gyis: phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sa thob nas: tshom bu gcig tu 'tshogs pa'i smon lam shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rgya rgya rgya: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa zhes pa'i gter chen nyid kyi mtshan byin rlabs thob pa sku yi sprul pa'i zlos gar lnga pa nges don chos dbyings grol gyis rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug lor mchog gyur zla ba'i nyer lnga'i nub mor mtsho rgyal sgrub thabs phyi nang gsang gsum mtha' gtad bcas brda yi bskul ba las byung ba'i dus dman nyams chag skyon gyis lo brgyad gsang rgya btab cing*/ shing phag lor mdo khams sa yi thig le sgo chen ri khrod kyi grwa padma tshe 'dzin nas yang yang bskul ba la brten nas gsang sgrub cha shas tsam brda las phab pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ba)༈ dregs 'dul gnam lcags 'khor lo las: gtum po nā ga raksha'i gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar bzhugs so: rgya gar skad du: badzra tsanḍa nā ga raksha gu hya sā dha na badzra dzwa la raṃ: bod skad du: rdo rje gtum po nā ga rakshī gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar zhes bya ba: dpal chen khro po'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo: dus gsum kun mkhyen padma 'byung gnas bdag: gsang sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mdzod klong rdol: gang la gang 'dul man ngag dpag med bstan: khyad par yang gsang snying gi thig le 'di: ma 'ongs snyigs dus nga yi rjes 'jug rnams: chos kun bcud yal rgyud sde'i gzhung mi tshugs: gdams phran sna rer blo gtad 'cha' ba'i dus:

shes shes blo mang byed don gnad la 'gags: bka' brgyad la sogs sgrub sde dpag yas kyang : yun du mi 'grub rgyu rkyen dus mi tshogs: de phyir zhi khro bdun brgya nyer lnga yi: mthu stobs bcud 'dril gsang ba'i yang zhun te: shis la tshan che rno myur thog lta bu: sgrub sla rtags myur yang gsang dgongs pa'i gter: ye shes 'ji rten srog rgyud 'dus panyid: gsang bdag thugs kyi dgongs pa rab bkrol nas: gtum po'i gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar bstan: sku mchog rab 'jigs srid gsum 'bar la rngams: nā ga raksha phe laṃ gha ru ṭa: gsung mchog rig sngags padma dbang gi rgyal: nyi khri chig gastong drug brgya'i 'gyu ba sngags: thugs mchog mi g.yo gsang bdag rdo rje gtum: ting 'dzin thugs rje'i 'od snang drag po'i zer: rang byung mnyam gnas gdod ma'i ye shes te: zab mo'i gnad kyis ji bzhin mngon du byed: phrin las yongs rdzogs dmar nag me phreng rtsal: drag rtsal stogabs bskyed bdag 'dzin ru dra gzhon: stong gsum bdud dpung stobs gnon khro bo bcu: thugs rje'i rtsal gy-is phrin las so sor gsal: bka' nyan las byed ye shes sgo ma bzhi: phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'phro 'du 'gags med gsal: kun kyang ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul te: dgongs gsang srog rgyud chos dbyings chen po zlum: de phyir gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar zhes: rig sngags mchog sgrub lha yi dkyil 'khor bstan: gang phyir ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i yang mtha' la: skye 'gro'i bsod nams mar 'gribs longs spyod 'tshubs: nang du mdze lhog 'brum yangs parpa ta: gdon du klu dang sde brgyad 'dre srin gnod: sngags pa'i srung mar bsdebs nas rang la 'khu: kun la 'tshe zhing rme 'khrugs ngan mtshamasasbyor: de phyir rang rgyud dam 'dre 'dul ba gnad: ci phyir rig dang ma rig khyad gyis: 'khrul rgyun ma chad bar du dam sri ldang :

ye shes klong du chos skun rgyal ba'i dal: ma byas lhun gyis grubapar ye nas gnas: dug lnga'i dbang gyur ye shes dbyings su nub: nyon mongs rang mdangs 'dre srin bu yug 'tshubs: ngar 'dzin chags sdang rang bzhin dam 'dre dngos: lha bdud dngos grub bar chad mnyam gnas te: kun kyang rang gi sems las 'byung ba'i phyir: dug gis dug 'joms rags pas rags pa 'dul: rang rig dngos med spros dang bral na yang : gsal mdangs ma 'gags yi dam lha ru gsal: 'byung 'jug rlung sngags grags stong lhun grub gsung : gsal stong dbyer med rang byung thugs rje'i dpal: thabs kyi 'jug pas ye shes rtsal rdzogs phyir: bskyed rdzogs dbyer med gsang sngags lam la 'jug: 'di ltar rten 'brel ldan pas nyams su longs: 'gal rkyen kun zhi mchog dngos tshe 'dir thob: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes: dang po sngon 'gro'i rtsal sdom la: legs bshams rnam dag bgegs bskrad mtshams: srung 'khor byin dbab mchod rlabs so: dang po dkyil 'khor dbang gzhung bzhin: rgyas bsdus rnala'abyor blo dang sbyar: dbus su seng ldeng khri'ui khar: gri thod nang du rdzas rgod ril: dar dmar khud du blugs la bzhag: dur g.yam rgya gram bris pas dgab: steng du gtso bo'i sku 'bag la: dmar ljang dar gyi lding gur phub: 'og thu e nang ling ga gzhug: seng ldeng phur pa steng nas gzug: mdun du sman rag gtor mchod dang : khor yug phyi dang mchod pas bskor: dar khang gsum rim yol ba dang : mda' gri me long bur pas brgyan: gzhan yang mchod rdzas spyan gzigs bkram: rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'dug: gnyis pa tshogs bsags rnam dag ni: rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub bar du gcod pa'i bgegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi:

phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang : dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med don gyis skyabs sumache: tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i dge ba kun: bsdus te byang chub chen po bsngo:

gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni ye shes khro bo'i rgyal: dmar nag padma dbang gi sku: rdo rje'i dbyug pa sdigs mdzub bsgrengs: gnam lcags rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: hūm̐ phaṭ sgra yis bgegs dpung brgyal: log 'dren bdud rigs tshar gcod gyur: oṃ hrīḥpadma tsaṇḍa kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nyon cig log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs: tshe rabs lan chags 'byung po'i rigs: 'dod yon glud gtor 'di khyer la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: gal te 'tshe zhing glags lta na: rab tu gzhom par gdon mi za: sarba bhū ta gatstsha: hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang thun gyis brab: bzhi pa srung mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas: khro bo spros pas nam mkha' gang : khro mo spros pas sa gzhi gang : sras mchog khro chung bar snang gang : lcags sdig bya khyung tshwa tshwa 'khyug: sku smad sgrol mtshon dbal phur gyis: log 'dren bdud rigs srog snying la: gdab bo badzra kī la ya: bro brdung phye ma rdul du bshig: na ma sa manta kā ya wāktsitta badzra nan: oṃ gha gha: gha tā ya gha tā ya: sarba duṣṭaṃ: gnod pa'i bgegs thams cad mā ra ya rbad: kī li kī la ya: sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī li kī la ya: badzra dha rod ādzñā pa ya ti: kā ya wāktsitta: badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pas mtshams phur gdab cing rgyal tho bslang : lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs kyi: sku las 'phros pa'i 'od rtse la: mtshon cha sna tshogs rdul ltar 'khrigs: rdo rje 'khor lo tho ba dang : phur po ral gri gtun shing mdung : rim pa bdun gyi gur gang las: ye shes lnga yi me dpung mched: snang srid thams cad rig sngags sku: 'bar ba drag po'i bsrung mtshams las: bskal pa'i rlung yang 'da' mi 'gyur: badzra krota rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: drug pa byin dbab pa ni:

hūm̐: phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rnams: drag po e yi gzhal yas 'dir: 'bar ba drag po'i skur bzhengs la: byin chen phog la dbang chen skur: bdag dang sgrub rdzas gzi byin skyed: mi phyed rdo rje'i rang bzhin du: byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can: sku yi gar bsgyur lams se lam: gsung gi gad rgyangs ya la la: thugs kyi byin rlabs thibs se thibs: mthu stobs glog dmar khyugs se khyug: drag rtsal thog rgod sha ra ra: sreg pa'i me dpung 'u ru ru: mkha' la char ltar babs nas kyang : byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das: dbang chen dbang skur bcom ldan 'das: mthu chen mthu stsol bcom ldan 'das: las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: badzra dhā ra ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: dzñā na ā be sha ya a āḥ bdun pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: rang gi gnas gsum padma nyi zla'i steng : oṃ dkar ā dmar hūm̐ mthing 'od du 'bar: oṃ las 'od 'phros mchod rdzas 'bags gtsog sbyangs sa: ā las 'od 'phrod ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: hūm̐ las 'od 'phrod 'dod yon sprin phung gtibs: sman gtor rakti sbyor sgrol mchod pa'i sprin: nam mkha'i mtha' klas sprul lam lhun gyis grub: oṃ bhrām̐ trām̐ hrī:a: zhes byin gyis brlab po: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi ting 'dzin gsum: gzhal yas lha bskyed sbyan 'dren bzhugs: phyag 'tshal mchod bstod 'dzab phrin no: dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: hūm̐: chos rnams dmigs medarang bzhin spros dang bral: thugs rje'i rtsal snang snying rje'i rol pa shar: stong nyid snying rje dbyer med rang ri hūm̐: rang byung rten 'brel rgyu yi srog tu gnas: oṃ badzra tsitta sa mā ti hūm̐: gnyis pa gzhal yas bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: 'od lnga 'dus pa'i hūm̐ chen sngon po las: e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bhrum̐ yig 'phros: e las nam mkha' mtha' dbus med par brdal:

yaṃ las rlung dkyil ljang nag rgya gram g.yo: ra las rakta'i rgya mtsho dmar zlum 'khrug: suṃ las mi shigs sra brtan gru bzhir brdal: keṃ las rdo rje'i ri rab lhun po brjid: ram̐ las bskal pa'i me dpung stong khams 'khrug: bhrūm̐ las snod bcud yongs rdzogs 'bar ba'i dal: snod kyi 'jig rten 'od lnga'i gzhal yas gang : bcud kyi 'gro drug dur khrod bhandha'i mkhar: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs chos 'khor tog: lha brgyad ka ba klu brgyad ka gdan la: gza' brgyad ka zhu tshangs pa'i gdung ma bres: rgyu skar gral lcam zh-iing sbrul pags pas phub: nyi zla'i mthong khung rang 'od ye shes gsal: phyi nang rdo rje'i char dang ser ba 'bebs: chos nyid stong pa'i rang sgra 'brug ltar ldir: stong gsum brdal ba dpal gyi gzhal yas kyi: 'khor yug rtsibs stong dur khrod rdor mes gtams: rang byung lhun grub sra brtan mi shigs gsal: bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe bhandha dzñā na tsakra maṇḍa la hūm̐: gsum pa lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: pho brang lte bar dug mtsho khol ma'i klong : rdo rje'i ri brag klu 'bum gnyan khri dang : sa bdag stong sde lha srin 'byung pos gtams: padma nyi ste rgyu yi hūm̐ mthing las: 'od 'phros rgyal kun byin bsdus 'gro rgyud sbyangs: yongs gyur bde gshegs stobs 'dus 'jigs byed che: nā ga raksha mthing nag dbu dgu pa: bco brgyad phyag ldan sku smad dug sbrul gyis: dug ri lan gsum 'khyud cing mjug ma yis: srid pa lto dkrugs gling bzhi yom yom 'gul: g.yas dgus gri gug g.yon dgus rtsibs ldan bskor: rtsa zhal sdig pa lhag ma srin po'i zhal: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan dmar glog ltar 'khyug: sbrul nag ral pa bskal pa'i mun ltar gtibs: thod skam dbu rgyan sbrul rigs yan lag dkris: rdo rje'i rgyan drug spu gri'i sgro gshog brgyangs: gsang ba'i yum mchog klu mo dug sbrul 'khyil:

zhal gcig spyan gcig phyag gnyis sbrul zhags dang : nad rkyal 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: yab yum sku las ye shes me dpung 'bar: rdo rje'i tshwa tshwas stong gsum khor yug khyab: dbu gtsug rigs bdag gsang bdag thod phreng rtsal: mthing gsal rdo rje dril 'dzin yum dang sbyor: dung khang gnam lcags e yi gzhal yas su: zil gnon khyung nag me yi gshog pa can: bde gshegs stobs 'dus rigs bzhi'i bya khyung 'gyed: trig khroṃ sgra sgrogs khams gsum zil gyis gnon: mgrin par zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas su: dbang chen dmar nag dbyug pa sdigs mdzub bsgrengs: dur khrod chas rdzogs dor stabs me dpung klong : hrīḥphaṭ sgra sgrogs sde brgyad 'byung po bsngangs: las byed nyi khri chig stong 'phro 'du'i sku: thugs kar 'byung 'dus rus sbal gur khang dbus: gsang ba'i bdag po mthing nag rdo rje sdig: 'jigs byed chas rdzogs gtum rngams khro tshogs 'phro: hūm̐ gi rngam sgras steng gdon lha srin bsngangs: lte ba lcags sdig 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su: padma drag po dmar nag srin po'i gzugs: dor stabs zil gnon rdo rje lcags sdig 'dzin: drag gtum rab 'jigs khro bo khro mo 'gyed: phaṭ sgra drag pos srid gsum g.yo zhing ldeg: ba spu'i 'od klong khro rgyal 'bum sde dang : bya khyung lcags sdig dug sbrul me 'bar 'phyo: stong gsum sreg pa'i ye shes me dpung klong : iksha phe laṃ rngams pa'i sgra bsgrags pas: snang srid dregs pa thams cad brgyal zhing rengs: klu gnyan sa bdag kun gyi snying khrag lud: rab 'bar ye shes thugs rje'i sku ru gsal: khor yug gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa: nam mkha'i mthar thug steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'khor: de nang rab 'jigs khro rgyal dpal chas rdzogs: g.yas pas tho ba g.yon pas lcags kyu 'dzin: drag sngags sgra sgrogs rang 'dra'i sprul pa yis:

srid pa mtha' nas sdud cing klad nas 'joms: bka' yi las mkhan sprul pa srog gi gshed: buddha nag po klu yi ded dpon che: klu mo nag mo dung skyong sa bdag gtso: gnyan gyi sde dpon a ba glang mgo can: klu bdud klu srin nag po'i tshogs kyi bskor: kun kyang gdug pa'i sku la ye shes srog: drag rtsal mthu stobs rdzogs pa'i ngo bor gsal: oṃ badzra phe laṃ khroṃ hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐: bzhi pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub chos dbyings pho brang nas: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rab 'byams rnams: 'gro la brtse ba'i thugs rjes skur bzhengs la: 'jigs pa'i sku dang rngams pa'i rigs sngags sgra: dpa' ba'i thugs kyi ma rungs bdud dpung tshogs: gnyis med byang chub sems su shugs kyis sgrol: thugs rje chen po'i tshogs rnams 'dir gshegs la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badzra dha ra khroṃ hrīḥhūm̐ phe laṃ du dzaḥdzaḥ lnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid thabs kyis bskyed pa dam tshig lha: shes rab dbyings nas drangs pa ye shes lha: gdod nas dbyer med du ma ro gcig ngang : 'gyur med rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: dza:hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: 'gags med mkhyen pa'i ye shes rtsal: 'gro ba'i don du so sor sprul: ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tītstsha hoḥ bdun pa mchod pa la bzhi las: dang po phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs las sprul: ye shes gsang ba bde ba'i mchog: mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas tshogs: rol mo dbyangs snyan nam mkha' gang : phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la: khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la 'bul: a la la ste bzhes su gsol: badzra arghaṃ puṣpe sogs brjod: gnyis pa nang mchod sman gtor rakta 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs sgrub pa'i rdzas: rgyud drug sems can kun sgrol ba'i: dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang : 'bar ba'i khro bo'i lha la 'bul: gnyis su med par bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro: 'dod yon lnga yi rab brgyan pa: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs dam bzhin du bzhes su gsol: mahā ba liṃ ta khā raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: chags med rakta mkha' dby-iings rgyun: 'khor ba rnam dag bde chen mtsho: rgyud drug dbyings su sgrol ba'i phyir: khro chen 'bar ba'i lha la 'bul: mahā rakta khā raṃ khā hi: gsum pa gsang ba sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa: bde chen spros bral thig le'i sku: 'du 'bral med pa'i mchod pa bzhes: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥpadma yo gi ni ā be sha ya āḥ hūm̐: gnyis 'dzin mtshan ma'i chos rnams la: ngo bo cir yang grub pa med: ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos: gnyis su med pa'i mchod pa bzhes: ma traṃ ru dra a pa ra ṇa phaṭḥ bzhi pa mnyam pa nyid kyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po ni: bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul: bza' bca' btung bgo longs spyod rnams: mi dmigs mnyam pa'i mchod pa bzhes: dharma dhā tu a āḥ brgyad pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dmigs med spros bral mkha' ltar dag pa la: bde gshegs dgongs pa ma 'gags rgyun mi chad: ye shes rang gsal 'bar ba rngam pa'i dpal: dpal chen khro bo'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dug ri rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil nas: 'jigs byed rgyal po 'chi bdag mgo dgu pa: a kro rā dza nag po ti pa tsa: nā ga raksha'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'das dang ma 'das so mtshams gdug pa 'dus:

dbu dgu rtsa zhal sdig pas log 'dren za: khros pa'i zhal gdangs i la sha yi sgras: srid gsum skrag par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku stod srin gzugs sku smad dug sbrul 'khyil: bco brgyad phyag gi mtshon chas gdug pa 'dul: spyan m-ig nyer bdun nyi zla khrag mtshor 'khyil: stong gsum dus gcig gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: sbrul nag ral pa dug rlangs mun ltar gtibs: thod skam dbu rgyan bde gshegs zhing khams rdzogs: sbrul rigs lngas brgyan rdo rje'i gshog pa gdengs: stong khams zil gyis gnon la phyag 'tshal bstod: rul sbal stod kheb rdo rje'i rgyan drug dang : phur bu'i lan tshar dar nag cod pan 'phur: chu srin shun pa khrag zhag thig les brgyan: dpal gyi chas kun 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsang ba'i yum mchog gzi ldan klu mo 'khril: sbal sbrul sdom sdig gnam lcags tshwa tshwa 'phro: srid gsum byad ma klu rnams yongs kyi gshed: lha srin sde brgyad 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyal ba kun gyi spyi dpal rigs kyi bdag: kun bzang rig 'dzin rdo rje thod pa rtsal: mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i nyams: gsang sngags don rgyud ston la phyag 'tshal bstod: zla gam dmar po dbang gi gzhal yas nas: rta mgrin rgyal po khro gtum rngams pa'i sku: 'byin 'jug rlung sngags grags stong tshangs dbyangs sgras: khams gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'byung lnga'i stobs 'dus rus sbal 'od klong nas: chos nyid mi 'gyur gsang bdag rdo rje gtum: drag sngags dmod pa mthar phyin he ru kaḥ dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: gnam lcags sdig rgod 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: che btsan stobs ldan padma he ru kaḥ rdo rje drag rtsal mngon spyod stobs ldan shugs: khams gsum cig car sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'bar ba'i sku ni ri rab ltos dang mnyam: gdug pa'i nga ros srid gsum rmang nas ldeg:

sgrol byed drag po ngar ldan thog ltar myur: sku gsum thugs dbang rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: sprul pa'i khro rgyal 'bar ba chen po bcu: stong khams zil gnon rngams pa'i sgra gdangs can: dgra bgegs rdung zhing dam nyams snying rtsa gcod: ma rungs log 'dren 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'bar ba'i dbyings las dmod pa'i pho nya 'gyed: bra gsod ging bzhon 'bum sde thog ltar myur: snang srid thams cad rig sngags mtshon cha'i sku: srid pa dbyings su gzhom la phyag 'tshal bstod: rang rig gdod nas dag pa chos kyi sku: rang mdangs 'gags med gsal la longs spyod rdzogs: rang byung thugs rje'i rtsal rdzogs sprul pa'i sku: 'khor 'das dbyer med lhun gyis grub la bstod: dgu pa dzab bskul ba ni: hūm̐: rtse gcig bos pas bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dal: sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya mi 'da' bzung : dpal chen khro rgyal mchog dang mnyam sbyar na: zhal mthong gsung thos rig rtsal dbang thob nas: phrin las yongs su rdzogs par mdzad du gsol: hūm̐ badzra pra bhe sha ya phaṭḥ ces pas dzab dbye thor thun bzung na: oṃ badzra phe laṃ khroṃ hrī:hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes rtsa sngags dang : na mo buddha ya: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya: nā ga du: tsandhe tsandhe: mi li mi li: bhandha bhandha: nā ga ni swā hā:

zhes sgrub sngags dang : las sbyor dgra bgegs gang yin kyang : gud nas 'byung ba ltar du bzla: thun mtshams dzap kyi bstod pa ni: hūm̐: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig las: bskyed rim snang stong mchod pa 'di: dkyil 'khor lha yi sku la 'bul: grags stong dzap kyi mchod pa 'di: dkyil 'khor lha yi gsung la 'bul: bde stong ye shes mchod pa 'di: dkyil 'khor lha yi thugs la 'bul: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: ces dang dbyangs gsal yig brgya brjod: de ltar gsang sngags zab mo'i lam 'khor cing : bskyed rim 'gyur med rnam pa gsal rdzogs pas: tshe ring nad med thun mong yon tan 'byung : gsal stong dbyer med rnam par dag pa yi: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin mchog gi sangs rgyas thob: snying po'i dzap bzlas gsal dag thim par bskyal: gsang ba sngags kyi nus pa thod rgal 'byung : bden pa'i tshig 'grub kun gyis bkur zhing mchod: mnyam rdzogs dgongs pas bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub: bdag rgyud byin rlabs nyams dang rtogs pa 'char: gzhan sde dbang bsgyur chos la sbyor bar nus: yid gnyis the tshom bral bar nyams blangs pas: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la: tshogs mchod byin rlabs mchod bskang bshags: bsgral bstab lhag ma thugs dam bskul: chad tho brtan skyong dngos grub blang : dang po tshogs mchod byin rlabs ni: maṃ sa su ra la sogs: 'dod yon tshogs kyi longs spyod rnams: 'khyil ba'i sngags dang bdud rtsis bsang : hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten tshogs gzhong du: bcud kyi 'gro drug tshogs kyi rdzas: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid mchod pa'i sprin: bde stong bla med bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ ā:hūm̐: gnyis pa phud kyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: 'khor 'das bcud bsdus ba liṃ ta: tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di:

'dod yon lnga yi sprin phung gtibs: nam mkha' gang ba'i bde chen po: khro 'dus yi dam lha la 'bul: gnyis su med par bzhes nas kyang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: gsum pa bar pas bskang ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje sems: dgyes pa thugs rje'i phrin las gar: gsang bdag gtum po'i thugs dam bskang : dbyings las thabs kyi skur snang ba: gshin rje gshed po 'jigs byed sku: a kro rā dza'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs byed sku yi rol pa las: srid gsum zil gnon rlabs chen po: mkha' lding nag po'i thugs dam bskang : drag sngags gsung gi rang bzhin las: 'jigs pa'i sgra sgrogs khams gsum sdud: dbang chen padma'i thugs dam bskang : mnyam gnas dgongs pa 'pho 'gyur med: rig pa 'od kyi snying po can: ye shes sems dpa'i thugs dam bskang : spro bsdu gsal ba dran 'dzin zhig: rtog med mkhyen dang brtse ba'i dbyings: ting 'dzin sems dpa'i thugs dam bskang : shes rab chen po'i ye shes mes: snang srid bdag med zhugs su bsreg: drag po rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang : chos dbyings bde chen rdo rje 'chang : rtsa gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i dpal: rigs bdag gu ru'i thugs dam bskang : 'bar ba'i dbyings las thugs rje'i 'od: sbal sbrul sdom sdig sbrul char 'bebs: rang gshed pho nya'i thugs dam bskang : stong khams zil gnon ye shes rgyal: dpa' gtum rngams pas log 'dren sgrol: bdud 'dul khro bcu'i thugs dam bskang : shes rab dbyings las thabs kyi sku: srid gsum srog gshed ha la'i gdong : 'khor tshogs pho nya'i thugs dam bskang : bka' nyan bstan srung dgra bgegs sgrol: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrol: bka' srung gter bdag thugs dam bskang : 'khor 'das thams cad chos nyid ngang : dgyes pa'i rtsal chen rmas pa'i dal: mnyam rdzogs dbyings su thugs dam bskang :

gnyis med don gyi dngos grub stsol: bzhi pa phyi mas bshags pa ni: ho: gdod nas rang rig lha dang dbyer med kyang : ma rigs dbang gis gnyis rtog so sor bzung : bag med dbang gyur dam 'gal ci mchis par: rig pa ye shes lha yi 'khor lor bshags: gnyis med byang chub chen por dag gyur cig: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe ā: lnga pa tha ma bsgral bstab ni: na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma zhi khro rab 'byams lha: rdo rje me 'bar lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: sdang dgra gnod bgegs bdud dang dam sri sogs: khyad par klu gnyan byad gdon 'tshe rgol rnams: rang dbang med par gzugs lang 'di la khug: khro chen rnams kyis srid gsum mtha' nas sdus: pho nya rnams kyis 'byung bzhi'i phyi nang dkrugs: srog gshed rnams kyis dmigs pa'i snying la zung : ma mo rnams kyis shor med byad du chings: spor byed rnams kyis shes pa dbyings su spor: dus la bab po las mkhan mthu ma chung : rgyal ba'i mthu byin bden stobs ngad ma g.yel: las dang rgyu 'bras rten 'brel chud ma gsan: drag sngags dmod pa'i nus rtags rtsal ma bzhag: da lta nyid du mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: sarba nṛ:du phu tri dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ phur bu thogs la: sgrol byed sras mchog kī la ya: khro rgyal kun gyi stobs shugs 'chang : srid pa gsum yang sgrol byed na: dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos: bstab po gdug pa'i snying la ya: theb par mdzod cig kī la ya: oṃ badzra phe laṃ khroṃ hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐: kī li kī la ya sarba bighān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bstab pa ni: hūm̐: rig sngags dmod pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo yis: dgra bgegs lnga phung phye ma rdul du rlog: snang srid sha rus dwangs lnga'i 'dod yon tshogs: dwangs ma'i zer 'bar bdud rtsi'i sprin spro ba: ye shes 'bar ba dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dgra bgegs ldang med phrin las mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ru dra nṛ tri sha trāṃ ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi:

drug pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: dbang phyug ma mo ging lang dur khrod bdag: sha za las byed sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs: dpal gyi pha 'bab lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs sgrol la gsang sngags bstan pa srungs: rnal 'byor rtsal skyed gdug pa'i g.yul ngo zlog: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med 'grub par mdzod: ma ma dung dung ha he phaṭḥ bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam dus la babs: byin rlabs mthu stobs nus rtsal deng 'dir skyed: bdag lus phung khams lha yi dkyil 'khor la: 'bar ba'i stobs bcu rdzogs pas gzi byin mched: srid pa gsum yang rngams drag rol pa'i rtsal: me 'bar chu 'brub ri nyil rlung chen 'ur: 'brug sgra thog ser drag po'i ngar dang bcas: bdud dang dgra bgegs phye mar mya la la: byad ma gnod byed gzhob tu thu lu lu: rgol ba brtsams pa'i bdud rigs snying la ya: trig nan hur thum sha badzra tshindha rbad: brlag cing bcom nas nam yang ldang med du: ye shes 'khor lo 'bar bas rgyas thob la: rig 'dzin rnams kyis bden pa'i stobs skyed cig: yi dam lha yis bskyed rdzogs rtags phyungs shig: dam can rnams kyis dmod pa'i mthu skyed cig: khro rgyal rnams kyis mi shigs rgya sdoms la: mthar zhing gzhom pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ badzra phe laṃ khroṃ hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ kī li kī la ya: ru dra nṛ tri sha trūṃ gardza gardza ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bhandha bhandha hu lu hu lu tiṣṭha tiṣṭha tshindha tshindha bhindha bhindha spho ṭa spho ṭa mā ra ya sarba big nān trig nan a yaṃ phaṭḥ brgyad pa chad tho bsgrag pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min gsang sgrom me ri 'bar ba ru: chos sku gsang bdag rdo rje me 'bar gyis:

longs sku khro rgyal 'jigs byed chen po'i sku: sprul sku rab 'bar nā ga raksha yis: ye shes phyag rgyas srid gsum dbang bsdus shing : ma rig gling khams ngan song dong sprug tshe: dbyings kyi ḍākki srid pa'i ma rnams kyis: thabs kyi skur bstan tha tshig khas blangs bzhin: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags mthu skyed bar chad bdud dpung zlog: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bal yul yang le shod kyi gnas: gnod sbyin rdzong du rig 'dzin rnam gsum gyis: gsang bdag gtum chen rdo rje me 'bar gyis: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: nam mkha'i khams nas gza' dang rgyu skar dang : rgya mtsho'i gting nas sa bdag gnyan rgod klu: bar snang khams nas sde brgyad btul ba'i tshe: snying srung ma bzhi pho bdud nyer gcig sogs: srid pa'i lha srin dregs pa che dgu yis: rang rtags gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags mthu skyed bar chad bdud dpung zlog: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa tha ma la: brag dmar mchims phu dpal gyi phug ring du: slob dpon chen po padma thod phreng dang : bde chen yum mchog mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gyis: rdo rje srin po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: gza' klu rgyal po dbang chen sde gsum gyis: rang rtags gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags mthu skyed bar gcod bdud dpung zlog: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og dus kyi bskal pa'i yang mtha' la: yang rdzong mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gter phug tu: rig 'dzin sngags 'chang thugs mchog rdo rje dang : dbyings kyi yum chen rdo rje gzi ldan mas: gnyis med zil gnon dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe:
