ye shes rol pa'i pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis: rang rtags gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags mthu skyed bar gcod bdud dpung zlog: rnal 'byor bcauol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: da lta sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag gcag gis: stong gsum brdal ba dpal gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir: rdo rje gsum gyi ting 'dzin sgrub pa'i tshogs: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyi: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags mthu skyed bar chod bdud dpung zlog: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: 'dzam gling brtan pa'i brtan ma sde lnga dang : bod khams skyong ba'i skyong ma bcu gnyis rnams: mdzes pa'i gzugs la brjid pa'i chas dang ldan: rngams pa'i tshul gyis phrin las thogs med myur: 'dir spyon dmar chen gtor ma'i bshal chu bzhes: dpal gyi bka' bzhin rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs: rtsa rlung tshe dpal nyams rtogs rten 'brel spel: 'brel tshad don ldan smin grol mthar phyin nas: ma ma ting ting shag shag badzra pā ṇi hoḥ sarba dung dung hrīng hrīng dzaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu pa bro brdung ba ni: hūm̐: rngams chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'bar ba dpal gyi bro brdung bas: srid gsum bsdus shing dpyi nas 'joms: bdud dang dgra bgegs 'byung po rnams: byang chub mchog sems ma bskyed bar: nam yang ldang med rgyas btab bo: oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwambha ya nan: bcu gcig pa dbang blang ba ni: hūm̐: zil gnon thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes gsal ba'i nyi ma shar: dus gsum bde gshegs sprin ltar gtibs: khrag 'thung khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs: mkha' 'gro dam can bran ltar 'du:

dngos grub char 'bebs tshubs se tshub: bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod mtha' ru phyin: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs: sku mchog sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub stsol: gsung mchog gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas: 'gags med gsung gi dngos grub stsol: thugs mchog thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: kun 'byung yon tan dkyil 'khor nas: tshe dpal ye shes dngos grub stsol: thogs med phrin las dkyil 'khor nas: gang 'dul thugs rje'i dngos grub stsol: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs dang gnyis med stsol: rtsa sngags sham bur: kā ya wākka tsitta gu ṇa gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ āḥ bkra shis byin dbab brtan par bya: bcu gnyis pa bzod gsol ni: hoḥ dam tshig gnyan gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir: rdzas dang ting 'dzin bzlas brjod g.yel: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul thams cad bshags: sgrib bral tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces yig brgya bzla: bcu gsum pa gshegs bsdu ni: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las snying rje'i rol rtsal gyis: 'gro ba'i don du gsal rdzogs ye shes dal: gang 'dul stobs bcu'i phrin las mthar phyin nas: dgongs pa zang thal dmigs med dbyings su mu: bcu bzhi pa bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: mos pa lhur blangs bden pas stobs phyung ba'i: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin dge tshogs nam mkha'i khyon: nam yang 'dzad med ye shes 'khor lo'i rgyun: 'gro kun 'bad med grol ba'i rgyu ru bsngo: bco lnga pa smon lam ni: hoḥ bdag gzhan 'khor 'das dus gsum dge ba yis: 'gro drug rgud med dge legs dpal la spyod: phun tshogs gzi ldan ye shes don rtogs nas: rang gzhan 'pho med gtan srid zin par shog: ces rgyas gdab bo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: gsang ba yang dag snying po rdo rje'i tshig: ma nor tshul bzhin su zhig nyams blangs pa: 'gal rkyen bar gcod bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal:

sku bzhi mchog thob ye shes gdod mar grol: zhi rgyas dbang drag rten 'brel smon lam bsgyur: gang la ci 'dul phrin las thogs pa med: ci phyir pad 'byung dgongs rgyud thugs rje'i 'phrul: kun rdzob don dam gnyis med shes par gyis: bden rdzun mtha' bral bde klong yangs pa'i ngang : 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod pa mthar phyin bskyang : shin tu zab phyir ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i don: mtsho rgyal zab gsang mi shigs brda thabs la: rten 'brel mthar phyin zad med gter du rgya: bka' srung dam can rnams kyis thub par srungs: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ bkra shis ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs rdo rje 'dzin: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba he ru ka: gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags kun gyi bdag: lha dang dbyer med mchog gi bkra shis shog: sku mchog 'jam dpal gsung mchog padma dbang : thugs mchog yang dag yon tan che mchog rgyal: phrin las kī la khro bcu ma mo dbyings: ye shes mnga' dbang rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog: rig 'dzin slob dpon rigs kun thams cad rdzogs: mchod bstod bka' srung drag sngags rol rtsal 'gyod: phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'khor los rab bsgyur ba: dkyil 'khor byin chags brtan pa'i bkra shis shog: chos kyi dbyings nas thugs dam spyod pa'i lha: ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'bar ba sku yi dal: gnyis med yongs rdzogs drag sngags nus rtsal brnyes: mkhyen brtse ye shes rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: ྀatsha:

tshigs gnyis po rje bla mas bdag karma mthar phyin gyis gtum po'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa'i mnga' gsol yin phebs// ka) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: legs ldan mgon po'i dbang bskur bsdus pa bzhugs so: khrag 'thung legs ldan mgon por bstod: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: khrag 'thung mgon po'i dbang mchog bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas dbang gi rim pa ni: bum pa cha tshang rdzas dang chus: legs par bkang zhing me long brgyan: bhandha gtor ma tsakli bcas: bla rdo rdo rje phur pa dang : phyi nang rdzas rnams gzhung bzhin bsham: sa ma ya: de nas sngon 'gro grub nas su: maṇḍal phul zhing 'di ltar zhu: hoḥ bla med gsang sngags che ba'i mchog: dkyil 'khor kun gyi mnga' bdag nyid: deng nas mgon po'i dbang bskur stsol: dam las mi 'da' sa ma ya: de nas bum chu'i khrus bya zhing las bum thogs nas: hūm̐: 'di ni gsang ba'i dam tshig chu: dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob: ma bsrung rdo rje dmyal bar ltung : de bas dam tshig dran par gyis: oṃ ma hā kā la sa ma ya i dante na ra kan: de nas bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyi stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis e mthing nag 'bar ba'i rang bzhin: me ri kha dog lnga ldan gyi dbus su: padma nyi zla ro yi gdan la che mchog ye shes mgon po: sku mdog nag po shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can: sgeg cing sbom la gsus pa che ba: khro zhing seṅge'i g.yang gzhi gsol ba: g.yas gnyis tsitta gri gug dang ral gri: g.yon gnyis thod khrag dang rtse gsum bsnams pa: g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa: de yi pang du yum mchog lha mo dpal 'bar ma: gri thod 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud pa:

yab yum me ri 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: spyi bor rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs yab yum la 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bzhi: dpral bar gdong bzhi pa: mgrin par phyag drug pa: snying khar hūm̐ yig sngags phreng : lte bar ma ning nag po: gsang bar dur khrod bdag po bram ze'i gzugs can: yan lag bzhir rigs kyi yum bzhi: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba'i gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros pas: 'og min chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong chen po nas: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs te: bdag dang slob ma la thim par sgoms shig: oṃ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs shing slob ma dang bum par thim par bsgom: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ ye shes mgon po nag po yi: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur stsol: bla mas: hoḥ bla med ye shes ston pa'i phyir: dbang dang rab tu gnas par bya: de nas maṇḍal phul zhing : dbang bskur ba ni: bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub bum pa ru: bla med mgon po'i lha tshogs bzhugs: bum chu bskyed rim gsal stong ngang : skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badzra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang bskur zhing ngo sprod bya: de nas bhandha thogs la: hūm̐: 'gags med rtsal snang bhandha ru: dam tshig gsang ba'i bdud rtsis bkang : skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: 'gags med gsung gi dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhais dbang bskur zhing ngo sprod bya: de nas me long ngam shel rdo thogs la: hūm̐: rang byung dkyil 'khor bla na med: gsal ba ye shes mgon po'i thugs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rdzogs rim 'od gsal dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang bskur zhing : ngo sprod: de nas gtor ma thogs te:

hūm̐: bla med dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rdzas: rmad byung bha liṃ rgyan dang ldan: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rdzas mchog yon tan dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra gu ya hrī dha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes ngo sprod cing dbang bskur: de nas sku 'bag thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med ngang nyid las: rol rtsal legs ldan nag po ches: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs phrin las dbang thob shog: oṃ karma gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang bskur zhing ngo sprod: de nas dur khrod chas brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: prog zhu cod pan khrag zhag tshom: seng glang zhing lpags thod pa'i phreng : rus rgyan sbrul chun stag sham gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badzra dzñā na shrī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dai nas phyag mtshan thogs te: hūm̐: gri thod tsitta ral gri 'bar: bhandha kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra ka ra ra tri dhā ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas spyan ras gzigs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba thogs nas: hūm̐: rigs bdag 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: yum chen gsang ba mkha' 'gro lngas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: bla med rigs bdag dbang thob shog: oṃ lo ki shwa rī muṃ ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gdong bzhi pa thogs nas: hūm̐: ma hā kā la gdong bzhi pa: 'phags mchog sku yi rnam par sprul: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la shāntiṃ ku ru a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas ma ning thogs la: hūm̐: ma ning nag po bla med mgon: 'phags mchog yon tan rnam par sprul: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la puṣṭiṃ ku ru a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas mgon po phyag drug pa thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa:

'phags mchog gsung gi rnam par sprul: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: khams gsum dbang sdud dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la wa shaṃ ku ru a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas mgon po bram ze thogs la: hūm̐: dur khrod bdag po bram ze'i gzugs: 'phags mchog phrin las rnam par sprul: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ dzwa la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas khro mo bzhi thogs nas: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum chen dbyings phyug bzhi: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i brda gar can: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: tshad med dga' bzhi'i dbang thob shog: oṃ kro ti tsa tur su khaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bla rdo srog 'khor thogs nas: hūm̐: dpal chen ye shes mgon po yi: 'di ni bla rdo srog yig ste: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: sgrub cing bsten pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la ya dā hṛ dha ya sha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rdo rje phur pa g.yas g.yon du gtad cing : hūm̐: thabs shes rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zungs: sbyor sgrol sreg mnan bzlog cing 'phang : las mtha' sdud pa'i khro phur mchog: g.yas g.yon lag tu 'dzin par gyis: oṃ badzra kī la ya mā ra ya dha ha na ba me dhā ra sa ma ya hoḥ zhes dbang bskur zhing ngo sprad: de nas bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: bskyed rim sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin: snang la 'dzin med stong pa'i dbyings: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: dkyil 'khor bum pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra ga lakṣa tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hoḥ bskyed rim stong pa gang shar 'dzin med snang la bdag bzung bral ba me long 'jings logs lta bu bskyed rim bum pa'i dbang thob pa yin no: maṇḍal phul: de nas sngags phreng dang gzungs ma thogs la: hūm̐: ma 'gags zang thal grags stong ngang : zung 'jug bde stong gsang ba'i dbang : dga' bzhi grol lam 'byin 'jug gnad: pho nya sngags kyi dbang thob shog:

oṃ gu hya dzñā na rā ga dhā ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ ma bcos pa stong pa'i rang rtsal rlung 'byin 'jug thams cad rdo rje'i sgra rang byung brag cha lta bu de: 'dzin med ngo bo bde stong chen po longs sku gsang ba'i dbang thob pa yin no: maṇḍal phul: de nas shel rdo thogs te: hūm̐: ka dag ye shes rang byung che: gsal stong ma 'gag chos kyi dbyings: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rdzogs rim 'od gsal dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma dzñā na ma hā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ gsal zhing stong pa chos sku: rang bzhin ma 'gag longs sku: thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku: sna tshogs rang byung ngo bo nyid rig pa'i rang rtsal yin pas: 'gyu ba phra rags thams cad gang shar bzo med du zhog: des chos sku ka dag rdzogs rim 'od gsal chen po ste: tshig dbang bcas thob pa yin no: maṇḍal phul: deng phyin chad ye shes mgon po sde lnga lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin snyam pas: gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa: sogs nas brjod: de nas bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings ngang las rang byung drag po'i sku: shin tu mi bzad dpal ldan nag po che: bla med rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa skyong : ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor: hoḥ deng phyin chad chos skyong mgon po nag po'i sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig rnams mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung dgos te: sku yi dam tshig tu lus rgyan thams cad nag po bya zhing : gnas nag dur khrod dang shing gcig drung du sgrub pa brtson: bya nag dang khyi nag gcan spyang nag po dud 'gro nag po sogs la mi 'tshe: rgyun du rta nag dang g.yag nag rten dar nag po 'chang : rten thugs dang mkhar khang nag po bya zhing : kha bad thod tshal gyis brgyan: gsung gi dam tshig tu: sngags bzlas drag sngags nag po bgrang phreng raksha nag po'i phreng ba: thun nag rdzas:

gsang grogs nag mo bya: thugs kyi dam tshig tu: bla rdo nag po dang bla 'khor dar nag srog yig gri snying 'chang zhing : gzhi nag po mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin la rgyun du gnas par bya: yon tan gyi dam tshig tu: 'bru nag gtor mchod bskang rdzas nag po las sngags brtson zhing ma chag par bya: phrin las kyi dam tshig tu: rbad bsad nag po'i 'khor lo bskor zhing bzlog nag hom nag dgug mnan sogs bya: de ltar khyed rang rnams rgyun du mgon po'i dam tshig ma bral na: bu bzhin du skyong zhing lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'khor te: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnyan po srung ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyad chen gyi rdzong btsan zhing bya ra 'grub par 'gyur ro: zhes gsol ba btab cing bla ma yon gyis mnyes te: chos skyong gtor mas dgyes par bya: rjes snod ldan rnams la mgon po ru mnga' gsol zhal las shes: med kyang mi dgos so: sa ma ya: e maḥ bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: yang gsang mgon po'i dbang mchog bzhag: phyi rabs rig 'dzin rjes 'jug gis: dbang dang lag len ldan gyur na: brgyud pa bdun tshun mgon po dngos: de phyir snying gi thig le nyid: chos skyong yi dam dbyer med de: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i sprul: gang 'dul khro bo'i cha lugs tsam: don la sa bcu'i mgon po'o: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling dang sprod: bya rog gdong can rgya 'di srungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas padma sbas pa'i tshal nas lcags byi zla ba dgu pa'i nyer lngar mtsho nag klu bdud kyi lag nas/ khrom gter du bgyis te padma chos 'byung gsang ba'i gling du shog ser nas bsgyur ro// // kha) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i dgra chos byad ma snying 'byin nag po bzhugs so:

ma hā kā la khrag 'thung nag por 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang ye shes mgon po grub pa'i rnam 'byor pas: mtha' sdud las kyi rim pa bstan pa ni: 'di la don gnyis te: thog mar khungs btsun pa lo rgyus bstan par bya ba las: sngon rgya gar du rig 'dzin chen po phung byed shāntiṃ garbha bam ri khrag mtsho zhes pa'i mdun du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la gshegs pas: lam kha zhig na bud med dmar mo rus pa'i rgyan khrol le ba lag tu lcags kyi phur bu thogs pa zhig la 'phrad: bud med des na re: brtul zhugs kyi rnal 'byor pa gang du gshegs yul 'di tshang tshing phyi pa'i gling phyag na rdo rje yang skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas yin: 'di'i shar phyogs su khrag 'thung gi rgyal po ma hā kā la srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur nus pa: sku'i cha la ba spu'i bu ga re re nas dmar chen chu bo dal ldan tsam 'bab pa rtag tu dur khrod kyi sha khrag la dgyes shing : ma mo 'bum la rol ba sde brgyad thams cad pho nyar 'gyed cing skye 'gro'i las kun la dbang bsgyur ba yod de: khyod kyis mthong na yang bzod par yang mi rigs so: zhes brjod pa'i tshe: slob dpon shāntiṃ garbhas lan du gsol pa: 'o na dpal ma hā kā la de bsgrub na nus pa 'byin sam 'bras bu gang du 'dod ces pas: lan du gtab pa: khyod brtul zhugs kyi rnal 'byor pa nus ldan zhig yin pa 'dra ste: da dung spyod pa lam du ma lhong ba yin: ye shes mgon pos 'bras bu mchog dang thun mong kun 'grub: phrin las myur bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung nus: khyod khrag mtsho can gyi byang phyogs su gshegs dang : dur khrod shin tu rgya che ba zhig yod: de'i dbus su dur khrod kyi bdag po legs ldan skabs su 'gyu zhing gnas pa'i shing gcig kun las 'phags pa mi nor ba'i rtags dang ldan pa zhig yod: shing de'i mdun du pha wang nag po bya rog lto ba sbyor ba'i dbyibs can yod:

de'i nang du ma hā kā la'i srog sgrub gri gug brtsegs pa yod: de khyod kyis 'byin zhing bsgrubs pas bsad pa'i las kun dmod pa bor chog gi bden pas dor nus par 'gyur ro: zhes lung bstan pa bzhin gshegs pas: shing gcig de ni tsandan nus pa lnga tshang ba me dud kyi rgyun mi chad skem skem du 'thul ba de'i mdun du: sngar lung bstan pa'i pha wang de yod pas gter 'byin pa'i thabs ma mchis pa las: sngar gyi bud med de glo bur du lhags nas: lag tu thogs pa'i lcags phur de gtad nas 'dis phyungs shig bgyis nas gar yang mi snang bar gyur: lcags phur de pha wang la tshad pas dum bur gtor ba las byung ba kho bo buddha dzñā nas brda gnyis 'gyur du gtab pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas gnubs ston gyi shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ga) bka' brgyad chen po gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i las byang rngam pa 'od klong yangs pa bzhugs so: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag por 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: legs ldan nag po'i sgrub pa bstan: sangs rgyas bstan srung srog shing nyid: chos skyong yongs kyi ded dpon mchog: rin chen zab gter kun gyi bdag: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs las sprul: ye shes khro rgyal chen po nyid: thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa'i mdzod: yang zab mgon po'i sgrub pa 'di: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro skal ldan thugs kyi sras: padma'i ming dang 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dpal mgon po nag po bsgrub pa'i thabs: bkra shis yid 'ong dge ba'i tshal: yang na dur khrod shing gcig drung : ri rngam chu sgra nags 'jigs shing : brag phug me long 'dra ba sogs: rgyud lung rtags dang mthun pa'i sar: dug khrag ro sol la sogs pa'i: shin tu nag pa'i dal kyang bcag: las thig dkyil 'khor lha grangs ltar: tshom bu dag gis legs par brgyan: bhandha lcang lo mtshan ldan nang : rten gtor rgyan gyis mdzes par bzhag: bdud rtsi sman raka dag kyang gtams: bum pa cha tshang rdzas chus bkang : mda' mo sgro gsum legs pa la: dar nag gdugs dang cod pan 'phur: bla 'khor srog gi bla rdo dang : me long gri rkang rdo rje phur: brgyan te rten du 'dzugs par bya: sku 'bag la sogs spyan gzigs bsham: phyi nang mchod pa gzhung bzhin bsgrig: bde ba'i stan la shar du gyu: de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: ka dag kun gzhi'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: ma 'gags tshogs drug cir snang chos kyi sku: yengs med rtse gcig dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs: skyabs yul rang byung de bzhin bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum: sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ 'khor 'das mnyam zh-ing snod bcud dag pa'i zhing : kun gzhi ma bcos ye nas sems bskyed bral: mtha' bral sems can bdag gzhan gnyis su med: de don rig pas kun gzhi sems bskyed do: dang po dkar gtor btang zhing : gnyis pa bgegs la bka' yang bsgo: de nas bgegs gtor chu gtsang gis bran: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis brlab: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje legs ldan nag po yi: thugs las sprul pa ye shes pho nya'i tshogs: steng 'og phyogs bcur bar med khyab par 'phros: gnod byed 'byung po log 'dren bgegs kyi rigs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur bar khug: oṃ badzra shrī ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po karṣa ya dzaḥ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po lan chags rigs:

'dod yon glud dang gtor ma 'di khyer la: so so rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis: gal te mi 'gro 'di ru 'tshe byed na: rdo rje gri gug mtshon cha'i char chen gyis: log 'dren 'byung po'i mgo lus phye mar gtub: rdul phran bzhin du ming yang med par byed: de bas so so rang rang gnas su dengs: gnod byed 'byung po thams cad mā ra mā ra bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags sogs bzlas shing thun gyis brab: de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: rdo rje nag po khro rgyal thugs ka nas: srung ba'i 'khor lo me dpung mtshon cha 'phros: so bsnol drwa mig bya khyung nag pos gtams: bskal pa'i me ri smug nag tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: phra mo rlung yang 'gyu bar mi thar ba'i: sra mkhregs ting 'dzin rdo rje'i gur khang gyur: oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa oṃ ka ra te ka tsakra rakṣa: oṃ khaḍga tsakra rakṣa: oṃ tri shu la tsakra rakṣa: oṃ raṃ dzwa la tsakra rakṣa: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: dang : oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis sbyangs: hūm̐: phyi yi mchod pa spyan gzigs sna tshogs bkram: bskang rdzas sgrub rdzas mthun rdzas ma lus pa: sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon bkang ba: ye shes mgon po mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: de nas nang mchod byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: bhandha lcang lo stong gsum mnyam pa'i dbus: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa mtsho ltar 'khyil: rakta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs chi li li: gsang mchod byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i rgyun: ye shes mgon po mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ de nas gtor mchod byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: lhun grub bhandha rin chen snod mchog tu: dam rdzas ba liṃ gtor ma ri ltar spungs: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag dbang pos brgyan:

ye shes mgon po mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta āḥhūm̐: zhes byin gyis brlabs: de nas 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐: ye nas kun gzhi stong pa'i dbyings: rang byung rtsal gyi 'od zer shar: sna tshogs sprul pa'i sa bon hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: de nas 'byung ba rim lngar brtseg pa ni: hūm̐: e las chos 'byung nam mkha' mthing : yam̐ las rlung lnga'i rgya gram bsnol: ram̐ las bskal pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: kham̐ las rakta'i rba rlabs khol: sum̐ las sa gzhi smug nag khyab: keṃ las keng rus dur khrod chags: bhrūm̐ las thod mkhar 'jigs su rung : om̐ bhrūm̐ bi shwa tsakra hūm̐: a tsand+ra maṇḍa la: ma sūrya maṇḍa la: paṃ padma maṇḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: badzra tsakra bhrūm̐ dzñā na hoḥ de nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: yi ge bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang : bhandha skam rlon brtsegs pa yi: rab 'jigs drag po'i thod mkhar ni: rmang gzhi gnam lcags ur mo bsnol: gru bzhi sgo bzhi mthongs skar phyes: ka gdung lha klu srin lpags bkab: g.yang gzhi rgyal mtshan thod pa'i tog: phyi rol dur khrod mtshon cha'i gur: bskal pa'i me ri smug nag 'khrigs: nang na rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: bam ro skam rlon lhu dum 'khrol: mi lpags stag lpags g.yang gzhi bres: don snying rnam lnga 'phan ldi 'phyangs: de dbus chos 'byung padma dang : bam chen smug po'i gdan gyi steng : hūm̐ las byung ba'i nag po che: khrag 'thung legs ldan phyag bzhi pa: sma ra dbu skra dmar ser 'bar: thod skam prog zhu dar nag 'phur: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khyil: thal chen tshom bu sindhu ra: khrag zhag thig le zo ris bzhag: g.yas gnyis gri gug tsitta dang : g.yon gnyis bhan dmar kha ṭwāṃ gaḥ

sku la seṅge'i g.yang gzhi gsol: rus rgyan g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas: sgeg cing sbom la yan lag rags: gsus khyim zlum la rab tu 'khyil: phyed skyil dgyes pa'i rngam stabs bzhugs: yum mchog dpal 'bar tsaṇḍi ma: dmar mo khro 'dzum gzi 'od 'bar: gri thod yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha 'khrol: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: zung 'jug bde chen rgyas par bsgom: spyi gtsug nyi zla padma'i steng : rigs kyi bdag po spyan ras gzigs: zhi zhing khro 'dzum rin chen brgyan: dmar gsal rdo rje bhandha 'dzin: thugs rje'i bdag nyid phyed skyil bzhugs: ye shes mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'khril: nor bu 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud: rus rgyan zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril: phyogs bzhir gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan ni: khro 'dzum rus pa'i rgyan ldan gar: g.yas pas cang te'u chos sgra sgrog: g.yon pas bhandha bdud rtsi bsnams: brda skad sgrog cing chags tshul bsgom: hūm̐: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir 'khor lo'i rtsibs: shar phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: hūm̐ las yon tan bla med skyes: ye shes mgon po ma ning sku: mthing nag gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs ber nag gsol: tsandan beng chen sked par bcug: zhabs gnyis rol stabs bam steng 'gying : lho phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: hūm̐ las sku yi mgon po nag: ma hā kā la gdong bzhi pa: g.yas gnyis gri gug tsandan beng : g.yon gnyis bhandha rtse gsum 'dzin: khro gtum dur khrod chas dang ldan: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ro gdan 'gying : nub phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: hūm̐ las gsung gi mgon po ni: sku mdog mthing nag phyag drug pa: gri gug thod phreng cang te'u g.yas: thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ zhags pa g.yon: khro zhing dgyes la dur khrod chas: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ro yi gdan: byang phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du:

hūm̐ las phrin las mgon po smug: bram gzugs dur khrod bdag po ni: khro 'dzum rus pa'i rgyan drug can: phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u 'khrol: g.yon pas gri rkang gling bu 'bud: stag sham rus rgyan ro gdan 'gying : mtshams bzhir gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro bzhi: gri thod kha ṭwāṃ dku la brten: rus rgyan dor stabs ro gdan 'gying : khro 'dzum yab la dgyes par bsgom: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yi: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams: chu zla bzhin du gsal bar bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od zer 'phros pas spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes sha chen gyi gsur btang zhing mi rkang gi gling bu gtser: rol mo dang bcas nas: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong : 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: ye shes mgon po gshegs su gsol: nag po chen po gshegs su gsol: legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol: ma hā kā la gshegs su gsol: mgon chen sde lnga gshegs su gsol: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gshegs su gsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya: sa pa ri wā ra he dza dza dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang drag po'i gnas mchog tu: khrag mtsho padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs ma lus kun: mi g.yo bdag la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: om̐ badzra sa ma ya: tiṣṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen nag po khrag 'thung rgyal: dpa' bo gyad kyi ya dor can: drag pos sa bcu gnon mdzad pa: legs ldan mgon por bdag bstod do: om̐ na mo a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mi lpags g.yang gzhi bla bre mkha' la bres: rgyu ma'i lda ldi 'phan gdugs sna tshogs 'phyangs: mda' mo sgro gsum dar nag 'phan gdugs brgyan: bla rdo srog 'khor me long phyag mtshan dang :

nam mkha'i rgyan gyur bya nag lang ling 'phur: rta nag cang shes tshogs ni 'tsher skad tser: g.yag nag zhol chen tshogs ni ngar sgra sgrog: lug nag dpyi dkar tshogs ni 'ba' sgra 'byin: khyi nag snying dkar tshogs ni dgra sha rngam: mi nag nag mo gcer bu gar rtsed bsgyur: dug sbrul nag po'i tshogs ni 'khyug cing 'greng : tsitta nam mkha' nag po sprin ltar gtibs: rten gtor bshos bu nag po ri ltar brjid: dom nag la sogs gcan spyang sna tshogs ngar: g.yab dar ru dar rten dar nag po sogs: go khrab brjid ldan rno ngar mtshon cha gzengs: dur khrod pho brang spyan gzigs sna tshogs 'di: ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang ba'i khro mo ma sring tshogs la 'bul: mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskang ba ni: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : yum chen khro mo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la nā tha pañtsa ḍākki nī sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: dgra bgegs dbang po'i me tog phung por brtsegs: sha chen gu gul dri spos dud sprin 'khrigs: rkang dang lha ba'i sgron me nyi ltar gsal: dgra bgegs snying khrag dri chab mtsho ltar 'khyil: 'bru nag 'bras kyi bshos bu ri ltar brjid: thod rnga gsang rnga rkang gling rol mo ldir: sna tshogs dgyes pa'i mchod sprin gtibs pa 'di: ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang ba'i khro mo ma sring tshogs la 'bul: mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskang ba ni:

rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : yum chen khro mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la nā tha pañtsa ḍākki nī badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ga pur dzā ti dri mchog sna tshogs dang : legs par sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi sman mchod gtams: bde stong yid 'dzin lha mo sna tshogs la: zung 'jug sbyor te bsdus pa'i bdud rtsi dang : dbyings phyug bzang mo'i dmar chen rakta 'khyil: thabs chen rdo rje'i byang sems zla ltar rgyas: bhandha'i snod du bha ling gtor ma la: pha rol dgra bgegs sha khrag rus kyis brgyan: sgrol mchod la sogs dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'di: ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang ba'i khro mo ma sring tshogs la 'bul: mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskang ba ni: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : yum chen khro mo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la nā tha pañtsa ḍākki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta hrī ṭha bha lingta māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha kha khā hi:

de nas bdud rtsi lag gis mchod pa ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: 'chi med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di: drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos sku kun tu bzang po'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: longs sku spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku padma 'byung gnas zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: yi dam sgrub chen bka' brgyad zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos skyong mgon po phyag bzhi'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: ma ning dpal 'bar chen po'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: legs ldan gdong bzhi nag po'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: phyag drug yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: dur khrod bdag po bram ze'i gzugs kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsang ba'i khro mo sde lnga'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: dam can rgya mtsho gter gyi srung ma rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐:

zhes bdud rtsi lag mchod bya: de nas bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: deng 'dir bdag cag sgrub pa'i sgor zhugs nas: phyi nang dam tshig nyams shing 'gal ba dang : dam rdzas ma tshang tshogs gtor chag pa dang : sgo gsum bag med dam 'gal ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib tshangs par 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: ces yig brgya sogs bzlas shing lhag chad bkang : de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: dbyangs snyan pa dang bcas nas: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: chos dbyings thod mkhar e yi dal dbus su: legs ldan mgon po khrag 'thung phyag bzhi pa: sku mdog smug nag char sprin gtibs pa'i gzugs: dbu skra dmar ser srid rtse'i dbyings la bskyod: thod skam dbu rgyan snang srid dregs pa 'dul: dar nag cod pan ma sring mkha' 'gro sdud: a ra smin ma tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyen mthur gzigs: seng lpags gsol zhing snyan grags phyogs bcur sgrog: rus pa'i rgyan ldan g.yer kha 'u ru ru: lhu tshigs sbrul rgyan klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul: khrag zhag thig le thal tshom rgyan gyis spras: sgeg cing dgyes pas ye shes 'jig rten sngangs: phyag g.yas gri gug bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod: tsitta 'dzin kyang pha rol glo snying rol: ral gri 'bar bas bgegs dpung dum bur gtub: g.yon pas bhan dmar dam nyams klad khrag rol: kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin pas dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: gsus pa 'khyil bas 'gro ba'i tshe bsod sdud: phyed skyil rol stabs 'khor 'das zil gyis gnon: bam chen gdan bzhugs khrag 'thung nag por bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog lha mo dpal 'bar ma: shes rab rang bzhin dmar gsal gzi 'od 'bar: khro 'dzum mdangs ldan dga' bzhi bde stong bskul: phyag g.yas gri gug skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: g.yon pas bhan dmar dug lnga'i rakta stob:

rus pa'i rgyan ldan phar phyin spyod pa'i yum: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril dga' bzhi'i brda skad 'byin: tsaṇḍi dpal 'bar khro mo'i sku la bstod: hūm̐: spyi bor 'od dpung nyi zer gzi 'bar dbus: rigs kyi bdag po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: dmar gsal mdangs ldan ye shes mi g.yo ngang : khro 'dzum spyan gyis mkha' dbyings phyogs bcur gzigs: rdo rje bhandha bden gnyis 'du 'bral med: phyed skyil lham me 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog dmar gsal 'od lnga'i mdangs: 'dzum zhal dgyes shing mnyen lcug rus rgyan mdzes: phyag g.yas nor bu thabs 'gog dpa' bo sdud: g.yon pa'i padmas ma sring las la bskul: mnyen lcug zhabs 'khril bde stong ye shes ngang : yum mchog shes rab sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi ye shes gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan khro 'dzum mdzes: rin chen rus rgyan sgrub la dngos grub ster: mnyen lcug 'khril ldan dgyes nyams sgeg pa mo: phyag g.yas cang te'us dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sdud: g.yon pa'i bdud rtsis rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring : nu 'bur bha ga rgyas shing gar sgyur ma: ma gcig ye shes ḍākki sde bzhir bstod: hūm̐: rab tu 'khrigs pa'i dur khrod sprin nag can: khrag mtsho me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: gnyis med mgon po ma ning khro bo'i rgyal: sku mdog mthing nag bla med rgyud sde'i sprul: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril khro gtum sa gsum sngangs: dbu skra thod skam me zor ya la la: phyag g.yas gri gug bstan dgra'i srog dbugs phral: g.yon pas bhan dmar dam nyams klad khrag gsol: mun pa'i lhub chen dug lnga zil gyis gnon: dur khrod chas ldan 'dre rgod dmag dpung zlog: tsandan beng chen bdud 'dul dmag gi gter: brkyang bskum gar stabs bsgyur la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: ti se chen po gangs kyi pho brang dbus: myur mgyogs sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon pa: ma hā kā la gdong bzhi mthu bo che: sku mdog nag po mun pa'i tshwa zer 'phro: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: dbu skra'i gseb nas bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: thod skam 'bar ba'i prog zhu dar dmar 'phur: g.yas pas gri gug bdud bzhi rtsad nas gzhom: tsandan beng chen gdug pa'i g.yul ngo zlog: g.yon pas bhan dmar rakta zhal du 'dren: nyams pa bsgral phyir kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum phyar: dur khrod chas ldan bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel: brkyang bskum tshul bstan ma hā kā lar bstod: hūm̐: dur khrod chen po rab 'jigs bsil ba tshal: gdug pa'i shing drung ro langs 'tshogs pa'i dbus: dpal chen mgon po mthing nag phyag drug pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: dbu skra thod skam me yi bu yug 'tshubs: g.yas pas gri gug byad ma'i mgo lus phral: ḍā ma ru yis ma mo dbang du sdud: thod phreng 'dzin pas dmod pa'i drag sngags 'dren: g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dre rgod snying khrag rol: kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin pas dug gsum dbyings su sgrol: bdud zhags nag pos bstan dgra sgos dgra 'ching : dur khrod chas ldan 'byung po gdon tshogs 'joms: brkyang bskum gar ldan nag po che la bstod: hūm̐: rngam drag tshal gyi dur khrod ha ha rgod: bam chen gsar rnying ri ltar brtsegs pa'i dbus: dur khrod bdag po mgon po bram ze'i gzugs: smug nag khro 'dzum dbu skra spyi bor bcings: thod skam dbu rgyan srid gsum zil gyis gnon: phyag g.yas cang te'us dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bskul: g.yon pas rkang gling snang srid dbang du sdud: rus pa'i rgyan ldan dregs pa bran du bkol: gar stabs tshul gyis phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs 'joms: bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo che la bstod: hūm̐: chos 'byung e yi klong dkyil nas:

las kyi yum chen mkha' 'gro bzhi: mthing nag khro 'dzum bhyo sgra sgrog: thor tshugs skra grol sku rgyab khebs: rigs lnga'i rgyan ldan dar dpyangs 'phur: gri gug nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod: bhan dmar dam nyams snying khrag 'thung : kha ṭwāṃ dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: rus rgyan ldan gyis mkha' 'gro sdud: gcer mo nu ma bha ga rgyas: brkyang bskum gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro rigs bzhir bstod: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang skyong ba yi: ye shes dang ni las grub pa: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhing skyong tshogs: ma sring shugs 'gro yang 'khor 'bum: phyi nang skyong ba'i lha la bstod: 'dzab bskul ni: hūm̐: dpal chen mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: drag sngags hūm̐ gis 'brug sgra ldir: phyi nang bar chad dbyings su sgrol: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin sngags 'chang la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: 'dzab kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: spros pas ye shes 'dod yon dgyes: tshur 'dus bdag gis dngos grub thob: ma grub bar du mi gtang bzung : phrin las sgrub pa'i dus la bab: thugs dam gnad nas da bskul cig: rigs bdag la: om̐ ā wa lo ki te ḍākki pañtsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ rtsa sngags ni: om̐ ma hā kā la nā tha pañtsa kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ bhyoḥ las sngags ni: om̐ ma hā kā la ya kṣeṃ kṣeṃ ma tri tsa tri hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma ning sngags ni: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ga na gu hya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gdong bzhi pa la: om̐ ma hā kā la mu kha tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ phyag drug pa la: om̐ ma hā kā la kṣeṃ kṣeṃ ṭa ka ra ṣa ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ dur khrod bdag po la: om̐ ma hā kā la u ta a tsarya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas khro mo rigs bzhi la: om̐ ma tri ḍākki kro ti tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags rnams 'grub pa'i las rim ltar bzla: de nas drag sngags ni: om̐ ma hā kā la kro ta raṃ he ru ka kro ti ma tri da sha tsaṇḍa ya hūm̐:

drag sngags rnams rgyun du bgrang mi dgos: de nas dgra bo rbad bsad kyi sngags ni: dgra bo byad ma gdon gyi rigs: glo bur bsad thabs shin tu zab: 'gyang na 'di nyid lan gcig bskyar: ma spel gsang rgya sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: legs ldan mgon po ma hā kā la ya: nag po chen po khrag 'thung lha tshogs la: dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe ba rnams: khro rgyal drag po'i mngon spyod stobs kyis sgrol: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang : thugs dam bskang zhing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya nā tha pañtsa ḍākki nī hūm̐ bhyoḥ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa tsitta rakta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: zhes thun gtor phul: de nas mnga' gsol bya ba ni: gser skyems gtong zhing : hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: nag po chen po gshegs su gsol: legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol: khrag 'thung nag po gshegs su gsol: rnal 'byor dgra lha gshegs su gsol: mgon chen sde lnga gshegs su gsol: yum chen lha mo gshegs su gsol: sprul pa yang sprul gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: legs ldan dpal 'bar chen po dgongs: gri rkang gling bu'i gdangs kyis 'bod: gu gul sha chen spos kyis bsu: sna tshogs bam gyi gdan la bzhugs: sngon gyi tha tshig dran par gyis: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang gis: ci ltar bsgos pa'i bka' bzhin du: do nub bsnyen pa'i rdzas la 'khor: do nub sngags 'chang bdag la gson: do nub dgyes pa'i gtang rag gtong : do nub snyan pa'i gdangs kyis bstod: do nub mthun pa'i phud cig mchod: do nub mnga' gsol gser skyems 'bul: rten rdzas 'di la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: legs ldan mgon po nag po phyag bzhi pa: bla mar mnga' gsol rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs: theg chen chos sgra sgrog par mnga' gsol lo:

chos skur mnga' gsol sku mdog smug nag brjid: gsang sngags chos 'khor skyong bar mnga' gsol lo: rigs lngar mnga' gsol spyi bor thod phreng brgyan: 'gro kun thugs rjes skyong bar mnga' gsol lo: khro bor mnga' gsol zhal gdangs spyan rtsa 'khrug: log 'dren cham la 'bebs par mnga' gsol lo: bdud 'dul mnga' gsol gri gug tsitta bsnams: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mnga' gsol lo: chos skyong mnga' gsol 'og mas ral gri 'dzin: pha rol srog snying phral bar mnga' gsol lo: ma mor mnga' gsol g.yon pas bhan dmar bsnams: nad rims dal kha 'joms par mnga' gsol lo: dam can mnga' gsol 'og mas rtse gsum thogs: dug lnga dbyings su sgrol bar mnga' gsol lo: klu rgyal mnga' gsol yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan: ma rungs sa bdag 'joms par mnga' gsol lo: stobs ldan mnga' gsol seng lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: snang srid las la dgyes par mnga' gsol lo: gter bdag mnga' gsol rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: zab chos bstan pa'i bya rar mnga' gsol lo: ma sring mnga' gsol yum mchog pang du 'khyud: zab gter bla med rgyas par mnga' gsol lo: dkyil 'khor mnga' gsol phyed skyil bam gdan bzhugs: bdud dang dam sri tshar gcod mnga' gsol lo: hūm̐: yon tan mnga' gsol dpal 'bar ma ning sku: a ti theg chen sgron mer mnga' gsol lo: hūm̐: sku mchog mnga' gsol legs ldan gdong bzhi pa: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya rar mnga' gsol lo: hūm̐: gsung mchog mnga' gsol dpal mgon phyag drug pa: sgrub mchog dgos 'dod 'byung bar mnga' gsol lo: hūm̐: phrin las mnga' gsol bram ze dur khrod bdag: brgyud 'dzin bu bzhin skyong bar mnga' gsol lo: hūm̐: rten 'brel mnga' gsol rigs bzhi'i yum chen bzhi: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i grogs su mnga' gsol lo: hūm̐: nag po chen por mnga' gsol lo: legs ldan nag por mnga' gsol lo: rnal 'byor dgra lhar mnga' gsol lo:

rig 'dzin srung mar mnga' gsol lo: khrag 'thung phyag bzhir mnga' gsol lo: stobs ldan nag por mnga' gsol lo: dpal 'bar ma ning mnga' gsol lo: phyag drug nor bur mnga' gsol lo: mgon po bram zer mnga' gsol lo: phyi nang srung mar mnga' gsol lo: hūm̐: mnga' gsol gser skyems 'di bzhes la: bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra: g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma rtul: brten pa'i tshe na phrag ma dog: bskul ba'i tshe na rgyang ma ring : sgrub pa'i tshe na rtags ma zhan: rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung : gsol ba'i tshe na mgu ma dka': bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la phaiṃ phaiṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ya ya bhyo bhyoḥ gser skyems mchod cing phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: de nas tshogs bya ba ni: chu gtsang gis bran la: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bdag nyid yi dam thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge 'phros: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las: 'dod yon zad med dbyings dang mnyam: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs: dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: chos sku kun bzang yab yum la: zhi ba bzhi bcu'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lnga ldan longs sku'i pho brang nas: longs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang la: sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'gag med sprul sku'i pho brang nas: sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la: rig 'dzin grub thob tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: khrag 'thung e yi pho brang nas: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs la: phyi nang srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas khang 'di la byin cig phob: tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo la:

mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: chos sku kun bzang zhi khro'i lha: ye shes mgon po'i tshogs dang bcas: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: de nas bsgral bstab ni: tha ma bshams la: hūm̐: mdun du lcags khang nag po rngam 'thug dbus: nṛ tri dmar nag byad ma mngon sum gsal: hūm̐: rtsa brgyud mchog gsum dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: khro rgyal mgon chen 'dus pa'i bden pa dang : ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu stobs kyis: bstan dgra sgos dgra gdug cing sdang ba'i tshogs: steng 'og phyogs bcu khams gsum gar gnas kyang : rang dbang med par tha ma'i liṅgar khug: 'gugs shing bsdoms nas myos shing bskrad par gyis: oṃ ma hā la trag thur ya: dur yag dur yag: dgra bo nṛ tri a karṣa ya dza dzaḥ trig tri shag thum rbad: de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i khro rgyal che: srog bdag nag po las mkhan bya rog gdong : las byed shan pa phur bu phyag na bsgril: rno dbal gzir 'debs stong gsum tshwa tshwas khengs: gdug cing sdang ba'i dam nyams 'di nyid kyi: dkar nag snying gi mtshams su kī la ya: oṃ badzra ma hā kā la tsaṇḍa nā tha khā kha mu kha hūm̐: badzra kī li kī la ya trig ra tsa byad ma'i snying la rbad rbad: myog thum baṃ ril shag tshal pa nan:

de nas btub cing zhal du 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: khro rgyal mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: lhag med chos dbyings ngang la bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: zhes bdud rtsi sman raka bran zhing : rtsa sngags kyis phul kyang chog go: de nas dngos grub la rol ba ni: oṃ: chos dbyings ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang : 'khor 'das zung 'jug rang bzhin can: nga bdag 'dzin pa'i g.ya' bral nas: bde stong ye shes ngang du rol: ces phyag rgya pad kor bya zhing blang : mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam: de nas lhag ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: ma 'di nas u tsa la yi gnas: rab tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod nas: gnas nyul las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: yang 'khor sha za bye ba stong : gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: zas su māṃ sa sha la dgyes: skom du skyems bzang khrag la 'thung : las su dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod: rnal 'byor kun gyi tshogs khang nyul: dur khrod las kyi ma mo 'bum: sha khrag lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor mas: rtags dang mtshan bzang myur du ston: nyams pa'i dgra bo cham la phob: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma mo ḍākki ma tri ma bhyo bhyoḥ bha lingta khā hi: de nas rnga brdung dung bus raktas bran cing gtor ma la dpal 'bar 'dzugs la: thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung e yi klong : kun rgyu mtshan ma mi mnga' yang : gang 'dul 'jigs byed so sor ston: rdo rje gdan gyi shar lho'i mtshams: rab 'jigs dur khrod bsil ba tshal: nags 'dabs chu klung 'bebs pa'i mtha': gdug pa'i tsandan rkang gcig la: nyin mo dud pa'i mun nag 'khrigs: mtshan mo bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: dus drug sha za sprin ltar gtibs:

rtse mor ye shes mkha' 'gro 'tshogs: rtsa bar gcan spyang ro za 'gyu: dur bya sna tshogs skad ngan sgrog: bam ro skam rlon ri ltar nyil: gdug pa'i keng rus gar stabs sgyur: las kyi ma mo'i dmag tshogs rngam: khrag mtsho 'khyil zhing rlangs pa phyur: dbus su thod pa'i sku mkhar ni: dmar nag zur gsum dbyings dang mnyam: gnas der bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo che: khrag 'thung ma hā kā la ya: legs ldan nag po srin po'i bdag: bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can: snang srid srog gi bdag po che: ye shes 'jig rten khro bo dang : yang 'khor sha za 'bum gyis bskor: ma thogs bzhengs la gnas 'dir gshegs: dri rkang gling bu'i gdangs kyis 'bod: gri snying dar nag g.yab cing 'bod: gu gul sha chen dri yis bdug: sha khrag 'bru nag rdzas kyis mchod: hūm̐: legs ldan mgon po nag po che: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa las: khrag 'thung sku lnga yongs rdzogs bzhengs: ye shes rtsal lnga'i klong nas bzhengs: dug lnga 'joms pa'i klong nas bzhengs: khrag 'thung legs ldan bzhengs pa'i tshe: bskal pa'i me 'bar 'u ru ru: drag po'i glog dmar khyugs se khyug: ngan sngags 'brug sgra di ri ri: dug gi ser ba hri li li: gnam lcags thog rgod sha ra ra: gzi brjid tshwa tshwa si li li: dar nag g.yab mo lings se ling : ru dar mtshon cha zengs se seng : bya nag gshog 'gyur lings se ling : na bun rlung nag tshubs se tshub: zor bzlog spu gri wa la la: las kyi dmag dpung thibs se thib: dgra sha khrag mchod 'bru nag gi: dmar nag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba dang : dben ri chos 'khor gnyan po bshig: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor la: do bsdo phod btsugs 'gras 'tshol ba'i: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: dmag sna jag sna ston pa dang : 'phrog bcom lam nas sgug pa yi:

dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: gnam sa gling bzhir gar gnas kyang : bla tshe rnam shes rten dang phrol: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: yang sprul las kyi bshan pa 'bum: ru tra'i bla srog khyer la shog: hūm̐: legs ldan phyag bzhi dgra la bhyoḥ bdud rgyal ma ning dgra la bhyoḥ nag po gdong bzhi dgra la bhyoḥ myur mgyogs phyag drug dgra la bhyoḥ bram ze ging chen dgra la bhyoḥ beng chen nag po dgra la bhyoḥ gri gug nag po dgra la bhyoḥ a gho nag po dgra la bhyoḥ gur ldan nag po dgra la bhyoḥ stag zhon nag po dgra la bhyoḥ chos shig dmag dpung dgra la chos: ru mtshon nag po dgra la g.yobs: spu gri mtshon char dgra la phob: dgra bo'i yul zhing mgo mjug ldog: dgra bo'i srung skyob phye mar gtor: phung thal sna dgu dgra la zlog: byad zor phur kha dgra la zlog: shwa khram rtsis kha dgra la zlog: nad yams dal kha dgra la zlog: gro rags btso brgyad dgra la zlog: 'dre rgod 'byung po dgra la zlog: lo skag zla skag dgra la zlog: dus skag 'chi skag dgra la zlog: mi rung sna dgu dgra la zlog: hūm̐: bzlog zor nag po dgra la ya: dug zor nag po dgra la ya: khrag zor nag po dgra la ya: rdo zor nag po dgra la ya: thun zor nag po dgra la ya: tshe zor nag po dgra la ya: gri zor nag po dgra la ya: mda' zor nag po dgra la ya: thod zor nag po dgra la ya: me zor dbal kha dgra la ya: zor bhyo thun bhyo mā ra ya: rbad bhyo raṃ bhyo mā ra ya: oṃ ka la ha la ya: dgra bo nṛ tri thum zlog zlog: rakta myog thum ya dgra bo zlog zlog: sha la gzer thum ya dgra bo zlog zlog: thun dza shag dza ya dgra bo zlog zlog: ka la a purtsi dgra bo zlog zlog: ka la khaḍga dgra bo zlog zlog: ha la na ṇa ya dgra bo zlog zlog: ha la bhandha ya dgra bo zlog zlog: dzwa la raṃ raṃ ya dgra bo zlog zlog: rbad ya bzlog ya thum myog dril chod chod bhyo bhyoḥ

bzlog bzlog: ces gtor ma 'phangs shing dgra bo'i yul khang thams cad gnam lcags thog gis bshig pa ltar phye mar btang bar bsgom: de nas chad mdo gtong ba ni: gtor ma bran zhing rol mo dang bcas nas: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min chos dbyings pho brang dbus: kun bzang dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas: yang gsang bla med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dregs pa dam btags khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: tha tshig bzhin du phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de 'og 'jig rten bar bskal gnyis pa ru: legs ldan mgon po ma gcig dpal 'bar gnyis: gri gug las rgyud dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: 'byung po dam btags khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: tha tshig bzhin du phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og brag dmar dpal gyi mchims phu ru: padma 'byung gnas ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: gsang ba zil gnon gnyer gtad bskos pa'i tshe: dpal mgon srung mas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: tha tshig ma nor bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: padma sbas tshal bal phu mtsho 'brog nas: gter bdag gling dang las kyi ḍākki gnyis: rgya mtsho'i klong nas gter sgrom gdan drangs tshe: gnyer gtad srung mas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: tha tshig bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe rig 'dzin pad 'byung gi: bka' dang dam la gnas pa yi: ye shes 'jig rten srung ma kun: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor skyong : bstan pa'i bya ra ma g.yel bar: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma hā dzñā na ya pa la kṣeṃ ya kṣe ṭa kro ta sarba lo ka pa la ya bha lingta khā hi: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: ting 'dzin sgyu las ngang grub ma: 'jig rten bde skyong brtan ma sman:

don la chos sku'i rang rtsal te: gnas nyul dus 'dzin bcu gnyis tshogs: sman mo bzhi dang skyong ma bzhi: sha za bzhi ste mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: lhab lhub dar dpyangs pu ru ru: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: glu len bshugs sgra kyu ru ru: sna tshogs zhon rta sga ra ra: gtor len myur 'gros khyugs se khyug: pad kor phyag rgya lings se ling : 'jo sgeg mdzes 'phrog brtan ma'i tshogs: mchod gtor 'dod yon 'di bzhes la: zab chos gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badzra ḍākki ma tri ma mo kro ti ya bha lingta la khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul zhing bstan pa'i mel tshe bsgrubs par bsam: de nas rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: che mchog khro rgyal 'dus pa'i bro: g.yas pas chem chem dgra bo mnan: kro ti yum chen 'dus pa'i bro: g.yon pas mnan mnan bgegs dpung gzhom: gnyis med mgon chen 'dus pa'i bro: bstan dgra sgos dgra thal bar rlog: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar bzed la mchod pa gang rung 'bul: tshe 'gugs bya: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mkha' 'gros bskor: mgyogs ma sgo skyong mda' dar bum pa 'dzin: snang srid tshe bsod bcud bsdus bdag la stims: oṃ badzra gu ru ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ zhes dbang dang tshe 'gugs bya: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' spyod rang byung lhun grub mkha' yi khyon: kun 'dus che btsan sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: yid bzhin nor bu mgon chen lha tshogs kyis: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: 'chi med tshe dang snyan grags chos gos srid: longs spyod phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu'i tshogs: deng 'dir stsol la 'khor lo'i dbang bzhi bskor: mchog thun 'dod rgu'i dngos grub thob gyur cig: oṃ ma ma puṇye sarba ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hūm̐: zhes dang

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la nā tha pañtsa sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ sogs: hūm̐: dpal chen nag po khrag 'thung rgyal: dpa' bo gyad kyi ya 'dor can: dregs pa sa bcu gnon mdzad pa: legs ldan mgon por bdag bstod do: bstod par 'os pa sogs? zhes dngos grub blangs shing dga' bzhi thob par bsam: de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: sku gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid padma 'byung : gdung ba rtse gcig mi 'bral bkra shis shog: legs ldan dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i bya ra ba: gsang sngags chos sgra sgrog pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis gang rigs brjod: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ mi dmigs 'ja' lus chos sku stong nyid la: mtha' nas dbus yang 'khor rnams gtso la bsdu: gtso bo yab yum hūm̐ thim skye med ngang : rang byung rang shar ngo bo a ru ldang : a a āḥ de nas bsngo smon ni: hoḥ ma gyur mtha' yas rigs drug srid 'khor rnams: bdag blo'i dge bcu don gnyis bla med bsngo: byang chub lam thob phyir mi ldog gyur nas: mngon dga' dpal rir skye ba'i smon lam shog: ces bsngo smon yang zab rgyas gdab pa mchog tu rigs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs skal ldan bu yi don: lha tshogs mgon po'i sgrub pa bzhag: gsang ba zil gnon cha lag nyid: yang gsang gcig sgril bla med mchog: cha tshang don dril snying thig 'di: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo gter bdag gling pas: lcags byi lor sbas yul padma tshal nas: pha wang bya rog rngam 'dra'i ske 'og mtsho 'khor rba rlabs drag tu g.yo ba'i klong nas khrom gter du bgyis te/ padma gsang sngags chos 'byung gling du shog ser nas bsgyur ro/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // nga) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las:

mgon po'i bzlog pa'i mdun bskyed bzhugs pa'i dbu'o: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag por 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: legs ldan mgon po'i bzlog byang bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: legs ldan mgon po'i bzlog byang las: bca' gzhi lag len rim pa ni: drag po'i lcags snod la sogs su: dug khrag dkyil 'khor chag chag gdab: ma traṃ g.yang gzhi chos 'byung brtsegs: de steng 'bru nag zan la ni: dpal gtor nag po khru tshad tsam: dmar nag me ris zur rgyan btags: 'khor rnams gtso bo'i phyed char sleb: lha grangs lta bus bskor bar bya: rtse mor khri sgor tsitta dang : dar nag gdugs sogs me long brgyan: tsitta chos 'byung nam mkha' gzugs: phyi rtsang drug cu rtsa bzhi dang : nang rtsang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o: ba su ta yi thag pas dkris: dur khrod g.yang gzhi'i sham bu spras: rtsang rtse bya nag sha yis brgyan: phyi nas las zor rnams kyis bskor: bsgral chas la sogs tshang bar bsags: gang yang 'tshams pas gzhi bskor la: ri rab dag la bskang rdzas bskor: g.yag nag ru sngon 'gying ba la: rgyab tu dgra bgegs bam ro bkal: de dag mdun du bzhag par bya: gzhan yang phyi nang spyan gzigs dang : mchod rdzas la sogs tshang bar bsags: sa ma ya: de nas las byang sngags la bskyal: mdun bskyed bya ba'i rim pa ni: pho brang ma gtogs gzhung nas blang : de nas gtor mdos bran byas te: drag po'i ngang la 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: e ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ suṃ keṃ bhrūm̐: de dag dran rdzogs yongs gyur las: mdun du dur khrod sa gzhi brjid: 'byung lnga brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin dbus: dmar nag thod mkhar 'jigs su rung : zlog byed las kyi pho brang ni: phyi ni gnam lcags zur gsum dbal: bshan pa myur mgyogs rtsang gis brgyan: dur khrod gcan gzan bya nag 'tshubs:

gri snying dar nag ru mtshon gzengs: dug dang mun pa'i bu yug 'tshubs: drwa mig bshan pa'i dmag tshogs 'gyu: bskal pa'i me 'bar 'u ru ru: nang na dmar nag zur gsum brjid: rakta'i rba klong phyu ru ru: mi ro rta ro bcal du bkram: de dbus gnam lcags 'khor lo dang : padma nyi zla bam gyi gdan: hūm̐ las byung ba'i nag po che: khrag 'thung legs ldan phyag bzhi pa: sma ra dbu skra dmar ser 'bar: thod skam prog zhu dar nag 'phur: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khyil: thal chen tshom bu sindhu ra: khrag zhag thig le zo ris zhag: g.yas gnyis sogs nas sngags la bskyal: thun gtor dang bcas nas phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: yang bzlog cha lag rim pa bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so/ /sarba lo ka pa la shu bhaṃ// // ca) ༈ bka' brgyad chen po gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i bskang bsdus nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs so:

khrag 'thung legs ldan nag por bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: bskang bsdus nor bu'i phreng ba bstan: dbyangs can brda yi ri mor gzugs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: bskang ba bya ba'i rim pa ni: sgrub rdzas spyan gzigs sna tshogs bsham: nag po chen po'i rten yang bkram: gzhan yang mthun rdzas tshang bar bya: bdud rtsi sogs kyis bran zhing gso: rol mo sna tshogs 'khrol byas nas: rang nyid sgom srog ting 'dzin ngang : hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: pho brang e yi dbus su bzhugs: dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dpal chen ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas kyi: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni: dur khrod bkod pa ri rab gling bzhi stai: rtag gtor nag po brjid pa ri rab tsam: gri rgod snying dang dar nag tsittas brgyan: mi 'bral rtse gcig 'grogs pa'i bskang rdzas kyis: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas thugs dam bskang : bya gcan sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rin chen snod mchog bhandha lcang lo'i nang : dam nyams dgra bgegs gdug pa'i tsitta la: mig dang rna ba sna dang lce yis bskor: dgra bgegs dbang po'i me tog spungs pa 'dis: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang :

sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas thugs dam bskang : bya gcan sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dgra bo'i phung khams yangs pa'i bhandha ru: shing khams rtsa dang mtsher pa smug nag brgyan: lcags khams keng rus lha ba zhag la sogs: chu khams mkhal ma rkang gling tshil bu'i tshogs: rlung khams glo ba rgyu ma ba su ta: dgra bo'i khams gnyis rnam shes 'byung lnga 'dis: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas thugs dam bskang : bya gcan sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gu gul nag po dug khrag thang phrom dang : gri sha khyi sha rta sha gcan gzan sha: rdzas dud spos kyi na bun 'khrigs pa 'dis: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas thugs dam bskang : bya gcan sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dug shing nag po tsher ma'i kong bu la: ro ras shi skras g.yogs pa'i sdong bu'i tshogs: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i snod mchog thod par btsugs:

ru tra bsgral ba'i zhag klad mar khus gtams: drag po'i zhun me nyi ltar gsal ba 'dis: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas thugs dam bskang : bya gcan sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i lcang lo ya kha'i nang : mi khrag rta khrag khyi khrag yugs mngal khrag: rgya khrag gtsod khrag 'byung khrag mkhris pa sogs: dug khrag sna tshogs sbyar ba'i dri chab 'dis: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas thugs dam bskang : bya gcan sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: 'bru nag bra bo 'bras dang dug 'bras dang : ngar btags gri khrag sbyar ba'i dpal bshos la: dgra bo'i mgo snying rgyan gyis spras pa 'dis: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas thugs dam bskang : bya gcan sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang :

hūm̐: 'bod pa'i gri rkang gling bu tse re re: gsang rnga rdza rnga thod pa'i cang te'u: mkhar rnga rnga zlum ḍā ma sham kha sogs: sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir ba 'dis: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas thugs dam bskang : bya gcan sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rnga thug nag po khams gsum zil gnon dang : ru dar rten dar g.yab dar nag po gzengs: 'bod sngags rbad sngags gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor: drag sngags thun sngags me lce ya la la: mi lpags rta lpags g.yang gzhi mkha' la bsgrengs: don snying 'phen rdo rgyu ma'i drwa ba bkod: mchog chen mchog phran keng rus gar stabs bsgyur: ro langs sha za srin po sprin ltar gtibs: tsitta dmar po nam mkhar rgyal mtshan btsugs: dug shing mda' mo dur bya'i sgro yis brgyan: dar nag mgul 'phyangs shwa rdel bla 'khor gzugs: rten rdzas sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs pa 'dis: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas thugs dam bskang : bya gcan sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: byang g.yag kham pa ru ring la: rgyab tu dgra bgegs bam ro bkal: zhol g.yag bcu gsum ngar zhing 'gyings: rta nag bcu gsum dar gyis brgyan:

lug nag bcu gsum 'ba' sgra tser: khyi nag bcu gsum dgra sha rngam: bya nag bcu gsum gshog 'gyur lding : dom dred sbrul nag bcu gsum 'gyu: mi nag pho mo bcu gsum gar: bskang rdzas gzugs 'gros sprin ltar gtibs: bskang rdzas brjid ldan ri ltar spungs: bdud rtsi dkar dmar mtsho ltar 'khyil: sbyor sgrol mchod pa spyan gzigs kyis: mgon chen lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs dam bskang : chos 'byung e yi klong dkyil nas: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : mthing nag drag po'i pho brang nas: legs ldan phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: ma ning nag po'i thugs dam bskang : bstan dgra thal bar brlag mdzad pa'i: gdong bzhi chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sgrub la dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i: phyag drug mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : las bzhi phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir: dur khrod bdag po'i thugs dam bskang : dam tshig las kyi bya ra ma: ma mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : phyi nang bar chad dbyings su bsgral: sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang : thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsol: zhes pas thugs dam bskang zhing bshags pa ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi sgor zhugs nas: tshul bzhin ma ldan bag med dbang gyur te: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par bstsal du gsol: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas shing lhag chad bkang : sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: khrag 'thung legs ldan chen po yi: thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa bzhag: phyi nang bar chad sel ba dang : chos skyong dam la gnas pa'i phyir: gsang sgrub bskang ba 'di nyid zab: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas/ lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing*/ chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // cha) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gsol mchod bsdus pa bzhugs so: dpal mgon chen po khrag 'thung ma hā kā lar 'dud: ye shes kyi mgon po ma hā kā la'i rgyun gsol gyi rnal 'byor rtsom par 'dod pas: rin po che'i snod bhandha'am lcags zangs gang rung las grub pa'i nang du thog mar 'bru nag gi ngar phye dug khrag gi khu bas sbrus pa'am: yang na gri khrag gis brgyan pa'i dpal gtor khru gang ngam mtho gang ba zhig sha khrag dang liṅgas brgyan te tshe nyungs kyi rkang bu 'dzugs: de la dpal gtor lha grangs dang mtheb skyus bskor: rgyan gtso bo ltar bya: gnad 'gag che zhing dgra bzlog dang rbad bskul dgos pa byung na dug shing tsher ma can gyi rtsang gis brgyan: mtho dman tshad ni sngags pa rang gi khru gang gtso bo la dgu: 'khor rnams la gsum: khrag kyu rnams las gzhung so so'i dug rdzas sna tshogs byugs te: drag po'i shing la ro ras kyis dkris pa'i dpal 'bar lha grangs ltar 'dzugs: de yang mtshon phur gsum stegs kyi khar bzhag la ma grub na lcags kyi mañdzi'i khar bzhag: mdun du sman raka phud bha ling drag po'i bshos bcas shin tu tshang bar bsham: phyi mchod grub na spyi mthun bsham: spyan gzigs la sogs ni mthun rdzas yin pas bskang gzhung ltar bgyis kyang chog: lam gtong sogs la mchog kyang med na mi 'gal: mchod rdzas rgyas bsdus gang 'byor bsgrigs nas: thog mar ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bag sgrib kun nas bslangs pa sbyong : gnyis pa sku gsum gyi sa bon om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas gsum pa ma bcos gdod nas rang byung he ru ka'i rigs yi dam kyi cho ga 'dra bdag bskyed byas kyang chog:

ma grub kyang don la dpal ye shes mgon po yang thugs rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sprul pa gang la gang 'dul der ston gyi cho 'phrul sgyu ma tsam gyi khyad chos ltar: chos nyid mnyam bzhag gi dgongs klong yin pas rnal 'byor bla med theg pa'i don rdzogs bzhin gnas lugs gsal bzhag cig car byed pa'i ngang nas 'di ltar brtson par bya'o: sa ma ya: dang po mchod pa byin rlabs ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis spel: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod bhandha mtshan dang rtags kyis brgyan zhing don dang ldan pa'i nang du: gtor ma sman raka byad ma dgra bgegs kyi khams dang dbang po thams cad gcig tu spungs pa'i ngo bo sha khrag rdzas kyi phung po rgya che zhing : dpangs mtho ba drag po'i dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig spel bar gyur: oṃ sarba pañts oṃ ma hā? oṃ ma hā bha lingt oṃ ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su la ta la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren zhing mchod pa ni: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag ni pha ki na: nyi ma byang phyogs mtshams shed kyi: u tsa la yi dur khrod nas: nag po chen po gshegs su gsol: rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi dur khrod nas: phyag bzhi mgon po gshegs su gsol: rngam klong khrag mtsho'i dur khrod nas: ma ning nag po gshegs su gsol: ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas: gdong bzhi mgon po gshegs su gsol: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas: phyag drug mgon po gshegs su gsol: baṃ ro brtsegs pa'i dur khrod nas: bram gzugs las mkhan gshegs su gsol: rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i dur khrod nas: tsaṇḍi rigs lnga gshegs su gsol: las bzhi sprul pa'i dur khrod nas: rigs bzhi sgo ma gshegs su gsol: bshan pa gnas nyul dur khrod nas: dregs pa sde brgyad gshegs su gsol:

srod 'gyu mtha' sdud dur khrod nas: sprul pa yang sprul gshegs su gsol: gri rgod rkang gling gdangs kyis 'bod: gri sha bsregs pa'i dri yis bsu: rnga yab rol mos spyan 'dren no: ma thogs yud kyis gnas 'dir byon: sngon gyi tha tshig ma g.yel bar: dus 'dir sangs rgyas bstan bsrung phyir: sgrub la mchog thun stsol ba'i phyir: drag po'i gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: dam bsre gnyis med yid kyis mchod: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod par 'tshal: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la dharma pā la ya sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: hūm̐: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs la: mthun pa'i rdzas mchog 'bul ba ni: phyi mchod dbang po rnam pa lnga: nang mchod klad khrag mtsho ltar 'khyil: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dgyes pa'i rigs: spyan gzigs dkor cha la sogs pa'i: ye shes mgon po'i tshogs la 'bul: bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs la: khyad du dmod te bcol ba'i las: gsang sngags gnyan gyi chos 'khor la: 'tshe dang sdang ba bdud kyi rigs: smon lam ngan pas 'brel ba yi: pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul chen dang : dus la bab pa'i chad pa sogs: sdang zhing mi mthun brtsams pa'i rigs: ye shes mgon po'i zhal du bstab: gtad do gnyer ro las ma g.yel: dgra dpung chom la bgegs dpung snubs: dgra bo'i dmag dpung dmag mi phyes: dgra bo'i mthun gsum nang 'thab thongs: dgra bo'i pha tshan gnyen 'khor dkrugs: dgra bo'i sgo nor phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i pho rgyud bla srog phrol: dgra bo'i mo rgyud snying khrag 'thung : dgra bo'i dbang thang byad du chugs: dgra bo'i yul zhing ser bas khongs: dgra bo'i mi rabs rtsad nas chod: dgra bo smyos shing 'bog tu chugs: dgra bo brgyal zhing reng par gyis:

dgra bo mgo 'khor 'byung ba dkrugs: dgra bo phung ba'i ltas ngan thongs: byad kyi zhags pas dgra bo chings: rtsis shwa thog ltar dgra la phob: bshol med khram la dgra bo thob: sde brgyad za kha dgra la ston: rno ba'i dbal kha dgra la ston: dgra bo'i mgo chod yan lag phrol: dgra bo'i don snying dbang po'i tshogs: ye shes mgon po'i zhal du bstab: nag po chen po'i zhal du bstab: legs ldan nag po'i zhal du bstab: dpal mgon chen po'i zhal du bstab: bdud rgyal thod phreng zhal du bstab: srog bdag nag po'i zhal du bstab: khrag 'thung phyag bzhi'i zhal du bstab: ma ning nag po'i zhal du bstab: zhing skyong gdong bzhi'i zhal du bstab: phyag drug rngam pa'i zhal du bstab: bram ze dgyes pa'i zhal du bstab: ma mo tsaṇḍa'i zhal du bstab: sha za rigs bzhi'i zhal du bstab: za byed mgon po'i zhal du bstab: gsod byed mgon po'i zhal du bstab: sgrol byed mgon po'i zhal du bstab: 'joms byed mgon po'i zhal du bstab: las byed mgon po'i zhal du bstab: dregs pa lha yi zhal du bstab: khram thogs gshin rje'i zhal du bstab: khrag bdag ma mo'i zhal du bstab: zhags thogs bdud rje'i zhal du bstab: srog bdag rgyal po'i zhal du bstab: shwa thogs btsan rje'i zhal du bstab: gnod sbyin gdug pa'i zhal du bstab: 'chi bdag klu yi zhal du bstab: rngam byed sprul pa'i zhal du bstab: gcan spyang 'tshubs pa'i zhal du bstab: srod la 'gyu ba'i zhal du bstab: dus la gnas pa'i zhal du bstab: bstab bo dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: sgrol cig phung ba'i byad ma sgrol: legs ldan mgon po mthu ma chung : rbad pa'i lha srung rtsal ma zhan: bzhes shig dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs rol: thun gyi gtor ma 'di nyid dang : dgra bo 'khor bcas mnyam par bzhes: bcol ba'i las la mthu ma chung : mngon rtags dus 'dir 'grub par mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya dharma pā la ma tri kā li he sarba nā tha ma hā kā la he ka thun bhyoḥ
kā la ra tri ye a ya ma du ru tsa sha na byad ma nṛ tri trig nan dgra bo bhi sha tsakra ha la ha la ma tha ma tha dgra bo nṛr myog bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ces lan bdun nam gang rung bzlas: de nas sman raka mchod cing : om̐ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ dpal ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa yi zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: sngags bdag ma ning nag po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: legs ldan gdong bzhi chen po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: phyag drug yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bram ze dur khrod bdag po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: tsaṇḍi sha za rigs lnga'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: gsod byed gdong can rigs bzhi'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: srog bdag dregs pa sde brgyad zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: sprul pa'i bya gcan sha za'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs la: mchod cing phrin las bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba dang : thad nas langs pa'i dgra bgegs rigs: bar chod brtsams pa'i 'byung po rnams: mngon spyod drag pos tshar chod cig: om̐ sarba lokt+ri pā la ya dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces sngags lan dgu bgrang zhing thal mo brdab: dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin brlags pa'i 'dun pa bya: 'di byad zor phur kha dang dgra byung ba rmi ltas mtshan ngan byung bar ched du dgos pas gal che: gsum pa las la bskul ba ni zor chen ltar 'phen pa dang : rgyun sgrub ltar mchod pa dang gnyis te: rgyun sgrub ltar mchod pa ni 'di'i skabs su sman raka gis bran: zor chen ltar rdzong ba ni: gtor ma la dpal 'bar 'dzugs: bdud rtsis bran zhing btegs la rol mo drag tu rdung ba dang bcas nas:

hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub dag pa'i dbyings: mkha' ltar khyab pa'i pho brang nas: ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul gyis: rtsal 'gyed khrag 'thung nag po che: 'khor 'das kun gyi spyi gzugs can: khyon gyis srid gsum rab g.yo ba: 'jigs byed me 'bar dus kyi bdag: sa bcu'i dbang phyug kā lar bstod: he kṣeṃ 'brug sgra ltar du sgrog: 'joms byed kā hi nag po che: bskul lo bde chen klong nas bzhengs: hūm̐: dpal chen phyag bzhi skur bzhengs shig: ma ning nag po skur bzhengs shig: khrag 'thung gdong bzhi skur bzhengs shig: myur mdzad phyag drug skur bzhengs shig: dur khrod bdag po skur bzhengs shig: tsaṇḍa rigs lnga skur bzhengs shig: las byed sgo skyong skur bzhengs shig: dregs pa sde brgyad skur bzhengs shig: sprul pa yang sprul skur bzhengs shig: rdzu 'phrul rtsal bcu'i gzi byin skyed: bskul zhing las la chas pa'i tshe: drag spyod bskal pa'i rlung g.yos ltar: spu gri'i mtshon cha dgra la bsnun: phyung rdeg sgyogs chen 'phen pa ltar: dgra bo'i mkhar khang mgo mjug sgyur: myur nas byol med las kyi mtshon: gnam lcags thog ltar dgra la phob: legs ldan sprul pa'i las byed pa: mon pa dmar nag pho mo'i tshogs: gcer bu za byed shan pa'i gzugs: bye ba sa ya mun ltar gtibs: dgra bo'i bla 'gugs nyi li li: do nub nam gyi srod thun la: dgra srog dmar po chod la shog: ye grub srid pa'i srog bdag tshogs: dregs pa sde brgyad las la bskul: dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can la: bka' yi chad pa drag po phob: pha rol dgra bgegs pho mo rnams: las rlung spu gri'i rta la bskyon: bla srog rbad kyis chod la shog: snying khrag dron mo hub kyis thob: rnam shes tshe yi 'ju thag chod: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mgon po'i drag sngags dgra la phob: lha mo'i thun sngags dgra la phob:

mon pa'i cho 'phrul dgra la phob: lha yi bka' chad dgra la phob: gshin rje'i khram kha dgra la phob: ma mo'i khrag nad dgra la phob: bdud kyi mtshon kha dgra la phob: rgyal po'i smyo 'bog dgra la phob: btsan gyi shwa kha dgra la phob: gnod sbyin za kha dgra la phob: klu bdud mdze nad dgra la phob: byad ma lha srung rten dang phrol: bskul zhing rbad pa'i myur mgyogs can: rlung ltar khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston: shi bla bdud kyis 'phrog pa bzhin: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: 'ju thag rten phur phud la shog: dam can chos skyong mthu ma chung : dregs pa sde brgyad rtsal ma zhan: gza' rgod mkha' la 'gyu ba bzhin: glo bur yud kyis sgrol la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu hya he ka thun bhyoḥ ma tri kā li ya thun bhyo a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dgra bo'i srog lus la bhandha na sha nṛ tri thun bhyoḥ dgra bo'i lus ngag la ma tha gardza nṛ tri trig bhyoḥ dgra bo'i yid la satwaṃ bha ya bighnān nṛ trig thun bhyoḥ dgra bo'i srog la tshindha ma ni trig rbad bhyoḥ oṃ lokka du pra ma ya sarba ru tra nṛ trig nan: e hur thum mā ra ya nan nan: bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces pas zor ltar 'phen pa yin na: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sde lnga'i 'khor lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pa dgra bo'i thog tu dmag g.yos nas: mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char drag po phab pas phye mar rdul phran bzhin tu brlag cing : sha khrag thams cad gtso bo rnams kyis hab hab ljib ljib tu gsol nas lhag ma rjes shul tsam yang med par bsgom: gtor 'bul ltar bgyis skabs stegs kyi khar 'bul zhing gtor mchod dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus gsum lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bzhes shing dgyes pas: pha rol gyi rgol ba 'joms ngan pa'i rigs gang byung ba thams cad tshar gcod pa'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos:
