rgyun sgrub yin na gtso bo gtor ma la bdud rtsi sman raka ba liṃ ta gsol zhing thun gtor phra mo tsam ma chad na rab dang : ma grub na gser skyems btang zhing gong ma'i tshig dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la zer ba'i mtshams su: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la zhes pa kha bsgyur: gtor 'bul lam gser skyems rdzogs nas slar yang mchod cing bstod pa'am gtor ma gso phan bgyis gtang rag yin na gong gi kha bsngos bya: de nas dkyil 'khor dmigs pas bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: mthun pa'i dngos grub 'dod rgu yid bzhin nor: deng 'dir sgrub la rtsol zhing byin brlabs nas: yid smon rgyas par gyur cig srung ma'i tshogs: 'gro kun sa bcu'i rtse mor rab gnas shog: hoḥ bskyed rim sgyu ma'i rol rtsal klong thim nas: rdzogs rim de bzhin ting 'dzin gnyug mar bsdu: zung 'jug ka dag kun gzhi skye med āḥ zhes ye shes pa gnas lugs klong thim rang bzhin du gnas pa gsal gdab mi dgos pa de bzhin ngang : cho 'phrul dregs pa yang kun gzhi snod kyi klong du rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs dkyil 'khor rnam pa can rang gnas su gshegs pa'o: sa ma ya: zhes dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'di nyid sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa la mchog thun gyi 'bras bu dus 'dir smin zhing phrin las nam mkha'i glog ltar myur: khyad par dgra bgegs bar gcod rtsom pa'i rigs la ma gtogs 'di nyid rbad bskul mang po mi bya: dam med lag tu dpe dang gdams pa mi bstan: ci phyir chos skyong 'di thun mong ma yin zhing bka' btsan pas slar yang phrin las bcol ba'i tshe cung zad gnod par bshad: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i tshe rmi lam du dar nag gi gos gyon pa: nags tshal 'thug po'i gling du sleb pa: rngon 'gyed pa mi nag pho mo mi sdug pa'i rngam chen mang pos gar 'gyed pa: rlung nag dang sprin gtibs pa: 'dus sa me 'bar ba dur khrod mang po 'grim pa:

bam gsar rnying dang keng rus khral khrol gling du sleb pa: bya gcan sha gzan sna tshogs pa'i yul du 'grim pa: mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas g.yul 'gyed pa: dngos sam rmi lam du 'ur gyi sgra 'byin pa brag bshig pa: chu dkrugs pa: rma gdong ba: dmod pa'i las sna tshogs dgyes pa sogs grub rtags 'byung ba: de yi tshe dga' brod kyi bdag 'dzin zhig nas btang snyoms su bzhag: dam tshig yin pas tshogs bskang la 'bad: de bzhin rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bsgrub par bya'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sngags 'chang gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes lcags byi lor sbas tshal rngam pa rong nas gdan drangs te shing pho 'brug lor rnam mkhyen thar pa gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o/ maṅga laṃ// // ja) ༈ bka' brgyad chen po gsang ba zil gnon las: myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i gsol bsdus bzhugs so: bla ma dang mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: kho mo mtsho rgyal gyis: ye shes mgon po'i gsol mchod bstan: sangs rgyas ye shes legs par zungs: brda gzugs rin chen gter du sbos: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: mgon po'i gsol mchod rim pa ni: bhandha rgyan bzang gtor ma bsham: sman raka phud kyis legs par bran: dang po mchod pa byin brlab ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod: hoḥ gtor ma sman raka dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa: ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur: oṃ ha ho hrī phaiṃ phaiṃ: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rang gi thugs ka nas ting 'dzin rol pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas: shar lho bsil ba tshal nas dur khrod shing tsan dan rkang gcig pa'i drung nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po spyan drangs: oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣeṃ kṣe ṭa bighnān bi na ya ka baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bhyo ma tri ka li tsaṇḍa lī ku ru kulle hūm̐ phaṭḥ

oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ padma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: oṃ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ hoḥ mgon po'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya bhyo ma tri ka li hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes pas gtor ma legs par bsngo: gsum pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: che btsan dbang phyug ma hā kā la ya: mthing nag rngam pa'i zhal gsum rab tu 'khros: rigs bdag mi bskyod gtsug rgyan cod pan 'phur: dpral bar dam tshig sindhu ra yis byugs: 'bar ba'i gri gug thod khrag cang te'u g.yas: bhan dmar rtse gsum dgra 'ching zhags pa g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: glang po'i gdong can lha chen pho mo brdzis: kṣeṃ kṣeṃ sgra sgrogs me dpung klong du bzhugs: tsan dan la gnas nag po phyag drug pa: sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong ba'i dpal chen po: yid bzhin nor bu mgon po khyod la bstod: hūm̐: sbyor ba'i yum mchog sngags bdag dpal 'bar ma: dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtum pa mo: gri khug mgul 'khyud thod khrag yab la stob: dur khrod chas ldan ma sring pho nya 'gyed: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dpa' bo'i sku la 'khril: dbyings phyug lha mo 'dod rgu mchod sbyin ma: lha mo tsaṇḍa ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzhi pa gtor 'bul ni: hūm̐: legs ldan mgon po ma hā kā la ya: yum mchog sngags bdag 'dod khams dbyings phyug ma: nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor: bstan srung mthu chen dbang phyuug khyed rnams kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub mchog bdag gi bka' nyon bu bzhin skyongs: ma rungs 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la kṣeṃ kṣe ṭa pā la bighnān bi na ya ka baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

bhyo tri ka li tsaṇḍa lī ku ru ku lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: 'di nyid bstan srung kun gyi mchog: slob dpon shāntiṃ gharbha ni: bsil ba tshal du bzhugs pa'i tshe: mgon pos dngos su zhal gzigs nas: tsan dan shing la thim pa yi: dur khrod shing rkang gcig ces pa'i: tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i mgon po ni: nags 'dabs ma hā kā lar grags: spyir na che btsan 'gran zla bral: ye shes mgon po nor gyi bdag: bsgrubs pas 'dod rgu char bzhin 'bebs: pha rol dgra bgegs dmod pas brlag: de bas mthu rtsal rmad byung 'di: dam du bzung la legs par bsten: kun gyi thun mong ma yin rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs pa'o: sarba maṅga laṃ// nya) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po bya rog gdong gi gsol mchod bzhugs so: khrag 'thung chen po g.yul las rgyal la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang khrag 'thung legs ldan ma hā kā la'i gsol mchod brtsam pa'i rim pa ni: lcags sam bhandha'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: 'bru nag gi ngar phye la dpal gtor zlum po khram ris can g.yas gcus: gdan chos 'byung gi kha ru bzhag: mdun du khrag kong lhan du 'brang rgyas tshe nyungs kyis mtshan pa bzhag: 'khor dpal gtor bzhi dang kyu gu bzhi mtheb skyu brgyad gzhan yang sha sna snying sna ke tshe shang tshes brgyan: nyungs dkar nag gi rkang bu kyang gzugs: phud rgod sna tshogs gtams shing rol mo sgrogs gu gul sha chen gyi dud pa bdug tshil chen gyi mar me gtams khrag chen gyi yon chab bshams: dgyes pa'i dar phyar rngam pa'i dbyangs dang bcas nas legs ldan he ru ka chen po'i thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing phrin las kyi bya ba sna tshogs bsgrub phyir spyan 'dren pa ni:

hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen 'bar ba'i mdun: khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du: dur khrod e yi pho brang ni: mi mgo'i sku mkhar rgyan dang ldan: de dbus pad nyi ro gdan du: hūm̐ las legs ldan bya rog gdong : dur khrod chas ldan yum dang sbyor: 'khor du las byed pho nya ba: bya rog khros pa'i gdong can bzhi: mtshams su rang 'dra 'bar ma gnas: gzhan yang bya gcan yang sprul bcas: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros chos skyong spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badzra ma hā kā la kau bha ma dākṣi ya kṣa tsa tur li ha ho shwa ri ya badzra sa mā ya dza dza dzaḥ hūm̐: 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas mchog nas: khams gsum yongs kyi ded dpon che: mthu chen ma hā kā la ni: khrag 'thung nag po mi bsrun pa: dur khrod tshogs bdag skur bzhengs shig: nag po chen po gshegs su gsol: legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol: dpal mgon nag po gshegs su gsol: bdud rgyal thod phreng gshegs su gsol: bya rog ming can gshegs su gsol: gnam lcags spu gri gshegs su gsol: srog bdud 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: rngam chen bkrag med gshegs su gsol: las mkhan me 'bar gshegs su gsol: sprul pa yang sprul gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas dur khrod pho brang 'dir: mi g.yo dgyes pas gdan la bzhugs: om̐ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan:

zhes legs ldan mgon po'i dmag tshogs rnams sprin chen rlung gis bskyod pa ltar byon nas bzhugs par bsam: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: ma hā kā la dgongs su gsol: dpal mgon chen po dgongs su gsol: khrag 'thung rgyal po dgongs su gsol: bya rog ming can dgongs su gsol: dam can rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: hūm̐: khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: bhandha lcang lo'i gtor gzhong du: 'bru nag ngar phye'i myos chang la: gri khrag la sogs dug rigs sbyor: kha zhing ngar ldan bam pa'i rigs: shin tu bstar ba'i gtor mchod 'di: dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: khyed la mnyes pa'i dam rdzas ni: bum ril 'bar ba'i snod yangs su: mi khrag rta khrag glang po'i khrag: khyi khrag la sogs khrag chen la: thang khrom re lcag bong nga dang : sman chen dang bcas sbyor ba'i khrag: ru tra'i snying khrag dmar chen 'di: dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma hā rakta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: mtshan ldan zhal bu'i ka pā lar: ga pur dzā ti a ga ru: 'bras dkar dmar nag 'bru yi chang : rin chen zhun gyi brdar phye dang : byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i rgyun: rdzas mchog lnga sogs bdud rtsi 'di: dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: 'bru bcud sna tshogs phye ma'i rigs: bcud g.yo zhag gis sbags pa'i zan: dkar dmar brgyan pa'i zhal zas tshogs: dgra bgegs don snying dbang pos brgyan: tshil chen mar me gsur chen spos: rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra bcas 'di: dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul:

bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya ga ṇa tsakra ma hā pū dza ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: de nas bskang bstod bya ba ni: g.yag nag la bam ros brgyan pa de'i steng du dpal gtor zur gsum zhig la/ dkar me bya rog gsum gyis brgyan: sha dum dang mtheb skyus bskor ba mdun du gser skyems bshams la: hūm̐: rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i dur khrod bsil ba tshal: khrag gi rgya mtsho bam ro ri ltar nyil: keng rus khral khrol rus pa gram ltar bdal: steng du lho sprin ngam nag bun ltar gtibs: 'khor yug kun kyang mi sdug rlung dmar 'tshubs: de dbus drag po'i pho brang gzhal yas ni: rmang gzhi nag po klu dang sa bdag bsnol: de steng gnam lcags rdo rje'i rgya gram bkod: zur bzhi khro chu mdzes po so phag ldan: shar phyogs mi mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: dur khrod bdag mo'i gad mo ya la la: lho phyogs rta mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: gyi ling cang shes mtsher rgyangs tse re re: nub phyogs g.yag mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: kho mo 'brong gi ngar sgra 'u ru ru: byang phyogs stag mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: gcan gzan gdug pa'i ngar sgra di ri ri: ka gdung gza' dang rgyu skar bris pa la: 'brug glog thog ser zi ra chi li li: kha bad srin po'i thod pa bsgrigs pa la: raksha pho mo sprin ltar gtibs se gtib: g.yang gzhi 'phan dar ro skra'i ba dan la: mi mgo'i rgyan tog du ma rongs se rong : tri shul la sogs mtshon chas brgyan pa la: 'phyang ba'i cod pan nag po pu ru ru: de ltar pho brang sna tshogs rgyan ldan gyi: bkod pa yo byad bdag gis bshams pa 'dis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : sras mchog bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang : yum mchog tsaṇḍi dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang :

bdud po sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa bya rog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gcan spyang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: hūm̐: de dbus khrag mtsho pad nyi ti ra'i steng : hūm̐ las skyes pa'i myur mgyogs mthu bo che: las kyi mgon po dpal ldan bya rog gdong : mthing nag rngam pa srog bdag khros pa'i gzugs: khā kha mu kha rab 'jigs zhal gdangs shing : dmar zlum spyan 'khyil shangs nas 'brug stong ldir: dbu skra ser nag nam mkha'i dbyings su bskyod: thod skam dbyings nas bya rog sprin ltar gtibs: phyag g.yas gri gug srid gsum mthongs la phyar: g.yon pa'i bhan dmar gdug pa'i snying khrag 'thung : gti mug tshar gcod glang ko stod la g.yogs: pha rol gzhom phyir zhing lpags sked la dkris: zhe sdang tshogs 'joms sbrul gyi 'ching rgyan 'khyugs: nga rgyal mthar byed stag gi sham thabs dkris: nyon mongs mtsho skem mgo rlon phreng bas brgyan: bag chags gtor byed khrag zhag thal tshom spras: myur mgyogs shugs 'chang sgro gshog dbyings su brgyangs: log lta tshar gcod me ri smug nag 'bar: tsaṇḍi dmar mo srin gzugs pang du 'khyud: gri thod 'dzin cing rgyan drug chas kyis spras: zung 'jug ngang ldan khrag 'thung dor thabs can: las mdzad chen po gar dgu dgyes pa yi: bskyed rdzogs brtan po'i yid kyis sprul pa 'dis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : sras mchog bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang : yum mchog tsaṇḍi dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang : bdud po sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa bya rog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gcan spyang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i g.yas kyi bka' nyan pa:

sku mdog dmar nag nyin gyi pho nya ba: bdud po sgrol byed 'bar ba satwa re thogs: nad kyi rlangs pa dgra dang bgegs la bhyoḥ hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i g.yon gyi bka' nyan pa: sku mdog dkar sngon mtshan gyi pho nya ba: las mkhan 'bar ba lag na spu gri thogs: mtshon gyi gru gu dgra dang bgegs la phob: hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i rgyab kyi bka' nyan pa: sku mdog ser nag dus kyi pho nya ba: shan pa srog bdag las byed ral gri thogs: dmod pa'i dug mda' sngo dmar dgra la gtong : hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i mdun gyi bka' nyan pa: sku mdog mthing nag gnas nyul pho nya ba: las mkhan myur mgyogs gnam lcags phur pa thogs: mngon spyod chen pos dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: kun kyang gcer bu 'jigs pa'i nyams gyur can: g.yon pa thams cad lcags kyu 'bar ba thogs: rus pa'i rgyan ldan za byed srin po'i tshul: me ltar mched cing dgra bo'i snying khrag 'thung : hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i mtshams kyi bka' nyan pa: shar lho 'bar ba ma mos zor ba thogs: lho nub ma mos kha rlangs sog le thogs: nub byang dur khrod ma mos be con thogs: byang shar srin mo gser mig khram shing thogs: kun kyang nag mo bya rog khros pa'i gdong : g.yon pa thams cad dgra bo'i tsitta bsnams: mi sdug gzugs can ma mo rngam pa'i tshul: byad ma mthar byed sprul pa sgyu ma'i sku: bka' yi 'khor du gnas pa'i srung ma'i tshogs: dgyes pa'i yid la bkod pa'i bka' sdod kyi: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams? sras mchog? yum mchog tsaṇḍi? bdud po sde bzhi? sprul pa bya rog? yang sprul gcan spyang? thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs? hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i sprul pa yang sprul po: dgra sha za byed bya rog nag po bzhi: dgra khrag 'thung byed bya rog dmar po bzhi: kun kyang mchu sder bgrad cing dgra la rngam:

dgra bo'i snying nas 'dren pa'i stag mo bzhi: dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i dom nag bzhi: kun kyang kha gdangs mche gtsigs bam ro 'drad: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams 'gugs pa'i lcags spyang bzhi: dgra bo'i tshe len zangs kyi 'phar ba bzhi: kun kyang ngu 'dur brgyugs shing gshin skad 'don: dgra la phung thal 'gyed pa'i spre'u bzhi: dgra la cho 'phrul 'gyed pa'i srin bya bzhi: kun kyang mi rung sna tshogs cha lugs ston: gzhan yang nying sprul ma lus rlung ltar 'tshub: ma nges gar gyi 'phrul 'khor ltar bsgyur nas: sna tshogs dgra la dmar 'gyed sprul 'khor 'dis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams? sras mchog bya rog? yum mchog tsaṇḍi dmar mo'i? bdud po sde bzhi? sprul pa bya rog rnams? yang sprul gcan spyang rnams? thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i dam skong rdzas mchog ni: gling gi gling mchog 'dzam gling kha ba can: dbus 'gyur chen po'i dpag tshad gsum mtho'i gnas: 'khor yug gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba ru: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i dal zhing gnas: phyi nang pho brang rgyan sogs bskyod pa'i mthar: rgya che dpangs mtho dur khrod gling bzhis bskor: gnyis mched tshul du yid dpyod mtha' yas kyi: grangs med blo yis sprul te bskang ba ni: sna tshogs spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: yid kyi me tog tsitta'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: mkhal ma'i me tog rna ba rdza ltar nyil: srog rtsa'i me tog mig 'bras phung por spungs: mchin pa'i me tog lce yi pur len phyur: glo ba'i me tog sna yi zur bu 'khrigs: dbyings ltar mtho ba'i me tog sna tshogs 'dis: thugs rje'i spyan gyis bdag la gzigs pa'i phyir: dbang po'i me tog rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : tsandan dkar dmar dkon mchog mnyes pa'i spos: ga pur dzā ti yi dam mnyes pa'i spos:

li shi sug smel mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i spos: gri snying na gi dpal mgon mnyes pa'i spos: gu gul shing kun bgegs srin tshar gcod spos: sha chen sna tshogs dregs pa mnyes pa'i spos: sprin ltar gtibs pa'i dri mchog sna tshogs 'dis: brtse ba'i dgongs pa bdag la dgyes pa'i phyir: dri mchog sna tshogs spos kyis thugs dam bskang : nyi zla'i zhun me 'dzam gling gsal ba'i mdangs: sems nyid zhun me 'khor 'das gsal ba'i mdangs: 'bri mar zhun me smag rum gsal ba'i mdangs: til mar zhun me zor mda' gsal ba'i mdangs: tshil chen zhun me dpal mgon mnyes pa'i mdangs: rkang dmar zhun me dregs pa mnyes pa'i mdangs: dbyings ltar gsal ba'i sna tshogs zhun me 'dis: gnas lugs dgongs pas bdag la skyong ba'i phyir: dkar me sna tshogs gtams pas thugs dam bskang : mkha' yi chu 'dzin dag gtsang dri yi chab: lha yi bdud rtsi brgyad ldan dri yi chab: byang sems bdud rtsi 'chi med bdud rtsi che: rol mtsho phyur 'khyil mchod 'os dri yi chab: dug khrag gri khrag dpal mgon dri yi chab: khrag chen du ma shan pa dri yi chab: bsil ldan ma nges sbyar zhing gtams pa 'dis: mdangs bzang rdzas kyi dngos grub 'byung ba'i phyir: dri chab sna tshogs gtams pas thugs dam bskang : shing 'bras lha yi zhal zas bcud dang ldan: 'bras dkar drang srong zhal zas bcud dang ldan: gro nas tshogs kyi zhal zas bcud dang ldan: khre til rdzas kyi zhal zas bcud dang ldan: se 'bru mchod pa'i zhal zas bcud dang ldan: bra sran dpal mgon zhal zas bcud dang ldan: bu ram mtha' yi zhal zas bcud dang ldan: 'bru mar 'bras bu'i zhal zas bcud dang ldan: dgyes pa'i bsod nams dpal rten bskyed pa'i phyir: ro bcud zhal zas rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : lha yi rnga chen mkha' spyod dgyes pa'i sgra: dbyar gyi rnga chen 'byung lnga bskyed pa'i sgra: ghaṇḍi'i rnga chen chos 'khor bskor ba'i sgra:

drag shing rnga chen yi dam dgyes pa'i sgra: rin chen rnga zlum mkha' 'gro bskul ba'i sgra: thod pa'i rnga chen dpal mgon dgyes pa'i sgra: rdza yi rnga chen gar dang mchod pa'i sgra: lcags kyi hom rnga mthu gtad nag po'i sgra: 'brug ltar grags pa'i rol mo sna tshogs 'dis: snyan pa'i dung chen sna tshogs bsgrag pa'i phyir: rol mo 'brug ltar grags pas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rang bzhin khyon yangs mtshan ldan ka pā la: rgya che'i nang du sman mchod gtams pa ni: dzā ti rgyal po rlung sman bdud rtsi che: gi waṃ rgyal po mkhris sman bdud rtsi che: li shi rgyal po bad kan bdud rtsi che: a ru rgyal po 'dus pa'i bdud rtsi che: tsandan ga pur tshad pa'i bdud rtsi che: ka ko sug smel grang ba'i bdud rtsi che: gur gum cu gang snyoms pa'i bdud rtsi che: dbang ril sbyor ba zhi ba'i bdud rtsi che: chig thub sbyor ba drag po'i bdud rtsi che: glang chen sbyor ba mngon spyod bdud rtsi che: phyi nang bzang ldan bdud rtsi sna tshogs 'dis: rang gzhan nyon mongs nad las bskyab pa'i phyir: bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil bas thugs dam bskang : lcags zangs drag po'i snod mchog zur gsum du: bskyed pa'i rang bzhin gtor ma spungs pa ni: dbyings ltar mtho ba ri rab bha lingta: zhi la zlum pa'i lus 'phags bha lingta: rgyas la gru bzhi 'dzam bu'i bha lingta: dbang la zla gam ba glang bha lingta: drag po zur gsum sgra mi'i bha lingta: gangs dkar rtse mtho sgrub pa'i bha lingta: ri nag rngams 'thug bskang ba'i bha lingta: brag dmar dbal ldan rbad pa'i bha lingta: g.ya' sngo rtse gzengs bsad pa'i bha lingta: shing nags tshal gzengs bha ling brgyan pa'i rdzas: 'bru rigs ma nges bha ling las kyi thun: dur sa phung sa bha ling las kyi zor: g.yul sa'i lcags ri bha ling bzhugs pa'i gdan: dkar thig zlas brgyan dmar lam nyi zlas byugs: mkha' yi dmar 'od 'khyugs pa'i zhags kyis dkris:

de ltar rang byung bha ling gtor ma 'di: gdod nas dgyes shing brtse bas dgongs pa'i phyir: bha ling lhun mtho sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : bum ril dung dmar rgya che'i snod mchog tu: mkha' yi dbang mo'i mu khā las byung ba: a haṃ rakta rgyal ba bsgrub pa'i rdzas: ma hā rakta yi dam bsgrub pa'i rdzas: mu la rakta dpa' bo bsgrub pa'i rdzas: gu hya rakta mkha' 'gro bsgrub pa'i rdzas: mā ra rakta dpal mgon bsgrub pa'i rdzas: du na rakta chos skyong bsgrub pa'i rdzas: andza rakta dam can bsgrub pa'i rdzas: dza la rakta gter srung bsgrub pa'i rdzas: ha la rakta dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rdzas: bhi shwa rakta dam can bsgrub pa'i rdzas: e ma rakta dam tshig bskang ba'i rdzas: du ma sbyor ba'i rmad byung rakta 'di: chag nyams bag sgrib ma lus bsal ba'i phyir: mdangs ldan rakta sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: sgrub cing bskang ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: rang bzhin mkha' yi spyan gzigs thugs dam bskang : bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: dur khrod pho brang 'bar bas thugs dam bskang : skyon gyi ma gos rang bzhin gsal ba'i phyir: padma nyi ma'i gdan gyis thugs dam bskang : sgrib pa'i g.ya' bral rtog med don ldan phyir: zla rgyas bam ro'i gdan gyis thugs dam bskang : phyi nang sgrib gnyis ka nas dag pa'i phyir: me rlung dkar ltar 'khrugs pas thugs dam bskang : srid pa'i rgya mtsho rmang nas skem pa'i phyir: rakta zham chu 'khyil bas thugs dam bskang : dgyes pa'i gar gyis sa bcu gnon pa'i phyir: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis thugs dam bskang : pho rgyud thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir: rab 'bar gnam lcags gri gug thugs dam bskang : mo rgyud thams cad dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir: bhan dmar rakta phyur bas thugs dam bskang : dug gsum mtshan ma'i bag chags 'joms pa'i phyir: ngar ldan tri shul rtse gsum thugs dam bskang :

dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: phyung rdeg ral gri 'bar bas thugs dam bskang : ma rungs bgegs srin snying la bsnun pa'i phyir: gdab pa ri rab phur bus thugs dam bskang : byad ma sdig can snying la bsnun pa'i phyir: ru mtshon gzir 'debs nag pos thugs dam bskang : pha rol rgol ba cham la dbab pa'i phyir: spu gri mtshon cha du mas thugs dam bskang : sgrub cing 'khor ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir: mda' mo dar nag brgyan pas thugs dam bskang : rten du mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grog pa'i phyir: srog 'khor bla rdo rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : nam mkha'i rgyan gyur rang bzhin pho nya'i phyir: mkha' lding gser mig nag pos thugs dam bskang : ngar sgras sa gzhi ma lus g.yo ba'i phyir: g.yag rog zhol chen rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : bya lam yud ldang rlung gshog myur ba'i phyir: cang shes rta mchog rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : srid la 'jol ba'i rnga yab sham bu can: sa le zal mo 'bri yis thugs dam bskang : 'ba' sgra'i tser skad gdangs snyan len pa'i phyir: 'jam legs shel sgong lug gis thugs dam bskang : snang glu ki sgra sang sang bsgrag pa'i phyir: tsa ra rog po mkhal dkar thugs dam bskang : snang ba'i yid spyod dgyes shing dgyes pa'i phyir: gzugs 'gros 'phur bskyod sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs ma nges pa: mkha' ltar yangs shing gling ltar phyug pa'i tshogs: bskyed cing spel nas legs par bkram pa 'dis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : sras mchog bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang : yum mchog tsaṇḍi dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang : bdud po sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa'i bya rog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gcan spyang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol:
nyams chag bshags shing mi sgrib dag par stsol:

zhes yi ge brgya pas chad lhag bkang : de nas mgon po'i gtor bskul bya ba ni: gtor ma mañdzi'i khar bzhag nas 'gugs gzhug bya ba ni: phaṭḥ na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan bya rog gi gdong pa can bka' 'khor las kyi pho nya dang bcas pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas deng 'dir dkyil 'khor zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po gdug cing sdang ba'i tshogs thams cad drag po thun gyi gtor ma 'di la rang dbang med par khug cig: badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ de nas gtor ma de dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus par bsam: om̐ āḥhūm̐: mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: dpal ye shes mgon po'i zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: phyag bzhi ma hā kā la'i zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: phyag drug yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: ma ning srog bdag nag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: dpal 'bar gdong bzhi chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: bram ze dur khrod bdag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: las kyi mgon po chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: myur mgyogs bya rog gdong can zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: sgrol byed gdong can bzhi yi zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: 'bar ba nag mo rnam bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: bya rog rngam pa du ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: gcan spyang 'dur byed du ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi:

yang sprul las kyi bya ra du ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: hoḥ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma phul bas: gdug cing sdang ba'i dgra bo thams cad tshar gcod pa mngon spyod kyi las dang ldan par gyur cig: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la sha sa naṃ u pa ha ri ṇi e ka a pa tsi ma hā kā la e yaṃ kā la khā kha mu bhyo ma tri sandha li ku lu ku lu du pra ma ya sarba i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes pas bdud rtsis bran te gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog u tsa la: dur khrod chen po phra men kun tu rgyu: nye zhing tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i gnas kyi mchog: shin tu rngam pa'i 'byung 'jug bsil ba'i tshal: gling gi dbang gyur laṅka'i yul dang nye: srid pa 'di ru ci srid gling gi cha: 'khor 'das sa mtshams bral ba'i zhing mchog ni: mtshan ma gzugs bral g.yul las rgyal ba'i gnas: nyon mongs dug rlung ngam nag sprin ltar g.yo: mtshan mo srid pa'i me chen mched cing 'bar: dus drug rlung nag sngo dmar bu yug 'tshubs: ri bo thams cad keng rus rus pa brtsegs: 'bab chu thams cad khrag gi rba klung 'khrugs: rang bzhin 'byung ba'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrog: de ru ye shes 'jig rten 'dus pa yi: tsandan las grub dur shing rkang gcig pa: mi bzad rtsub pa'i rno ngar rab tu gzengs: rtse mor dur bya sha gzan skar ltar 'khrugs: rtsa bar dur khyi gcan spyang rlung ltar 'tshubs: mche gtsigs dur phag 'khyugs shing dug sbrul gtibs: gzhan yang mi gdug dur gyi las byed sogs: ro za rnams kyis ngar skad stong ldir ba: de 'dra'i gnas su bzhugs pa'i nag po che: srog bdag chen po las mgon bya rog gdong : mi bsrun khros pa khrag 'thung mthu bo che: mun nag lta bu'i rnam par sgyur ba po: za byed yum dang sprul pa du ma'i tshogs:

bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs: mthu ldan khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: ma g.yel dam tshig gnyan po'i dus la bab: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs sdig can 'di: bla tshe rnam shes srog dbugs 'gyu ba'i tshe: da lta nyid du khug cig sgrol bar mdzod: srog la rngam par rol te rkan sgra rdeb: sha la dgyes pa'i rngam zhal mkha' ltar gdangs: khrag la btung ba'i ljags dmar glog ltar 'khyugs: rus la dkrig pa'i mche ba zangs yag gtsigs: 'dus byas gtor ba'i shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub: ma rungs sngangs byed snyan nas 'brug stong ldir: gcod byed gri gug mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: rgyas byed bhan dmar rakta zhal du 'dren: thogs med spu gri'i sgro gshog dbyings su brgyangs: dpa' ba'i dur khrod chas rdzogs gtum pa po: tsaṇḍi las byed ma mo pang du 'khyud: phyag na mthu ldan las kyi mtshon cha 'dzin: brkyang bskum gar ldan stob 'chang zung du 'jug: 'khrigs pa'i rang bzhin me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil: las mdzad nag po yab yum dus la bab: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sdang zhing gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rnams: myur du sgrol mdzad las mgon mthu ma chung : zhing bcu'i byad ma sgrol mdzad las la ya: hūm̐: sgrol byed satwa re thogs pa'i dus la bab: de ring dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: las mkhan spu gri thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: srog bdag ral gri thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo mo rgyud rnams kyi mngal nas skoms: las mkhan phur bu thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo rigs rgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod: hūm̐: 'bar ba zor thogs khyod kyi dus la bab: dgra bo'i mkhar khang thams cad mgo mjug ldog: me yi kha rlangs sog thogs dus la bab: dgra bo'i sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dur khrod be con thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i nang spyad ka cha phung shig thongs:

gser mig khram shing thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i yul zhing thams cad ser bas khongs: bya rog nag po sde bzhi'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i pha tshan thal ba'i rdul du rlog: bya rog dmar po sde bzhi'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: snying 'dren stag mo mched bzhi'i dus la bab: dam nyams slob ma snying ngan srog rtsa chod: rtsad bcad dom nag mched bzhi'i dus la bab: byad ma yon bdag gzhung ngan rtsad nas chod: 'gugs byed lcags spyang sde bzhi'i dus la bab: kha 'jam snying rtsub dgra bo'i bla tshe sdud: zangs kyi 'phar ba sde bzhi'i dus la bab: yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bo phung bar gyis: phung byed spre'u sde bzhi'i dus la bab: ma rungs dgra la ltas ngan sna tshogs thongs: ltas ngan srin bya rnam bzhi'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra la cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs: sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi dus la bab: dam nyams dgra la mi rung sna dgu thongs: mthu rtsal myur mgyogs chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams: sprin ltar gtibs shing rlung ltar 'tshubs pa yi: las mdzad chen po 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying khrag 'di bzhes la: ma rungs log 'dren srog dbugs 'di bzhes la: sdig can bsgral ba'i phung po 'di bzhes shig: ru tra'i skye mched rnam shes 'di bzhes la: pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: ban bon sngags pa'i byad kha bzlog tu gsol: gling bzhi'i yul gyi mi kha bzlog tu gsol: rgya 'dre dam sri smyo 'bog bzlog tu gsol: 'byung po rnams kyi sgab 'dre bzlog tu gsol: mi min lha 'dre'i za kha bzlog tu gsol: srin pos tshe la rku ba bzlog tu gsol: mu stegs nag po'i gtad khram bzlog tu gsol: gshin rje bdud kyi khram kha bzlog tu gsol: klu btsan the'u rang bar chad bzlog tu gsol:

yul lha sa bdag gdug pa bzlog tu gsol: mo 'dre sman mos 'tshe ba bzlog tu gsol: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs bzlog tu gsol: mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog tu gsol: gdug cing sdang ba'i byad ma dgra bgegs rnams: bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes: dam bca' dus la ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la karma he ru ka khā kha mu kha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ka li tsaṇḍi ma ma tri mu kha ya baṃ hūm̐ bhyoḥ om̐ du ma pra ma raksha tsa du yaksha trag rakmo mu kha li bhyo bhyoḥ byad ma nṛ tri ha la ham shang rbad ki kang shag shag du ru du ru hag hu lu ya pha rol byad ma thams cad zlog zlog: rbad nan mā ra ya bhyo bhyoḥ zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngam gang rung bgyis: dpal khrag 'thung bya rog srog gzan nag po byad ma rtsad brlag zhes bya ba chos skyong thun mong ma yin pa kun las 'phags pa 'di nyid sgrub cing mchod pa'i gang zag rnams la: nus mthu me las ngar tsha zhing myur mgyogs glog las bang mgyogs par 'byung zhing las kyi he ru ka chen po'i dgongs pa dang nges par mnyam mo: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug legs ldan rngam klong las: mchod bskang bsgrigs chog yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i bum: kun 'byung nor bu rin chen 'od rab gsal: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: dus bdag chen po'i tha tshig bya ra srungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi lor bal phu ya 'brog mtsho nas gdan drangs shing me rta lor shog ser las zhal bshus so// // ta) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i gsol kha bzhugs so: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag por 'dud: sa ma ya: dpal mgon nag po sgrub pa'i thabs: bkra shis yid 'ong dga' ba'i tshal: yang na dur khrod shing gcig drung :

ri rngam chu sgra nags 'jigs shing : chu brag chos 'byung 'dra ba ru: bhandha lcang lo mtshan ldan nang : gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng : 'bru nag dpal gtor snying gi gzugs: 'khor ni rang 'dra brgyad dang ni: sha khrag la sogs rgyan gyis brgyan: bdud rtsi sman raka dag kyang gtams: bum pa'i cha phyed chu yis bkang : mda' mo sgro gsum legs pa la: dar nag gdugs dang cod pan 'phur: bla 'khor srog yig bla rdo dang : me long gri snying rdo rje phur: brgyan te rten du 'dzugs par bya: sku 'bag la sogs spyan gzigs bsham: de nas 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐: ye nas kun gzhi stong pa'i dbyings: rang byung rtsal gyi 'od zer shar: sna tshogs sprul pa'i sa bon hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: de nas 'byung ba lnga brtseg pa ni: hūm̐: e las chos 'byung nam mkha' mthing : yam̐ las rlung gi rgya gram bsnol: ram̐ las bskal pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: kham̐ las rakta'i rba klong khol: sum̐ las sa gzhi smug nag khyab: keṃ las keng rus dur khrod chags: bhrūm̐ las thod mkhar 'jigs su rung : om̐ bhrūm̐ bhi shwa tsakra hūm̐: a tsand+ra maṇḍa la: ma sūrya maṇḍa la: paṃ padma maṇḍa la: ru ṭa ti ra baṃ: hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: badzra tsakra dzñā na hoḥ de nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: yi ge bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang : bhandha skam rlon brtsegs pa yi: rab 'jigs drag po'i thod mkhar ni: rmang gzhi gnam lcags ur mo bsnol: gru bzhi sgo bzhi mthongs skar phyes: ka gdung lha klu srin lpags bkab: g.yang gzhi rgyal mtshan thod pa'i tog: phyi rol dur khrod mtshon cha'i gur: bskal pa'i me ri smug nag 'khrigs: nang na rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: baṃ ro skam rlon lhu dum 'khrol: mi lpags stag lpags g.yang gzhi bres: don snying rnam lnga'i 'phen rdo 'phyangs: de dbus chos 'byung padma dang : bam chen smug po'i gdan gyi steng :

hūm̐ las byung ba'i nag po che: khrag 'thung legs ldan phyag bzhi pa: sma ra dbu skra dmar ser 'bar: thod skam prog zhu dar nag 'phur: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khyil: thal chen tshom bu sindhu ra: khrag zhag thig le zo ris zhag: g.yas gnyis gri gug tsitta dang : g.yon gnyis bhan dmar kha ṭwāṃ gaḥ sku la seṅge'i g.yang gzhi gsol: rus rgyan g.yer kha'i sgra dang ldan: sgeg cing sbom la yan lag rags: gsus khyim zlum la sma ra 'khyil: phyed skyil dgyes pa'i rngam stabs bzhugs: yum mchog dpal 'bar tsaṇḍi ma: dmar mo khro 'dzum gzi 'od 'bar: gri thod yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha 'khrol: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: zung 'jug bde chen rgyas par bsgom: spyi gtsug nyi zla padma'i steng : rigs kyi bdag po spyan ras gzigs: zhi zhing khro 'dzum rin chen brgyan: dmar gsal rdo rje bhandha 'dzin: thugs rje'i bdag nyid phyed skyil bzhugs: ye shes mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'khril: nor bu 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud: rus rgyan zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril: phyogs bzhir gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan ni: khro 'dzum rus pa'i rgyan ldan gar: g.yas pas cang te'u chos sgra sgrog: g.yon pas bhandha bdud rtsi bsnams: brda skad sgrogs shing chags tshul bsgom: hūm̐: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir 'khor lo'i rtsibs: shar phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: hūm̐ las yon tan bla med kyi: ye shes mgon po ma ning sku: mthing nag gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs ber nag gsol: tsandan beng chen sked par bcug: zhabs gnyis rol stabs bam steng 'gying : lho phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: hūm̐ las sku yi mgon po nag: ma hā kā la gdong bzhi pa: g.yas gnyis gri gug tsandan beng : g.yon gnyis bhandha rtse gsum 'dzin: khro gtum dur khrod chas dang ldan: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ro gdan 'gying :

nub phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: hūm̐ las gsung gi mgon po ni: sku mdog mthing nag phyag drug pa: gri gug thod phreng cang te'u g.yas: thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ zhags pa g.yon: khro zhing dgyes la dur khrod chas: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ro yi gdan: byang phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: hūm̐ las phrin las mgon po smug: bram ze dur khrod bdag po ni: khro 'dzum rus pa'i rgyan drug can: phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u 'khrol: g.yon pas gri rkang gling bu 'bud: stag sham rus rgyan ro gdan 'gying : mtshams bzhir gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro bzhi: gri gug kha ṭwāṃ dku la brten: rus rgyan dor stabs ro gdan 'gying : khro 'dzum yab la dgyes par bsgom: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yi: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams: chu zla bzhin du gsal bar bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od zer 'phros pas spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes sha chen gyi gsur btang zhing mi rkang gling bu gtser: rol mo dang bcas nas: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong : 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: ye shes mgon po gshegs su gsol: nag po chen po gshegs su gsol: legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol: ma hā kā la gshegs su gsol: mgon chen sde lnga gshegs su gsol: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gshegs su gsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra ho dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang drag po'i gnas mchog tu: khrag mchod padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs ma lus kun: mi g.yo bdag la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: om̐ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen nag po khrag 'thung rgyal: dpa' bo gyad kyi ya 'dor can: drag pos sa bcu gnon mdzad pa: legs ldan mgon por bdag bstod do: om̐ na mo a ti pu hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i bla bre mkha' la bres: rgyu ma'i lda ldi 'phan gdugs sna tshogs 'phyangs: mda' mo sgro gsum dar nag gdugs kyis brgyan: bla rdo srog 'khor me long phyag mtshan dang : nam mkha'i rgyan gyur bya nag lang ling 'phur: rta nag cang shes tshogs ni 'tsher skad gtser: g.yag nag zhol chen tshogs ni ngar sgra sgrog: lug nag dpyi dkar tshogs ni 'ba' sgra 'byin: khyi nag snying dkar tshogs ni dgra sha rngam: mi nag pho mo gcer bus gar rtsed sgyur: dug sbrul nag po'i tshogs ni 'khrug cing 'greng : tsitta'i nam mkha' nag po sprin ltar gtibs: rten gtor bshos bu nag po ri ltar brjid: dom nag la sogs gcan spyang sna tshogs ngar: g.yab dar ru dar rten dar nag po sogs: go khrab brjid ldan rno ngar mtshon cha gzengs: dur khrod pho brang bkod legs sna tshogs 'di: ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang ba'i khro mo ma sring tshogs la 'bul: mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskang ba ni: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : sku mgon gdong bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : yum mchog khro mo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang :

mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la nā tha pañtsa ḍākki nī sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: dgra bgegs dbang po'i me tog phung por brtsegs: sha chen gu gul dri spos dud sprin 'khrigs: rkang dang lha ba'i sgron me nyi ltar gsal: dgra bgegs snying khrag dri chab mtsho ltar 'khyil: 'bru nag 'bras kyi bshos bu ri ltar brjid: thod rnga gsang rnga rkang gling rol mo ldir: sna tshogs 'gyed pa'i mchod sprin gtibs pa 'di: ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang ba'i khro mo ma sring tshogs la 'bul: mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskang ba ni: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : yum chen khro mo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la nā tha pañtsa ḍākki nī puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ga pur dzā ti dri mchog sna tshogs dang : legs par sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi sman mchog gtams: bde stong yid 'dzin lha mo sna tshogs la: zung 'jug sbyor te bskul ba'i bdud rtsi dang : dbyings phyug bzang mo'i dmar chen rakta 'khyil: thabs chen rdo rje'i byang sems zla ltar rgyas: bhandha'i snod du bha ling gtor ma la: pha rol dgra bgegs sha khrag rus kyis brgyan: bsgral mchod la sogs dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'di: ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma sring tshogs la 'bul:

mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskang ba ni: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : yum chen khro mo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta hrī ṭha bha lingta māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: deng 'dir bdag cag sgrub pa'i sgor zhugs nas: phyi nang dam tshig nyams shing 'gal ba dang : dam rdzas ma tshang tshogs gtor chag pa dang : sgo gsum bag med dam 'gal ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma yaḥ ma nu pa la sogs yig brgya bzlas shing lhag chad bkang : de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: dbyangs snyan po dang bcas nas: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: chos dbyings thod mkhar e yi dal dbus su: legs ldan mgon po khrag 'thung phyag bzhi pa: sku mdog smug nag char sprin gtibs pa'i gzugs: dbu skra dmar ser srid rtse'i dbyings la bskyod: thod skam dbu rgyan snang srid dregs pa 'dul: dar nag cod pan ma sring mkha' 'gro sdud: a ra smin ma tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyen mthur gzigs: seng lpags gsol zhing snyan grags phyogs bcur sgrog: rus pa'i rgyan ldan g.yer kha 'u ru ru: lhu tshigs sbrul rgyan klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul: khrag zhag thig le thal tshom rgyan gyis spras:

sgeg cing dgyes pas ye shes 'jig rten sngangs: phyag g.yas gri gug bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod: tsitta 'dzin pas pha rol glo snying rol: ral gri 'bar bas bgegs dpung dum bur gtub: g.yon pas bhan dmar dam nyams klad khrag rol: kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin pas dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: gsus pa 'khyil bas 'gro ba'i tshe bsod sdud: phyed skyil rol stabs 'khor 'das zil gyis gnon: bam chen gdan bzhugs khrag 'thung nag por bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog lha mo dpal 'bar ma: shes rab rang bzhin dmar gsal gzi 'od 'bar: khro 'dzum mdangs ldan dga' bzhi bde stong bskul: phyag g.yas gri gug skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: g.yon pas bhan dmar dug lnga'i rakta stob: rus pa'i rgyan ldan phar phyin bskyed pa'i yum: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril dga' bzhi'i brda skad 'byin: tsaṇḍi dpal 'bar khro mo'i sku la bstod: hūm̐: spyi bo 'od dpung nyi zer gzi 'bar dbus: rigs kyi bdag po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: dmar gsal mdangs ldan ye shes mi g.yo dang : khro 'dzum spyan gyis mkha' dbyings phyogs bcur gzigs: rdo rje bhandha bden gnyis 'du 'bral med: phyed skyil lham me 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog dmar gsal 'od lnga'i mdangs: 'dzum zhal dgyes zhing mnyen lcug rus rgyan mdzes: phyag g.yas nor bus thabs mchog dpa' bo sdud: g.yon pa'i padmas ma sring las la bskul: mnyen lcug zhabs 'khril bde stong ye shes ngang : yum mchog shes rab sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi ye shes gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan khro 'dzum mdzes: rin chen rus rgyan sgrub la dngos grub ster: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem dgyes nyams sgeg pa mo: phyag g.yas cang te'us dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sdud: g.yon pa'i bdud rtsis rnal 'byor tshe srog sring :

nu ma bha ga rgyas shing gar sgyur ma: ma gcig ye shes ḍākki sde bzhir bstod: hūm̐: rab tu 'khrigs pa'i dur khrod sprin nag can: khrag mtsho me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: gnyis med mgon po ma ning khro bo rgyal: sku mdog mthing nag bla med rgyud sde'i sprul: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril khro gtum sa gsum dngangs: dbu skra thod skam me zer ya la la: phyag g.yas gri gug bstan dgra'i srog dbugs phral: g.yon pas bhan dmar dam nyams klad khrag gsol: mun pa'i lhu chen dug lnga zil gyis gnon: dur khrod chas ldan 'dre rgod dmag dpung bzlog: tsandan beng chen bdud 'dul dmag gi gter: brkyang bskum dor stabs brjid la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ti se chen po gangs kyi pho brang dbus: myur mgyogs sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon pa: ma hā kā la gdong bzhi mthu bo che: sku mdog nag po mun pa'i tsha zer 'phros: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyug: dbu skra'i gseb nas bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: thod skam 'bar ba'i prog zhu dar dmar 'phur: phyag g.yas gri gug bdud bzhi rtsad nas gzhom: tsandan beng chen gdug pa'i g.yul ngo zlog: g.yon pas bhan dmar rakta zhal du gsol: nyams pa bsgral phyir kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum phyar: dur khrod chas ldan bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel: brkyang bskum tshul ldan ma hā kā lar bstod: hūm̐: dur khrod chen po rab 'jigs bsil ba tshal: gdug pa'i shing drung ro langs 'tshogs pa'i dbus: dpal chen mgon po mthing nag phyag drug pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: dbu skra thod skam me yi bu yug 'tshubs: g.yas pas gri gug byad ma'i mgo lus phral: ḍā ma ru yis ma mo dbang du sdud: thod phreng 'dzin pas dmod pa'i drag sngags 'dren: g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dre rgod snying khrag rol: kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin pas dug gsum dbyings su sgrol: bdud zhags nag pos bstan dgra sgos dgra 'ching :

dur khrod chas ldan 'byung po'i gdon tshogs 'joms: brkyang bskum gar ldan nag po che la bstod: hūm̐: rngam drag tshal gyi dur khrod ha ha dgod: bam chen gsar rnying ri ltar brtsegs pa'i dbus: dur khrod bdag po mgon po bram ze'i gzugs: smug nag khro 'dzum dbu skra spyi bor bcings: thod skam dbu rgyan srid gsum zil gyis gnon: phyag g.yas cang te'us dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bskul: g.yon pas rkang gling snang srid dbang du sdud: rus pa'i rgyan ldan dregs pa bran du bkol: gar stabs tshul gyis phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs bcom: bram ze'i gzugs ldan dpa' bo che la bstod: hūm̐: chos 'byung e yi klong dkyil nas: las kyi yum chen mkha' 'gro bzhi: mthing nag khro 'dzum bhyo sgra sgrogs: thor tshugs skra grol sku rgyab khebs: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangs 'phur: gri gug nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod: bhan dmar dam nyams snying khrag 'thung : kha ṭwāṃ dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: rus rgyan las kyi ma mo sdud: gcer mo nu ma bha ga rgyas: brkyang bskum gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro rigs bzhir bstod: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang skyong ba yi: ye shes dang ni las grub pa: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhing skyong tshogs: ma sring shugs 'gro yang 'khor 'bum: phyi nang skyong ba'i lha la bstod: 'dzab bskul ni: hūm̐: dpal chen mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: drag sngags hūm̐ gis 'brug sgra ldir: phyi nang bar chad dbyings su sgrol: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin sngags 'chang la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: 'dzab kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: spros pas ye shes 'dod yon dgyes: tshur 'dus bdag gis dngos grub thob: ma grub bar du mi btang bzung : phrin las sgrub pa'i dus la bab: thugs dam gnad nas da skul cig: rigs bdag sngags la: om̐ ā wa lo ki te ḍākki pañtsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ

rtsa sngags la: om̐ ma hā kā la nā tha pañtsa kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bhyoḥ las sngags ni: om̐ ma hā kā la ya kṣeṃ kṣeṃ ma tri tsa tri hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma ning sngags ni: om̐ shrī ma hā ka la ga na gu hya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gdong bzhi pa la: om̐ ma hā kā la mu kha tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ phyag drug pa la: om̐ ma hā kā la kṣeṃ kṣeṃ ka ra ṣe ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ dur khrod bdag po la: om̐ ma hā kā la u ta tsarya hūm̐ phaṭ: de nas khro mo rigs bzhi la: om̐ ma tri ḍākki kro ti tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags rnams sgrub pa'i las rim ltar bzlas: de nas drag sngags ni: om̐ ma hā kā la kro ta raṃ he ru ka kro ti da sha tsaṇḍa ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ drag sngags rnams rgyun du bgrang mi dgos: de nas dgra bo rbad gsod kyi sngags ni: dgra bo byad ma gdon gyi rigs: glo bur bsad thabs shin tu zab: 'gyang na 'di na lan cig bskyar: ma spel gsang rgya sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: maṅga laṃ/ bkra shis// // tha) ༈ bka' rgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: ma hā kā la'i ka bstod ye shes rol pa bzhugs so: dpal ye shes mgon po ma hā kā lar 'dud: de yang yang rdzong shel gyi phug pa ru gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes ka dag zab mo'i snyan brgyud kyi lam mchog 'byongs shing rdo rje phur pa'i gdeng tshad grub pa'i tshe: ma hā kā las zhal dngos su bstan nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes shing : lhag par tu gnubs kyi gdung rgyud skyong bar tha tshig bgyis pa'i tshe: dran rdzogs nyid du ye shes mgon po la bstod pa'o: hūm̐: kā la rab 'jigs ye shes rol pa'i sku: kha gdangs mche gtsigs srid gsum lto bar 'gengs: ga shal mgo phreng dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: nga bdag g.yul las rgyal la bdag bstod do: ca co rgol ba'i dregs ldan ma rungs tshogs: cha lugs rtsal bcu'i stobs kyis 'joms mdzad pa: ja ltar mdangs ldan raktas rtag tu dgyes:

nya rgyas gzi 'bar 'od 'phro bdag bstod do: lta ba bla med bstan pa'i bya ra mkhan: tha dad so so'i snang ngor nag po che: da ni ma g.yel sngags bsrung tha tshig bzhin: na raka smin pa'i bdud bgegs 'joms la bstod: pa sangs dbyings su 'gyu ba'i rtsal chen ltar: pha rol dgra la mngon spyod 'bad mdzad pa: ba spu'i bu gar khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs: ma rungs sgrol mdzad mgon por bdag bstod do: rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bka' srung che: tsha zer dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar: dza yig spros pa'i pho nya dgra la 'gyed: wa skyes gnyen po seng ltar bdag bstod do: zhwa ltar spyi bor rigs bdag 'phags mchog brgyan: za byed tsaṇḍi ma mo pang du 'khyud: 'a 'ur sgra 'byin nag po phyag bzhi pa: ya nga srid gsum sngangs la bdag bstod do: ra gdong gri gug la sogs phyag mtshan thogs: la la rngam dang la la gtum pa mo: sha khrag dgyes mdzad legs ldan mgon po'i tshogs: sa steng dgra dpung gzhom la bdag bstod do: ha ha dgod pa'i bstan srung nag po che: a ti rdzogs chen skyong ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la kṣeṃ kṣeṃ dharmā pā la ra tri ghu na hri da hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ces ye shes mgon po'i bstod pa 'di rgyun du brtson zhing gsang sngags gnyan gyi slob ma la: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grog par 'gyur ro: ka bstod 'di ha ha dgod pa'i tshal du ma hā kā las zhal gzigs skabs kho bo buddha dzñā nas brda gnyis 'gyur du btab pa'o: sa ma ya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas gnubs ston gyi shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ maṅga laṃ// // da) ༈ khrag 'thung legs ldan mgon po'i srung bzlog khrigs su bsdebs pa bzhugs so: srung dmigs ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid legs ldan mgon po gsal ba yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ nang bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud: sku las khro tshogs me 'od skar ltar 'khrugs: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre sa gzhir gyur: om̐ ma hā kā la tsaṇḍa ka ra tsa tur hūm̐ bhyoḥ om̐ ka li de wi ḍākki hūm̐ bhyo nṛ bhrūm̐: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la pha rol gyi byad zor phur kha gang gis mi tshugs par srungs shig badzra rakṣa: lan gsum mam bdun bzlas: bsad dmigs ni: hūm̐ dzaḥ legs ldan nag po sprul pa'i pho brang 'og: zangs lcags 'khor lo spu gri so 'thab 'khor: bar du dgra bgegs sha khrag dum bur gtubs: brlag cing las mkhan pho nyas gsol bar gyur: om̐ lo ka du pra ma ya sarba ru tra trig nan e hur thum mā ra ya nan nan: dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad sha la gtub gtub: snying rtsa myog myog 'ur 'ur shig shig rbad rbad: zlog dmigs ni: hūm̐ dza bhyoḥ legs ldan mgon po'i srung 'khor phyi rol du: bzlog pa'i drag sngags dmod pa he ru kaḥ grangs med mtshon thogs zhal kha phyi la gzigs: dgra bgegs gnod byed phar la bzlog par gyur: om̐ sarba lokt+ri pā la ya dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: om̐ lo ka la trag raksha ya byad kha rbod gtong thams cad dgra la bzlog bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ya ma ha la ru tra kā wa tsi zlog zlog:

raksha kha la dun shag ru tra a mu ka waka thams cad baṃ ril zlog: pha rol bsam ngan 'chang ba'i dgra bo ban bon byad kha phur kha thams cad mā ra ya bhandha bhandha ṭa tra shag thum rbad nan: zhes zlog sngags gnyis zlog lan dgu bgrang zhing thal mo brdabs pas dgra bgegs byad ma 'byung po thams cad rdul du brlags par bsam/ zhes gong gi srung dmigs bkra shis mtshams su 'don pa dang bsad bzlog gnyis bzlog pa'i mthar sbyar na rno so che bar gsungs/ gter gzhung nas bsdus te shrī ming gis sbyar bas nyes 'gal gang mchis ye shes mgon por bshags// // na) bya rog gdong gi bstod pa bsdus pa ni: hūm̐ e: mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas: pad nyi ro yi gdan steng du: dbyings las ma g.yos nag po che: legs ldan srog bdag bya rog gdong : shin tu khros pa'i bka' sdod gzugs: phyag mtshan rno bas ma rungs mthar: dpa' ba'i chas ldan stag gis spras: tsaṇḍi yum 'khyud me dpung klong : bzhugs mdzad stobs ldan dpa' bo'i sku: dpal mgon chen por bdag bstod do: khyod kyi las byed pho nya ba: bdud po srog bdag mtshon thogs bzhi: nyin mtshan dus bzhi dgra srog nyul: de yis spyod pa'i ma mo bzhi: 'bar ma dus mtshan gnas nyul ma: pha rol gdug pa'i srog la 'khu: sprul pa yab yum tshogs la bstod: za gsod sprul pa glog ltar 'khyugs: bya rog dmar nag sprin ltar gtibs: stag dang dom nag brangs se brang : lcags spyang zangs 'phar 'du ru ru: mon pa srin bya'i ku sgra sgrog: ma nges cho 'phrul 'gyed pa'i tshogs: yang sprul tshogs la bdag bstod do: de nas bskang gzhung la 'jug par bya'o/ rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs pa'o// // pa) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i bskyed chog dregs pa rab 'bar nag po bzhugs so: dpal chen khrag 'thung ma hā kā lar 'dud: de yang dregs pa las la bskul zhing nyams pa thams cad tshar gcod pa'i sde brgyad bskyed chog la 'jug pa ni:

dkyil 'khor cha tshang shin tu gtsang zhing legs par bsgrigs nas: mi dmigs gsal rdzogs de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ngang las 'di ltar bya'o: om̐ badzra ma hā kā la kṣeṃ kṣe ṭa bighnān ma tri bhyo san dha li ku lu ku lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las snod bcud thams cad drag po'i zhing khams 'byung ba tsha grang drag tu 'khrugs pa'i dbus su pad nyi ru tra bsnol ba'i gdan la rang nyid khrag 'thung legs ldan nag po gsal bar gyur: de'i mdun du gnam lcags kyi brub khung shin tu yangs shing mi bzod pa'i dug rlangs nag po sngo dmar du phyur ba'i nang du dgra bgegs pho mo mngon sum ci bzhin du gsal bar gyur: hoḥ phyi rol rtsibs brgyad du shan pa las la chas pa'i pho nya dgra bgegs byad ma 'gugs shing gshed du 'bebs pa'i sde tshogs bskyed pa ni: hoḥ shar du srid pa lha yi rgyal po sku mdog dkar po g.yas shel gyi ral gri dang g.yon mdung dar 'dzin cing rta dkar la zhon pa: lho ru gshin rje ya ma ra tsa sku mdog mthing nag g.yas be con dang g.yon rgyu zhags 'dzin cing ma he la zhon pa: nub tu sman mo srid pa'i rgyal mo g.yas ral gri dang g.yon nad rkyal 'dzin cing g.yu 'brug la zhon pa: byang du bdud rje mi zan nag po g.yas dgra satwa dang g.yon khram shing 'dzin cing rta nag la zhon pa: shar lho srog bdag shel ging rgyal po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dgra snying rol zhing seṅge la zhon pa: lho nub tu btsan rje srog zan dmar po g.yas zangs gri dang g.yon zhags dmar 'dzin cing rta dmar la zhon pa: nub tu gnod sbyin 'bar ba khrag 'thung smug nag g.yas tho ba dang g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin cing stag mo ri bkra la zhon pa: byang shar du klu bdud 'chi bdag gnyan rje sku mdog sngo nag g.yas spu gri dang g.yon sbrul zhags 'dzin cing chu srin la zhon pa: de dag thams cad kyang shan pa dmag thabs can khrab rmog phub dang :

stag ral gzig shubs ldan zhing sga srab thams cad srin po'i cha lugs can bsam pa tsam gyis gling bzhi bskor ba: skye 'gro kun gyi srog la dbang ba de yi 'khor du gtogs pa bya sha zan gcan gzan khrag 'thung ste bye ba grangs med pa: rlung ltar 'tshubs par dran rdzogs su gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: srid pa ye grub kyi pho brang chen po rang rang gi gnas gsum las: dregs pa khrag 'thung sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs: om̐ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na badzra sa ma ya dza dza: mdun bskyed dang dbyer med du thim par gyur: dza hūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣṭha satwaṃ: de nas gtor mdos raktas bran zhing : hūm̐: dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul lo: rkang dmar lha ba'i gsur chen 'bul lo: mthun dgyes rdzas mchog sna tshogs 'bul lo: mnyes shing tshim pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la: pha rol nyams pa'i dgra bo pho mo chaig mo'i mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i srog la dbang ba drag po mngon spyod kyi las byed chen po mdzod cig: om̐ dharma dar pa bhri ka tri sarba dharma pa shaṃ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya dgra bgegs pho mo'i mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta i daṃ duṣṭāṃ kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: stong gsum khams na dbang byed pa: yab ni srid pa ma hā dhai: gnyis med spyad cing bshos pa'i bu: myur mgyogs las la grub pa yi: mi bsrun pho nya dregs pa'i sde: dgra srog gcod pa'i mthu bo che: gling bzhi'i mkha' la glog ltar 'gyu: nyams pa'i pha rol bla tshe 'gugs: rbad na bcol ba'i las mdzad pa: sde brgyad shan pa'i tshogs la bstod: ces bstod cing bka' yi lha srin sde brgyad thams cad byad ma dmigs pa'i dgra bo srog gcod shan pa'i tshul du gang yin bcol ba'i las bsgrubs par bsam: sde brgyad kyi snying po 'di brgya phrag gcig bzlas:

om̐ duṣṭāṃ dhe wi ging ka ra ya ma shu la ma tri yakṣa nā ga du pra ma sarba tsitta hri dha ya dza dza thun thun swā hā: zhes sde brgyad so so'i snying po 'di snying khar 'khor bar bsam: des ni sde brgyad thams cad rang dbang med par 'dus so: gang phyir yi dam lha yi go bsnyen pa chung ba rnams kyis sde brgyad dbang du mi 'du zhing 'gu ba dang ldog pa byung na: bla rdo 'chang ba ni: lha la dar dkar po'i nang du shel rdo btum: gshin rje la dar mthing khra gi nang du shing btum: ma mo la dar tshon sna tshogs kyi nang du me long btum: bdud la dar nag gi nang du bya rog gi snying btum: rgyal po la za 'og gi nang du spre'u snying btum: btsan la dar dmar po'i nang du bya mtshal lu'i snying btum: gnod sbyin la dar dmar smug gi nang du stag gi snying btum: klu bdud la dar sngon po'i nang du dug sbrul gyi snying btum: de rnams skyes pa stag lo dang byi glang lo pa gnyis kyi thod pa gwa'u kha sbyor gyi nang du bzhag: de dang zung du sde brgyad spyi chings sngags 'di mgo mjug ma log par bzhag: de yang hūm̐ gi mgo thod pa'i dpral bar bstan zhing sgrub pa po'i sar phyogs: pho thod steng dang mo 'og tu bzhag: bla rdo rnams sngags 'bru gsum gyis rab tu gnas shing bstim: 'chang ba'i tshe gri lcags kyis g.yogs de yi phyi stag gzig gang rung gi pags pas g.yogs: steng du lcags phur zangs phur seng lding gi phur pa gsum gyis brgyan: phur pa rnams mgon po yongs rdzogs kyi bsnyen pa khri yis rab tu gnas: rab ltar lus la 'chang ngam sgrub khang du rten 'dzugs bya yang bud med kyi mi mthong bar bya: khyi dang bud med kyi mi 'gom zhing dam nyams kyi lag gis mi reg: 'di'i dmod pa rgyun du bya na gza' rā hu la yi 'dra 'bag bzhengs nas de yi snying khar bzhag pas rbad pa tsam gyis skye 'gro gum nus par 'gyur ro:

khyad par mthu bsgrub na rā hu la'i lte ba'i kha ru dgra bo'i ming yig dmod tsam bzhag pas brlag nus par 'gyur: sde brgyad kyi zhal bstab dang dmod pa bgyis pa rnams ni lta ci smos: de phyir rang la mi ldog zhing rang gi gzhan la nus pa 'byin pa'i ched du bla rdo srog 'khor 'di gtso bas shin tu gsang : khyad par lus la ma 'chang na drag po mngon spyod kyi dus nyer dgu'am sbyin thebs kyi dus nyi mar bsten par bya: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug dpa' bo las kyi mtha': gang la btab kyang shor med sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal rngam pa rong nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ dge'o// // pha) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i dmag bskul gri gug rngam chen bzhugs so: dpal chen khrag 'thung nag por bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: legs ldan khrag 'thung nag po yi: dmag bskul gri gug rngam chen bstan: phyi nang bar chad bzlog pa dang : bstan dgra sgos dgra la sogs la: spu gri phyung rdeg gdams pa ste: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dmag bskul bya ba'i rim pa ni: ru mtshon dar nag mkha' la bsgreng : rang nyid chas gos nag po bya: gdong la rakta'i thig le byug: drag po'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig ngang : rnga brdung dung bus rakta dang : dgyes pa'i gtor tshogs rnams kyang bsham: legs ldan mgon po'i lha tshogs dang : srung ma dam can ma lus kun: go gyon ru mtshon thogs nas su: dgra la dmag sna 'dren par bsam: rig 'dzin lha dang srung ma rnams: rang gi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dang : gzu dang dpang du bzhugs par bsam: de nas dmag bskul 'di ltar bya: hūm̐: mi mngon chos dbyings pho brang nas: thugs rje'i bdag po spyan ras gzigs:

byang sems rigs lnga lha yi tshogs: gsang ba mkha' 'gro 'bum dang bcas: rdzu 'phrul dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dmag dpung bsdus: rdzu 'phrul drwa ba'i go cha gsol: ting 'dzin drag po'i mtshon cha thogs: myur mgyogs thugs rje'i rta la chibs: rtsal chen mthu yi ru mtshon phyor: gzi brjid thugs rje'i dmag chen g.yos: smon lam ngan pa'i bdud rigs rnams: shes rab mtshon gyis gzhom par gyis: dus la bab bo thugs rje can: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ārya lokki shwa ra ya hūm̐ dharma hrī dha phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐: rngam chen 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: nag po khrag 'thung phyag bzhi pa: gzi brjid me dpung 'u ru ru: drag sngags 'brug stong di ri ri: gzi brjid 'gying bag ye re re: bskal pa'i mun nag 'khrigs pa'i gzugs: che btsan ma hā kā la ya: mi mngon drag po'i dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pho rgyud khro rgyal dmag dpung skyed: ba spu'i bu ga re re nas: rang 'dra'i dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: gnam lcags go khrab si li li: rno dbal ral gri lhabs se lhab: dgra la mtshon 'beb sha ra ra: chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chos: pha rol g.yul ngo cham la phob: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: yang sprul lha dang rgyal po 'bum: dam nyams dgra bo sgrol la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la ra tsa tur ya bhyo bhyoḥ hūm̐: chos 'byung e yi klong dkyil nas: yum chen tsaṇḍa dpal 'bar ma: dmar mo me dpung tshwa tshwa 'khrug: hūm̐ bhyo drag sngags sha ra ra: stobs rtsal rang mdangs ta la la: snang srid g.yo 'khrug nyi li li: ma gcig lha mo re ma ti: gzi ldan 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod:

dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rgyud khro mo'i dmag dpung skyed: sprul pa yang sprul mkha' 'gro 'bum: rang 'dra'i dmag tshogs bye ba 'gyed: zangs khrab go cha si li li: gnam lcags ral gri lhabs se lhab: gri gug mtshon char dgra la phob: chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la bhyoḥ pha rol byad ma cham la phob: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: yang sprul ma mo bye ba 'bum: dam nyams dgra bo sgrol la shog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma tri kro ti ya bhyo bhyoḥ hūm̐: dur khrod thod mkhar pho brang nas: ma ning srog bdag khro bo'i rgyal: sku la dar nag lhubs se lhub: mun pa'i g.yung drung chi li li: rdzu 'phrul rngam stabs shigs se shig: stobs ldan nag po dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khro rgyal las kyi dmag dpung skyed: tsandan beng chen sgo drung nas: bdud btsan gshin rje'i dmag dpung 'gyed: rang 'dra'i dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: lcags khrab nag po si li li: spu gri'i mtshon cha zings se zing : dgra la thog rgod sna tshogs phob: chos shig byad ma'i steng du chos: pha rol dgra bo cham la phob: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: gshin rje btsan bdud bye ba 'bum: dam nyams dgra bo sgrol la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya ghu ye kro ta ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: gsang chen rngam pa'i dur khrod nas: ma hā kā la gdong bzhi pa: nag po chen po khrag 'thung rgyal: 'jigs byed chen po rdo rje'i gdong : dgyes pa'i gad mos sa gsum sngangs: stobs ldan nag po gdong bzhi pa: skye med chos dbyings klong nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sprul pa khrag 'thung dmag tshogs 'gyed: rang 'dra'i dmag dpung bye ba 'bum: smug po mchong khrab si li li:

rno dbal gri gug wa la la: rdo rje'i thog ser dgra la phob: chos shig dmag dpung dgra la chos: pha rol dgra bo'i mgo snying rol: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: yang sprul klu dang gnod sbyin 'bum: dam nyams dgra bo sgrol la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la kha kha tsa tur kro ta ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas: legs ldan mgon po phyag drug pa: ma hā kā la thod phreng can: sku la me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil: ri rab gling bzhi nyi li li: nyi zla gza' skar sha ra ra: nag po chen po dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'jigs byed las kyi dmag dpung skyed: rang 'dra'i khro rgyal bye ba 'bum: bswe khrab ser po si li li: gdeng chod spu gri zangs se zang : mtshon gyi char pa dgra la phob: chos shig pha rol dgra la chos: byad ma'i g.yul ngo cham la phob: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: yang sprul klu dang dam can 'bum: dam nyams dgra bo sgrol la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya kṣeṃ kṣeṃ kro ta ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: rtsub 'gyur rab 'jigs pho brang nas: dur khrod bdag po bram ze'i gzugs: snang srid snod bcud las la 'gyed: dbang sdud smug nag he ru kaḥ ye shes 'jig rten 'khor dang bcas: dur khrod bdag po dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khrag 'thung sprul pa'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: rang 'dra khro bo bye ba 'bum: sngon po'i g.yu khrab si li li: gdug pa'i mtshon cha wa la la: dug mda' sna dgu dgra la phob: chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chos: byad ma'i g.yul ngo cham la phob: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: yang sprul gza' dang ging chen 'bum: dam nyams dgra bo sgrol la shog:

dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la ghu ya kro ta ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ bhyoḥ me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas: khro mo sde bzhi skur bzhengs shig: gzi brjid tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: drag sngags glog dmar khyugs se khyug: ḍākki sde bzhi skur bzhengs shig: rig 'dzin bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sha za yang 'khor dmag dpung 'gyed: rang 'dra'i dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: dung khrab dngul khrab si li li: mtshon cha'i dbal kha sha ra ra: dgra la zor thun char ltar phob: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: yang sprul gter srung pho nya 'bum: dam nyams dgra bo sgrol la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma tri tsa tur kro ti ya hūm̐ bhyoḥ

zhes gtor ma phul zhing dmag la chas par bsam: dgra bo'i yul zhing thams cad rdo rje mtshon char gyis phye mar dkrugs par bsgom: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas padma sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bshus so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ba) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i bsgral las byad ma snying 'byin bzhugs so: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag por bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: khrag 'thung nag po'i las mtha' bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rim pa ni: mdun du drag po lcags snod du: liṅga dbang po tshang bar bsham: bsgral mtshams la sogs bsags nas su: rang nyid khrag 'thung chas gos brgyan: dang po gser skyems gtong ba ni: hūm̐: dag pa rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs su gsol: bdag ni rtse gcig don gyi rnal 'byor pa: thar pa sgrub cing gzhan don phan sems kyang : 'byung pos glags ltas dam nyams dgra bgegs kyis: byed du ma ster bar chod sdang gyur bas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: mkhyen ldan srung mas gzu dang dpang por mdzod: ye shes 'jig rten lha srung thams cad kyis: dam nyams 'di yi mgon skyabs ma byed cig: byad ma nyes can bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gser skyems btang : de nas rang nyid yi dam phyag bzhi par bskyed la: hūm̐: rang nyid skad cig khrag 'thung nag po'i sku: ye shes mgon po legs ldan phyag bzhi pa: srid gsum zil gnon sku las me dpung 'bar: ba spu'i bu gar rang 'dra'i khro chung 'gyed: mthu ldan dbang phyug khro rgyal chen por gsal: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ka ra tsa tur ni hūm̐ bhyo:

zhes drag sngags bgrang zhing mdun du liṅga bskyed pa ni: phaṭḥ mdun du rngam la 'thug pa'i lcags khang nag po sgo med pa'i nang du nṛ tri yongs su gyur pa las: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo byad ma sdug bsngal zhing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can: mgon skyabs kyi lha dang phral ba: bu ga dgu nas khrag bskyugs shing yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: phaṭḥ na mo drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa: ma ning gdong bzhi pa: phyag drug pa bram ze'i gzugs can ma mo bzhi: gzhan yang bka' sdod chos skyong dam can gter bdag rnams kyi bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa'i stobs drag po la brten nas: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sgos dgra: rnal 'byor pa dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la: gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bo byad ma: khyad par dmag sna jag sna ston pa: byad kha dang rbod gtong ngan pa: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: 'dzing rtsod 'khon ya byed pa'i dgra bo: mthu bu lon bzhin du snyog pa'i dam nyams byad ma 'di: mtho srid pa'i rtse mo: dma' na raka rdo rje: 'jig rten gyi mngal: sa 'og sa steng sa bla bar snang : chos bon srung ma'i skyabs 'og gar gnas kyang : las kyi pho nya nag po stong gi tshogs rnams kyis: rang dbang med par sbur ma rlung gis khyer ba bzhin du: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig: badzra aṅku sha ya dgra bo dzaḥ nṛ tri gzer thums: rmug chings khug dril rbad gtubs: nan nan: de nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid legs ldan nag po yi:

thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya'i tshogs: dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad rnams: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: las kyi spu gri g.yas la thogs: 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu g.yon na gdeng : mun pa'i zhags pa gru la bkon: stobs kyis skad cig dpag tshad khyab: chos shig rbad do dregs pa'i tshogs: yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bo 'di: steng 'og phyogs bcur gar gnas kyang : las mkhan pho nyas mgul nas khrid: 'gugs pa'i lcags kyus snying nas zungs: mun pa nag pos mdun nas bsus: las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas ded: bla 'gugs liṅga 'di la phob: 'dzin cing bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya a mu ka dza dzaḥ ru tra dzaḥ trig thum baṃ ril shag rbad: myog thum: de nas lha dang dbye ba ni: bya rog dang 'ug pa'i sgro thogs nas gu gul bdug cing : hūm̐: khrag 'thung pho rgyud sprul pa ni: khā kha mu kha bya rog gdong : sha za mo rgyud las byed ni: hu lu mu kha 'ug pa'i gdong : phyag na lha dbye'i spu gri 'dzin: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: srung skyob ban bon lha dang phyes: lhan skyes srog lha lus lha phyes: yul gnas dgra lha gnyen dang phyes: dgra bor mgon dang skyabs byed rnams: rdul phran bzhin du gtor bar gyis: dgra bo bdud dang da sprod cig: sngon las 'phral rkyen bdud dang sprod: nag po 'chi bdag lag tu gtod: byed du chug cing khram la thob: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyis: oṃ khā kha mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: phe sha trig sha dgra bo shag phyes: kha thun rbad nan dgra bo shag phyes: gzer thum myog chings dgra bo shag phyes: dgra bo thums shig dril nan: zhes lha dang phyes shing bdud dang sprod: thun brdeg cing drag sngags bzlas: de nas bsgral phur thogs nas: hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las sprul pa yi: sras mchog badzra ki la yā: khrag 'thung legs ldan bya rog gdong :

phyag na gnam lcags phur pa bsgril: rgya mdud 'brug stong 'u ru ru: 'chang bzung glog dmar khyugs se khyug: chu srin tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: zur gsum me lce ya la la: dgra bo'i snying du kī la yā: dkar nag srog gi rtain phur chod: rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra kī li kī la sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kī la khā kha mu kha ya: dgra bo'i snying srog la rbad rbad: sha la gtub gtub: snying rtsa myog myog 'ur 'ur shig shig rbad rbad: de nas thun brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: nyungs thun zor mda' lams se lam: me thun tshwa tshwa si li li: dug thun rlung ltar tshubs se tshub: khrag thun nad yams phyu ru ru: rdo thun rbab rgod sha ra ra: mtshe thun gzer mda' kyu ru ru: lcags thun zangs thun chi li li: mtshon thun rno ngar zings se zing : gcod byed ral gri skar ltar 'khrugs: thun dang mtshon cha'i char pa phob: thun bhyo raṃ bhyo rbad bhyoḥtrag bhyoḥ trig thum myog thum gzer thum: mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces mtshon gyis gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen legs ldan mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams: gnam sa gling bzhi dgyes pa'i zhal phyes shig: gangs dkar ri rab gtams pa'i sgrol mche gtsigs: myur mgyogs glog dmar 'khyug pa'i ljags rkyongs la: dmigs pa'i dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag bzhes: lhun grub bde stong zab pa'i mgrin par drongs: lhag med khro rgyal 'dus pa'i lto bar bskyil: dgyes shing lhag ma med par bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma rnams kyis dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa tsitta rakta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: zhes phuul zhing sman raka gis bran: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal padma'i lung nas gdan drangs shing*/ sgrub gnas padma chos 'byung gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/

sarba maṅga laṃ// // ma) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las mgon po'i rtsang bskul khrag zhag 'bar ba bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: rtsang bzlog byad ma'i snying gzer bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas rtsang bzlog bya ba ni: rtsang la raktas bran byas shing : thugs dam bskul ba'i rim pa ni: hūm̐: rab 'jigs dur khrod khrag zhag klong dkyil nas: las mkhan shan pa rtsang gi lha tshogs rnams: dmar nag pho brang gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: khrag mchod dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: zlog sgyur drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur dmar nag dbal zur gsum: las mkhan shan pa phur bu'i 'gros su btsugs: sha khrag brgyan cing rgyu ma'i zhags pas bsdams: hūm̐ bhyoḥ zlog rbad drag sngags log la bris: rtse mor bskal pa'i me ri wa la la: sked pa rgya mdud sha za las mkhan mkhar: rtsa bar bskal pa'i mun nag thibs se thib: gzir 'debs pho nya rngam pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: dgra bo lha srung pho nya rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: rtsang phur rtse mor lcags kyi bya rog grags: sked par dred mong ral bsigs g.yengs se g.yeng : rtsa bar dom nag smyon pa brengs se breng : srog len pho nya rbad pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: dgra bo'i mi nor yul zhing rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: rtsang rtser shan pas gar thabs khrigs se khrig: sked par las mkhan srog len zhungs se zhung : rtsa bar sha za bu yug tshubs se tshub: shan pa'i dmag dpung 'gyed pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: dgra bo rigs rgyud nang tshan rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: rtsang rtser drag sngags hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: sked par zlog sngags dmod pa sha ra ra:

rtsa bar rbad bsad 'khor lo kyi li li: khro rgyal dmod sngags 'dus pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: dgra bo'i sngags bzlas dmod pa rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: dpal chen mgon po nag po yi: phyag na sprul pa'i rtsang phur 'bum: mtho dman srid pa'i rtse mor gzengs: che chung ri rab rngams pa'i stabs: mang nyung rtsi shing rno ba'i ngar: gzir 'debs thog rgod lhung ba'i shugs: gtum drag drag po las kyi rtsang : khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: chag che nyam nga dgra la zlog: byad zor phur kha dgra la zlog: rkyen kha glo bur dgra la zlog: dmag 'khrug nad mtshon dgra la zlog: mi rung ltas ngan sna tshogs rnams: pha rol dgra la bzlog tu gsol: thun bhyo zor bhyoḥ rbad bhyo ha la tshal pa shag phye ma dgra bo bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces zlog sngags bzlas shing byad zor phur kha dgra la bzlogs par bsam: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing chos gling du shog ser nas bsgyur ro/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // tsa) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i bzlog pa yang gsang dgu sgril bzhugs so: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag por bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: phyi rabs rnal 'byor rig 'dzin gyi: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir: yang zab mgon po'i smad las bstan: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de nas bzlog pa bya ba ni: mdos khrag mchod dang bdud rtsis bran byas te: ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi khro bo thams cad zhal phyir gzigs te: bzlog ba'i las byed par bsam: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: ma hā kā la dpal 'bar mthu bo che: ye shes las dang 'jig rten khro bo'i tshogs: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig:

de ring zlog sgyur drag po'i phrin las mdzod: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : 'og min lhun grub pho brang du: ye shes 'jig rten 'thab pa'i tshe: dpal chen che mchog khro bo yis: 'jigs byed las kyi dal chen bzhengs: stobs 'dus rang byung gtor snod du: rtsal ldan drag po'i gtor chen bshams: gtum rngam gzir 'debs rtsang gis brgyan: bden gnyis drag sngags btab pa'i tshe: 'jig rten khro bo'i gdon tshogs bcom: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : nang pa sangs rgyas bstan pa la: phyi pa mu stegs bdud kyis 'tshe: dus gsum sangs rgyas bka' bgros pas: legs ldan mgon po nag po byon: stobs bcu 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: srid gsum rngam klong gtor snod du: rtsal chen dpal gyi zor bzlog bshams: sde brgyad pho nya rtsang gis brgyan: drag sngags rang sgra sgrog pa'i tshe: mu stegs dmag tshogs rdul du brlags: sngon byung bzlog pa de bzhin tu: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: phyi nang bar chod dgra la zlog: hūm̐: ma hā kā la mthu bo che: gzi ldan me 'od klong nas bzhengs: zlog sgyur phrin las dus la bab: ye shes 'jig rten bka' chad rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: 'jig rten khro bo'i bar chod rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: sha zas bsu ba gtong ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: lha yi bka' chad 'bebs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: lha min mtshon cha 'khrugs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: khrag 'thung ngan sngags 'bebs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: rgya gar chos kyi zor zlog rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol:
