zhang zhung bon pos mthu sgrub rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: sum yul glang zor dmod pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: me nyag rtswa dur gdan bgos rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: sngags pas kong zor 'phen pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: ban de'i dmod sngags 'debs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bon po'i dbal kha 'debs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: li yi spar sme gdan bgos rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: 'byung pos gdug pa'i thog zor rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: gnam sman dkar mo'i rgyangs glu rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: the'u rang dkar nag khra gsum rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: dmu yi gnam rdo 'phen pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: 'dre mo mi ru brdzu ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: srin mos bla tshe rku ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: sman mos bslu ba 'debs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bdud mo bong zhon 'gyu ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: mi min ro khur mthong ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bshan pas bsha' gri brdar ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: gre bo yul la chags pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: 'byung po 'dre rgod 'gyu ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bse rag khyim du zhugs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: phywa g.yang spar sme nyams pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: pha mes dur sri langs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: yul khyim 'dre chag che ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: sbra gur chon thag rgyug pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: ri dwags khyim du 'ong ba rnams:

dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: ri btsan nang du log pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: 'chi ba gshin rje'i rta rgyug rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: gnam sa me chen 'bar ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: srin byas ku sgra 'debs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: gcan gzan sgo rtsar zug pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: khyim du bdud byas tshang bcas rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bya than khyim du zhugs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bya nag sder 'dzing byed pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: lo dang shing 'bras skam pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: lha yis bka' chad 'bebs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: klu yi gtad la 'debs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: gnod sbyin za kha ston pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: rgyal pos smyo 'bog gtong ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: btsan gyi jag pa 'phyo ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bdud kyis khram khar 'debs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: ma mos nad yams gtong ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: sa bdag zha grum mdze rigs rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: klu bdud nag po'i lhog yams rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: dri zas mdangs la 'phrog pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: byad kha phur kha 'bebs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: me lhas hom sbar gnod pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: srin pos bar gcod brtsam pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: ro langs 'byung po 'khrug pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol:

ma rungs gshin rje'i sho rdel rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: rlung lhas khang khyim g.yer ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: bgegs kyis bar du gcod pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: the'u rang srid g.yang rku ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: dbang ldan sa srung 'khrugs pa rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: ma yams sun ma gtong ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: brtan mas yul 'khrugs gtong ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: yul lhas phrag dog gtong ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: sa srin nag po'i dug mda' rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: 'gong pos rma g.yang rku ba rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: che sri chung sri dar sri rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: rgan sri gzhon sri gri sri rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: nad sri yams sri dgra sri rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: lo skag zla skag zhag skag rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: nad skag 'chi skag dus skag rnams: dmar nag gtor mas bzlog tu gsol: pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur: mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ kā la trag raksha ya byad kha rbod gtong thams cad dgra la zlog: bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

ces zlog sngags bzla zhing rkyen ngan bar chod dgra la bzlog par bsam: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // tsha) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i gser skyems mchog gnyis bde chen bzhugs so: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag por bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: gser skyems lha ma'i mngon brgyan bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gser skyems bya ba'i rim pa ni: rin chen snod mchog legs pa'i nang : 'bras rgun bu ram chang gis gtams: gser mchod phud dang bsre bar bya: rang nyid drag po'i ting 'dzin dang : gser skyems sbreng zhing 'di skad do: hūm̐: chos dbyings nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: kun tu bzang po che mchog zhi khro'i lha: rig 'dzin rgyal ba brgyud bcas ma lus kun: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: pha rol byad ma dgra bgegs cham la phob: hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum e yi klong dkyil nas: mgon chen sde lnga yang 'khor bye ba 'bum: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi lha tshogs ma lus kun: che btsan myur mgyogs drag po'i klong nas bzhengs: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: pha rol byad ma lha srung cham la phob: hūm̐: khrag zhag me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas: legs ldan nag po srog bdag bya rog gdong : dpal 'bar zhing skyong ma gza' rdo rje legs: khyad par gnyer gtad gter srung pho nya'i tshogs: thogs med mngon rgyug rtsal gyis dbyings nas bzhengs:

rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: myur mgyogs sde brgyad dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: hūm̐: srid gsum ma 'gags stong pa'i da la nas: lha klu gza' dang sde brgyad phyogs skyong bcu: rgyu skar rtsa brgyad 'gyu ba sum cu gnyis: sgra gcan hal khyi gnam khyi ki kang dang : khra tsha zin phung khyab 'jug bīṣṭi dang : dbang mo bstan ma 'byung po sa bdag 'bum: lo chen drug cu lo khyim bcu gnyis dang : zhag dang dus tshod 'byung ba spar sme'i bdag: 'phrog ma bco lnga the se lo yi rgyal: srid par chags pa'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i zor sna dgra la drongs: hūm̐: tshe rabs snga phyi bsten cing bsgrub pa'i lha: gzhan yang skyes lha dgra lha srog lha dang : khyad par yul phyogs 'di ru gnas pa'i lha: yul lha zo dor gzhi bdag drag rtsal can: gdong dang zor lam thod du gnas pa dang : ko long sdom dang ru nga byed pa'i rigs: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i zor sna dgra la drongs: hūm̐: gzhan yang snang srid yongs kyi bdag po rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: g.yas g.yon phyogs su bzur la zor lam phyes: gtor zor 'phros kyang ma len smras pa'i tshig: drag po'i zor ni thog rgod me yi ngad: gang la btab kyang thogs med myur mgyogs can: dgra bgegs ma gtogs g.yan g.yon sku bzur cig: de ring bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas gser skyems btang zhing gtor ma 'bul: nang gi sgo dbye bya ba ni: sgo so sor rim bzhin gser skyems mchod la sgo rtsang bsal: hūm̐: pho brang shar gyi sgo srung ma: dkar mo phyag na lcags kyu 'dzin: thabs kyi lde mig si li li: shes rab sgo 'byed sha ra ra: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po phyes: dmag tshogs bzhengs la dmag dpung bskyed:

shar phyogs lha rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: hūm̐: pho brang lho yi sgo srung ma: ser mo phyag na zhags pa 'dzin: thabs kyi lde mig si li li: shes rab sgo 'byed sha ra ra: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs gser sgo ser po phyes: dmag tshogs bzhengs la zor dpung bskyed: lho phyogs lha rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: hūm̐: pho brang nub kyi sgo srung ma: dmar mo phyag na lcags sgrog 'dzin: thabs kyi lde mig si li li: shes rab sgo 'byed sha ra ra: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar po phyes: dmag tshogs bzhengs la zor dpung bskyed: nub phyogs lha rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: hūm̐: pho brang byang gi sgo srung ma: ljang mo phyag na dril bu 'dzin: thabs kyi lde mig si li li: shes rab sgo 'byed sha ra ra: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs lcags sgo nag po phyes: dmag tshogs bzhengs la zor dpung bskyed: byang phyogs lha rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor phyi nang bar khyams la: gnas pa'i srung ma dam can kun: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: de ring lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dmag gi dpung chen bskyed du gsol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gser skyems btang zhing phrin las bcol: mdos lhas dbyings nas dmag gi dpung bskyed par bsam: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas pad tshal nas gdan drangs shing chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // dza) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i zor mda' ma rungs snying 'byin bzhugs so: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag por bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: zor mda' dgra bo'i snying 'byin bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas zor mda' bstan pa ni: dug rdzas dgu yi zor mda' la: phung shul sa la kong zor bya: dmar sngo nag po'i mtshon bkra 'gyed: dmar nag rtsang gis legs par brgyan: de nas drag zor 'phen pa ni: hūm̐: mthing nag drag po me ri 'khrugs pa'i klong : dug lnga khro chu khol ma'i nang shed nas: che btsan 'dus pa'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: legs ldan mgon po'i dmag tshogs skur bzhengs shig: phyi nang dam can chos skyong skur bzhengs shig: zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: nga rgyal ri ltar nyil ba'i klong nas bzhengs: 'dod chags khrag mtsho mer ba'i klong nas bzhengs: phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: gti mug mun rum gtibs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring myur mgyogs drag po'i zor sna drongs: zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal he ru kaḥ nga ni 'jigs byed khrag 'thung sku: nga ni dpal chen nag po che: nga ni legs ldan mgon po'i sku: nga las che ba su yang med: srid gsum thams cad nga yi 'khor: snang srid thams cad nga yi grogs: dregs pa thams cad nga yi bran: nga ni khro bo kun gyi rgyal: nga ni khro mo kun gyi yab: chos dbyings klong nas bzhengs pa'i tshe: bskal pa'i me 'bar 'u ru ru: nam mkha'i klong nas bzhengs pa'i tshe: drag sngags 'brug sgra di ri ri: dmod sngags thog mda' sha ra ra: rbad bskul glog dmar khyugs se khyug: nyi zla gza' skar cha la la: ri rab gling bzhi nyi li li: rakta'i rgya mtsho khrugs se khrug: me yi ser ba hri li li: dug gi bu yug tshubs se tshub: nad kyi na bun thibs se thib: shan pa dgra 'dzin khyugs se khyug: khrag 'thung gad mo di ri ri: las byed 'dur lding chems se chem: bya gcan sha za nyi li li: drag po'i zor mda' wa la la: dgra bo'i bla srog snying nas chod:

sde brgyad dregs pa sha zan 'bum: de ring zor gyi sna drongs shig: dgra bo bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: las mkhan pho nya'i dus la bab: mā ra ya las grub pa med: hūm̐: dmar nag gtor ma'i zor chen ya: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: mgo bo tshal pa brgya ru khos: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: oṃ mā ra ya bha lingta ka la dgra bo nṛ tri rbad: hūm̐: reg phung dug gi zor mda' ya: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: lus ngag myos sregs thal bar thongs: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: oṃ ha la shag bhyo dgra bo nṛ tri rbad: hūm̐: 'joms byed nag po rdo zor ya: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan la: gri gtibs gri mtshon sna tshogs thongs: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: oṃ shaṃ la ya: dgra bo nṛ tri rbad: hūm̐: sreg byed me zor dmar po la: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: srung skyob lha srung gzhom par gyis: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: oṃ sha ri raṃ thun ya: dgra bo nṛ tri rbad: hūm̐: smyo byed dmar po khrag zor ya: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan la: nad yams dal kha char ltar phob: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: oṃ rakta thun dza ya dgra bo nṛ tri rbad: hūm̐: gcod byed 'bar ba gri zor ya: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: mgo snying yan lag dum bur chod: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: oṃ kha ṭa ra ga ya: dgra bo nṛ tri rbad: hūm̐: ldog med las kyi phur zor ya: dam nyams dgra bgegs las ngan gyi: dkar nag snying gi mtshams su bsnun: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: oṃ badzra kī la ya dgra bo nṛ tri rbad: hūm̐: 'chi bdag nag po'i khram zor ya: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: thig nag gshin rje'i khram la thob: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: oṃ ya ma thun trig ya: dgra bo nṛ tri rbad: hūm̐: phung thod zor mda' dgra la ya: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan la: mi rung phung ltas sna tshogs thongs: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig:

oṃ dza thun bhandha ya: dgra bo nṛ tri rbad: de nas mda' gzhu thogs la: hūm̐: nga ni legs ldan phyag bzhi pa: thabs shes las kyi pho nya ba: byang g.yag nag po'i rwa gzhu la: mchog chen gri rgod rgyud pas 'gugs: ngan sngags dgu sbyor 'chang bzung spras: gzhu mchog rtsibs la bshan pa 'gyu: khrag gi kha char thibs se thib: gzhu nyid ma mo tsa ti nag: hūm̐: dug gi tsher ma nag po la: phung byed lcung ka'i sgro dang gcig: srin bya 'ug pa'i sgro dang gnyis: than bya sreg pa'i sgro dang gsum: dug khrag nag po'i sgro sbyar ba'i: 'chi bdag pho nya'i mda' mo la: gri lcags zhun ma'i mde'u bskyon: stong dang mde'u srog gcod 'gyu: legs ldan bya rog gdong can nyid: hūm̐: thabs shes yab yum sprul pa yis: zor mda' thog 'bebs dgra la ya: dgra bo'i pho rgyud rtsad nas chod: dgra bo'i mo rgyud mngal nas skoms: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud rlung la skur: dgra bo'i sgo nor phyags mas thob: srog rtsa chod cig mā ra ya: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: zor mda' snying gzir mā ra ya: rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ha la na ṇa ka la ya: dgra bo'i srog rtsa la rbad bhyoḥ raṃ gtor rmug chum mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces zor 'phang zhing dgra bo byad ma thams cad bya sgro mer bsregs pa'am thal zhag rlung gis bskyod pa ltar phye mar btang bar bsam mo: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing chos gling du shog ser nas bsgyur ba'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // wa) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mgon po'i dgongs gsol chos sku rngam klong bzhugs so: khrag 'thung nag po'i sku la bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: dgongs gsol rngam yangs klong chen bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: de nas dar nag bsgrengs shing : rang nyid yi dam gyi nga rgyal bskyed de: dmod bcol gtor ma logs su yod na de ltar dang : med na mdos chen btegs shing brjod: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: gsan du gsol lo: gzigs su gsol lo: 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i klong chen po nas: kun bzang che mchog 'dus pa'i bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol: khyad par du yang dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi drug pa: ma ning nag po gdong bzhi mgon po: dur khrod kyi bdag po bram ze'i gzugs can: gzhan yang las kyi mgon po bya rog mtshan can: sha za khro mo bye ba 'bum phrag rnams dang : bka' srung chos skyong gter bdag drag rtsal dang ldan pa: nag po stong gi gtso bo sha za 'bum gyi ded dpon: rin chen gter gyi srung ma: yab chen po legs ldan nag po: yum ma mo dpal 'bar lha mo: sras mgon chen sde dgu: sprul pa dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs: sha la dga' ba: khrag la dgyes pa: snying rje dang bral ba: khyed rnams kyi snyan legs par gsan cing dgongs su gsol: hoḥ spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la sdang ba'i dgra bo lag dmar: sgrub gnas dben ri gnyan po bcom pa: snga dgra lag gis brdar ba: phyi dgra yid la sems shing da dgra thad du langs pa: mthu bu lon bzhin du snyog pa'i dgra bo: mtho gong nas rgol ba: dma' ngan sar 'bebs pa: mdun nas sgug pa: rgyab nas bcom pa: 'phrog cing 'khyer ba: ngos la bstod cing lkog nas smad pa: kha 'o ma las 'jam pa: sny-ing tsher ma las rtsub pa: bslabs pa'i slob ma dam nyams: rus kyi nang tshang rgyab log: bcos pa'i nad pa gsos log: gtam pa'i shag rogs mna' gzan: 'grogs pa'i mdza' rogs snying ngan: nyos pa'i chung ma ngo log: bzhag pa'i bran 'khor dam nyams: skyabs pa'i yon bdag gzhungs ngan:

bsten pa'i mgo dpon khrel med: dmigs pa'i ru tra lag dmar: dmag jag chen po'i sna 'dren: mi kha gtam ngan sbyor rtsub: pha rol gzhan mthus rgol ba: bdag la sdang ba'i ban bon: 'gras ya rtsod pa'i byad ma: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha ye shes mgon po la mthu med zer ba: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bo byad ma 'di: mgo 'khor bar gyis: yid 'khrugs par gyis: smyo zhing 'bog par gyis: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo pha rol byad ma de: mtho srid pa'i rtse mo: dma' na raka dmyal khams bco brgyad: srid pa gsum gang du gnas kyang : skyes pa pho rgyud la phog pas bya sgong brag la brgyab pa bzhin du thongs shig: bud med mo rgyud la phog na bra nag ser bas gtor ba bzhin du thongs shig: pha khu rgan rgyud la phog na bya sgro me la bsregs pa bzhin du thongs shig: skyes pa dar ma la phog na shing skam la thog rgod lhung ba ltar thongs shig: byis pa chung rgyud la phog na thal zhag rlung dmar drag pos gtor ba lta bur thongs shig: yul dang khang khyim la phog na ri rab mgo mjug ldog pa lta bur thongs shig: phyugs zhing nor rdzas la phog na dbyar sos kyis gangs ri nyil ba lta bur thongs shig: dgra bo pho rgyud thams cad gri ru shi bar gyis shig: mo rgyud thams cad smyo zhing 'bog par gyis shig: dgra bo'i yul zhing thams cad bskal pa'i tshad than dang nad yams drag pos khongs shig: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di lo dang zla bar ma 'jog: zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang bar khrag 'thung bye ba 'bum gyis dmar nag gtor ma 'di dang mnyam du bzhes shig: oṃ ma hā kā la ya trag raksha ru tra rbad thum gzer myog baṃ ril shag thum: trig nan bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

ces dar nag lan dgu brdab cing zlog dmigs drag po bya: dgra bo yul zhing phye mar bshig ste ming yang med par bsam sa ma ya: de nas gtor gzhong 'og tu dgra bo lan gsum 'gugs la: las gzhung ltar rta bro bya: gom pa dgu log ste sgab 'dre bcad: me yi bya khyung dmar nag bzhag: nang du log nas dngos grub blang zhing tshe 'gugs bya: bkra shis bsngo smon rgyas yang gdab: rten 'brel rtags shing phrin las bsdu: mi dmigs ka dag ngang la bzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: phyi rabs skal ldan don phyir du: ye shes mgon po'i las mtha' bzhag: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: dam sri 'dre rgod 'byung po dar: rkyen dbang bar chod che ba'i tshe: legs ldan mgon po'i bzlog pa 'di: bar chod sel ba'i yang zab chos: spel bar 'phangs nas gter du sbas: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: kho bo pad 'byung thugs kyi sras: rtsa gsum gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags byi lor hor zla dgu pa'i nyer lnga nyin sbas tshal nas padma can gyi bal yul yar 'brog klu yi yul nas khrom gter du bgyis te/ gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu bsgyur ro/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ka) dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rgyud rngam klong 'od 'byin bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so: khyab bdag khrag 'thung legs ldan rngam klong las: ye shes rol pa'i khro gar dgyes byed phyir: 'bar ba'i me ltar mched pa'i gsang rgyud bstan: sa ma ya: de yang khyab bdag he ru ka'i sngon byung rgyud kyi rnam pa cung zad dbye bar bya na: sngon 'og min lcang lo can nas lha'i bu gzi brjid 'od 'byin tshe 'phos nas: ri ma la ya'i mdun du bram ze nye bar gnas pa las rab tu byung ba'i dge slong kun dga' gzhon nu zhes pa de nyid:

smad 'tshong ma kun 'dus ma zhes par nyer len 'brel bas ltung ba'i cha las tshe 'phos pas: pham sems kyi shugs kyis pha lha dang yum gnod sbyin mo gnyis mun rub bdud 'gyu ba'i tshe ma la ya bam ri'i rtser bshos pa'i bu seṅge'i mgo bo yod pa zhig tu rdzus te skyes: de'i tshe gling de la dbang bsgyur zhing kun gyis glags mi rnyed pa 'jig rten phung 'tshengs legs nyes su 'bebs pa zhig du mngon pas: dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos dam du bzhag nas rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug cing gsang mtshan gha ya dha ra zhes su gsol: ye shes dang las la grub pa'i phyir mkha' 'gro kun 'dus ma la si na ra ma zhes lus ma spangs par bstan pa'i bya ra 'grub par sbran: de yi tshe ye shes spros pa'i rgyud las: yab khyab bdag he ru kas ma rungs 'dul ba khro bo'i rgyal po dang : yum rdo rje dbyings kyi rnal 'byor kun 'dus mkha' 'gro: sras gzhon nu legs grub rdo rje rtsal: yum rdo rje rab rgyu ma zhes pa ye shes dang las kyi srung mar gyur: bar du rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas kyis gsang sngags bla med theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug ste: gnas yul thams cad kyi gnyer byang gtad de 'khor drug gi gling dang khyad par gyi gling bcu gnyis bcas kyi phrin las kun 'grub pa'i byed por mnga' mdzad nas: khyab bdag khrag 'thung he ru ka dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po yab yum dregs pa sde brgyad kyi 'khor bcas bstan pa'i bya ra 'grub pa po zhes bsngags pa brjod de gter kha thams cad kyi srung mar bskos: rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che skyong ba'i tha tshig phul: des na chos skyong thams cad kyi phrin las gcig 'dus ltar mngon spyod thog ltar 'bebs pa'i nus pa ldan: sgrub pa'i grogs rlung gi pho nya ltar bskul bde: sgrub pa po la 'khu ldog med: ye shes pa dang rol rtsal mnyam:

pha rol dgra la rtags 'byin pa gshin rje dmod pa dug mda'i nus pa dang 'gran yar bzod pa'i ngad 'byin: bka' skyong dkor nor gnyer pa'i chos skyong nag po rab 'bar du grags pa yin phyir kun las kyang 'gran zla bral ba'o: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis: dregs rgyud spyi chings las bsdus shing : sngon byung rgyud 'grel tha thor bzhag: mngon spyod las chings chen mor gsal: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor gdan drangs shing chu byi lor gnas chen smug brag rdzong gi mdun du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // kha)༈ dpal mgon zhing skyong legs ldan rngam klong las: dbang bskur dregs pa'i srog thig dmar po bzhugs so: shrī nā tha he ru ka ye bi bhu ma hā kṣe ṭa pa la dzwa la satwaṃ: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: dpal mgon zhing skyong nag po yi: dbang mchog srog thig dmar po bstan: dbyangs can ḍākki'i gzungs kyis zungs: mi nub gsang ba'i gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de nas dbang bskur bgyis pa ni: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum ste: rdzas bsags chas rnams bkram pa dang : dbang bskur lung 'bog me tog 'thor: bsngo smon bgyis sogs rnam gsum ste: thog mar rdzas bkram sgrub pa ni: shin tu gtsang ba'i stegs bu'i khar: ras bris sam ni 'bru tshom bsham: de dbus dpal mgon gtor ma ni: snying bshos padma 'dab bzhis bskor: rtse mor rgyan bkra legs par btags: sde brgyad grangs kyi ril bus bskor: mgon po'i tsa ka li yang gzugs: rgyud la dar nag gdugs kyang dbub: ci ltar mdzes shing dwangs par bya: g.yas su bum pa tshad ldan nang : rdzas sman dri bzang chu yis gtams: kha rgyan mgul chings tshang bar bya: g.yon du bla 'khor srog rten bzhag: mdun du sman rag mchod gzhung bsgrigs:

gzhan yang dbang las sna tshogs bkram: mdzes pa'i 'phan dar tshogs kyang bkod: bag dro lhun chags ldan par bya: sa ma ya: de nas bsgrub cing spel ba ni: thog mar dkar gtor legs par bsngos: mgon po'i las byang gzhung bzhin btang : bsnyen par bskyal te tshogs bgyis nas: slob ma thams cad gral du 'khod: thog mar bka' bsgo mtshams gcod bya: maṇḍal 'bul zhing khrus kyang bya: lo rgyus gzhung bsrangs rgyu 'bras bshad: de nas dngos gzhir 'jug pa ni: gsol btab tha tshig bsgrag par bya: slob mas: kyaiḥ che mchog dpa' bo he ru kaḥ rdo rje rgyal po dgongs su gsol: skal ldan dad mos yang dag pas: mgon pos las kun deng gnang stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ khyed rnams nges par snod ldan nam: 'di ni khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor te: gnyan cing skal med gshed du reg: de bas khas longs dbang mchog sbyin: slob mas: kyaiḥ bdag cag yang dag skal bar ldan: sngon nas smon lam las kyis 'brel: deng 'dir gsol 'debs gdung ba yis: bskul te dam tshig srog ltar 'dzin: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ de ltar skal ldan las sad na: dkyil 'khor 'jug cing dbang mchog sbyin: 'di ni bla med rgyud kyi mgon: sa bcu'i byang chub chen po'o: de nas bum pa thogs la: tha tshig dam chu sbyin pa ni: hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: dam srung mchog gi dngos grub thob: dam med dmyal ba'i sa bon smin: de nas dam tshig chu 'di 'thung : oṃ sa ma ya i dante na ra kan: zhes pas dam chu sbyin no: de nas bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ slob ma mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis e mthing nag me ri 'bar ba'i dbus su pad nyi ro yi gdan la: rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dran rdzogs su bskyed pa'i dpal chen ma hā kā la seṅge'i gdong pa can:

sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa'i cha lugs can dur khrod rgyan gyis mdzes pa phyag g.yas pas ru dar dang g.yon gtor chen bsnams pa: sgeg cing dpa' la zhabs gnyis dor thabs bgrad de yum seng gdong dmar mo'i sku la 'khril nas bskal pa'i me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su gsal ba'o: de'i mdun du sprul pa'i bam̐ gnyis phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs kyis bskor ba'o: bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: rang bzhin dbyings kyi pho brang dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gnas nas dpal chen lha tshogs spyan drangs te: sku che phra chung gsum rdul ltar 'khrigs te slob ma la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig: ces pas ye shes pa spyan drangs nas slob ma la thim par bsam: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya badzra sa mā ya dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ a we sha ya a āḥ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la: oṃ tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes bsnol thabs 'dod: de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni: hoḥ bla ma mgon po dbyings nas gshegs: mos pa'i skal ldan lus la zhugs: phyag 'tshal yid kyis dwang bas mchod: dbang bzhi'i mchog thun dngos grub stsol: lan gsum gyis brjod: de nas maṇḍal phul zhing lus ngag yid gsum gdung ba'i dad pa dang bcas nas me tog 'thor: thog mar sku bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni: ngo sprod dang bcas te: hūm̐: bum pa rang byung gzhal yas khang : bcud ni bla ma mgon po dngos: dbyer med de bzhin dbang bskur bas: sprul bsgyur skyed pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bhyoḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes maṇḍal dang bcas nas me tog 'thor: de nas gsung gi dbang bskur ba ni: sngags sam bhandha thogs la ngo sprod cing : hūm̐: bhandha lhun grub stong pa'i dbyings: bdud rtsi bla ma mgon po dngos: dbyer med de bzhin dbang bskur bas:

spro bsdu gsang sngags dbang thob shog: shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bhyoḥ wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes maṇḍal dang bcas nas me tog 'thor: de nas thugs kyi dbang bskur ba ni: dkyil 'khor me long thogs la: ngo sprod pa ni: hūm̐: snang stong ye shes 'od kyi klong : rang zhal bla ma mgon po dngos: dbyer med de bzhin dbang bskur bas: rdzogs rim thugs kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bhyoḥ oṃ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes maṇḍal dang bcas nas me tog 'thor: de nas yon tan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: gtor ma thogs la: ngo sprod cing : hūm̐: rmad byung bla med rdzas chen po: bcud mchog bla ma mgon po dang : dbyer med de bzhin dbang bskur bas: sgom sgrub spel ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bhyoḥ oṃ gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes maṇḍal dang bcas nas me tog 'thor: de nas phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba ni: rdo rje dang phur pa thogs la: ngo sprod pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen thabs shes rgya rtags ni: bla ma mgon po'i phyag rgya'i chas: byin gyis brlabs te gtad pa yis: las bzhi'i phrin las dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bhyoḥ oṃ gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes maṇḍal dang bcas nas me tog 'thor: de nas phyag mtshan dbang bskur ba ni: ru mtshon dang gtor zor thogs la: hūm̐: ru mtshon rgol ba 'joms pa'i rdzas: gtor zor dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon: de ring skal ldan lag tu gtad: dmod pa yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī si na ra ma tri hring dza hūm̐ bhyoḥ oṃ karma bhandha ra tyā ga sarba ya tshintu swā hā: zhes maṇḍal dang bcas nas me tog 'thor:

de nas drag mos dbang bskur ba ni ngo sprod cing : hūm̐: bde chen dbyings phyug gsang ba'i yum: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: 'khor lo phyag rgya rab bzung nas: 'bebs ldog rjes shes gsal rdzogs shog: oṃ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma gu hya mu ḍa a we sha ya rā ga dha ra sarba dzñā na ye satwaṃ: zhes maṇḍal dang bcas nas me tog 'thor: de nas srog 'khor bla rten gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: dam tshig gsang ba mchog gi rten: bla ma mgon po mnyes pa'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: bstan srung bsgrub pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra gu hya sa ma ya: sa dhe na bhi na a ya ka ra ye swā hā: zhes maṇḍal dang bcas nas me tog 'thor: de nas go cha thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba ni: gzhan nas sab pa yang 'thad: sde brgyad spyi gtor lag tu gtad te: hūm̐: lha btsan ma mo dge bsnyen dang : bdud gza' dgra lha dam can tshogs: de ring slob bur dka' gtad sbyin: las mdzad gter srung dbang thob shog: oṃ dhe wa tsa shu la e ka tsa ti nā ga raksha du pra ma rā hu la sa dhe wa riddha ma hā badzra sa du tri sarba dharma pā la karma dha ra swā hā: zhes pas lag tu gtad nas dam tshig 'chang : de nas byin rlabs bka' bsgo bya zhing bstims nas bkra shis brjod: dam tshig rdo rjes rgyas gdab: gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal sogs brjod: bsrung ba'i dam tshig 'bog bsgrub pa'i khas len bcol: rjes bsngo smon bzang pos mtshams sbyar: slar gtor 'bul bya zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu: thun tha mar 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhag: 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' srung yin slob ma snod ldan las dag ma yin par bka' mi gtad: shin tu gsang shing snying ltar brtse bas zungs: sa ma ya: e maḥ yang zab kun gyi snying thig yid bzhin las: dregs pa srog thig dwangs ma'i gdams pa bzhag: kun gyi thun mong ma yin myur zab rgya:

las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor/ lho gnas mchog tsā ri ṭa nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bshus so// // ga) ༈ dpal mgon zhing skyong legs ldan rngam klong las: sgrub pa'i phrin las khrag 'thung rab 'bar nag po bzhugs so: shṛ nā tha he ru ka ba shu ma hā kṣe ṭa pā la dzwa la satwaṃ: e ma bdag 'dra kho bo padma 'byung gnas kyis: yang gsang zab mo snying gi thig le las: dpal mgon zh-ing skyong stobs ldan nag po yi: sgrub pa'i las rim me rlung stobs sbyor bstan: ye shes mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: bka' yi rgya 'di gza' rgod 'bar bas srungs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma la: rig 'dzin thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de yang dpal mgon zhing skyong chen po'i bsgrub pa ni: las kyi rim pa dbye bar bya ste: dang po phyi ltar dkyil 'khor mchod rdzas la brten nas bsgrub pa dang : nang ltar ting 'dzin gnas lugs la brten nas bsgrub pa dang : gsang ba srog sngags dmigs pa la brten nas bsgrub pa dang : kho na nyid rang shar ye bzhugs la brten nas bsgrub pa dang : las kyi rim pa bzhi bstan pa las: 'di la rten 'brel zung 'jug tu bsgrub pa ste: dang po las rim sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum mo: de yang rdzas bsags rten bkram byin gyis brlab pa'o: de yang phyi yi mchod rdzas gzhung bzhin la: khyad par thun mong ma yin pa nyer mkho sgrub pa'i yo byad ni: stegs bu lcags kyi mañdza'i steng du dmar nag gtor ma khru gang ngam: mtho gang ba rtsibs brgyad thod mkhar dang ldan pa stegs bu'i kha ru bzhag: rtse mor khro bo'i seng zhal gyis mtshan pa'i mar rgyan 'dogs: mdun g.yon phyogs su yum la gtor ma phyed cha'i tshad tsam:

'khor rnams la sum cha tsam re thams cad rgyan gyis mdzes par bya: sgrub pa'i tshe dbang po rnam lnga'i tshom bu dang liṅga'i rgyal mtshan brgyad kyis spras: g.yas g.yon gnyis su dred mong la mi ro bkal ba: mtshams su o kyu khrag kong dang bhandha lha grangs ltar rtsibs kyi zur du ke tshe shang tshe nyungs dkar nag dang bcas pa: thun rdzas kong bu'i tshom bu de'i phyi la bha ling sgal can gyis bskor: rtse mo srog 'khor la dar nag po'i gdugs me long dang sgrub chas btags: rgyas pa ltar na ra snying tsitta'-i

tsitta zhes pa 'di la go don bzhi yod pa las skabs 'dir ri mor go dgos pa 'dra mchan snying dang gnam lcags 'khor lo drwa ba drug cu sku gsum rdo rje sogs 'dzugs: thun gtor sogs ni gzhung bzhin bya: bskang rdzas spyi mthun lag len ltar: ci bzhin tshang zhing lag len la rab tu mkhas par bya: sa ma ya: ho nag po chen po khrag 'thung gi: las rim sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: mchog thun bde blag nyid du bstsal: 'di nyid ye shes mgon po'i phyir: chos skyong kun gyis 'gran zla bral: khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa yi: gang 'dul snying rje'i rtsal chen gyi: nyid zhi khro gar sprul pa'-i lha: sems can so so'i snang ngo ru: bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe tshul: dpa' bo seṅge'i gdong du grags: bzhugs yul nges pa ma mchis kyang : brda yi bye brag mtshon pa'i phyir: srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing : 'jig rten dregs pa'i cha lugs 'chang : gnas ni khyab 'jug seṅge brag: sprul pa gang gnyan rtsa gnyis dang : mtsho chen drug cu rtsa gnyis khyab: dur khrod brgyad la rngam par rgyu: ma mo bcu drug rtag tu rol: rab rgyu'i srang kha nyer brgyad nyul: pho brang dgu yi bdag por skyong : rtsa ba gsum gyi gnyer gtad 'dzin: tshang tshing 'khrigs dang ha ha rgod: rngam sgra bsil ba tshal chen dang : sgyu ma'i sku nyid gar dgu ston: bstan pa'i bya ra dbyings nas 'debs: nag po stong gi gtso bo mdzad: ma rungs dpung tshogs rab tu mthar: rdul mtshon rlung gi 'khor lo'i dpal: dgra bgegs srog rtsa'i sbubs su bsnun: bka' skyong nor bsnyags chas la gnyer: las la mtha' sdud kun la rgyu: dga' bzhi'i thig le'i babs rgyun srung : mu stegs stong yang dmod tsam brlag: sgrub la dam tshig snying ltar brtse: de bas bka' skyong mchog gyur nyid: yid kyi tsittar sba nas bsgrub: bka' 'di kun gyi thun mong yin: zab pas mos snang gzungs kyis zungs:

'jigs med sgra gcan gzhon nus srungs: rten dang g.yo snang khyab des rgya: de yang legs ldan nag po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: dang po rang nyid yi dam gang rung gi: las byang bdag bskyed gsal btab de yi ngang : mchod pa'i rdzas dag mi gtsang bag chags sbyang : byin rlabs spel nas mdun bskyed wal gyis gsal: ting 'dzin rnam gsum nga rgyal brtan par bya: dang po sbyang ba ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ ā yur tsi sarba shuddhe shuddhe bi shuddhe ye swā hā: gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta pū dza om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum byin gyis brlabs: de nas mdun bskyed bya ba ni: sha chen gyi spos bsregs shing rkang gling rol mo drag tu btang ste rngam dbyangs hūm̐ dgu mas 'di skad do: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: rang nyid skad cig dpal chen gsal ba'i mdun: dur khrod bam ri khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong : thod mkhar dmar nag 'bar ba'i dbus shed na: byad ma mi ro rta ro brtsegs pa'i steng : raṃ dang nyi zla'i srog tu rdo rje'i dbus: hūm̐ bhyo mthing nag me zer tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: dgra bgegs tshar bcad gzi byin tshur 'dus pas: mthu stobs hūm̐ la thim pa'i he ru kaḥ dpal mgon legs ldan 'jigs byed seṅge'i gdong : sku mdog mthing nag zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: spyan gsum smin ma 'bar zhing g.yu ral gtibs: seng chung zer 'gyed thod skam dbu la brgyan: spyi bor rigs bdag dar dmar cod pan 'phur: dar nag phod gsol ru mtshon gtor zor bsnams: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri 'od ldan 'khyugs:

rgya lham g.yu mthil sga srab srin po'i chas: bdud rta nag po rlung gshog rting dkar chibs: me rlung klong bzhugs las chas tshul du gsal: oṃ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: g.yon du bhyo las ma gcig re ma ti: las chas tshul 'dzin bdud mo seṅge'i gdong : sku mdog dmar nag khros pa'i cha byad can: khrag ral seng chung 'phro dang thod skam brgyan: kha ṭwāṃ dgra snying dmar po gtor zor bsnams: dar dmar phod dang swag lham g.yu mthil gsol: bdud rta dmar po me yi gshog can chibs: srin po'i chas ldan dgra la rngam par bsgom: oṃ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: yab yum mdun du las byed sprul pa ni: bam ro pho mo zangs sprel dmar nag gzugs: lag gnyis sa la btsugs nas bya sder 'khrab: rkang pas bhandha lcang lo'i gtor zor thogs: dgra la cho 'phrul 'bebs byed tshul du gsal: oṃ nirmā marga ṭa na mu kha tri tri da ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: shar phyogs 'khor lo dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng : lha yi btsan rgod chen po rdo rje 'bar: sku mdog dkar po dung khrab rmog zhu can: phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas mdung dar 'dzin: stag ral gzig shubs ldan zhing dmag thabs can: ngang dkar sna sngon sga srab chas mdzes chibs: hūm̐: lho phyogs 'khor lo dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng : gter srung btsan gyi gnod sbyin khrag 'thung dmar: bswe khrab rmog zhu beng dang ru mtshon bsnams: stag ral gzig shubs brgyan cing swag lham gsol: rag pa rting dkar sga srab chas mdzes chibs: hūm̐: nub phyogs 'khor lo dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng : ma mo chen po srog bdag sngags srung ma: dmar nag ral gcig spyan gcig mche ba gcig: nu gcig rkang gcig gcer mo dur khrod chas: phyag g.yas rtse gsum g.yon pas tsitta bsnams: rol stabs tshul gyis g.yu 'brug mgo dgu zhon: hūm̐: byang phyogs 'khor lo dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng :

klu yi dge bsnyen nā ga raksha ni: sku mdog mthing nag rab khros phod kha nag: g.yu khrab gsol zhing lhu tshigs sbrul gyis brgyan: ral gri lcags par stag ral gzig shubs can: rta nag rting dkar sga srab chas ldan zhon: hūm̐: shar lho 'khor lo dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng : bdud mgon nag po mi bsrun khros pa'i gzugs: lcags khrab rmog zhu gsol nas 'khor gsum brgyan: dgra satwa lcags kyu zhags pa dar mdung gdengs: swag lham gsol nas bdud rta rlung gshog chibs: hūm̐: lho nub 'khor lo dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng : srog bdag chen po gza' bdud rā hu la: ljang sngon dud mdog dbu dgu bya rog gdong : g.yas gnyis ral gri gnam lcags thog mda' 'phen: g.yon gnyis chu srin rgyal mtshan sbrul zhags 'phen: lte bar zhal bgrad sku lus mig gis brgyan: dug sbrul mjug 'phyang glog zhags dmar po chibs: hūm̐: nub byang 'khor lo dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng : las kyi dgra lha chen po myur mgyogs can: sku mdog smug nag rdo rje'i go khrab rmog: ral gri ru mtshon gnam lcags phur bu bsnams: stag ral gzig shubs btsan mdung zhags pa thogs: mtshal stag dmar po dgra la rngam byed chibs: hūm̐: byang shar 'khor lo dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng : skyes bu chen po dam can rdo rje legs: sku mdog dmar smug bswe theb ber dmar gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas dgra snying rol: stag ral gzig shubs btsan mdung zhags pa thogs: rab tu 'gying ba'i seṅge dkar mo chibs: hūm̐: dam can rgya mtsho'i sprul pa yang sprul ni: shan pa dmar nag skyes bu gri thogs stong : mon pa nag po rlung zhags thogs pa 'bum: za gsod dbugs la rngam pa sa ya'i grangs: bya gcan sha za la sogs grangs med 'khor: ye shes las grub 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho rnams: khams gsum srid kyi bar snang sa gzhi gang : rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang mi bzad rngam par ston:

oṃ dhe wa tsa shu la e ka dzā ṭi nā ga raksha du pra ma rā hu la pa ti dhe wa riddhi ma hā badzra sā dhu tri dharma pā la satwaṃ: hūm̐: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams: rang rang gnas chen pho brang gar bzhugs kyang : las kyi rlung gi shugs ltar 'gyu nas su: skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig dbyer med du gyur: phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po spyan 'dren pa ni: sha chen gyi dud pa btang : ḍā ma shang kha ghaṇḍe bhandha'i cang te'u rnga bo che sogs drag tu brdung : dam tshig rdo rje dar nag gis spyan drangs: ru mtshon sna tshogs gzengs: rakta'i skyems chen sbreng : rang nyid dpa' bo'i nga rgyal gyi hūm̐ dgu ma'i gdangs dang bcas nas spyan 'dren: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: he ya hi: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: he ya hi: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: he ya bhyoḥ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: nag po chen po seng gdong gshegs su gsol: dag pa mkha' spyod ye shes pho brang nas: bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong gshegs su gsol: dug rlangs me dpung 'khrigs pa'i pho brang nas: sprul pa'i bam chen pho mo gshegs su gsol: rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: dam can sde brgyad dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol: bka' bzhin phrin las sgrub pa'i pho brang nas: sprul pa'i las byed 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: tshur gshegs tshur byon dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: khyad par gnas chen kun la dbang bsgyur tshe: ma la ya dang me ri 'bar ba dang : bsil ba tshal gyi gnas nas gshegs su gsol: ha ha rgod dang rngam pa sgra sgrogs dang : tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol: ti se gangs dang la phyi chu bar dang : mkha' spyod tsā ri ṭa nas gshegs su gsol: sham po gangs dang gzho stod ti sgro'i gnas:

mchims phu brag dmar gnas nas gshegs su gsol: gze rgyal gangs gnyan rong btsan kha ba dkar: sbas yul padma bkod nas gshegs su gsol: gtsug lag chos 'khor dben ri ma lus par: gar bzhugs gnas nas thogs med gshegs su gsol: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: dgra bgegs mi ro rta ro brtsegs khri'i steng : dpal 'bar zhing skyong dam can 'khor bcas rnams: mi g.yo dgyes shing gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: rtse gcig gdung zhing mos pa'i yid kyis bstod: deng 'dir dam tshig bsre'o phrin las sgrubs: bdag gi bcol ba'i 'dod don nag po che: yengs med bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: oṃ ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra sarba sa ma ya satwaṃ: a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ gsum pa phyi nang gsang ba'i sman raka gtor gsum mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: nag po chen po dpal ldan seṅge'i gdong : che ba'i yum mchog mi bsrun seng gdong ma: bam ro pho mo las kyi pho nya dang : dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas la: 'dod yon phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog phung por spungs: sha chen gu gul bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs: rkang dmar tshil chen zhun mar nyi ltar gsal: klad rus khu ba mkhris pa'i dri chab gtams: dgra snying sna tshogs zhal zas dbyings la bsnyegs: rkang gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog: ma mo 'bum gyis pra yi gzugs brnyan thogs: cang te'u rdza rnga rnga zlum stong gsum 'bir: dgra bgegs snying khrag dri bsung rlabs su 'khyil: gnod byed gtubs pa'i mgo lus ro mchog spungs: g.yang gzhi dur khrod chas kun reg bya bkram: sna tshogs phyi mchod ma tshang med pa 'di: zhing skyong mgon po dam can tshogs la 'bul: bzhes shig sdang ba'i dgra bgegs zhal du stob: bstan la 'tshe dang bdag la sdang ba rnams:

zhing skyong dpal 'bar khyod kyis bsgral bar mdzod: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: dpal 'bar zhing skyong legs ldan mthu bo che: dam can rgya mtsho dmag tshogs 'khor bcas la: dug lnga bsgral ba'i nang mchod 'bul ba ni: ma rig dmus long dgra bo gti mug can: khro rgyal chos dbyings ye shes rtsal shugs kyis: 'thibs pa'i dus su khug cig myur du sgrol: gtub cig dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du bstab: bsam sbyor log pa'i dgra bo zhe sdang can: khro rgyal me long ye shes rtsal shugs kyis: las rlung khrag 'khrug dus su khug cig sgrol: gtub cig dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du bstab: khengs sems chags sdang dgra bo nga rgyal can: khro rgyal mnyam nyid ye shes rtsal phyungs la: bdag 'dzin dus su khug cig myur du sgrol: gtub cig dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du bstab: zhan chags srid pa'i dgra bo 'dod sred can: khro rgyal sor rtog ye shes rtsal phyungs la: nyon mongs 'phel tshe khug cig myur du sgrol: gtub cig dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du bstab: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo phrag dog can: khro rgyal bya grub ye shes rtsal shugs kyis: 'jigs sngangs dus su khug cig myur du sgrol: gtub cig dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du bstab: dgra bo pha sde nang tshan mthun grogs rnams: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gar gnas kyang : khro rgyal mngon spyod chen po'i las mdzad nas: dam can pho nya 'bum gyis bkug cing sgrol: gtubs nas zhal bstab lhag med bzhes su gsol: bstan la 'tshe dang bdag la sdang ba'i dgra: zhing skyong dpal 'bar khyod kyis sgrol bar mdzod: oṃ a hūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta khā hi: hūm̐: stobs ldan chen po las mdzad seṅge'i gdong : dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas la:

dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: pha rol gdug pa'i dgra bgegs pho mo yi: a wa dhū ti srog gi rtsa chod la: zla ba nyi ma'i gsang mchod bzhes su gsol: la la rā sa nā da'i rtsa chod la: las dang ye shes gsang mchod bzhes su gsol: dgra bo pho mo las ngan sdig can gyi: don snod gnas pa brgyad kyi rtsa chod la: srog 'dzin brgyad kyi gsang mchod bzhes su gsol: ma rungs bdud rigs dgra bo pho mo yi: 'du ba chen po bzhi yi rtsa chod la: gnas su khyab pa'i gsang mchod bzhes su gsol: dam nyams log par lta ba pho mo yi: 'phro 'du srid pa bzhi yi rtsa chod la: sa bon bde sdug gsang mchod bzhes su gsol: byad ma pho mo'i mu kha'i rtsa chod la: 'dar ma sgra gcan gsang mchod bzhes su gsol: dgra bgegs pho mo ma lus rtsa chod la: khams rnams yongs rdzogs gsang mchod bzhes su gsol: bstan la 'tshe dang bdag la sdang ba'i dgra: zhing skyong dpal 'bar khyed kyis sgrol bar mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba a mu ka mā ra na ḍa tshindha a haṃ pañtsa kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: 'jigs byed legs ldan dpal 'bar seṅge'i gdong : dam can rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas pa la: sman gtor rakta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bhandha lcang lo'i nang : sha chen rdzas chen sbyar ba'i khu ba zhun: drag po sgrub pa'i sman mchod sna tshogs 'di: kha mngar skyur ba'i 'de gu khaṇḍa sogs: bcud mchog ngad ldan dgyes pa'i sman mchog 'di: dpal mgon dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: srid gsum snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: nang bcud 'byung ba srid pa'i dgra bgegs tshogs: bsgral zhing gtubs nas 'bru nag zan dang sbrags: bzhil te bsgral ba'i dmar chen gtor ma ni: ri rab lta bu srid pa'i rtse mor bsnyegs: dkar dmar rgyan dang bam ro'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: dmod pa'i las zor sna tshogs thun gyis bskor: 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus gling bzhi'i gtor kyus bskor:

ru tra bsgral ba'i snying khrag rol mtsho'i chab: dza gad sna tshogs phud kyi pū dza sbreng : g.yas g.yon mi sdug srid pa'i rngam dred la: dgra bgegs pho mo bsgral ba'i bam chen bkal: brtol ba'i sgo nas rakta na ra ra: gtor chen rtse mo bla 'khor dar nag gdugs: gri rgod snying sogs nam mkha'i tshogs dang bcas: dgyes pa'i mchod pa rgya mtsho chen po 'di: dpal mgon dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: dgra bo'i bhandha bum ril yangs pa'i nang : bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rmongs tshogs 'khrigs pa la: shes rig lta ba'i phur bu bsnun pa yis: 'gog lam 'khri ba gzhom pa'i raktas bkang : mkha' ltar khyab pa'i ma mo dus mtshan ma'i: chos 'byung tsant+ra mu kha'i dbyings rtse ru: khyab cing g.yo ba'i rdo rje rlung chen gyis: zlum por bsrubs pa'i shugs las rdol ba yi: lha mo'i mkha' las dwangs ma'i dmar chen dang : mtshan ldan ka la ping ka'i dbyangs can ma'i: yid chags 'dzum mo srid pa'i dwangs rtse ru: mi zad rtsa mchog 'dar ma g.yo ba nas: las kyi klung mo'i rlung las 'gyu ba yi: ro mar babs pa'i rgyun bzang rā ga'i mdangs: gzi 'od dru ma'i bzhin ltar rab tu 'khyil: pha rol gang zhig rgol ba rtsom byed pa'i: gzugs su snang dang dngos med yid dug 'chang : 'tshe zhing 'phral yun mi sdug rtags mngon rigs: g.yol zhing byol ba'i mtshon chen brdegs byed pas: yid brtan mi rung srid pa'i dgra bgegs dag: bskrad cing mthar ba'i zungs khrag rlabs su 'khyil: 'dun pa'i bskyed cing sbyangs pa'i dmar chen po: khyad du smos pa'i sman gtor dwangs ma'i phud: dpal ldan mgon po dus bdag gdong lnga'i phyug: ci bzhin tha tshig gnyer ba'i dam can tshogs: sprul pa nyid sprul gang de'i tshogs la 'bul: dgyes par bzhes la 'tshe ba'i mi sdug rigs: khro rgyal khyod la las bcol sgrol bar mdzod: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta bha lingta la rakta pū dza kha kha khā hi:

bzhi pa gsang ba'i bdag po he ru ka ma hā kā la dus su 'gyu ba'i tshe: bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ kṣeṃ kṣeṃ kṣe tra pa la dus bdag nag po che: ha ha gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog pa'i sgra ldan rngam byed pa: khyod ni snying rje chen po ston pa'i dbyings phyug mi g.yo mchog: thams cad zil gnon seng zhal gdong ni 'jigs pa'i zer dang ldan: 'bar ba'i me 'dra skra dang ag tshom sma ra rab tu 'bar: spyan rtsa rab g.yo shangs nas rlung dmar 'tshubs pas 'jig rten yom: raktar dgyes pa'i mche ba dmar po zangs mdog 'od du 'bar: mgo phreng lnga yis brgyan cing dar nag cod pan pu ru ru: ru mtshon nag po thogs pas pha rol kun gyi rgol ba 'joms: dmar chen gtor zor thog ltar 'bebs nas dgra yul brlag pa'o: dar nag phod gsol stag ral gzig shubs ral gri 'od ldan brgyan: zhabs la swag lham g.yu mthil mdzes pas dam sri'i mgo bo 'gems: dur khrod las byed sga srab thams cad 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can: bdud rta rlung gshog chibs nas 'dzam gling bskor zhing dgra dpung 'joms: me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil ba'i dbus su bzhugs mdzad nag po che: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes sgra chen sgrog pas snang srid pho nyar 'gyed: he he he zhes brjod pas ma mo dbang du bsdus nas sbyor: kṣeṃ kṣeṃ kṣeṃ zhes brjod pas 'byung po sdig can 'gugs nas sgrol: ḍa ḍa ḍa zhes brjod pas las bzhi phrin las myur du sgrub: pa pa la zhes brjod pas gsang sngags bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzad: bhyo bhyo bhyo zhes brjod pas seng gdong dmar mo g.yon du rngam: hring hring dza zhes brjod pas rtag tu rol nas sprul pa 'gyed: ḍi ḍi ḍi zhes brjod pas bam chen pho mo dgra la rbad: ka pa la zhes brjod pas sde brgyad dmag tshogs las la bskul: hi hi hi zhes brjod pas sgrub la dngos grub ster ba'o: hūm̐ las skyes pa'i legs ldan dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod:

ces gsang ba'i bdag pos me ri 'bar ba'i rtser bstod pa'o: lnga pa spyir bstod pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings ngang las rab khros nag po che: 'jigs byed dpa' bo 'bar ba'i gar dgu can: mthu stobs dbang phyug legs ldan seṅge'i gdong : dpal 'bar chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: seng zhal nga ro sgrog pas snang srid sngangs: shangs nas drag po'i rlung chen 'u ru ru: spyan rtsa sdang mig tshwa tshwa phyogs bcur 'khyil: sma ra smin ma dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: thod skam khrod nas seng chung skar ltar 'khrugs: rigs bdag dbu rgyan dar nag cod pan bskyod: mun pa'i phod chen srid gsum zil gyis gnon: phyag g.yas ru mtshon 'bar bas dgra snying 'byin: g.yon pas dmar chen gtor zor thog ltar 'phen: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri ngar chen brgyan: swag lham g.yu mthil ma rungs spyi bor 'gengs: sga srab dur khrod chas ldan 'byung po sngangs: bdud rta nag po rlung gshog lam lam 'gro: bdud dpung zil gnon bstan pa'i bya ra mkhan: legs ldan nag po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: rab tu 'bar ba dur khrod e yi klong : mdangs ldan dmar chen rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus: bhyo las ma gcig dpal ldan 'dod khams ma: rab khros shugs 'byin bdud mo seṅge'i gdong : sku mdog dmar po me 'od gdong pa can: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs rkan sgra rdeb: khrag ltar g.yo ba'i spyan rtsa sdang mig bgrad: sma ra smin ma tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: thod skam brgyan cing seng chung dgra la 'gyed: dar dmar phod chen gzi 'od shigs se shig: phyag g.yas kha ṭwāṃ ma rungs dgra snying bsnun: g.yon pas dgra snying rol cing gtor zor 'phen: swag lham gsol mdzad sga srab srin mo'i chas: bdud rta dmar po me gshog rlabs 'gros zhon: ma rungs tshar gcod las byed re ma ti: srid gsum bdag mo khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: tri tri rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i dbus shed na:

dpal gyi bka' nyan las mkhan bam ro'i gzugs: srin po khros 'dra zangs sprel gdong pa can: dgra bo smyo 'bog lus la dug rlangs 'tshubs: bya sder sa la 'khrab cing cho 'phrul 'gyed: rkang pas gtor chen zor mda' sha ra ra: dam nyams 'byung por bka' chad 'bebs mdzad pa: srog bdag bam chen gnyis la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: dung ri dung mtsho g.yu 'od rdza yi khrod: tshangs pa lha yi sde dpon btsan rgod ni: gze rgyal gnas kyi bka' srung rdo rje 'bar: sku mdog dkar dmar khro 'dzum ya la la: dung khrab rmog zhu ru dar pu ru ru: ral gri ru mtshon dam nyams dgra la 'debs: stag ral gzig shubs chas ldan dung rta zhon: sngags srung gter bdag khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: zangs ri rngam chen khrag mtsho 'khrugs pas bskor: btsan brag dmar po mchong dmar 'gyings pa'i dbus: gnod sbyin dmar po btsan rgod bswe khrab can: rab khros zhal gyi mche bas ma mchu mnan: rtse ber gsol zhing dang ru rlung ltar 'tshubs: phyag g.yas beng chen dmar gtor dgra la 'gyed: g.yon pas btsan zhags 'debs shing gnod byed 'ching : ru mtshon dmar po me lce ya la la: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri shang lang brgyan: swag lham gsol zhing sga srab khrigs se khrig: rag pa rting dkar rlung gi gshog can chibs: btsan rgod 'bar ba khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: dur khrod bam ri khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong : thod mkhar dmar po me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus: dbyings kyi gtso mo e ka dzā ṭi ma: ma mo dmar nag 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can: ral gcig thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan: spyan gcig gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: tshems gcig gdug pa'i dam nyams srog rtsa gcod: nu gcig sgrub la dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: rkang gcig rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis mkha' la 'gro: phyag g.yas rtse gsum ma rungs snying la 'debs: g.yon pas gdug pa'i dgra snying dmar po rol:

dur khrod chas ldan bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel: stong khams sgra sgrogs 'brug mo mgo dgu zhon: sngags bdag snying gi srung mar bdag bstod do: hūm̐: stong khams gling bzhi ri rab 'gying ba'i khong : mtsho nag rba klong 'khrug cing khol ma'i klong : klu yi dge bsnyen nā ga raksha ni: sku mdog mthing nag 'od du tse re re: g.yu khrab rmog zhu dang ru tshubs se tshub: phyag g.yas ral gris bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod: g.yon pa'i lcags par ngan sngags rdzas kyis bkang : stag ral gzig shubs brgyan cing rta nag zhon: dge bsnyen chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: kha rag mgo dgu tshang tshing mun pa'i gnas: brag dmar bdud mtsho khol ma'i nang shed na: bdud mgon rgyal po shan pa bkrag med ni: smug nag mi bzad rab khros srin po'i gzugs: gnam lcags go khrab rmog zhu si li li: dang ru mdung dar ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: phyag g.yas dgra satwas byad ma log 'dren sgrol: g.yon pa'i lcags kyus ma rungs snying nas 'dzin: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri 'od ldan brgyan: bdud zhags nag po dgra snying khyugs se khyug: swag lham bswe chen sga stan khrigs se khrig: bdud rta nag po rlung ltar 'dur ru ru: dgra srog gcod pa'i las byed mthu bo che: stobs ldan nag po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: dug mtsho khol ma'i klong yangs nang shed dbus: me rlung 'tshub ma'i tsha ngar ldan gyi steng : srog bdag ljang sngon gza' bdud rā hu la: dbu dgu khros pas mi bzad mdangs chen ston: rog ti nag po rngam pa'i rkan sgra rdeb: gnam lcags ral gris dam nyams mgo lus phral: rwa yi mda' gzhu ma rungs srog la 'debs: chu srin rgyal mtshan mi nub bstan pa gso: dug sbrul zhags pas bgegs srin yan lag 'ching : sku lus spyan stong sangs rgyas bstan pa srung : lte bar khro zhal log 'dren zas su za: dug sbrul mjug 'khyil klu srin snying rtsa 'dar:

glog zhags dmar po chibs te mkha' la 'gyu: gza' rgod chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: nam mkha'i dbyings dang dben ri gnyan po'i gnas: rngam lhun ri rab 'bar ba'i sku mkhar dbus: ma sang sgrub pa'i bdag skyob dgra lha ni: wer ma gnyan po sku mdog smug nag khro: rdo rje'i go khrab rmog zhu lams se lam: phyag g.yas ral gris pha rol dmag dpung bcom: g.yon pas lcags phur dgra bo'i g.yul ngo bzlog: ru mtshon nag po rgol 'joms lhabs se lhab: stag ral gzig shubs 'od ldan khra la la: swag lham rgyan can ma rungs klad nas gnon: dgra srog rngam byed mtshal stag mgo dgu chibs: lha srung gnyan po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: 'o yug shang gi gnas mchog lcags mkhar klong : bhandha skam rlon brtsegs pa'i nang shed dbus: skyes bu chen po dam can rdo rje legs: dmar nag rab khros mche bas ma mchu mnan: bswe khrab dang ni dar dmar phod chen gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje ma rungs snying la rdeg: g.yon pas dgra snying dmar po zhal du gsol: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri lams se lam: btsan mdung dmar po gzir 'debs wa la la: rgya lham gsol nas rtsal chen seṅge chibs: gtsug lag skyong ba'i dkor srung mthu bo che: rdo rje legs pa khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: gzhan yang dam can rgya mtsho yang sprul tshogs: bka' sdod las mkhan pho nya glog ltar 'khyug: shan pa ku 'debs mon pa rlung ltar 'tshub: bya gcan sha za 'bum gyis rngam skad sgrog: pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul tshogs 'joms byed pa: las la chas mdzad tha tshig skyong ba yi: yongs rdzogs srung mar bcas la bdag bstod do: ces bstod cing dam can rgya mtsho'i rtsa sngags bya ba ni: oṃ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ yum gyi rtsa sngags ni: oṃ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ bam chen gnyis kyi rtsa sngags ni: oṃ nirmā marga ṭa na mu kha tri tri da ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ

lha btsan sngags ni: oṃ dhe wa tsa tri shu la badzra dzwa la hūm̐ phaṭḥ btsan rgod ni: oṃ ma hā shu la ṭa tsa tri hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma mo'i sngags ni: oṃ re ma ti e ka dzā ṭi hūm̐ phaṭḥ klu'i dge bsnyen sngags ni: oṃ nā ga ra tsa nī laṃ sa ma ya ti pa ra tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdud kyi sngags ni: oṃ ma hā kā la du pra ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ gza' yi sngags ni: oṃ ki kang hri shag ghra ha rā hu la hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra lha'i sngags ni: oṃ ma hā badzra pa ti dhe wa riddhi phaṭḥ dam can gyi sngags ni: oṃ badzra shrī ya sa dhu tri shu la hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rtsa sngags sgrub pa'i las sbyor skabs bstun te bzlas: zhi ba ltar gtso bo la 'bum tsho: bam ro dang 'khor rnams la khri re re bya: khyad par 'di byin rlabs che zhing bka' btsan pas gar thod du bsgrubs nas bskul mi nyan: tshul bzhin ci ltar nyams su len na dur khrod dam shing gcig drung sogs dben par bsgrub dgos: rgyun gsol mchod sgrub tsam ni ma chag par rang nyid gar gnas su brtson chog la: spyir chos skyong rnams grangs mang yang byin rlabs nus rtags thon pa ni 'di nyid zab cing : myur mgyogs phrin las gzhan las che: sgrub la gang mos pa'i dngos grub 'byung zhing : gtsug lag dang chos skyong ka cha'i gnyer 'dzin cing 'gro ba dbang du sdud: 'jig rten kun gyi yid 'gyur zas nor dang longs spyod 'du bkra shis dang snyan grags 'byung : tshe ring zhing gzhan gyis byams: rgyun du bstan pa srung zhing bka' btsan 'di phyi kun tu phrin las bsgrubs nas dgra la rbad na rtsa brlag 'byung zhing rjes shul mi ldang ba 'byung bas: chos skyong 'di nyid rgyun du bsten zhing gsol mchod la brtson par bya'o: sa ma ya: skabs su thun gtor 'bul ba ni dgra bgegs lan gsum bkug ste byad ma'i sha khrag ngo bor dmigs te 'bul ba ni: thog mar chu gtsang gis bran la: na mo:

mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: stobs ldan zhing skyong bka' sdod dam can gyi: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rnal 'byor sgos kyi dgra: khyad par bdag la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs rigs: steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'khor yug gar gnas kyang : las rlung 'khor lo'i rta la bskyon nas su: pho nya las mkhan tshogs kyis khug la shog: dus la bab bo dgra bgegs shor ra re: gtor mar bstim zhing bsgral gtub sha khrag bskyil: dgra bgegs gtad do gsod pa'i las mdzod cig: oṃ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī si na ra ma tri hriṃ du tri phu tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dha sa dha sa a mu ka dza dza a be sha ya thun dzaḥ ru tra tsitta khaḍga bi shwa tsakra ha la ya ha la ya dzi bi mā ra rbad bhyo bhyoḥ byad ma thum thum myog myog trig nan hur thum rbad ya: zhes lan gsum gyis 'gugs shing bsgral ba'i dmigs pa yang bya: de nas thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: pho brang mkha' spyod tsā ri'i gnas: g.ya' dang gangs kyi rwa bas bskor: 'ja' 'od 'khyil zhing nags tshal gtibs: mtsho rnams rba klong khrag ltar 'khrugs: 'bab chu ngan sngags rang sgra sgrog: sha za gcan spyang ngar sgra 'byin: 'byung po mi min rlung ltar 'tshubs: bya nag gshog rdeb lang ling lding : sprin nag mun gling phyu ru ru: dur khrod ming ni rngam pa tshal: de dbus thod mkhar dbyings dang mnyam: mi lpags rgyal mtshan pu ru ru: thod skam rgyan tog rongs se rong : dar nag ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: phyi nang dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: ro langs keng rus gar stabs bsgyur: me rlung 'tshub ma chi li li: de 'dra 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog tu: ma hā kā la bzhugs pa ni: lha chen dpal 'bar he ru kaḥ nag po 'jigs byed seṅge'i gdong : legs ldan zhi skyong mthu bo che: yum chen khrag ral seṅge'i gdong : gzhan yang dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs:

'khor dang sde brgyad yang 'khor bcas: myur mgyogs shugs 'chang dbyings nas bzhengs: gri rkang gling bu tser tser 'bud: rnga chen rol mo sna tshogs dang : dar nag g.yab cing spyan 'dren no: ma thogs yud kyis gnas 'dir bzhengs: bdag gis khyed ni dung dung bsgrubs: khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab: zhing skyong mgon po dam la 'dus: yum chen ma mo dam la 'dus: dam can rgya mtsho dam la 'dus: dam la 'dus so dam tshig bsre: do nub snga ma'i gtang rag gtong : do nub phyi ma'i zhu rten 'bul: do nub mnyes pa'i dam rdzas 'dren: do nub rakta phud kyis mchod: do nub dgra bgegs zhal du 'debs: do nub snyan pa'i gdangs kyis bstod: do nub dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas 'bul: do nub ka cha'i gnyer du bskos: do nub rbad pa'i phrin las bcol: rengs chad brel tshul ma mdzad pa'i: bskul ba'i tshig la snyan gsan 'tshal: de nas phrin las bcol ba ni: hūm̐: legs ldan nag po seṅge'i gdong : yum mchog ma mo tsaṇḍi ma: sprul pa'i las mkhan bam ro gnyis: sde brgyad dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: khyed rnams bskul phyir rten rdzas ni: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa dang : mdzes pa'i rdzas chen bdud rtsi 'bul: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs bstims pa yi: dmar gyi thun gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs: dkon mchog rgyal ba'i dbu 'phang bstod: dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings: gtsug lag chos 'khor gnyan 'di srungs: snying thig chos 'di phyogs bcur spel: rig 'dzin bdag gi phrin las sgrubs: skye 'gro snang srid dbang du sdus: pha rol nor 'gugs lag ring sgul: lha srin mi gsum snang ba khug: mos gus dung dung bla yid zungs: tshe chos zas nor snyan grags spel: longs spyod bsod nams char bzhin phob: yul gru bkra shis dge legs stsol: pha rol dgra bgegs cham la phob: bdag la gnod pa'i byad ma sgrol: 'tshe ba'i bstan dgra mgo bo snubs:

dmigs pa'i log 'dren rtsad nas chod: nor rdzas ka cha'i phyi la rgyugs: dgra la cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs: dgra la grib rigs bco brgyad phob: gdug sems byad ma'i srog rtsa rkus: mu stegs bdud rigs snying khrag rol: bdag la 'gras pa'i dgra bo la: rmi ltas mtshan ngan thongs la shog: wa la sprel zhon sgo khyim khongs: ngu brang brdungs shing ming nas bos: than dang sdug bsngal char ltar phob: chos grwa 'di la gnod byed tshogs: thun gtor 'di dang mnyam por bzhes: bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra: g.yab pa'i tshe na dpung ma nyung : bskul ba'i tshe na rgyang ma ring : sgrub pa'i tshe na rtags ma zhan: brten pa'i tshe na ya ma nga : gnyer bskos tshe na phrag ma dog: mchod pa'i dus su mgu ma dka': grogs por bcol gyis snying ma ngan: rbad pa'i dus su mthu ma chung : bskang ba'i dus su dam ma g.yel: bshags pa'i dus su 'khon ma 'tshol: mngon spyod dus su rtsal ma zhan: dgra la rbad sod las mdzod cig: hūm̐: zhing skyong chen po dgra la bhyoḥ yum mchog seng gdong dgra la bhyoḥ bam chen pho mo dgra la bhyoḥ lha btsan thog 'bebs dgra la bhyoḥ btsan rgod bswe khrab dgra la bhyoḥ sngags srung ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ klu yi dge bsnyen dgra la bhyoḥ bdud mgon bkrag med dgra la bhyoḥ gza' rgod khyab 'jug dgra la bhyoḥ myur mgyogs dgra lha dgra la bhyoḥ skyes bu dam can dgra la bhyoḥ bya gcan sha za dgra la bhyoḥ sprul pa yang sprul dgra la bhyoḥ dgra bo'i mgo snying nang rol phrol: dgra bo'-i sgo nor phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i rten mkhar thog gis shigs: dgra bo'i yul zhing ser bas khongs: dgra bo'i pha sde gnyan tshan gtor: dgra bo'i mthun gsum nang 'thab thongs: dgra bo'i yul 'khrug chu ltar 'brub: dgra bo'i sde 'khrug 'bras ltar sigs: dgra bo'i bu dang chung ma sgrol: dgra bo'i mi rabs rtsad nas chod: tre tre dmar nad dgra la phob:

steng grib smyo 'bog dgra la phob: zha rengs lkug gsum dgra la phob: glo gor hon gsum dgra nor choms: mngon rtags lo zla'i dus ma 'gyang : chu tshod 'di la 'grub par mdzod: pha rol dam nyams ma bsgral na: chos skyong mthu med dgras kyang khrel: sgrub pa'i sngags 'chang yi yang 'chad: de bas phrin las dus la bab: myur du las mdzod sa ma ya: oṃ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na: dgra bo'i mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i srog rtsa la rbad rbad: snying rtsa la myog myog: khrag rtsa la gzer dbugs la thum mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

ces pas zlog dmigs dang bcas dgra phyogs su 'bul: dmod pa dgos na zor thab 'phang ste lag rdeb bya zhing dar nag g.yab: phur thogs stong gis rbad kyang dgra bo kho rang la bzlog nus: 'di nyid khro rgyal gyad kyi dpa' bo yin pas dmod pa lag zor tsam gyis dgra dpung gzhom nus: phyis 'byung las can rnams kyang chos skyong 'di nyid kho nar brtson pas bsgrub: sha/ma/tha/rgya rgya rgya: de nas skabs su gtor ma 'bul zhing bsngo ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang sman raka gis bran: hoḥ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan dam pa dang ldan pa: dri dam pa dang ldan pa: ro dam pa dang ldan pa: bcud kun 'dus la dgyes shing phun sum tshogs pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: sangs rgyas kyi bstan srung : rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha: rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po: gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che bya ra mel tshe mkhan: legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin cing dam tshig nyams pa thams cad tshar gcod pa'i las byed pa: bsam sbyor log par 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs kyi srog gcod: mna' tho chad la mi brtsi ba'i gshed ma: gtsug lag khang gi dkor bdag: nag po stong gi rgyal po: ma mo 'bum gyi gtso mo: sha za bye ba'i las byed: gtsug lag khang gi chos 'khor gnyan po: 'di nyid skyong ba'i srung ma chen po: yab khyab bdag khrag 'thung he ru ka chen po: yum ma gcig rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma: sras legs ldan 'bar ba gzhon nu seṅge'i gdong pa can: khyad par ye shes dang las la chas pa'i tshe: ma la ya bam ro'i mdun du rgyal ba'i dbang po dge slong kun dga' gzhon nu chen po: yum mchog mkha' 'gro kun 'dus ma: sras mchog thog rgod rdo rje: sras mo gling bzhi dbang sgyur: e ka dzā ṭi ma la sogs te: sngon nas rgyal ba'i dam tshig la gnas pa chen po: sku yi mtshan mchog kun dga' gzhon nu:

gsung gi mtshan mchog gha ya dha ra: thugs kyi mtshan mchog legs ldan nag po: yon tan gyi mtshan mchog dur bdag dpal 'bar: phrin las kyi mtshan mchog bdud mgon seng gdong chen po he ru kaḥ gnas dang yul gyi bdag po chos skyong drag rtsal can khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: hoḥ yum mchog ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma las la grub pa'i cha lugs can: ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma seṅge'i gdong can dri za'i sras mo 'dren bzang dbyangs can ma: bdud kyi sras mo re ma ti: srin po'i sras mo khri sde ma: lha yi sras mo u ma dhe wa: gnod sbyin gyi sras mo ku ru kulle: klu yi sras mo dung skyong ma: btsan gyi sras mo khrag ral ma: gshin rje'i sras mo dmag rgyal ma: ma hā de wa'i sras mo srid rgyal ma: rgyal po'i sras mo gzi legs nor skyong ma: gza' yi sras mo ha shang sbal mgo ma: dam can gyi sras mo rab brtan gser mig ma: dmu rje dgra lha'i sras mo rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: las kyi ma mo'i sras mo sngags srung spyang zhon ma: 'jig rten srid pa grub nas bstan pa srung ba'i sras mo a phyi chos kyi sgron ma jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma ste: ye shes dang las la grub pa'i ngo bo gcig pa'i gtso mo khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: yab yum las byed kyi sprul pa bam ro dmar nag spre'u gdong pa can gnyis la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: hoḥ khyad par du bka' sdod dregs pa las la chas shing rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa shan pa spu gri thogs pa'i sde tshogs mtshan nas smos shing mchod sbyin 'bul ba ni: hoḥ sku yi sprul pa lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba chen po: gsung gi sprul pa srog bdag btsan gyi sde tshogs gyi sde dpon gnod sbyin bswe yi khrab can:

thugs kyi sprul pa sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi ral gcig ma: yon tan gyi sprul pa klu yi dge bsnyen nā ga raksha: phrin las kyi sprul pa bdud rje mgon po bkrag med: gnyis med kyi sprul pa ki kang gza' rgod chen po rā hu la: dmag dpon dgra 'dul du sprul pa dgra lha bdag skyob che btsan: gtsug lag dkor skyong du sprul pa dam can rdo rje legs pa ste: sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa'i las byed chen po khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: hoḥ gzhan yang nag po stong : sha za 'bum: ma mo bye ba: gnod sbyin khri: sha za sa ya la sogs pa sprul pa yang sprul gyi dmag tshogs khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul zhing bsngo'o: dgyes par bzhes su gsol: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod: dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa mchog gi bstan pa rin po che mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs: khyad par du yang rgyal dbang padma kā ra'i gdung gsob 'dzin pa skyes chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag yang zab gter gyi bka' bab dam pa: yongs 'dzin mchog gi sprul sku rnams kyi chos grwa chen pos mtshon pa'i mkhan chen lo tsā sngags kyi dbang phyug nyi 'od ltar gsal ba khu dbon rnams dang : snga 'gyur rgyal bstan 'dzin pa cha tshang padma gter bdag gling pa gang de'i yab sras kyi ring lugs sor mar gnas shing : gang du rgyas pa'i dge 'dun 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams bsrung zhing skyabs te sde snod lung rigs rgyud sde chen po bzhi thos bsam dang sgom sgrub: bslab pa dang rgyu 'bras drang por gnas pa'i nyams len dang : 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bya ba rnams mthar phyin te: bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i 'gal rkyen gyi bar chad sol: mthun rkyen bsam pa ci smos pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzod cig:

phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dza dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ skabs 'dir rtsa sngags dang sbrags nas gtor ma legs par bsngo: 'di'i mtshams dmod pa bor ba ni: thal mo brdab cing : hoḥ zhing skyong dam can 'khor bcas la: bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba'i mthus: pha rol log pa'i dgra bgegs kyis: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : gsang sngags chos la smad pa dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa'i dgra: sdang zhing gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun: dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis: myur du bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ kṣeṃ kṣeṃ pha rol dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces lan gsum bskyar: las byang rgyas pa ma lcogs na: gtor bsngos bsdus pa 'di rgyun du gtong rung : de nas bskang ba gtong ba ni: mchod rdzas rnams sman raka gis bran cing mchod pa kha gso: rol mo bya zhing sha chen gyi spos btang la spyan drangs shing bskang ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir da tshur byon: hūm̐: kun tu bzang pos mtshan btags pa: 'jigs byed nag po sa bcu mgon: mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon: 'khor lo sdom pas mtshan btags pa: 'jigs byed nag po dur khrod bdag: mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon: 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis mtshan btags pa: kun dga' gzhon nu tshogs kyi bdag: mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon: spyan ras gzigs kyis mtshan btags pa: gha ya dha ra myur mgyogs can: mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon: phyag na rdo rjes mtshan btags pa: legs ldan nag po dus kyi bdag: mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon: slob dpon chen pos mtshan btags pa: bdud mgon nag po seṅge'i gdong : mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon: sngags 'chang bdag gis mtshan btags pa: dgra lha chen po myur mgyogs can: mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon: do nub bskang phyir bshags pa 'bul:

dam can gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: mthun pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs 'bul: mgon po'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: om̐ ma hā kā la shrī kṣe ṭa pā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma: tri tri marga ṭa mu kha dhe wa tsa shu la e ka dzā ṭi nā ga raksha du pra ma rā hu la: pa ti dhe wa riddhi ma hā badzra sa dhu tri sarba dharma pā la ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dza sa ma ya satwaṃ: mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbang po lnga dang sha chen lnga: rdzas chen lnga dang sman gtor lnga: rakta la sogs sbyor sgrol rdzas: mthun pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs 'di: mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: mchod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi ngo bor gyur pa: chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas: 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur pa: mtshungs med 'gro mgon drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rin po che'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: slar yang rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dam pa thog ma'i mgon po'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'-i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin shrī singha'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: 'gro mgon padma 'byung gnas zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐:

chos bdag rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: slar yang khyab bdag 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: sngags 'chang tsiṇḍa li'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: dge slong kun dga' gzhon nu'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: yum mchog kun 'dus mkha' 'gro'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: sras mchog thog rgod rdo rje'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: sras mo dhe wa ral gcig ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ drag byed las la chas pa'i bdud mgon seṅge'i gdong can zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: seng gdong ma mo yum gyi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: sprul pa bam ro pho mo'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnod sbyin bswe'i khrab can gy-i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra 'dul dmag dpon chen po'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: skyes bu rdo rje legs pa'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: bka' sdod dam can yongs rdzogs zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: pho nya sprul pa yang sprul zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: las mkhan 'khor tshogs stong gi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ lha tshogs rnams dam rdzas bdud rtsis mnyes shing tshims nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad bde blag nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsol: kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi hūm̐: zhes pas bdud rtsi phul te lha tshogs rnams mnyes par bsam: rang gi lce ru myong zhing gnas gsum du thig le bya: mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par bsam: de nas bskang bar 'jug pa las: bskang bsdus mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud ni: hūm̐: dhā tu tsant+ra he ga ga: dzwa la ram̐ ma hā me thu na ye: ma dhya wirdhi kā la siṃ ha mu kha: tshurdhi yaksha he ru ka ye: a nu ta ra maṇṭa pa ri wa ra: sa dhu sa mu tra pu tsa tra bye ni: aṇṭa pañtsa bai ṣañtsa rakta bha lingta: he ḍākki te bi shwa urthi ta he:

ma hā kā la sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: shrī ya sd+yi to shrī dzwa la sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: sha ma sha na pa ti sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: a nanta ku mā ra sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: gha ya dha ra sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: ka la a mu ka bi na ya sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: pra ma na siṃ ha mu kha sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: ma tri ka ma hā siṃ ha mu kha sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: marka ṭa mu kha ti ta da ya sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: dhe wa shu la dzwa la sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: yaksha shu la tsant+ra sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: ma tri e ka dzā ṭi sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: nā ga ti pa ra tsa sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: pra ma nā tha kā la sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: ghra ha ma hā margha nī laṃ sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: ma ma sha ra ṇa ka ya dhe wa sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: sa dhu badzra shrī ya sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: kā la sa hā dhe sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: māṃ sa khā hi lakṣi he sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: ma tri kro ti hi sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: dzi bhi ma ri ba shi ka sa ha da sha sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: nirmā na bi shwa sa ma tsitta pu ra hūm̐: sa dhu sa ma ṭa pa ri wā ra ṇi: sa ma tsitta mā ra ya ṇa pu ra bha wa tu: u ta ṇi na sd+yi ro siddhi pra yatstsha: andha ka ra pā paṃ ā ba ra na bi shwa dha ni ye: sa dhe bi shwa dha ra pa pa ti ye: kā ya wākka tsitta pra ya rakṣe ye pā la swā hā: bo dhi ka ru ṇa pra kri tikṣu ḍa: prañdza ma hā ā yu dha te: a mu ka bhu ta gha ta ya ma tha ya: maṅga laṃ shrī tiṣṭha ya bha wa tu ye swā hā: zhes pa gsang ba ḍākki'i tshig rkang bsdus pa snyan brgyud bzhi pa'i skor shlau ka bcu pa me ri 'bar bar gnang ba'o: thog ma'i sngags bskang de ga ru 'dug pa 'don bde'i ched brda 'di bkrol ba'o: hūm̐: chos dbyings drag po e yi klong : 'bar ba'i me chen 'khrigs pa yi: dbus bzhugs nag po seṅge'i gdong : dpa' bo gnod sbyin khrag 'thung pa:

bla med sngags skyong 'khor dang bcas: dam can rgya mtsho mchod pa'i rdzas: dbang po lnga dang sman raka gtor: spyan gzigs sna tshogs sbreng ba 'dis: nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang : legs ldan dpal 'bar thugs dam bskang : dur khrod bdag po'i thugs dam bskang : kun dga' gzhon nu'i thugs dam bskang : rngam chen 'dzin pa'i thugs dam bskang : nag po dgra 'dul thugs dam bskang : bdud mgon seng gdong thugs dam bskang : yum chen seng gdong thugs dam bskang : sprel gdong bam gnyis thugs dam bskang : lha btsan 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin btsan rgod thugs dam bskang : ma mo ral gcig thugs dam bskang : klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : bdud mgon nag po'i thugs dam bskang : gza' chen ljang sngon thugs dam bskang : bdag skyob lus lha'i thugs dam bskang : dam can rdor legs thugs dam bskang : nag po stong gi thugs dam bskang : sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : ma mo bye ba'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod nyi khri'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas ni: thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: ma rig sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: lus ngag yid gsum srung zhing skyobs: byang chub snying po'i rang bzhin spel: shes rab chen po'i mtshon cha yis: dgra bgegs 'byung po mthar zhing choms: bkra shis dge legs brtan par mdzod:

de nas spyi bskang bya ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: bskul zhing bzhengs pa'i dbang phyug che: ma hā kā la seṅge'i gdong : dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas kyi: mnyes phyir thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir: dbang po lnga yi me tog dang : sha chen bsregs pa'i dri gsur spos: rkang mar zhag gi sgron me gtams: mkhris pa'i dri chab gser 'od 'khyil: 'bru nag dpal bshos ro bcud ldan: rkang gling thod rnga 'brug ltar sgrog: dgyes pa'i phyi mchod sna tshogs 'dis: dpal 'bar zhing skyong thugs dam bskang : yum mchog seng gdong thugs dam bskang : bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : dam can sde brgyad thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dgra bgegs ru tra bsgral ba yi: snod bzang bhandha lcang lo ru: sman mchog sna tshogs sbrings se sbring : sha lnga bdud rtsi me re re: rdzas chen ngad pa chi li li: rakta'i rba klong phya ra ra: zhag g.yo kyu mo lings se ling : dbyings bsnyegs dpal bshos rtse re re: khrag mdog zangs 'od ta la la: rgyan dang rtsang phur hrangs se hrang : liṅga'i rgyal mtshan nyi li li: gdugs dang dar nag pu ru ru: dar mdung ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: gzugs 'gros sna tshogs tshubs se tshub: mthun pa'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'dis: dpal 'bar zhing skyong thugs dam bskang : yum chen seng gdong thugs dam bskang : bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : dam can sde brgyad thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten srid pa'i snod: ye nas ye bteg brtsegs pa'i nang : bsdus bya srid pa'i 'byung lnga'i bcud: gdod nas dag pa'i tshogs mchod dag: rgya che lhun po'i rang bzhin nyid: kun tshang lhun grub rdzas chen po: rgyan mdzes snang ba'i sgron mes spras:
