rgyu skar rgya mtsho'i thig kyang gtab: dbang po'i gzhu bzang zer kyang 'phro: rmad byung ro brgya'i bcud ldan pa: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes rdzas: dkar mngar skyur dang kha ba'i ro: sha chen rdzas sogs gtsang ma'i rigs: ting 'dzin rlabs kyis bcud bsdus pa'i: tshogs mchod sman raka mdangs dang ldan: sha sna snying sna bsam mi khyab: 'chi med bdud rtsi me re re: khyad par brten cing gnas pa'i rdzas: bla 'khor srog yig bris pa'i sku: blos blang 'dra 'bag 'bur gzugs sogs: me long rin chen sna lnga 'phyangs: gsang mchog mnyes pa'i dbyangs can rigs: gzhan yang 'phan dang bla bre dang : dur khrod rgyan cha du ma'i rigs: bcal du bkram dang yol ba bres: rnga thug ru mtshon sna tshogs gzengs: go khrab brjid ldan 'od 'gengs gzugs: bzlog 'khor g.yab dar dgra la phyar: ging dang keng rus gar thabs sgyur: bya gcan sha za 'dur ru ru: bdud kyi ling pa dgra la snyog: pha rol bla 'gugs sha ra ra: snyan dang mi snyan cho nge 'debs: dam nyams bsgral sogs dgyes pa'i tshogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bskang rdzas kyis: dpal 'bar zhing skyong thugs dam bskang : yum mchog seng gdong thugs dam bskang : bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : dam can sde brgyad thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: las bzhi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bdud rtsis bran zhing gsol kha bya ba ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag: gtsang ma phud kyi gser skyems: rgya chen po 'di gsol zhing mchod pa ni: yab khrag 'thung chen po bdud mgon gyi zhal du gsol lo mchod do: yum ma cig rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do: sras gzhon nu 'bar ba'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do: sbyor yum bdud mo seng gdong ma'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do:

las mkhan bam ro pho mo'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do: gnod sbyin bswe yi khrab can zhal du gsol lo mchod do: ma mo sngags kyi srung ma'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do: klu bdud nā ga raksha'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do: bdud mgon nag po bkrag med zhal du gsol lo mchod do: ki kang gza' bdud rā hu la'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do: mtshal stag dgra lha chen po'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do: skyes bu rdo rje legs pa'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du gsol lo mchod do: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyi zhal du gsol lo mchod do: hūm̐: dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: sman raka gtor mas mnga' gsol lo: spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: sgra dbyangs rol mos mnga' gsol lo: gtsang ma phud kyis mnga' gsol lo: bstan pa bsrung bar mnga' gsol lo: dben ri bdag por mnga' gsol lo: chos 'khor skyong bar mnga' gsol lo: zab gter spel bar mnga' gsol lo: dkor nor gnyer 'dzin mnga' gsol lo: sgrub la grogs mdzad mnga' gsol lo: bar chad sel bar mnga' gsol lo: snang srid dbang sdud mnga' gsol lo: srid gsum zil gnon mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs bsgral bar mnga' gsol lo: phrin las bsgrub par mnga' gsol lo: gsol lo mchod do 'grub par mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo dam can tshogs: bag med dbang gyur bdag cag gis: brtson 'grus go cha dor ba yis: g.yeng ba le lo rmongs shing 'khrul: bsnyen sgrub g.yel zhing dus mchod chag: mchod rdzas 'byor tshogs yo byad chung : phud lhag 'dres dang tshod yod kyis: bskang mchod sbyor sgrol gnad la 'gal: gzhan yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis: dam 'gal nyams chag ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod par gsol ba yis: mi sgrib tshangs par bstsal du gsol: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya:

sogs zhes yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : de nas bskul bya zhing gtor ma 'bul ba ni: gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs nas rol mo drag tu btang zhing : hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'og min bkod pa lhun grub pho brang nas: thugs nyid ye shes dbyings las bzhengs pa'i sku: snying rje gar dgus gdug pa tshar gcod phyir: log 'dren 'dul mdzad nag po dus kyi bdag: khrag 'thung chen po 'jigs byed seṅge'i gdong : sbyor ba'i yum mchog pho nya bka' sdod bcas: dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: bskul lo bzhengs shig mthu stobs gzi byin skyed: pha rol rgol ba 'joms pa'i mtshon cha thogs: log 'dren cham la 'bebs pa'i sgyogs chen sgrengs: byad ma brlag cing bcom pa'i ru dar g.yobs: dgra yul phung thal stong ba'i cho 'phrul 'gyed: sde dpon las chas rtsal bcu 'gyed pa'i tshe: lha srin sde brgyad dmag tshogs sha ra ra: shan pa 'bum gyi gri brdar yugs se yug: pho bdud ging chen ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: mo bdud srin mo'i sha skor sga ra ra: bdud kyi ling pa mtshon thogs nyi li li: btsan rgod 'bum gyi shwa kha tha ra ra: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khram kha rubs se rub: las kyi pho nya srog len zhungs se zhung : mon kha dgra 'dzin zhags pa khyugs se khyug: ma mo'i nad yams dud pa phyu ru ru: klu bdud mdze nad 'tshub ma chi li li: dgra lhas dmag 'gyed rta rgyug sprengs se spreng : gza' bdud thog mda' 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: bya nag gcan spyang rkan sgra thags se thag: zor rtse mtshon thun me lce ya la la: bsreg gtor gzhom pa'i tshwa tshwa si li li: zor bhyo thun bhyo dam nyams dgra la ya: sha khrag dmar chen phud kyi gtor chen bzhes: lhag ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon char gyur: hūm̐: drag po dmar gyi gtor zor dbal chen 'dis: pho rgyud khro bo'i dmod pa bzlog tu gsol: mo rgyud ma mo'i rig sngags bzlog tu gsol:

lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa bzlog tu gsol: ban de gdug pa'i hom sbar bzlog tu gsol: mu stegs bon gyi mthu sgrub bzlog tu gsol: nag po klu la gtad pa bzlog tu gsol: bskrad gzir ngag mnan dmod pa bzlog tu gsol: gri mtshon skye bo'i bsam sbyor bzlog tu gsol: mya ngan bud med dmod zor bzlog tu gsol: phyogs skyong bcu yi byad kha bzlog tu gsol: gling bzhi srid pa'i mi kha bzlog tu gsol: dbang thang g.yang kha ral ba bzlog tu gsol: tshe bdud bar chad sna tshogs bzlog tu gsol: dmag sna dgra rkun jag chom bzlog tu gsol: mi nad phyugs nad yams nad bzlog tu gsol: dus nad rgyal 'gong the'u rang bzlog tu gsol: god sri dgra gyod phung sbyor bzlog tu gsol: yul 'dre 'byung po'i bar chod bzlog tu gsol: rmangs 'dre chung sri dbul sri bzlog tu gsol: 'byung po'i thog zor 'bebs pa bzlog tu gsol: pho nyas bla tshe rku ba bzlog tu gsol: sgrub pa'i rkyen ngan bar chod bzlog tu gsol: dur kha gshed sgo bye ba bzlog tu gsol: spar sme rlung rta nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog tu gsol: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu bzlog tu gsol: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog tu gsol: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad bzlog tu gsol: tshe zad za 'grang thebs pa bzlog tu gsol: lo skag zla skag zhag skag bzlog tu gsol: za skag dus skag 'chi skag bzlog tu gsol: bzlog go zor bzlog dmar po 'di yis zlog: bsgyur ro dug thun sna tshogs 'di yis sgyur: thog mda' las kyi zor chen dmar po khyod: gnam lcags ri rab mgo mjug ldog pa ltar: bzlog nas mnan cing bskrad de sa la bsres: ming shul lhag ma tsam yang med par mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma hūm̐ phaṭḥ

tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya dgra bo bighnān trig thum thum tsitta thum: a mu ka sha truṃ myog myog: zor bhyo thun bhyo bhyo bhyo zlog: ces spyi ltar zlog dmigs bya: khyad par zhing skyong dpal 'bar dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dgra la drangs shing pha rol thams cad brlags nas rjes shul tsam yang med par bsgom: 'di nyid myur mgyogs che la bka' gnyan pas dus dang gnad 'gag chen po med par drag dmigs bskul mi rung : 'di nyid rnal 'byor pa rang gis bsgrub pa ma gtogs gzhan don gar thod du btang mi rung : 'di ni byad ma 'bum thub dgra bo rtsad brlag dmod pa bor chog spu gri dug gi 'khor lo yin pas shin tu gsang zhing spel ba'o: sa ma ya: rjes bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab bkra shis brjod nas rten dang 'dra 'bag sogs la bstim: rgyun du gsol tshe rten med na rang dbyings su bstims te mi dmigs gnas lugs lta ba'i ngang la bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra kho bo padma thod phreng gis: snying thig zab mo skyong ba'i srung ma ni: las can seng gdong dpal 'bar sgrub thabs bzhag: bka' btsan rtags myur kun gyis 'gran zla bral: chos 'khor bstan pa'i khyad par srog ltar gnyer: de bas mel tshe bstan srung 'di nyid bsgrub: ma 'ongs las 'phro can gyis nyams su longs: shes rab blo ldan gcig dang 'phrad par shog: dur khrod tsā ri'i tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor tsā ri zil chen gsang phug nas gdan drangs shing stag lor gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du dag par zhal bshus so// dge'o// // nga) ༈ de nas thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ na mo/ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgy sogs hur thum rbad ya nas/ hūm̐: legs ldan mgon po seṅge'i gdong pa can/ /dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i lha tshogs la/

/dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul/ /bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe ba rnams/ khro rgyal drag po'i mngon spyod stobs kyis sgrol/ /deng 'dir sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /thugs dam bskangs shing bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ om̐ ma hā kā la shrī kṣe ṭa pa la siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma: tri tri marga ṭa mu kha de wa tsa shu la e ka dzā ṭi: nā ga raksha du pra ma rā hu la pa ti dhe wa riddhi: ma hā badzra sa dhu tri sarba dharma pā la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na māṃ sa la kha kha khā hi: thun gtor 'bul las byang spu gri dmar po ltar na sngags 'di 'don/ om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ kā la sing nga sing nga phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hoḥ dgra bgegs ma hā māṃ? sogs ces phul lo/ thun mtshams su mchod bstod ni/ om̐ sarba dharma pā la badzra puṣpe? sogs shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakt zhes mchod/ om̐ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul? sogs ces bstod/ ces karma o rgyan nas bris// // ca) ༈ ma hā kā la khrag 'thung rngam klong las: tshogs mchod rgyal ba spyi mnyes bzhugs so: khrag 'thung khros pa'i rgyal po he ru ka dgyes pa rdo rje mchog gi rol par 'dud: de nas tshogs mchod bya ba'i rim pa ni: dngos 'byor yid sprul blo yis legs blangs nas: yid spyod kyi dmigs yul spros bcas dang spros med gang zhig nges pa'i yo byad 'du tshogs par bgyis te thog mar: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lanagasum: om̐: tshogs gzhong gling bzhi ri rab bkod pa'i nang : āḥ bcud kyis bsdus pa'i bye brag snang srid rgyu: hūm̐: tshogs zhing phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: trām̐: zad med nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur nas:

hrīḥ dpag yas spros pas mchod sprin bla med gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ sarba pra tītstsha ye swā hā: dang po sbyang ba ni: hūm̐: mtshan ldan rdo rje 'bar ba'i snod nang du: āḥ skye 'gag bral ba rang bzhin bla med rdzas: om̐: sku gsum don ldan spros bral dkyil 'khor gyis: hrīḥ mchod yul snang stong bde chen rab bskyed nas: trām̐: 'khor 'das byed po mi dmigs ngo bor spel: bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ swā hā: dngos gzhi spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: 'og min rnam dag rang byung pho brang nas: rigs 'dus rgyal ba kun bzang rdor 'chang la: phyogs dus rigs lnga bde gshegs rnams kyis bskor: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rtsal snang ma 'gags lhun grub pho brang nas: rdo rje sems dpa' 'jig rten dbang phyug la: dkyil 'khor 'dus sde lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bde chen lhun grub kun khyab pho brang nas: dga' rab rdo rje gsang bdag gtum po la: rig 'dzin kun 'dus rol pa'i tshogs kyis bskor: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rnga yab gling dang gsang ba yongs rdzogs nas: rig 'dzin pad 'byung grub thob rgya mtsho la: dbyings phyug ḍākki ma sring 'bum gyis bskor: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: he ru ka yi gnas brgyad pho brang nas: khyab bdag khrag 'thung zhing skyong yab yum la: dregs sde shan pa nyi khri 'khor gyis bskor: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: phyi nang gnas yul dur khrod sna tshogs nas: sprul pa yang sprul chos skyong rgya mtsho la: dam tshig bya ra sgrub pas 'khor gyis bskor: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ sarba dharma pā la kṣe ṭa pa la swā hā:

de nas tshogs mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma rigs 'dus rgyal ba dang : khyad par kun bzang rdo rje 'chang : rdor sems longs sku spyan ras gzigs: dga' rab gsang bdag gtum po che: pad 'byung grub thob mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: khrag 'thung zhing skyong yab yum dang : sde brgyad sprul pa yang sprul bcas: dkyil 'khor bya ra sgrub pa yi: chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: sman raka bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: sha khrag gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: spyan gzigs mthun rdzas mchod pa 'bul: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'dis: zhi ba dbyings kyi thugs dam bskang : drag po khros pa'i thugs dam bskang : khrag 'thung mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : yum mchog lha mo'i thugs dam bskang : bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : dregs pa sde brgyad thugs dam bskang : sde dpon sum cu'i thugs dam bskang : sngags bdag yang 'khor thugs dam bskang : dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bdag gi g.yar dam sor chud nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dam tshig 'gal dang nyams chag rnams: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: dgyes par bskyed la phrin las stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba dharma pā la ya ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi: om̐ badzra sa ma ya sarba shuddhe hoḥ a la la hoḥ kun bzang bde chen yangs pa'i klong du mchod cing bskangs te bshags nas sor chud cing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bdag la bstsal du gsol: sarba siddhi pha la a la la hoḥ zhes pas tshogs mchod rnam gsum phyogs gcig tu btang ste dngos grub kyang rol dga' ston chen po bya'o: de nas tshogs ling bsgral bar hom bskyed bya ba ni: na mo: rang nyid dpal chen mdun du drag po'i snod: lcags khang nag po mun pa dgu rim can: de nang dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum gsal: phaṭḥ bla ma rgyal ba rigs 'dus zhi khro dang :

bka' sdod chos skyong bcas pa'i bden stobs kyis: bstan dgra sgos dgra gnod byed gang yin pa: tha ma'i liṅga 'di la myur du khug: nṛ tri dgra bo shwa ra ma tri 'grim 'grim dza dzaḥ phur thun brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: las byed pho nya shan pa bam gnyis 'phros: me chu tsha ngar 'khrigs pa'i dbal phur gsal: 'dril zhing nam mkha'i mthongs nas gdab pa yis: byad ma'i 'du phung shig cig mā ra ya: oṃ badzra tri tri baṃ tri marga ṭa baṃ bhyoḥ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gtub cing mchod pa ni: hoḥ las byed mtshon thogs mang pos thun gyi char: dgra bgegs byad mar phab nas gtubs pa 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha kha khā hi: tshogs dngos grub rol ba ni: hoḥ chos dbyings ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang : 'khor 'das zung 'jug rang bzhin can: nga bdag 'dzin pa'i g.ya' bral nas: bde stong ye shes ngang du rol: sarba siddhi pha la a la la hoḥ de nas lcags zangs snod du lhag ma bzhag la: hūm̐: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i bka' nyan pa: dregs pa'i las byed gnod sbyin srin po dang : ging dang gshin rje ro langs dur khrod bdag: 'gyu ba'i pho nya gnas nyul lhag sdud ma: nag po dus bdag mtshan mo rgyu ba sogs: mi sdug gzugs 'chang ha ha'i gad mo sgrog: dur khrod nags 'dabs rten bcas dkyil 'khor skyong : rnal 'byor drod nyul snang 'byed las byed ma: sngon tshe gsang bdag gtum po'i bka' bzhin du: lhag ma bzhes la bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: om̐ ma dun shag bhyo kha kha khā hi: de nas bskul pa ni: hūm̐: pho brang chen po dpal gyi tsā ri nas: bstan pa'i las mdzad bdud mgon nag po che: khrag 'thung seng gdong yab yum dbyings nas bzhengs:

las byed bam ro pho mo dbyings nas bzhengs: sde brgyad dregs pa yang 'khor dbyings nas bzhengs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir dmod pa'i las la rgyud bskul nas: khrag 'thung las byed pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis: zhing bcu'i bstan dgra rnal 'byor sgos dgra rnams: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnas yul gar mchis kyang : rbad pa'i lha srung gnyan pos sgrol bar mdzod: gnam lcags thun dang ha la'i dug chen gyi: ngad 'bar gdug pa'i mtshon chen zor mda' yis: ma rungs byad ma'i snying la mā ra ya: dgra bgegs dbang po lnga la kha khā hi: zhing bcu dgra bgegs thams cad ha na ha na ma tha ma tha hūm̐ phaṭ bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de nas chad mdo ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min chos dbyings khyab brdal du: kun bzang rdor 'chang snang mtha'i cho rol las: rigs lnga'i zhing du chos sku'i longs sku la: 'khor 'das dbyings rig gnyis med rtsal 'phos tshe: chos sku longs sku gnyis snang sgyu ma bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: longs sku chos sku thog grol phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lcang lo can dang ma la ya: rdor sems spyan gzigs dga' rab phyag rdor gyis: longs sku'i sprul sku phrin las rtsal bstan nas: snang mched thob pa mched thob ngos sprad nas: bde ba ma la stong pa'i bu rdzogs ltar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sprul sku'i longs sku'i rtsal snang shes par shog: hūm̐: de 'og rnga yab dpal gyi tsā ri ṭa: sprul sku'i rol pa nyid sprul bstan pa'i tshe: gzugs snang smig rgyu la bzla ngo sprad nas: de nyid zhi khro rang rtsal cho 'phrul bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gdos gzugs mtshan ma sprul skur ye grol mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og sha stag gcig tu ma nges kyang : tsā ri ye shes 'khor lo'i pho brang du: rig 'dzin thod phreng chen pos bka' bsgos nas: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i gnyer byang gtad:

rjes 'jug ci bcol bsgrub pa'i tha tshig tu: zhing skyong khyod kyis khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la kṣe ṭa pā la sarba ba su ra hūm̐ siṃ ha mu kha baṃ ḍākki tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya: ka la karma shrī ya sarba bha lingta ye me gha pū dza āḥhūm̐ sarba khā hi swā hā: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: bhyo bhyoḥ bdud dang mu las bshos pa'i bu mo bzhi: g.yang gzhi'i gos gyon spu gri bhandha thogs: dom dred 'phar ba gcan spyang ro zan zhon: lha dang gnod sbyin bshos pa'i bu mo bzhi: stag phod gos gyon lcags kyu zhags pa thogs: khyung 'brug seng stag rtsal chen rdzogs la zhon: g.ya' spang klu las bshos pa'i bu mo bzhi: dar tshon bklubs nas mda' dar bum pa thogs: g.yag dkar khyu mchog chu glang lug la zhon: g.ya' gangs nags chu spang ljongs mkha' sogs rgyu: ma nges cha lugs sgyu ma'i gar rtsed ltar: dkyil 'khor phyi nang gsang gsum dben ri srung : khyad par dam tshig can gyi bya ra byed: bstan skyong ya ma nyer bzhi'i srung ma rnams: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'dzam gling bod khams chos la 'god pa dang : gsang sngags bstan pa'i chos srid rgyas mdzad nas: dpal ldan rnying mar grags pa'i bstan pa srungs: dge legs bkra shis 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod: du pra ma yakṣa ting ting ma tri le le ya dza bha lingta kha kha khā hi: de nas dngos grub len pa nyer mkho ni: hūm̐: khyab brdal rol pa'i cho 'phrul 'dul dka'i gnyen: 'bar ba'i gzi byin nus pa'i dpung chen g.yo: che ba'i lha bcas srid gsum gdod ma'i dbyings: zla med dpa' bo khyod kyi sor rtse'i khyon: nges par khyab pa'i shugs dang g.yo ba'i stobs: mi shigs rdo rje'i gur du bdag bskyal nas: nam yang snang srid dbang du sdud pa yi:

'gro 'dul thabs kyis skyong ba'i dngos grub zhu: 'byor drug legs tshogs bstan pa rmad byung ba'i: 'dod don char bzhin 'bebs par mdzad du gsol: om̐ sarba pa shaṃ ku ru siddhi pha la ye swā hā: zhes dngos grub kyi grogs gang 'thad ces pa'o: de nas skabs su bab tshe rta bro'i cha lag ni: hūm̐: ri rab rdo rje'i rmang gzhi ru: dbang chen pho brang 'debs pa'i phyir: sa 'dul rdo rje'i bro ra bcag: rngam stabs gar gyi brtul zhugs kyis: sa sri pho mo dam la btags: pho brang bskyed rdzogs mtha' ru phyin: de bzhin bro bar dam ma g.yel: hūm̐: ma traṃ bsgral ba'i sa gzhi la: ye shes mgon po'i las tshogs bkram: dmar chen gtor ma'i thod mkhar brtsegs: las chas nag po seng gdong bskul: dregs pa sde brgyad pho nyar rbad: bzlog zor spu gri las mtha' ru: sgab 'dre dam sri 'dul ba'i phyir: sngags 'chang dmod pa'i chas dgu spras: gtum rngam gshe ba'i 'gying 'gros bro: phyag mtshan mtshon cha bsnams pa yis: mā ra ya yi rgyud bskul las: dam sri dam la btags pa'i phyir: chem chem khro bo 'bar ba'i bro: mnan mnan khro mo dgyes pa'i bro: lam lam sde brgyad myur 'gros bro: dgra bgegs dpung 'joms hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bhyo bhyo bzlog cig mā ra ya: zhes pas bro brdung : rnga chang la sogs ci bder 'gyed: de nas bkra shis me tog ni: hūm̐: gnas chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi a tsi ta: rab 'jigs tsitta 'bar ba 'khor lo'i bdag: la la rā sa'i dbang sgyur nag po che: kṣe ṭa pa la gtso 'khor bkra shis shog: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐ maṇḍa tsakra tsa turta he dzñā na: a nu dha ra sarba dharma ḍaḥ.ātma ko3 haṃ sarba ga ga aḥswa bhā a ti mu ye a haṃ hoḥ zhes bsngo smon ni: hoḥ mkhyen brtse'i mkha' la rgyas pa'i shes rab mtshon: ma rig nad rlung 'thug po'i gling du bsnun: btol ba'i mthongs skar skye 'gro'i bskyed du bsngo:

chos dbyings ma ma dwangs pa'i bsil yab kyi: gsher ba padma'i grogs bzhin rab dkar mdangs: byang chub gdengs ka 'khyil ba'i rlabs phreng nyi: srid zhir mi gnas phun tshogs gnyen du shog: ces pa 'khor gsum yongs dag tshogs chen gyi sa la rab tu gzhol ba'i 'dun pa dang du bsu zhing : nyon mongs log lta'i spu gri byur lag can dben pa'i pha mthar bskrad: rjes shes dag pa rnams nges kyi btsun mo yid du blang zhing bag med rgyal 'gong gyi rnam rtog so ma nyams pa'i khengs log thams cad 'byung po bcal du yas rdzong ba ltar phyogs su bskyal: phyung rdeg las tshogs 'di ka spu gri'i cha lag ltar bag yod kyis 'chang ba gnad du go: gcer bu'i ral kha nges par byol la g.yar dam ci cher gnyer bar bya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor gdan drangs chu byi lor gnas chen smug po lha zhol du shog ser las bsgyur ba'o/ bskul ba po ni rlangs chen dpal seng gi gdung las 'khrungs pa'i dge bshes yongs su grags pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis maṇḍal phun sum tshogs pa phul bas zhag gcig la rten 'brel cher 'grigs so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // cha) ༈ dpal mgon zhing skyong dmag 'gyed nag po'i rgyud phreng las: las byang spu gri dmar po byad ma reg gcod bzhugs so: dpal chen he ru ka la 'dud: dpal mgon zhing skyong bdud 'dul gyi: bsgrub pa brtson par bya ba'i thabs: dur khrod dam ni gang rung byas: dben gnas gangs kyi rwa ba dang : las bskul chos skyong pho brang du: ro sol dug khrag stegs bu bcas: de steng dkyil 'khor cha tshang gdab: dbus su bhandha mtshan ldan nang : bla 'khor sgrub rdzas ril bu bzhag: dar dmar kha bcad rdo rjes gdab: g.yas su bha ling rgyan rdzogs bsham: g.yon du bum pa bdud rtsis gtams: steng du me long sindhu ra: legs byug ḍākki'i srog sngags bris:

mdun du phyi nang mchod pa bsham: rgyab tu sku 'bag bla rten bsham: g.yas g.yon mdun sogs 'tshams pa'i sar: ru dar dpal chas spyan gzigs bkram: mda' mo rgod sgros brgyan pa la: me long shwa rgyan dar nag dang : khram dang rtsis kyi shog bkra dang : gri rgod snying dang bla rdo gzungs: ru mtshon la yang de bzhin no: tshogs rdzas la sogs gzhung bzhin bsham: mdun du brub khung stegs kyi khar: dmar nag gtor ma rtsang gis brgyan: yang yang bskul zhing dgra ling 'gugs: liṅga bsgral nas zor chen 'phang : sgrub pa grol nas dbang bzhi blang : bla rten srog 'khor tshang bar bya: dang po skyabs yul sems bskyed ni: gtso bo'i las byang gzhung bsrang zhing : de nas dkyil 'khor 'jug pa ni: rang nyid skad cig gsang bdag ni: dmigs pa gsal bar 'di skad do: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las bdag mdun dkyil 'khor gyi: dur khrod bkod pa rab rdzogs pho brang e: bskal pa'i me dpung 'tshubs klong gsal rdzogs bsgom: de dbus dgra bgegs snying khar gnam lcags 'khor: khrag mtsho mi rta bam chen nyi zla'i steng : gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ nag tshwa tshwa can: 'od 'phros dgra bgegs tshar gcod tshur 'dus nas: hūm̐ mthing 'brug sgras stong gsum shig shig 'gul: skad cig gnas 'gyur dpal mgon seṅge'i gdong : sku mdog mthing nag char sprin gtibs pa'i gzugs: g.yu ral bsigs shing khro chung skar ltar 'khrugs: thod skam rgyan ldan spyan 'khrugs shangs rlung 'bud: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs dgra snying rol: phyag g.yas ru mtshon nag po mkha' la phyar: g.yon pa'i dmar chen gtor ma dgra snying brgyan: sku la mun pa'i g.yung drung ber chen gsol: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri zhags pa 'khyugs: zhabs la swag ri nag po sbrul rgyan gsol: chibs su bdud rta nag po rting dkar chibs: srin po'i thod sga srin mo'i pags ldan la: dug sbrul nag po'i gong smad srab mda' ldan:

dpa' ba'i chas ldan phyi nang rgyan rdzogs bsgom: mdun du tri las bdud mo seng gdong ma: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan 'khrug khrag ral bskyod: thod skam dar dmar rgyan ldan sbrul nag 'khyugs: phyag gnyis rtse gsum dmar gtor dgra snying brgyan: dar dmar ber gsol btsan rta dmar zhur chibs: zhing lpags sga stan mtshon drug nad rkyal brgyan: sho khram rtsis rdo gdug pa'i chas rdzogs bsgom: yab yum mdun du sprul pa'i bam ro ni: dmar nag spyi gtsug gtad cing lag gnyis 'khrab: rkang pas dmar chen gtor zor thog ltar 'phen: shar du rma gnyan spom ra stag la chibs: phyag gnyis dgra satwa ru dar dkar po bsnams: shar lho sngags bdag ma mo g.yu 'brug chibs: phyag gnyis spu gri bsnams shing dgra snying rol: lho ru sku rgyal zangs btsan rta dmar chibs: phyag gnyis ral gri btsan dar zhags pa 'khyug: lho nub mgar ba nag po rwa skyes chibs: phyag gnyis tho chen stag gi sbud pa bsnams: nub tu klu bdud mkhar nag chu srin chibs: phyag gnyis sbrul zhags mdze nad par bu bsnams: nub byang gza' bdud nag po glog dmar chibs: phyag gnyis gnam lcags ral gri thogs mda' 'phen: byang du gnyan chen thang lha g.yag dkar chibs: phyag gnyis gnam lcags ral gri ru dar bsnams: byang shar srog bdag dpe dkar seṅge chibs: phyag gnyis lhung bzed 'khar gsil dgra snying rol: thams cad rang rang rigs mthun khrab rmog phub: ru dar dang ru phod chen sprin ltar gtibs: stag ral gzig shubs rang rtags mtshon cha phyar: phyi rol yang sprul dregs pa'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: sha za gcan spyang dur bya tshogs kyis bskor: de ltar chos skyong yongs rdzogs gsal ba yi: om̐ āḥhūm̐ tri dzaḥyig gnas lnga 'phros: de las 'od 'phros rang rang gnas mchog nas: skad cig thogs med pho brang gnas 'dir gshegs: brtan bzhugs phrin las drag po 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra e hya hi phaiṃ phaiṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ
dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: pho brang mkha' spyod tsā ri nas: seng gdong yab yum gshegs su gsol: sde brgyad dmag dpon mdzad pa'i tshe: bsil ba tshal nas gshegs su gsol: sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed pa'i tshe: ti se gangs nas gshegs su gsol: mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mdzad pa'i tshe: la phyi gangs nas gshegs su gsol: rnal 'byor dgra lha mdzad pa'i tshe: tsā ri ṭa nas gshegs su gsol: dgra la dmag dpung 'gyed pa'i tshe: gze rgyal gnas nas gshegs su gsol: byad ma cham la 'bebs pa'i tshe: rong btsan gnas nas gshegs su gsol: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i tshe: padma bkod nas gshegs su gsol: sgrub mchog bka' gter skyong ba'i tshe: gar bzhugs gnas nas gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: zhing skyong bdud mgon gshegs su gsol: bdud mo seng gdong gshegs su gsol: bam ro pho mo gshegs su gsol: rma gnyan spom ra gshegs su gsol: srog bdag ma mo gshegs su gsol: gnod sbyin zangs btsan gshegs su gsol: dam can mgar nag gshegs su gsol: klu bdud mkhar nag gshegs su gsol: gza' bdud ki kang gshegs su gsol: gnyan chen thang lha gshegs su gsol: srog bdag dpe dkar gshegs su gsol: yang sprul dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: me ltar g.yo ba dregs chen sde: drag po bdud 'dul lha tshogs rnams: bka' gsang bstan pa rgyas pa'i phyir: gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badzra sa ma ya a ti pu hoḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod me ri khrag zhags bam gyi gdan: bdud dgra mu stegs bsnol ba'i dal dbus su: dpal mgon zhing skyong seng gdong dregs pa'i tshogs: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir dgyes par bzhugs: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha ldan: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dgra bgegs dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog spungs: sha chen bdug spos bsregs pa'i dri mchog ldan:

rkang mar lha ba zhag gi sgron me 'degs: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs snying khrag zham chu 'khyil: sha khrag bam chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs: rkang gling thod rnga sgra chen 'brug ltar sgrog: zhing gi g.yang gzhi lhab lhub mkha' la bres: dgyes pa'i mchod tshogs sprin ltar gtibs pa 'di: zhing skyong yab yum dregs pa yang 'khor la: 'bul lo sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs: bdag cag sgrub la lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: dgyes pa rab bskyed thugs dam bskang gyur cig: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥ tri hriṃ dzaḥ baṃ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma hūm̐ phaṭḥ tri hriṃ dzaḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ru tri ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa sha na bha su ta bha lingta pra tītstsha kha kha khā hi: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza āḥhūm̐: drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: rab 'jigs ri bo dur khrod tsā ri ṭaḥ sha za khrag 'thung lhang lhang dgod pa'i gnas: dbyer med phyi nang thod mkhar 'bar ba'i dbus: gnam lcags khrag mtsho e yi dbus nyid du: dpal chen gdug pa 'dul byed seṅge'i gdong : sku mdog mthing nag chos nyid phyogs bcur 'gyed: seṅge'i nga ro 'brug sgras mu stegs 'dul: g.yu ral bsigs pas stong khams me 'od 'khrug: thod skam dar nag dbu rgyan seng chung 'gyed: spyan dmar phyogs bcur 'khyil bas dgra snying 'dar: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril ru tra'i snying khrag rol: phyag g.yas ru dar g.yab mos dgra yul 'joms: g.yon pas dmar chen gtor mtshon dgra la 'debs: stag ral gzig shubs ldan pas lha srin sngangs: dar nag ber chen ma rungs g.yul las rgyal: rgya lham swag chen dam sri'i mgo bo gnon: srin po'i sga srab rnam rtog bdud srin 'joms: bdud rta rab 'dur dgra yul phye mar gtong : mthu chen stobs kyis gdug pa'i byad ma sgrol:

khrag zhag dbus nas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung : gtum chen dpa' bo seṅge'i gdong la bstod: hūm̐: khrag mtsho lbu ba rab 'khrigs ro gdan steng : tri las dmar nag bdud mo seng gdong ma: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril g.yu ral seng chung 'khrug: thod skam dar dmar rgyan ldan snang srid 'dul: phyag g.yas kha ṭwaṃ' dgra satwas dgra srog gcod: g.yon pas dgra snying rol zhing thod zor 'phen: dal dmar lhub ldan bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel: shwa khram rtsis rdo dgra yul phye mar dkrug: btsan rta 'dur lding nad yams dgra la bhyoḥ skad cig glog ltar 'gyu zhing dgra yul 'joms: snang srid dbang sdud dpal 'bar drag mor bstod: bam ro sprul 'gyed dgra yul than gyis 'gengs: bya sder 'khrab pas sa gzhi 'gul zhing bsnyil: rkang pas zor btegs dgra la thog ltar 'bebs: bdud dgra'i g.yul bcom bam chen gnyis la bstod: hūm̐ bhyoḥ bka' yi las byed shan pa sde brgyad ni: mi sdug gzugs 'chang 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrog: go khrab mtshon cha gdeng zhing rlung ltar 'tshubs: thog mda' mtshon dal 'bebs shing dgra yul 'joms: dregs pa srog gcod shan pa'i tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: zhing skyong dpal 'bar sku la bdag bstod do: bdud 'dul seng gdong drag mor bdag bstod do: bam chen shan pa gnyis la bdag bstod do: rma chen spom ra'i sku la bdag bstod do: srog bdag ma mo'i sku la bdag bstod do: gnod sbyin zangs btsan sku la bdag bstod do: dam can mgar ba nag por bdag bstod do: mkhar nag dge bsnyen sku la bdag bstod do: gza' bdud ki kang sku la bdag bstod do: gnyan chen thang lha'i sku la bdag bstod do: srog bdag dpe dkar sku la bdag bstod do: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs la bdag bstod do: de ltar bstod cing thugs dam rgyud bskul mthus: sangs rgyas bstan srungs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod: bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod:

bsnyen pa ni: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la sing nga sing nga phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes sngags phreng sgra chad zur chag med par bzla'o: e ma kho bo padma 'byung gnas ngas: zab don legs bshad mtsho rgyal yig ger thob: ma 'ongs sems can dmu rgod 'dul slad du: phyi rabs rjes 'jug smon lam ldan pa'i don: gdams pa'i yang snying zer ma'i spu gri 'di: las mtha' dmag 'gyed ru dar nag po'i rgyud: dmod pa brdab chog bdud mgon sgrub thabs 'di: ma 'ongs sum cu kha ral nyi shu la: dmag 'khrug mtshon gyi bskal pa dar ba'i dus: chos khrims rgyal khrims bdud blon nag pos 'tshe: chos srid tshul ldan mi dbang rgyal po la: 'pho 'chug rkyen dang bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir: sbas yul gangs can bstan skyong sgrub thabs bzhag: da lta spel ba'i gnas min gter du sbos: ma 'ongs yang mtha'i dus 'joms 'khrug pa'i tshe: sangs rgyas ye shes skye ba 'dzin pa la: sprod cig klu rgyal dbang lag bka' tshig rgya: bai ro'i gsung sprul bu la sprod cig rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyan rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod mtsho chen dmar nag rakta'i klong nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal rgyas so// // ja) ༈ dpal mgon seng gdong nag po'i gtor 'bul byad ma snying 'byin gdug pa'i g.yul 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so: dpal mgon zhing skyong ma hā kā la'i sku la 'dud: gsol mchod gtor 'bul bsdus pa'i las rim ni: 'bru nag las byas dpal gtor bshams nas dang po 'di skad do: hūm̐: bzhengs shig dur khrod tsā ri'i gnas nas bzhengs: deng 'dir gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan bsrung phyir:

zhing skyong 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs mchod gtor bzhes: bstan srung mthu rtsal bskyed pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: kā la seng gdong drag po mthu stobs rgyal: kha gdangs mche gtsigs dgra sha khrag la rngam: ga shal rgyan ldan ru dar dmar gtor 'dzin: nga ro ha ha sgrogs shing bdud rta chibs: ca co rigs ldan ma rungs bstan dgra rnams: cha lugs du ma'i cho 'phrul 'gyed cing sgrol: ja chang phud rgod gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nya rgyas lta bu'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: ta thā ga ta'i bstan srung nag po che: tha dad gcig tu ma nges seṅge'i gdong : da dgra rtsad gcod snying dang kha ṭwāṃ bsnams: na 'chi rkyen ngan dgra la rbad pa'i tshe: pa sangs rgyu 'dra'i bdud rta rlung gshog chibs: pha rol byad ma'i sha khrag gtor ma bzhes: ba mor nyi ltar dgra bo bsgral bar mdzod: ma hā kā la'i bstan srung bam chen rngam: tsā ri ṭa sogs sbas yul zab gter srung : tsha grang 'khrugs 'dra mdog sdug 'jigs shing 'khrigs: dza lang byad ma bsgral zhing gtor ma bzhes: wa seng rtsal 'gyed ji ltar mngon par mdzod: zhe sdang 'byung po sgrol mdzad dregs pa'i tshogs: za gsod dbugs la rngam zhing ha sgra sgrogs: 'a cag rbad cing bskul lo pho nya'i tshogs: ya ma gshin rje'i dmag tshogs gtibs pa bzhin: ral gri mtshon cha'i dal yams dgra la phob: la yog kha smras ngan pa dgra la bhyo: sha khrag dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: sa steng dgra bo bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: ha la zor thun char phob bsregs gtor nas: a don ngo bo chos dbyings la gnas shog: hūm̐: bskul lo zhing skyong dpal 'bar 'khor bcas kyis: pha rol byad kha log lta bdud rigs rnams: myur du bsgral zhing sha khrag don snying rol: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: mi kha dmod tshig do bsdo dgra dang bgegs: skad cig nyid la bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥ

tri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥ tri hriṃ dza: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ tri hriṃ dza: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes phul: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: rgyun gtor 'bul ba'i cha rkyen 'di: tshig nyung don 'brel nus rtags 'byung : rgyun khyer gtor 'bul e ma ho: skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad par shog: bdag 'dra gter bdag gling pa'i mtshan can gyis/ /tshig nyung don dril cha rkyen bsgrubs/ /'dis kyang bstan srung mngon gyur shog /ces bdag 'dra karma las 'brel gling pas jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas dregs pa sha za 'gyu ba'i dus su gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // nya) ༈ dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i gtor zlog zur 'gebs ni/ gzu dpang gser skyems hom̐ bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: mkha' spyod dag pa rab 'byams phyogs bcu nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas rig 'dzin rgyal sras tshogs: mchog gsum 'phags pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag ni ma nyes drang por bskul ba'i tshe: gzu dpang bden rdzun gnyen po'i phrin las bskul: rin chen gser skyems bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la: nyes can dgra la mgon skyob ma byed par: bdag gi mgon mdzod dgra la bka' chad phob: phyogs bcur gnas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes drag po'i las mdzod cig: byad ma gdug pa'i yul la dmag sna drongs: rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag gi sdongs grogs mdzod: sngon tshe rgyal bar dam bcas ji bzhin tu: dam tshig gnyan gyi phrin las nyan par gyis: byad ma gdug pa'i dmag tshogs bsgral bar mdzod: gser skyems mchod cing ma nyes yus bshags gdab: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: ma nyes ma len gzu dpang dkon mchog bzhugs:

drang shan 'byed pa'i sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams: rin chen gser skyems bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la: dam nyams log 'dren byad ma 'di nyid la: drag sngags rdo rje phur pa'i thun brdegs pas: ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: mngon spyod bka' yi chad pa drag po ni: de ring dam nyams dmag 'dren 'di la phob: las mkhan dus la bab bo sa ma ya: rang nyid lhar gsal gsal ba gsum ldan gyis: hūm̐: bdag nyid hūm̐ las gsang bdag gtum po'i sku: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan rtsa g.yo: sma ra smin ma dbu skra me ltar 'bar: bhandha skam po'i rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: tshwa tshwa 'khrugs pa'i dar nag cod pan 'phur: dug sbrul rigs lngas skra bcings lhu tshigs brgyan: phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la: za byed rngam pa'i khro bcu me ltar 'bar: g.yon par me yi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la: gsod byed khro mo sha za chu ltar khol: stobs bcu dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs: zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel: sku la stong khams sreg pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: 'jigs byed dpa' bo stobs ldan sku ru gsal: om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa maṇḍa la tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ nyer gcig bzlas: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī si na ra ma tri hriṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bhyoḥ lan bdun lnga: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes bzlas gzi byin bskyed nas byug bdug brab gsum bya'o: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen? sogs nas lta bur gsal: bar om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī si na ra ma tri hriṃ du tri phu tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dha pa dha pa a mu ka dza dzaḥ a be sha ya thun dza ru tra tsitta khaḍga bi shwa tsakra ha la ya dza bhi mā ra rbad bhyo byad ma thum thum myog myog trig nan hur thum rbad ya: zhes sngags bgrang zhing mdun du liṅga bskyed pa ni: phaṭḥ mdun du rngam zhing 'thug pa'i lcags khang nag po sgo med pa'i nang du nṛ tri yongs su gyur pa las:

dam nyams dgra bo byad ma sdug bsngal zhing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can: mgon skyabs lha dang bral ba: bu ga dgu nas khrag bskyugs shing yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: phaṭḥ na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po yum mchog si na ra ma las byed bam ro pho mo bka' 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad gzhan yang bka' sdod chos skyong dam can gter bdag rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa'i stobs drag po la brten nas spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sgos dgra: rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dam nyams pa'i dgra bo byad ma: khyad par dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: byad kha rbod gtong ngan pa: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: 'dzing rtsod 'khon ya byed pa'i dgra bo: mthu bu lon bzhin du snyog pa'i dam nyams byad ma 'di: mtho srid pa'i rtse mo: dma' na raka rdo rje: 'jig rten gyi mngal: sa 'og sa steng sa bla bar snang chos bon srung ma'i skyabs 'og: gang du gnas kyang las kyi pho nya nag po stong gi tshogs rnams kyis rang dbang med par sbur ma rlung gis khyer ba bzhin tu gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra aṅku sha ya dgra bo dzaḥ nṛ tri gzer thum: rmug ching khug dril: rbad gtub nan nan:

lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug bya gzhung gi pho nya 'gyed pa la 'jug pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: las la bskul zhing sogs rang gzhung nas bris so zhes bla ma dam pa karma'i ming gis bris pa'o// // ta) ༈ dpal mgon zhing skyong ru mtshon nag po'i rgyud las: rtsang bzlog spu gri reg chod bzhugs so: shan pa rtsang gi rbad bskul ni: bzlog pa'i dmigs rim dang bcas la khrag gis mchod nas: hūm̐: drag po dpal chen bdud 'dul seng gdong gi: myur mgyogs pho nya shan pa 'tshogs pa'i rten: rno dbal drag po rtsang phur ldan pa ni: zur gsum sku gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: mtho dman srid gsum rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings: mang nyung grangs med tsha ngar me yi zer: myur mgyogs thog rgod drag po rlung gi shugs: gzi byin nyi zla myur mgyogs glog gi 'gyu: rno dbal spu gri sgrol 'debs ki kang myur: rtse mor zhe sdang gdug pa'i me ri 'bar: sked pa rgya mdud gti mug mun rim gtibs: rtsa bar 'dod chags srid pa'i khrag mtsho khol: drwa mig shan pa las mkhan nga rgyal nyil: zur gsum phrag dog gdug pa'i rlung nag 'tshubs: bzlog med las kyi drag po'i rtsang phur tshogs: bskul lo bzhengs shig myur mgyogs mthu stobs bskyed: khrag mchod dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: pha rol g.yul ngo gdug pa'i dmag tshogs rnams: dug mda' gzer phur nag po khyed kyis zlog: chag che nyam nga rmi ltas mtshan ngan rnams: dam nyams dgra bo byad ma'i steng du zlog: mi kha gleng gzhi gshe skur smra mi myur: phung shig kha sbyor pha rol dgra la zlog: rtsang la gnas pa'i chos skyong pho nya'i tshogs: bskul lo rbad do tha tshig dam ma g.yel: dgra bo byad ma'i rten yul mkhar khang shigs: srung skyob ban bon lha srung bcas pa rnams: gnam lcags ri bo brgyab myos bsregs byas nas: bskal pa'i rlung g.yos thal ba bun gtor bzhin: lhag ma rjes med brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod:

om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī si na ra ma a ya ma du ru tsa sha na ru tra tshindha ya tshindha ya bhandha ya bhandha ya mā ra ya trag raksha ha la ha la hu lu hu lu na sha ya ru tra ru tra bhyo bhyo zlog zlog mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces thal mo brdab pa dang bcas nas zlog sngags bgrang ngo : e ma yang zab ti ka la: rtsang bzlog spu gri reg chod 'di: byad ma bsgral ba'i mtshon cha ru: dmigs pa'i las kyi mtshon char shog: bdag 'dra karma las 'brel rtsal gyis gdan drangs shing shog ser las bshus so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // tha) ༈ dpal mgon zhing skyong ru mtshon nag po las: zor bzlog byad ma 'bum thub bzhugs so: dpal mgon zhing skyong ma hā kā lar 'dud: gser skyems bskul dang 'phang ba'i rim pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' spyod dag pa rab 'byams phyogs bcu nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas rig 'dzin rgyal sras tshogs: mchog gsum 'phags pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag ni ma nyes drang por bskul ba'i don: gzu dpang bden rdzun gnyan po'i phrin las bskul: rin chen gser skyems bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la: nyes can dgra la mgon skyob ma byed par: bdag gi mgon mdzod dgra la bka' chad phob: phyogs bcur gnas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes drag po'i zor lam phyes: byad ma gdug pa'i g.yul la zor sna drongs: rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag gi sdong grogs mdzod: sngon tshe rgyal bar dam bcas ci bzhin tu: dam tshig gnyan gyi phrin las nyan par gyis: byad ma gdug pa'i dmag tshogs sgrol bar mdzod: de nas dgra bo 'gugs pa'i phyogs su zor 'phang ba ni: de nas zor sna dgu thogs te: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dpal chen seng gdong yab yum thugs las sprul: thabs shes gnyis bsdus rab bskul drag po'i mtshon: bam chen pho mo sbyor ba'i las gzhus dal: gnyis med sras mchog lcags sdig nag po 'phros: gnam lcags dbal ldan 'khyugs pa'i mtshon gdab pas:

byad ma lha srung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces 'phang ngo : de nas dgra satwa thogs la: hūm̐: dregs pa'i sde dpon srog bdag rma rje bskul: dregs pa rbad pas bdud kyi g.yul gzhom phyir: dregs byed rtsal ldan shugs che dgra satwa'i zor: dregs 'joms zor chen dgra la mā ra ya: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces 'phang ngo : de nas khrag rkyal thogs la: hūm̐: snang srid ma yams bu yug nad kyi bdag: snang ngor bdag gis bskul lo sngags bdag la: snang srid nad yams gcig bsdus khrag gi zor: snang khams bshig pa'i khrag zor dgra la ya: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de nas zhags pa dang bsha' gri thogs la: hūm̐: sha za zangs btsan snying 'byin sku rgyal che: sha khrag srog la rngam phyir zor la bskul: sha rus phye mar btang zhing bshig pa'i mtshon: sha dang nang rol dkrugs shig gri zor ya: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de nas tho ba'i zor dang rwa mgo thogs la: hūm̐: dam can 'dzam gling yongs kyi srog 'phrog pa:

dam tshig ldan pa sngags 'chang bdag gis bskul: dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba'i phyag mtshan zor: dam 'gal gnod pa'i dgra la zor mda' ya: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de nas sbrul zhags dang par bu thogs la: hūm̐: klu bdud nag po rab 'bar dbugs sdud pa: klu rgyal gdug pa'i dregs sde skur bzhengs la: klu nad sna dgu 'bebs pa'i par bu 'di: klu gtad dgra bo'i yul la mdze zor ya: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de nas bya rog gi mchu dang mda' gzhu thogs la: hūm̐: 'chi bdag gza' bdud ki kang rā hu la: 'chi bdud dgra la 'dren phyir las la bskul: 'chi byed gdug pa'i zor rdzas las mtshon 'di: 'chi kha khram kha dgra la zor drongs ya: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de nas nyungs thun dang mdung dar thogs la: hūm̐: lha btsan thang lha skyes po las la bzhengs: lha 'dre srid pa'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: lha min gdug pa'i mtshon cha zor thun ya: lha yi bka' chad zor mda' dgra la ya: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ

ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de nas lhung bzed dang khrag kong thogs la: hūm̐: bka' yi las byed srog bdag rgyal po bzhengs: smyo 'bog snying gzer dam nyams dgra la thob: bka' 'gal dgra bo byad ma bdud dgra la: bka' chad dbab phyir khrag rkong dgra la ya: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: dgra bo byad ma'i dmag dpung rnams myur du sgrol bar the tshom med: de nas zor rdzas kyi rgyab la gtor chen thogs la: rnga brdung dung 'bud raktas bran la 'di skad do: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dgongs su gsol lo dpal ldan nag po che: rgyud srung bka' bstan skyong bar zhal bzhes rnams: deng 'dir drag po'i mthu stobs nus rtsal skyed: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i mthu bo rtsal shugs bskul: dpal mgon seng gdong dmag la bzhengs bskul tshe: snang srid g.yo 'khrug nyi zla cha lang rdeb: tsha grang 'thab pa'i 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: ri rab rmang 'gul stong sgra chems se chem: las gshin pho nya gad mo lhangs se lhang : snang srid lha srin dmag tshogs thibs se thib: bya nag sha zan gshog sgra di ri ri: mon pa pho mos gar byed shigs se shig: pho nya las byed bla 'gugs sha ra ra: ro langs srin mo sha za nyi li li: lha srin dmag tshogs bswo sgra di ri ri: mun nag 'dre mos 'o dod lhangs se lhang : 'jigs rung gdug pa'i dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: shar nas dri za'i dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: lho nas gshin rje'i dmag tshogs bye 'bum: nub nas klu bdud dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: byang nas gnod sbyin dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: gzhan yang bka' sdod las byed bye ba 'bum:

zhing skyong phyogs skyong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon dgra la phyor: de ring dmar nag gtor ma'i zor sna drongs: zor dpung dpal mgon zhing skyong srung mas skyed: zor sna gza' bdud dam can ma mos drongs: zor 'debs shan pa srog bdud nag po ya: zor 'phen rgyud srung rig 'dzin gnyan pos mdzod: sangs rgyas bstan bshig bla ma zhe nas smad: dben ri gnyan po bcom zhing chos sgra 'joms: dkar po khyad gsod nag po'i sna yang 'dren: do bsdo phod btsugs 'gras 'tshol shag kha 'debs: dam la bsdo zhing ma nyes kha yog 'gel: snga phyi dgra gshom ka cha dkor nor 'tshe: bdag la 'tshe zhing ya kha phra tshig 'byin: mi la lha med lha la mthu med zer: dkon mchog bka' dang rgyud 'gal dgra bo 'di: steng nas gnam rdeb ri rab bsnyil bzhin thongs: bar nas mtsho dkrugs thog ser 'bebs bzhin thongs: 'og nas mya ngan mun pa 'thibs bzhin thongs: g.yas nas pho rgyud bya sgro bsregs bzhin thongs: g.yon nas mo rgyud shing skam chag bzhin thongs: mdun nas chung rgyud byi'u sgong myag bzhin thongs: rgyab nas rigs rgyud bya sgong chag bzhin thongs: gnyen 'brel mdza' bshes kun rgyud rlung la bskur: yul mkhar srung ma sa gzhi rten yul rnams: thal zhag chu la g.yeng ba bzhin du thongs: pha rol byad ma'i lha srung g.yul ngo 'di: myur du brlag cing bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: dmag dpon shan pa dmar nag lag na sprod: dmag gi las mkhan pho nya dpa' zas gyis: 'og rta gshin rje'i spu gri 'khor los gtubs: go mtshon gza' bdud nag pos sil bur thongs: don snying dam can srog bdag 'bar bas bzhes: dmag dpung sngags bdag ma mos rlung la bskur: srog gcod dbugs sdud tshe yi bla rten phrol: sha za khrag 'thung lhag ma med par bzhes: bskul lo zhing skyong rgyal po mthu ma chung : rbad do dregs pa sde brgyad bang ma bul:

mdzod c-ig sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol bar mdzod: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can ma bsgral na: bka' srung mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu med do: rig 'dzin rgyal bar khas blangs tha tshig 'gal: sngon gyi dam dgongs hur thum da lta nyid: rdul du brlag cing bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭ tri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces zor 'phang : dgra bo byad ma'i g.yul thams cad bsgral zhing sha khrag stong gsum kheng bar gyur: de nas las mkhan rnams kyis gsol bar bsgom: dgra bo'i nang rgyas sam dus kyi dmag 'dren yin na rang nyid zhing skyong lha tshogs bdag bskyed ltar gsal zhing bskul zor dang sbrags nas 'thab pas myur du sgrol bar the tshom med dau: e ma: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas ngas: phyi rabs ma 'ongs bod 'bangs don: g.yul 'gyed ru dar nag po'i rgyud: dmag bzlog spu gri'i zor mda' bzhag: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: yang snyigs tha ma dus 'khrugs tshe: mi chen srog la hur thum 'byung : dben ri sde dgon bcom pa'i tshe: zab chos 'di dang 'phrad nas kyang : 'di 'chang g.yul las rab rgyal shog: klu bdud kha la raksha rgya: dam nyams log lta'i dbang po snubs: chos bdag bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra karma las 'brel gling pas jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas spyan drangs shing phag lor shog ser nas zhal rgyas so/ /dge legs 'phel lo// // da) ༈ dpal mgon zhing skyong dmag 'gyed ru dar nag po'i rgyud: zor bzlog rlung gi spu gri dmar po bzhugs so: che btsan rab khros khro bo'i rgyal: rngam pa ma hā kā la 'di: dbyings zer rtsal spros seng sgra sgrog:

dpal 'bar he ru ka la bstod: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs sems can phan blo'i don: srid gsum stobs 'dus seng gdong gi: dmag 'gyed ru dar nag po'i rgyud: sangs rgyas bstan srung drag po'i mtshon: btab pas bzlog med ru dar rgyud: nag po dregs 'dul yang snying bstan: yi ger legs thob mtsho rgyal lcam: ma 'ongs sum cu'i yang mtha' la: gsang sngags dbus dor mtha' nas khul: btsun gzugs ghirtis bstan la 'tshe: shākya'i rjes 'jug sil bur 'thor: gsal shing mdag me'i tshal bzhin 'khrug: 'dzam gling kye hud 'o dod bsngang : sems can mya ngan nyi ma ngu : stod nas zla ba zlos gar ling : khol bu sil 'thor ra thag bsdom: lo nyes sad ser dbul phongs te: chos rgyal dmangs kyis kha yog shom: dam nyams log chos lug khyu 'dren: bstan 'dzin ri dwags brag la mkhar: las ngan sdug bsngal zad mtha' med: kye ma bod 'bangs snying re rje: sgron cig mun gling gsal ba'i lcam: kho mo khyod kyi sprul pa ni: 'dzam gling snang ngor khyab par 'byung : de phyir rje 'bangs grogs rnams kyang : mkha' la nyi zla zung ltar 'byung : ma 'ongs rtsod ldan de yi dus: chos rgyal bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir: zhing skyong dmag gi rgyal po yi: ru dar gdug pa'i g.yul bzlog 'di: gangs can ri mgul rakta'i mtsho: drag po klu la bcol te sbos: dpal chen sangs rgyas ye shes khyod: 'di 'don zhe sdang lo 'dzin 'byung : de dus zab chos 'di 'phrad kyis: las can smon lam ldan par shog: nā ga raksha tsitta rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dmag 'gyed pho nya ling bskul ni: dmag thabs bskul rbad gdams pa bstan: byad ma ru tra bstan pa'i dgra: myur du cham la dbab pa'i thabs: dang po bca' bzhi lag len ni: drag po lcags sam rtsub pa'i snod: ro sol gri khrag chag chag gdab: gnam lcags spu gri 'khor lo ste: liṅga dang ni chos 'byung bsnol:

de steng 'bru nag gang rung la: dmar nag dbal 'dra'i gtor ma ni: rab ltar seng gdong mtshan par bya: dmag thabs yin na gtor ma ni: yab yum mtho la 'khor lha grangs: khrag chu dug rdzas dag gis bkang : rtse mor dar nag gri snying brgyan: phyag rtsang phyi rtsang dug thun rnams: shan pa'i 'gros btsugs bha sus bcing : 'og tu lcags sgyed zhing lpags gzhi: dgra ling bla gzugs yul rten bzhag: de phyir 'debs pa'i mtshon cha ni: las rim gzhung bzhin legs par bkod: spyan gzigs mchod rdzas gzhung ltar du: dpa' bo dgyes pa'i rten du bsham: bdag mdun bstod bya rdzogs rjes su: bsgral ba'i sha khrag bha ling ni: bcu gsum gzugs su bsgral zhing mchod: smad las bzhengs bskul dmag 'gyed ni: drag po bdud 'dul 'khros pa'i ngang : bskyed rdzogs zung ldan spos gsur btang : rol mo rkang gling drag tu gtser: dgra ling bsang sbyang grub rjes su: skye med dbyings nas 'di ltar bskul:

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen bdud 'dul khro rgyal gyi: mdun du dur khrod sa gzhi e yi klong : shin tu rab 'jigs thod mkhar dmar nag dbus: dpal 'bar drag po seng gdong lha tshogs gsal: de 'og gnam lcags 'khor lo so 'thab 'khor: dgra bo byad ma'i sha khrag bla tshe gtub: de 'og las gshin 'chi bdag lte ba'i dbus: bsad khang dmar nag dug lnga'i tsha zer g.yo: nad mtshon dug char srog gcod pho nya 'tshubs: bshas ra bsad khang dmar nag de yi mthil: pha rol byad ma'i bla gzugs srung skyob mkhar: skad cig yud tsam mngon sum lta bur gsal: phaṭḥ de nas bden stobs lan gsum brjod pho nya 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: las la bskul zhing drag tu rbad pa'i lha: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i bka' nyan pa: srog gcod sha khrag don la rngam pa yi: dregs pa'i dmag dpon sde brgyad gnas 'dir bskul: chos shig myur rbad las mkhan mthu ma chung : sangs rgyas bstan bshig pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul: snga dgra phyi dgra da dgra sgos kyi dgra: byad ma'i yul zhing mkhar rdzong skyob pa'i lha: pha tshan sde tshan gnyen 'brel mthun pa'i grogs: rgyab rten ban bon srung ba'i gur khang rnams: steng 'og phyogs bcu ri rab bgrod 'gyu'i srang : gang du gnas kyang skad cig myur ba nyid: pho nya las kyi myur mgyogs glog gi zhag: dmar 'od gdong bzhin bsdams pa'i drag rtsal gyis: dbang med yud tsam rang dbang med par khug: thar med btson dong gzugs ling 'di la phob: om̐ ma hā ro ga a ya ma dgra bo byad ma nṛ tri a karṣa ya dzaḥ de nas bsgral phur thogs nas: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las rab sprul bsgral ba'i mtshon: btab bo bzlog med pho nya 'dus pa'i rdzas: phur rtse srung lha spyi bor lan gsum bskor: phur sked bzlog bskul rngam zhing lan gsum bskor: phur mjug mtshon cha 'og tu lan gsum bskor: pho rgyud zil gnon g.yas su lan gsum bskor:

mo rgyud dbang sdud g.yon du lan gsum bskor: byad ma'i srog phral mdun du lan gsum bsgril: srog bdag bam gnyis phur pa'i dbal nas 'phros: ru tra'i snying gar srog gi dwangs ma rngub: bam ro gnas 'gyur lcags sdig dpag med gyur: dbang por khyab cing sha khrag phye mar dkrugs: byad ma'i rnam shes chos nyid mkha' la bsdu: tshe bsod 'ub bsdus sngags 'chang gzi byin 'bar: sprul pa'i pho nya phur pa'i dbal dang 'gros: drag tu bsnun pas byad ma thal bar rlog: om̐ baṃ ma hā kī la ya ru tra traka raksha rbad rbad srog la yaṃ yaṃ tsitta baṃ ril nan: de nas phaṭḥdrag pos spar te mkha' spyod zhing du drangs: lhag ma sha khrag mtshon cha re res bsgral nas 'bul ba ni: bskul dang sbrags te: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rab 'jigs dur khrod sha za srin po'i yul: gnas chen nyer gcig sprul pa'i pho brang nas: drag rtsal kun dga' gzhon nu skur bzhengs shig: rngam pa tshang tshing ti se'i gnas mchog nas: mgon po siṃ ha khrag 'thung skur bzhengs shig: chu bar gnas sogs tsā ri mkha' spyod nas: lha btsan nag po srog bdag skur bzhengs shig: gze rgyal gnas dang rong btsan gangs ri'i gnas: dgra lha gha ya dha ra skur bzhengs shig: dpal ri padma sbas yul gnas mchog nas: bstan pa'i las mdzad seng gdong yab yum bzhengs: phyogs mtshams las bzhi'i tha tshig gnas mchog nas: drag chen srog len shan pa'i dmag tshogs bzhengs: rbad bskul thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: sha khrag 'di bzhes gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas dpal chen zhing skyong lha tshogs rnams dmag dpung du bskyed nas dgra bo'i g.yul ngo bzlogs par bsam: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mi mngon mkha' spyod dag pa dbyings kyi zhing : dug lnga bsgral mdzad khrag 'thung pho brang nas: 'khor lo sdom pa khyab bdag he ru kaḥ rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus lha tshogs rnams:

thugs rje thogs med nus rtsal dpa' ba'i stobs: gzi byin pho brang drag po dbyings nas bskul: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: dmag dpung skyed cig dgra yul cham la phob: rig 'dzin sgrub pa po la rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus: dur khrod rab 'bar tsā ri'i pho brang nas: snang srid gdug pa'i g.yul 'joms dpa' bo che: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra seng gdong rngam: dpal mgon zhing skyong rgyal po dmag la bskul: mthu stobs dpa' ba'i rtsal shugs myur du skyed: pho rgyud chos skyong dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: seṅge'i nga ro hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: pho nya dgra bo'i srog len sha ra ra: dar nag ru mtshon g.yab mo lings se ling : gnam lcags ur mo'i go cha si li li: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri lhabs se lhab: dar dmar phod ga mun rub lhubs se lhub: zor mda' nag po'i dbal kha sha ra ra: cang shes nag pos 'dur lding chems se chem: yang sprul lha btsan bye ba grangs med 'gyed: pha rol byad ma dmigs pa'i dgra bo 'di: myur du choms la rnam shes rten dang phrol: pho rgyud mgon po chos skyong dus la bab: sha khrag dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad ma gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'di: bskal pa'i drag spyod 'khrugs ltar cham la phob: log 'dren byad ma'i dmag tshogs bdud rigs 'di: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi myur du gtor: go cha bshus la mtshon cha dum bur thongs: mi rta phyes la nang tshan phye mar dkrugs: mgyogs pa'i rgyud chings dpung pa myur du chogs: dregs pa srog la dbang zhing sha khrag rol: bzlog go pha rol byad ma'i g.yul ngo zlog: ltas ngan brgyad cu'i cho 'phrul dgra la phob: mi rung sna dgu yams nad dgra la phob: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo mthu ma chung : rig 'dzin sngon gyi tha tshig dam ma g.yel: drag rtsal dus la bab bo sa ma ya:

nyes can dgra bo'i dmag tshogs cham la phob: dmag bskul mdos zor drag po'i sna drongs shig: om̐ ma hā ka la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥm hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: yum gyi bzlog pa bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ sha khrag rgya mtsho dmar nag 'khrigs pa yi: rab 'jigs sha za mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas: srog len bdud mo seng gdong las la bskul: myur mgyogs sha za'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: mo rgyud ma mo'i dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: seṅge'i nga ro 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: las mkhan drag po'i bla 'gugs zhungs se zhung : 'dre mo'i dmag tshogs g.yab mo lings se ling : tri shul rno mtshon me 'bar lhabs se lhab: thod zor gtor ma'i zor mda' lams se lam: 'od ldan zangs kyi go khrab zengs se zeng : phod dmar lhab lhub khrag mdangs ta la la: btsan rta dmar pos 'dur lding khyugs se khyug: yang sprul sha za bye ba sa ya 'gyed: srog gcod dbugs sdud bka' yi bya ra 'bum: dgra bo'i mi nor yul zhing thal bar rlog: pha rol byad ma gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'di: da lta nyid du skad cig cham la phob: dgra bo bdun rgyud rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod: snga dgra phyi dgra da dgra rdul du rlog: ma rgyud ma mo mkha' 'gro'i dus la bab: sha khrag dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad ma gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'di: bskal pa'i drag spyod 'khrugs ltar cham la phob: log 'dren byad ma'i dmag tshogs bdud rigs 'di: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi myur du gtor: go cha bshos la mtshon cha dum bur thongs: mi rta phyes la nang tshan phye mar dkrugs: mgyogs pa'i rgyud chings dpung pa myur du chogs: dregs pa srog la dbang zhing sha khrag rol:

bzlog go pha rol byad ma'i g.yul ngo zlog: ltas ngan brgyad cu'i cho 'phrul dgra la phob: mi rung sna dgu yams nad dgra la phob: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo mthu ma chung : rig 'dzin sngon gyi tha tshig dam ma g.yel: drag rtsal dus la bab bo sa ma ya: nyes can dgra bo'i dmag tshogs cham la phob: dmag bskul mdos zor drag po'i sna drongs shig: om̐ ma hā ka la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥm hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: dug rlangs ser nag 'khrugs pa'i dbus nyid du: las kyi srog bdag yab yum bam ro'i gzugs: nad kyi rlangs 'phro dri ngan phyogs bcur khyab: gcer bu mi lus sder mo rab tu bgrad: 'chi bdag sprul pa'i ro langs dmag tshogs bskul: bam chen sde drug gad mo lhangs se lhang : zhal nas nad yams kha phru chi li li: bhyo bzlog sgra sgrogs lag rdeb khrigs se khrig: rkang pas dmar nag gtor zor sha ra ra: sku la na bun skyi bun thu lu lu: yang sprul sdom sdig pho nya tshubs se tshub: byad ma 'dre rgod dmag tshogs cham la phob: dam sri pho mo'i bla srog snying khrag drongs: gson 'dre shi 'dre yul 'dre rdul du rlog: mi kha phung thal stong ba'i snying khrag rol: sprul pa'i bam chen dmag tshogs dus la bab: sha khrag dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad ma gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'di: bskal pa'i drag spyod 'khrugs ltar cham la phob: log 'dren byad ma'i dmag tshogs bdud rigs 'di: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi myur du gtor: go cha bshos la mtshon cha dum bur thongs: mi rta phyes la nang tshan phye mar dkrugs: mgyogs pa'i rgyud chings dpung pa myur du chogs: dregs pa srog la dbang zhing sha khrag rol:

bzlog go pha rol byad ma'i g.yul ngo zlog: ltas ngan brgyad cu'i cho 'phrul dgra la phob: mi rung sna dgu yams nad dgra la phob: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo mthu ma chung : rig 'dzin sngon gyi tha tshig dam ma g.yel: drag rtsal dus la bab bo sa ma ya: nyes can dgra bo'i dmag tshogs cham la phob: dmag bskul mdos zor drag po'i sna drongs shig: om̐ ma hā ka la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas dregs pa'i dmag 'dren pa: srog bdag rma gnyan spom ra dmag la bzhengs: shar phyogs dmag gi dpung bskyed ru mtshon phyor: dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du dmag 'dren no: dkar po lha dmag mtshon thogs bye ba 'bum: khrab rmog ru mtshon ba dan lhabs se lhab: thog mda' mtshon gyi dbal zor sha ra ra: dgra srog hur thum gcod pa'i dus la bab: dgra khrag rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bo shar phyogs dmag gi dpung tshogs choms: snga dgra phyi dgra bstan pa'i ru tra rnams: srog gcod dbugs longs tshe yi 'du byed shigs: dgra bo skyob byed yul mkhar rten dang phrol: bzlog go dgra bo dmag dpon dmag mi zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la sgyur: lo zla zhag za'i skag rkyen dgra la thongs: mi kha ltas ngan phung byed dgra la sgyur: sngon gyi tha tshig dus bab phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: shar lho'i nad bdag ma mo'i dmag 'dren pa:

sngags bdag las kyi ma mo dmag la bzhengs: shar lho dmag gi dpung bskyed ru mtshon phyor: dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du dmag 'dren no: dmar nag ma mo mtshon thogs bye ba 'bum: khrab rmog ru mtshon ba dan lhabs se lhab: thog mda' mtshon gyi dbal zor sha ra ra: dgra srog hur thum gcod pa'i dus la bab: dgra khrag rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bo shar lho'i dmag gi dpung tshogs choms: snga dgra phyi dgra bstan pa'i ru tra rnams: srog gcod dbugs longs tshe yi 'du byed shigs: dgra bo skyob byed yul mkhar rten dang phrol: bzlog go dgra bo dmag dpon dmag mi zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la sgyur: lo zla zhag za'i skag rkyen dgra la thongs: mi kha ltas ngan phung byed dgra la sgyur: sngon gyi tha tshig dus bab phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: lho phyogs btsan rgod dregs pa'i dmag 'dren pa: zangs btsan sku rgyal she ne dmag la bzhengs: lho phyogs dmag gi dpung bskyed ru mtshon phyor: dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du dmag 'dren no: dmar po btsan dmag mtshon thogs bye ba 'bum: khrab rmog ru mtshon ba dan lhabs se lhab: thog mda' mtshon gyi dbal zor sha ra ra: dgra srog hur thum gcod pa'i dus la bab: dgra khrag rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bo lho phyogs dmag gi dpung tshogs choms: snga dgra phyi dgra bstan pa'i ru tra rnams: srog gcod dbugs longs tshe yi 'du byed shigs: dgra bo skyob byed yul mkhar rten dang phrol: bzlog go dgra bo dmag dpon dmag mi zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la sgyur: lo zla zhag za'i skag rkyen dgra la thongs:

mi kha ltas ngan phung byed dgra la sgyur: sngon gyi tha tshig dus bab phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: lho nub mgar ba dam can dmag 'dren pa: dam can shan pa'i 'khor tshogs dmag la bzhengs: lho nub dmag gi dpung bskyed ru mtshon phyor: dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du dmag 'dren no: smug nag dam can dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: khrab rmog ru mtshon ba dan lhabs se lhab: thog mda' mtshon gyi dbal zor sha ra ra: dgra srog hur thum gcod pa'i dus la bab: dgra khrag rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bo lho nub dmag gi dpung tshogs choms: snga dgra phyi dgra bstan pa'i ru tra rnams: srog gcod dbugs longs tshe yi 'du byed shigs: dgra bo skyob byed yul mkhar rten dang phrol: bzlog go dgra bo dmag dpon dmag mi zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la sgyur: lo zla zhag za'i skag rkyen dgra la thongs: mi kha ltas ngan phung byed dgra la sgyur: sngon gyi tha tshig dus bab phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nub phyogs gdug pa klu bdud dmag 'dren pa: dug gi spu gri 'khor tshogs dmag la bzhengs: nub phyogs dmag gi dpung bskyed ru mtshon phyor: dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du dmag 'dren no: sngo nag klu bdud dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: khrab rmog ru mtshon ba dan lhabs se lhab: thog mda' mtshon gyi dbal zor sha ra ra:

dgra srog hur thum gcod pa'i dus la bab: dgra khrag rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bo nub phyogs dmag gi dpung tshogs choms: snga dgra phyi dgra bstan pa'i ru tra rnams: srog gcod dbugs longs tshe yi 'du byed shigs: dgra bo skyob byed yul mkhar rten dang phrol: bzlog go dgra bo dmag dpon dmag mi zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la sgyur: lo zla zhag za'i skag rkyen dgra la thongs: mi kha ltas ngan phung byed dgra la sgyur: sngon gyi tha tshig dus bab phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nub byang 'gyu byed gza' bdud dmag 'dren pa: ki kang thog 'bebs 'khor tshogs dmag la bzhengs: nub byang dmag gi dpung bskyed ru mtshon phyor: dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du dmag 'dren no: kham nag gza' bdud dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: khrab rmog ru mtshon ba dan lhabs se lhab: thog mda' mtshon gyi dbal zor sha ra ra: dgra srog hur thum gcod pa'i dus la bab: dgra khrag rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bo nub byang dmag gi dpung tshogs choms: snga dgra phyi dgra bstan pa'i ru tra rnams: srog gcod dbugs longs tshe yi 'du byed shigs: dgra bo skyob byed yul mkhar rten dang phrol: bzlog go dgra bo dmag dpon dmag mi zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la sgyur: lo zla zhag za'i skag rkyen dgra la thongs: mi kha ltas ngan phung byed dgra la sgyur: sngon gyi tha tshig dus bab phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hring dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ

ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: byang phyogs dge bsnyen thang lha'i dmag 'dren pa: gnyan chen srid pa'i lha tshogs dmag la bzhengs: byang phyogs dmag gi dpung bskyed ru mtshon phyor: dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du dmag 'dren no: dkar gsal gnyan gyi dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: khrab rmog ru mtshon ba dan lhabs se lhab: thog mda' mtshon gyi dbal zor sha ra ra: dgra srog hur thum gcod pa'i dus la bab: dgra khrag rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bo byang phyogs dmag gi dpung tshogs choms: snga dgra phyi dgra bstan pa'i ru tra rnams: srog gcod dbugs longs tshe yi 'du byed shigs: dgra bo skyob byed yul mkhar rten dang phrol: bzlog go dgra bo dmag dpon dmag mi zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la sgyur: lo zla zhag za'i skag rkyen dgra la thongs: mi kha ltas ngan phung byed dgra la sgyur: sngon gyi tha tshig dus bab phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: byang shar dpe har rgyal chen dmag 'dren pa: snying 'byin khrag 'thung rgyal chen dmag la bzhengs: byang shar dmag gi dpung bskyed ru mtshon phyor: dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du dmag 'dren no: dmar smug rgyal po'i dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: khrab rmog ru mtshon ba dan lhabs se lhab: thog mda' mtshon gyi dbal zor sha ra ra: dgra srog hur thum gcod pa'i dus la bab: dgra khrag rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dgra bo byang shar dmag gi dpung tshogs choms: snga dgra phyi dgra bstan pa'i ru tra rnams: srog gcod dbugs longs tshe yi 'du byed shigs:

dgra bo skyob byed yul mkhar rten dang phrol: bzlog go dgra bo dmag dpon dmag mi zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la sgyur: lo zla zhag za'i skag rkyen dgra la thongs: mi kha ltas ngan phung byed dgra la sgyur: sngon gyi tha tshig dus bab phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ḍākki nī siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ tri tri a ya ma du ru tsa sha na kṣe ṭa pa la dharma pā la hūm̐ phaṭḥtri hriṃ dzaḥ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha rgyug rgyug breng breng bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

ces drag sngags zlog sngags bzlas shing dgra bo thal mo brdab chog gis non: e ma bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs dus dang sa rtags 'dul zhing bshad: phyi rabs rjes 'jug chos rgyal gdung brgyud la: dam sri phung sdeb sde dpon bdud kyis sdang : dam log ban bon 'chi tshad sdug 'drer skye: 'gong po dge bshes dmag gi sna thag 'dren: dam nyams ser gzugs rgyal khams yul gru dkrug: bdud blon ngan pas rgyal srid bstan pa bsnub: bod khams rgya hor kun dang ghirtis 'tshe: 'dzam gling tha ma mi min 'byung pos 'dzin: chos srid zla ba'i ri mo shul rjes 'byung : sdug bsngal las smin sems can 'khor bar 'khyams: zhes gsungs so: de'i tshe bai ros: kye ma kyi hud bod 'bangs a tsa ma: ma 'ongs yang mtha' rtsod ldan dus 'di ru: chos rgyal rjes 'jug smon lam ldan rnams la: ma 'ongs bdud las rgyal ba gdams pa'i gnad: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i thabs ka stsol: zhes zhus pas: slob dpon zhal nas: e maḥlas can skal ldan la: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ru: las mgon sgrub thabs las byang 'di: da lta bai ro khyod dang ni: ye shes grogs gsum dag la gdams: snying du chongs la gter du sbos: yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus: 'di 'don skyes bu blo gros ldan: rngam byed zhe sdang lo 'dzin pa: karma las 'brel gling zhes grags: ye shes khyod kyi skye ba ru: ma nges spyod ldan tshul can 'byung : las can gter sgo mang rab 'gyed: de dus zab chos 'di 'phrad shog: klu bdud drag po zla ba skyong : ma yengs bya ra lhang lhang gyis: dam nyams la sogs bdud kyi rigs: bka' yi chad pa drag po phob: chos bdag bu la sprod cig rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gu hya rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas drag po'i nyin par zhal bshus so/

/sarba maṅga laṃ// // na) ༈ bsad khang bcu gnyis rim bzhin rgyug byang bsgral ba hom bskyed ni/ hoḥ rang nyid dpal chen mdun du drag po'i snod: lcags khang nag po mun pa dgu rim can: de nang dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum gsal: phaṭḥ bla ma rgyal ba rigs 'dus zhi khro dang : bka' sdod chos skyong bcas pa'i bden stobs kyis: bstan dgra sgos dgra gnod byed gang yin pa: byad ma'i liṅga 'di la myur du khug: om̐ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ nṛ tri dgra bo shwa ra ma tri 'grim dzaḥ phur thun brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: las byed pho nya shan pa bam gnyis 'phros: me chu'i tshwa ngar 'khrigs pa'i dbal phur gsal: 'dril zhing nam mkha'i mthongs nas gdab pa yis: byad ma'i 'du phung shig cig mā ra ya: om̐ badzra tri tri baṃ tri margi ṭa yi baṃ bhyo badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral nas gtub cing bzlog pa'i nang rim bzhin so sor 'bul bar bya'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// // pa) ༈ dpal ldan zhing skyong rngam klong las: gser skyems gling bzhi sgo 'byed bzhugs so: khyab bdag khrag 'thung nag po las: gser skyems bya ba'i rim pa ni: thog mar rnga gshang rol mo g.yab dar sogs legs par bsgrengs nas dngos gzhi la: hūm̐ bhyoḥ phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i phyogs bcu nas: bzhengs bskul mkhyen gsol gzigs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: deng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: bstan pa'i ru tra bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha srung gnyan po rnams: thugs dam gnyan po dus las mi 'da' phyir: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: gzi byin nus pa'i rtsal dang zor dpung bskyed: hūm̐: las byed chen po dregs sde yang 'khor dpung : mi bsrun dgra bgegs gshed du 'bebs pa'i tshogs: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la:

myur mgyogs mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la phob: hūm̐: shar phyogs rgyal chen yul 'khor srung gi tshogs: dri za grul bum gnod sbyin dpung dang bcas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: lus 'phags gling gi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: hūm̐: lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po yi tshogs: gshin rje me lha za byed dpung dang bcas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: 'dzam bu gling gi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: hūm̐: nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang gi tshogs: srin po klu dang 'phrog byed dpung dang bcas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ba glang spyod kyi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: hūm̐: byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi tshogs: rlung lha dbang ldan bgegs kyi dpung dang bcas: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: sgra mi snyan gyi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: hūm̐: lo zla dus dang tshes grangs chu tshod kyi: srid par 'gyu ba'i gdong gnas ma lus kun: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: zor lam phyes dang phyogs su da bzur cig: om̐ lo ka pā la ya pañtsa a mṛ ta swā hā: zhes pas gser skyems gling bzhir mchod nas: snang srid sde brgyad kyi zor lam dbye bar bsam: mdos kyi sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: pho brang phyogs bzhi la gnas pa'i: bstan pa'i las mdzad chos skyong rnams: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: thod mkhar gling bzhi'i sgo phyes nas: dregs pa sde brgyad dmag la chos: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor: las byed yin no rtsal ma zhan: mngon rtags yin no mthu ma chung : mngon spyod yin no bang ma bul: dgra lha yin no rgyang ma ring : dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: las bzhi mthu dpung bskyed du gsol: om̐ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha si na ra ma du tri phu tri sarba sa ma ya sde brgyad dregs sde yang 'khor bcas kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi:

zhes pas mdos sman raka gis bran nas gtor ma stegs su dpag: phrin las kyi bskul tshar gcig btang : mngon spyod ci bcol don la sbyar: sa ma ya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas phab pa'o/ dge'o// // pha) ༈ tshe 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi: mgyogs ma sgo skyong mda' dar bum pa 'dzin: snang srid tshe bsod bcud bsdus bdag la thim: om̐ badzra gu ru ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ zhes dbang dang tshe sgrub bya: ༈ gtang rag mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: dbang po lnga dang sha chen lnga: rdzas chen lnga dang sman gtor lnga: rakta la sogs sbyor sgrol rdzas: mthun pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs 'di: mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badzra puṣpe? sogs shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings ngang las rab khros nag po che: 'jigs byed dpa' bo 'bar ba'i gar dgu ldan: mthu stobs dbang phyug legs ldan seṅge'i gdong : dpal 'bar chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: phyag 'tshal bstod pa ni: hūm̐: me ltar g.yo ba dregs chen sde: drag po bdud 'dul lha tshogs la: bka' gsang bstan pa rgyas pa'i phyir: gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod// // ba) ༈ dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po ma hā kā la yi: rten gzugs rgyun gsol khams gsum zil gnon bzhugs so: mgon po ma hā kā la khrag 'thung bstod: mnga' gsol gser skyems btang ba'i rim pa ni: dpal gtor che ba dkar dmar mdzes pas brgyan: chung ba dgus bskor yum dang sde brgyad do: sha khrag dag gis legs brgyan gser skyems bsham: rin chen 'bru sna lnga sogs rdzas kyi mchod: rkang gling rol mo sgrogs shing gsur chen btang :
