dar nag ru dar bsgrengs shing lha rten 'dzugs: de nas ngag snyan gdung dbyangs tshul ldan ngang : hūm̐ hūm̐ he ya hi hūm̐ la ye ni bhyo ya: hūm̐: 'og min phyogs bcu dag pa dpal ri'i zhing : sbas yul gangs gnas nyer gcig so bdun nas: dpal mgon zhing skyong seng gdong bka' sdod bcas: gdug pa 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren no: nyams pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral phyir gshegs su gsol: dur khrod pho brang drag po'i gnas mchog 'dir: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir brtan par bzhugs: dam rdzas mnga' gsol 'bul lo sngags bstan srungs: hūm̐: zhing skyong ma hā kā la dam la 'dus: dregs byed gha ya dha ra dam la 'dus: mthu stobs kun dga' gzhon nu dam la 'dus: bdud mgon 'jigs byed seng gdong dam la 'dus: lha btsan nag po myur mgyogs dam la 'dus: rong btsan chen po khrag 'thung dam la 'dus: gter srung chen po dpal 'bar dam la 'dus: dgra lha chen po mngon rgyug dam la 'dus: bhyoḥ yum mchog drag mo seng gdong dam la 'dus: sprul pa bam ro pho mo dam la 'dus: dregs pa sde brgyad yang 'khor dam la 'dus: sha za btsan rgod stong sde dam la 'dus: dam la 'dus so sngon gyi tha tshig dgongs: snga ma'i gtang rag btang ngo gzhungs ma ngan: phyi ma'i zhu rten 'bul lo rgyang ma ring : da lta'i gsol mchod 'bul lo dam ma g.yel: las bzhi'i phrin las bcol lo mthu ma chung : sde bzhi'i dgra la rbad do rtsal ma zhan: bstan pa'i bya ra bcol lo phrag ma dog: rten rdzas mchod pa 'bul lo mgu ma dka': bdag gi rgyun du 'bod do snyan ma sra: sngags 'chang bdag dang khyod kyi dam tshig ni: srog la bab kyang brtse ba'i don stsol cig: hūm̐: bdud rtsi rnam lnga dam rdzas dza gad chang : dgra bgegs dbang po'i me tog ri ltar spungs: sha khrag don snying rnam lnga rdza ltar nyil: spyan gzigs g.yab dar nag po sprin ltar g.yo: rkang gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir:

sha chen spos kyi gsur dud sprin ltar g.yo: sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs phyi nang gsang mchod ni: mgon po seng gdong chen po brten phyir 'bul: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir mnga' gsol lo: dregs byed gha ya dha ra brten phyir 'bul: dam chos bstan pa rgyas par mnga' gsol lo: mthu stobs kun dga' gzhon nu brten phyir 'bul: brgyud 'dzin sde dgon skyong bar mnga' gsol lo: lha btsan nag po myur mgyogs brten phyir 'bul: gsang sngags skyong ba'i sgron me mnga' gsol lo: rong btsan chen po khrag 'thung brten phyir 'bul: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral bar mnga' gsol lo: bstan srung chen po dpal 'bar brten phyir 'bul: zab chos bstan pa rgyas par mnga' gsol lo: dgra lha chen po mngon rgyug brten phyir 'bul: lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs par mnga' gsol lo: pho lha chen po rgyal mtshan brten phyir 'bul: khams gsum dbang du bsdus par mnga' gsol lo: bhyoḥ yum mchog drag mo seng gdong brten phyir 'bul: gsang sngags grogs kyi lha mor mnga' gsol lo: dbyangs can yid 'ong lha mo brten phyir 'bul: 'byor drug rgyas shing sdud par mnga' gsol lo: dpal 'bar dbyings kyi lha mo brten phyir 'bul: snang srid bran du khol bar mnga' gsol lo: padma ḍākki'i rnal 'byor brten phyir 'bul: rtsa rlung bde drod rig mar mnga' gsol lo: mdangs ldan dri za'i sras mo brten phyir 'bul: zab chos spel ba'i grogs mor mnga' gsol lo: sngags bdag ral gcig ma mo brten phyir 'bul: dam nyams srog gi shan par mnga' gsol lo: hūm̐ ya bhyoḥ thugs sprul bam ro pho mo brten phyir 'bul: pha rol lag snying bsgul bar mnga' gsol lo: shan pa lha srin sde brgyad brten phyir 'bul: log 'dren cham la 'beb par mnga' gsol lo: yang 'khor srog gcod pho nya brten phyir 'bul: dgra bo don snying len par mnga' gsol lo:

sprul pa'i bya gcan stong sde brten phyir 'bul: bstan pa'i ru tra 'joms par mnga' gsol lo: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs brten phyir 'bul: sgrub mchog bdag gi srung mar mnga' gsol lo: gsol lo mchod do sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs: dgyes par dgongs shig zhing skyong mgon po'i tshogs: rnal 'byor bdag cag mi nor dgon sde bcas: dpal ldan zhing skyong khyed la gnyer du gtad: nyin mtshan dus drug srung ba'i mel tshe mdzod: de nas rten gzugs pa ni: mchod pa gsol zhing rol mo bsgrag: hūm̐: rnga thug nag po khams gsum zil gnon 'di: pha rol g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: g.yab dar nag po pha rol rgol 'joms 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: ru mtshon nag po rlung gi 'khor lo 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: zer ldan 'od phreng ba dan rgyal mtshan 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: srid pa'i tsha zer ral gri 'od ldan 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: ma rungs snying 'byin kha ṭwāṃ dgra satwa 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: gnam lcags zor ldan mda' gzhu thog 'bebs 'di:

dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: srid gsum zil gnon rmog phor ldem 'phru 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sra brtan rdo rje'i go khrab brjid ldan 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: bdud bzhi klad 'joms phub mo ling chen 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: zer 'khyug khro bo'i mdung ring rtse rno 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: dgra bo'i lag 'ching g.yas shag 'od ldan 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: dgra bo'i lus 'ching dmar nag zhags pa 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: dgra bo yid 'chang zhing lpags rgyun bu 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: dgra bo'i dmag 'dren pho nya'i rbad sngags 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig:

stong gsum yud bskor rta nag shugs ldan 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: srin po dam sri'i zhing lpags sga stan 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: dur khrod pho brang thod tog mdzes pa 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: g.yag rog zhol ldan rwa sngon ngar 'byin 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: lcang shes rlung gshog rtsal ldan mdzes pa 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: lug nag rwa bzhi 'jam legs go gyon 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: dgra bo'i snying 'byin bya nag rngam 'jums 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: kha gdangs 'jigs sgrog khyi nag snying dkar 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sha za khrag 'thung stag gzig dom dred tshogs: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod:

mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: rtsal 'gyed khyung 'brug seng chen sgra sgrogs 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: gri rgod snying brgyan dmar chen gtor ma 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: dmar chen rlabs g.yo 'khyil zhing 'phyo ba 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: gsur chen dud pa sprin bzhin gtibs pa 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: rnga dung rkang gling sgra sgrogs 'bir ba 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: phyi nang spyan gzigs legs par bshams pa 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang spyan gzigs 'dir bzhugs mdzod: mgon po zhing skyong bdag dang ma 'bral cig: rten btsugs 'di la zhing skyong brtan par bzhugs: bla 'khor 'di la yul rten ri ltar tshugs: bla rdo 'di la srog rten mkha' ltar brtsegs: bla dar 'di la bstan srung mel tshe sgrubs: me long shwa rdil rtsis pra mngon mkhyen phob: phyi nang spyan gzigs 'di la byin chen phob: sngon gyi dam dgongs bstan pa'i bya ra mkhan: le lo btang snyoms med par dam ma g.yel: dam rdzas mnga' gsol gser skyems 'di bzhes la: de ring go cha ru mtshon rten btsugs bzhin: dus 'dir dgra la dmag 'dren mthu ma chung :

nyes can dam nyams dgra bo cham la phob: bstan dgra sgos dgra thad nas langs pa 'dir: bka' yi chad pa drag po myur du phob: sngon tshe gsang bdag gtum po'i bka' ma bcag: bar du rig 'dzin padma'i dam ma bkral: da lta rnal 'byor gsol mchod chud ma gzon: dam tshig sngon gyi smon lam ji bzhin du: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

ces gtor ma lha rten stegs kyi kha ru bzhag nas go mtshon rnams la zhing skyong spyan drangs nas bstim: dmag 'dren tshe go cha byin rlabs bya ste rab gnas bskyal: e ma yang gsang spu gri las: bsad pa ru dar nag po'i rgyud: ma 'ongs phyi ma bod 'bangs la: stod nas ghirti nag pos 'tshe: mdo sngags bstan la sdang ba'i tshe: dmag 'gyed 'dre rgod snying 'byin bzhag: las mtha' bzlog med gu hya rgya: yang gcig rtsod ldan dus mtha' la: chos rgyal gdung brgyud skyob pa yi: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i mel tshe shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bka' rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: spel rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos gnas mchog dam pa jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod dmar nag rakta'i mtsho chen 'jigs rung 'khyil ba nas dregs gza' 'gyu ba'i dus su gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ bkra shis par shog/ // ma) ༈ dpal mgon zhing skyong gi bca' 'don phyag len gyi zin bris bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs/ dpal ldan zhing skyong lha la gus pas 'dud/ de yang zhing skyong mgon po de nyid kyi bzlog mdos bca' ba 'don pa'i sgrigs rim ni/ dang po rtsa gsum gang rung sngon du song la bsnyen pa ci 'grub byas nas las byang gzhung du 'jug pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ ā yur?sarba shuddhe shuddhe bi shuddhe ye swā hā: zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bar brjod la mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rang nyid skad cig dpal chen gsal ba'i mdun: zhes nas/ phaiṃ phaiṃ a we sha ya a āḥ bar dang 'di'i mtshams su/ spos sha chen dang tshil chen gyi dud pa legs par btang la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ he ya hi/ zhes nas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol/ mchod pa sogs rim bzhin dkyus ltar bstod pa'i gong du bdud rtsi lag mchod byas nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: mchod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa

sogs nas kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi hūm̐: zhes pas bdud rtsi myong*/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: kṣeṃ kṣeṃ kṣe?pā la sogs nas yongs rdzogs srung ma bcas la bdag bstod do: 'di'i mtshams bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya/ thun gtor bya/ rten rdzas sogs la bdud rtsi 'thor/ bsang mchod bya la mnga' gsol byas kyang rung mchod pa kha gso/ hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: sogs/ ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ brgyan pa'i mchod gtor? sogs nas/ gsol lo mchod do phrin las mdzod bar brjod/ 'di'i mtshams bdag mdun bya na ru dar dmag bzlog las byang 'don pa ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las bdag sogs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: bar 'don bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya/ tshogs bya ba ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: byin rlabs spyan 'dren mchod pa 'bul skong ba tha ma bsgral gtub bstab pa sogs bya/ 'di skabs gzhung gi skong ba ni/ hūm̐ dhā tu tsaṇḍa hi ga ga sogs/ hūm̐: chos dbyings drag po e yi klong sogs nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas sogs gsum 'don la/ bshags pa ni/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo dam can tshogs sogs zhes pas bshags pa bya/ yi ge brgya par 'bung*/ thun gtor bshams la/ na mo mchog gsum rtsa ba sogs nas bskul ba'i tshig la snyan gsan 'tshal bar 'don/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i sogs nas bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog bar 'don la mdos nang du 'bul/ hūm̐: legs ldan nag po seṅge'i gdong : zhes pas phrin las bcol/ hūm̐: zhing skyong chen po dgra la bhyoḥ zlog sngags bcas gtor ma 'bul/ ru dar nag po'i zor bzlog ni/ gtor chung liṅga sha dum lha grangs sbyar ba bshams la sman raka gis mdos bran la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen bdud 'dul khro rgyal sogs lta bur gsal: phaṭḥ bden stobs lan gsum brjod la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:

dur khrod rab 'bar srin po sha za'i yul sogs kyi mtshams su ling ro dum bu re dang gtor chung ngam khrag kyu bcas mdos nang du 'bul/ 'di'i mtshams rtsang bzlog yar 'dzud pa rang lugs spyi'i 'gros dang lhag par dmag thabs yin pas dmag bzlog 'dir 'bad pas bzlog pa'i gong du rtsang 'dzud dgos mchan/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mi mngon mkha' spyod dag pa dbyings kyi zhing sogs bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog bar 'gre lags so/ 'di'i mtshams rtsang bzlog bya ba ni/ hūm̐: drag po dpal chen bdud 'dul seng gdong sogs nas mā ra ya rbad: 'di'i mtshams dmar gtor gcig theb tu bshams la/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: sogs/ a mu ka sha truṃ myog myog zor bhyo thun bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog bar 'don gtor ma 'bul la thal mo brdab dmigs pa drag po bya/ de nas lhag ma 'bul/ kā la seng gdong gi gtor 'bul bya/ chad mdo 'bul/ brtan ma skyong*/ rta bro bya/ bkra shis bsngo smon rgyas 'debs pa ni/ rgyun gyi byed las so/ /༈ 'don 'grigs bsdus pa'i lugs la zhing skyong las byang 'don/ bstod pa'i mtshams su sman mchod bya la sngags la bskyal/ bsnyen pa bya tshogs skong ba'i mjug tu skong ba rgyas bsdus bsags/ bshags pa 'then/ ru dar bzlog gzhung btang zor 'phen pa sogs ni gzhung ltar srung bzlog bsad gsum bgyi ba gnad do/ /rgyas pa las byang gsol kha mnga' gsol skong ba gtor 'bul bya/ ༈ 'bring po ni las byang skong ba gsol kha tsam bsags/ bsdu ba ni thun gtor la tshang ba'o/ ༈ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la skyabs su mchi'o/ zhing skyong mgon po'i sgrub gtor rgyas pa'i lugs ni/ ri rab bang rim sum brtsegs la ma tram gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng thod mkhar rtsibs bcu drug kha bad thod pas mtshan pa/ de steng 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad thod pas mtshan pa/ de steng rtsibs bzhi pa/ de steng 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la bshos bu brgyad la liṅgas mtshan pa/

de'i steng chos 'byung bsnol ma'i mdun zur gtad pa'i dbus su/ dpal bshos seng zhal can la mdun du yum gyi gtor ma sum cha'i tshul du bslebs pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis bam ro pho mo bshos zur gnyis/ gtso bo me ri dang chos skyong sku gzugs gtor gdugs sogs kyis legs par bag gro lhun chags su bgyis pa'o/ /'bring po ni/ bang rim sum brtsegs/ de'i steng rtsibs bcu gnyis/ de'i steng rtsibs brgyad/ de'i steng rtsibs bzhi/ de'i steng rtsibs brgyad/ de'i steng dpal bshos/ ༈ bsdus pa ni gzhi gnam lcags rtsibs brgyad/ de'i steng thod mkhar zur brgyad thod pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng rtsibs bzhi/ de'i steng 'khor lo gong ltar ro/ /yang bsdus pa ni/ thod mkhar med cing*/ dpal gtor gcig la 'khor bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba mtheb skyu sha dum sogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /༈ gtor zlog gi bca' lugs ni/ gzhi lcags slang nang du ma tram gyi gzugs bya ste/ de'i steng 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de'i steng chos 'byung bsnol ma bya la dpal bshos che zhing legs pa'i 'og tu liṅga bzhag pa'i phyag srol yod/ mdun du yum gtor g.yas g.yon du bshos bu gnyis/ de'i mthar brgyad/ rtse la me ri dang dar gdugs sogs bya/ khrag kyu sgang thun sogs kyis brgyan/ dbu rtsang phyag rtsang*/ mtha' rtsang sum cu tham pa shan pa'i 'gros su btsugs/ ba su ta dang sngo dmar zhags pas dkris/ mdun du dug khrag /dmar chen mchod sprin gyis bskor bar bya/ ༈ bskang gtor ni ri rab bang rim lnga pa chos 'byung bsnol ma/ de'i steng dpal bshos rtse legs zur gsum thod skam gyis mtshan pa bshos bu bcu gcig gis bskor ba bang rim rnams la bsags/ bya nag bcu gsum/ mi nag bcu gsum/ khyi nag bcu gsum/ rta nag bcu gsum/ g.yag nag bcu gsum/ lug nag bcu gsum/ dom nag bcu gsum/ dred nag bcu gsum/ sbrul nag bcu gsum/

bshos bu nag po bcu gsum gyis bskor/ de 'og dbang po rnam lnga/ de 'og mchod pa sna bdun zur bzhir zhing lpags kyi rgyal mtshan bzhi dar nag po me long mtshon cha mda' dar sogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de sogs rgyas pa'i lugs su 'dod/ bsdus pa bya bar 'dod pa'i ci 'byor legs so/ /gtor 'bul ni/ las byang ji bzhin bzlog pa'i yig chung du gzigs/ 'don bya la gser skyems mchod la/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i sogs kyis phyi nas mchod/ rang rang gi sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: pho brang phyogs bzhi la gnas sogs nas/ khā hi sogs kyis dbye/ de nas bskul ba spyi bskul ni/ hūm̐: pho brang chen po dpal gyi tsā ri nas? sogs nas/ bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog sogs nas chad mdo'i tha tshig bsgrag par bya/ zhes pas mdos dpags la 'bul sar phyin tshe dkar gtor gser skyems sogs la/ hūm̐: mkha' spyod dag pa rab 'byams sogs gdug pa'i dmag tshogs sgrol bar mdzod ces pas dkar gtor gser skyems 'bul/ liṅga hom bskyed bya 'gugs gzhug sogs tshogs tha ma'i bya ba'am gang rigs kyis lan gsum bsngo la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra mngon sum bsams la zor rnams rim par dug zor lag tu thogs nas/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo dpal ldan sogs kyis 'phen/ hūm̐: 'og min bkod pa sogs kyis bzlog pa me hom du bya la dar nag g.yab/ brtan ma skyong*/ rta bro bya/ nang du log /tshe 'gugs bya/ srung 'khor bsgom/ bkra shis bsngo smon mi dmigs khyab gdal ye grol dgongs pa la gnas pa gnad dam pa lags so// //
